heroes.actions.advance.rules.en:
Advance

When a creature takes the Advance move action, they move a number of squares up to their speed. They can break up this movement with their maneuver and main action however they wish.
heroes.actions.advance.rules.zh:
行進

若你執行行進移動動作，你可以移動最多等於速度的格數。你可以隨意將這段移動拆分到其他機動動作和主要動作之間。

heroes.actions.aid-attack.rules.en:
Aid Attack

A creature who uses the Aid Attack maneuver chooses an enemy adjacent to them. The next ability roll an ally makes against that enemy before the start of the aiding creature’s next turn gains an edge.
heroes.actions.aid-attack.rules.zh:
助攻

若你使用助攻機動動作，選擇 1 個與你相鄰的敵人。直到你下個回合開始前，盟友對該敵人進行的下次招式檢定會獲得 1 個優勢。

heroes.actions.catch-breath.rules.en:
Catch Breath

A creature who uses the Catch Breath maneuver spends a Recovery and regains Stamina equal to their recovery value. (See below for Stamina. See Recoveries in Chapter 1: The Basics.)

A creature who is dying (see Dying and Death in Stamina below) can’t use the Catch Breath maneuver, but other creatures can help them spend Recoveries in other ways.

fs.en:
A creature who uses the Catch Breath maneuver spends a Recovery and regains Stamina equal to their recovery value.

A creature who is dying can’t use the Catch Breath maneuver, but other creatures can help them spend Recoveries in other ways.
fs.zh:
若你使用喘息機動動作，你會花費 1 點復元力，並恢復等於復元值的體力。

瀕死的生物無法使用喘息機動動作，但其他生物可以用其他方式協助他們花費復元力。

heroes.actions.catch-breath.rules.zh:
喘息

若你使用喘息機動動作，你會花費 1 點復元力，並恢復等於復元值的體力。（體力詳見下文；復元力詳見第 1 章〈基礎〉。）

瀕死的生物（詳見下文「體力」中的「Dying and Death」）無法使用喘息機動動作，但其他生物可以用其他方式協助他們花費復元力。

heroes.actions.charge.rules.en:
Charge

When a creature takes the Charge main action, they move up to their speed in a straight line without jumping, then make a melee free strike (see Free Strikes below) against a target when they end their move. If the creature has an ability with the Charge keyword, they can use that ability against the target instead of a free strike.

A creature can’t move through difficult terrain or shift when they charge. They can fly or burrow as part of the Charge main action if they have that movement available to them, but they can’t climb or swim while charging unless they can automatically use that movement at full speed.

fs.en:
When a creature takes the Charge main action, they move up to their speed in a straight line, then make a melee free strike against a target when they end their move. If the creature has an ability with the Charge keyword, they can use that ability against the target instead of a free strike.

A creature can’t move through difficult terrain or shift when they charge. They can fly or burrow as part of the Charge main action if they have that movement available to them, but they can’t climb or swim while charging unless they can automatically use that movement at full speed.
fs.zh:
當你執行衝鋒主要動作時，你會以直線方式移動最多等於自身速度的距離，然後在移動結束時對 1 個目標發動 1 次近戰基礎打擊。若你擁有帶有「衝鋒」關鍵詞的招式，你也可以發動該招式來取代基礎打擊。

你在衝鋒期間無法穿越困難地形或進行遁移。若你擁有相應的移動能力，你可以在衝鋒期間飛行或掘地，但在衝鋒期間無法攀爬或游泳，除非你能夠自動以全速進行這類移動。

heroes.actions.charge.rules.zh:
衝鋒

當你執行衝鋒主要動作時，你會以直線方式移動最多等於自身速度的距離（期間不能跳躍），然後在移動結束時對 1 個目標發動 1 次近戰基礎打擊（詳見下文「基礎打擊」）。若你擁有帶有「衝鋒」關鍵詞的招式，你也可以發動該招式來取代基礎打擊。

你在衝鋒期間無法穿越困難地形或進行遁移。若你擁有相應的移動能力，你可以在衝鋒期間飛行或掘地，但在衝鋒期間無法攀爬或游泳，除非你能夠自動以全速進行這類移動。

heroes.actions.defend.rules.en:
Defend

When a creature takes the Defend main action, ability rolls made against them have a double bane until the start of their next turn. Additionally, you have a double edge on tests when called for to resist environmental effects or a creature’s traits or abilities. A creature gains no benefit from this action while another creature is taunted by them (see Conditions in Chapter 5: Classes).

fs.en: When a creature takes the Defend main action, ability rolls made against them have a double bane until the start of their next turn. Additionally, you have a double edge on tests when called for to resist environmental effects or a creature’s traits or abilities. A creature gains no benefit from this action while another creature is taunted by them.
fs.zh: 若你執行防禦主要動作，針對你進行的所有招式檢定都會承受雙劣勢，直到你下個回合開始。此外，若你被要求進行考驗來抵抗環境效果、生物的特性或招式，你的考驗會獲得雙優勢。若有其他生物正被你嘲諷，你無法從此動作中獲得任何好處。

heroes.actions.defend.rules.zh:
防禦

若你執行防禦主要動作，針對你進行的所有招式檢定都會承受雙劣勢，直到你下個回合開始。此外，若你被要求進行考驗來抵抗環境效果、生物的特性或招式，你的考驗會獲得雙優勢。若有其他生物正被你嘲諷，你無法從此動作中獲得任何好處（詳見第 5 章〈職業〉的「狀態」）。

heroes.actions.disengage.rules.en:
Disengage

When a creature takes the Disengage move action, they can shift 1 square. Certain class features, kits, and other rules allow a creature to shift more than 1 square when they disengage. A creature who does so can break up their shift with their maneuver and main action however they wish.
heroes.actions.disengage.rules.zh:
撤離

若你執行撤離移動動作，你可以遁移 1 格。某些職業特性、套裝和其他機制會允許你在撤離時遁移超過 1 格。若是如此，你可以隨意將這段遁移拆分到其他機動動作和主要動作之間。

heroes.actions.escape-grab.rules.en:
Escape Grab

A creature who is grabbed by another creature, an object, or an effect (see Grab below) can attempt to escape by using the following ability.

Escape Grab
Maneuver
Self | Self
Power Roll + Might or Agility:
≤11 No effect.
12–16 You can escape the grab, but if you do, a creature who has you grabbed can make a melee free strike against you before you are no longer grabbed.
17+ You are no longer grabbed.
Effect: You take a bane on this maneuver if your size is smaller than the size of the creature, object, or effect that has you grabbed.

See Conditions in Chapter 5: Classes for information on the grabbed condition.

fs.en: You take a bane on this maneuver if your size is smaller than the size of the creature, object, or effect that has you grabbed.
fs.zh: 若擒抱你的生物、物體或效果的體型 > 你的體型，你進行此招式會承受 1 個劣勢。

heroes.actions.escape-grab.rules.zh:
掙脫

被其他生物、物體或效果擒制的生物（詳見下文「擒抱」），可以使用以下招式來嘗試掙脫。

掙脫
機動動作
自身｜自身
檢定 + 力量或敏捷：
T1：你無法掙脫。
T2：你可以掙脫，但若這麼做，擒抱你的生物可以在你掙脫前對你發動 1 次近戰基礎打擊。
T3：你順利掙脫，不再被擒制。
效果：若擒抱你的生物、物體或效果的體型 > 你的體型，你進行此招式會承受 1 個劣勢。

擒制狀態的相關資訊詳見第 5 章〈職業〉的「狀態」。

heroes.actions.free-maneuvers.rules.en:
Free Maneuvers

Boring stuff like opening an unlocked door, picking up an arrow from the ground, giving an object to an adjacent ally, or drawing a weapon doesn’t require a maneuver or a main action. Rather, you can undertake such straightforward activities as free maneuvers on your turn. A free maneuver follows the same rules as a regular maneuver, but you can typically take as many free maneuvers as you like.

At the Director’s discretion, circumstances could make something that is typically boring more impactful and exciting. For instance, if you need to pick a magic arrow up off the ground during a violent earthquake, what would otherwise be a free maneuver could require a maneuver or a main action to accomplish.

Likewise, the nature of an activity might make it too complicated for a free maneuver. For example, picking up the body of an unconscious talent ally to carry them to safety can probably be done as a free maneuver. But if your Might is lacking and you need to pick up a tactician ally decked out in the Shining Armor kit, the Director might determine that you need to use a regular maneuver to hoist their armored form over your shoulders.

Any effect that prevents you from using maneuvers also prevents you from using free maneuvers.
heroes.actions.free-maneuvers.rules.zh:
免費機動動作

例如開啟未上鎖的門、從地上撿起箭矢、將物體交給相鄰的盟友，或是拔出武器等瑣碎行為，都不需要使用機動動作或主要動作。你可以在自己的回合中執行這些簡單的免費機動動作。免費機動動作雖然遵循一般機動動作的規則，但通常不限次數。

根據導演的判斷，某些情況可能會讓原本簡單的行為變得更有挑戰性和戲劇性。例如，若你試圖在劇烈地震時撿起地上的魔法箭矢，這個原本可以用免費機動動作完成的動作，可能就需要使用 1 個機動動作或主要動作才能完成。

同樣地，某些行為會因為太過複雜而無法以免費機動動作完成。例如，抱起失去意識的異能者盟友並帶到安全處，大概可以用免費機動動作完成。但如果你的力量不足，而你需要抱起 1 名穿著【Shining Armor】套裝的戰術家盟友，導演可能會判定你需要使用一般機動動作，才能把穿著護甲的他扛到肩上。

任何會禁止你使用機動動作的效果，同樣也會禁止你使用免費機動動作。

heroes.actions.free-strike.rules.en:
Free Strike

A creature can use this main action to make a free strike (see Free Strikes below). Most of the time, you’ll want to use the more impactful main actions granted by your class, kit, or other feature, just as the Director will use the main actions in a creature’s stat block, but free strikes are available for when all else fails. For instance, a fury who has no other options for ranged strikes might use the Ranged Weapon Free Strike ability with an improvised weapon when battling a flying foe.

fs.en: A creature can use this main action to make a free strike.
fs.zh: 你可以使用此主要動作來發動 1 次基礎打擊。

heroes.actions.free-strike.rules.zh:
基礎打擊

你可以使用此主要動作來發動 1 次基礎打擊（詳見下文「基礎打擊」）。大多數時候，最好的選擇是使用由職業、套裝或其他特性賦予、效果更強的主要動作，就像導演通常會使用生物數據欄中的主要動作一樣。不過，當其他手段都派不上用場時，基礎打擊永遠可用。例如，熾怒者若沒有其他遠程打擊選項，在對抗飛行敵人時，可能會使用臨時武器發動【遠程武器基礎打擊】招式。

heroes.actions.grab.rules.en:
Grab

A creature seeking to keep a foe close and locked down can attempt to grab a creature using the following ability.

Grab
Melee, Weapon Maneuver
Melee 1 | One creature
Power Roll + Might:
≤11 No effect.
12–16 You can grab the target, but if you do, the target can make a melee free strike against you before they are grabbed.
17+ The target is grabbed by you.
Effect: You can usually target only creatures of your size or smaller. If your Might score is 2 or higher, you can target any creature with a size equal to or less than your Might score.

Unless otherwise indicated, a creature can grab only one creature at a time.

See Conditions in Chapter 5: Classes for information on the grabbed condition.

fs.en: You can usually target only creatures of your size or smaller. If your Might score is 2 or higher, you can target any creature with a size equal to or less than your Might score.
fs.zh: 你通常只能擒抱體型 ≦ 你的生物。若你的力量為 2 以上，則可以擒抱體型 ≦ 你力量的生物。

heroes.actions.grab.rules.zh:
擒抱

若你想將敵人控制在近身距離並限制他的行動，可以使用以下招式來嘗試擒制目標。

擒抱
近戰、武器　機動動作
近戰 1｜1 個生物
檢定 + 力量：
T1：你無法擒抱目標。
T2：你可以擒抱目標，但若這麼做，目標可以在被擒制前對你發動 1 次近戰基礎打擊。
T3：你順利擒抱目標，目標被你擒制。
效果：你通常只能擒抱體型 ≦ 你的生物。若你的力量為 2 以上，則可以擒抱體型 ≦ 你力量的生物。

除非另有說明，你同時只能擒抱 1 個生物。

擒制狀態的相關資訊詳見第 5 章〈職業〉的「狀態」。

heroes.actions.heal.rules.en:
Heal

A creature who uses the Heal main action employs medicine or inspiring words to make an adjacent creature feel better and stay in the fight. The target creature can spend a Recovery to regain Stamina, or can make a saving throw against one effect they are suffering that is ended by a saving throw.
heroes.actions.heal.rules.zh:
治療

若你使用治療主要動作，你可以透過醫療手段或鼓舞人心的話語，讓 1 個相鄰的生物恢復活力並繼續戰鬥。目標生物可以花費 1 點復元力來恢復體力，或是針對他正在承受的 1 個效果進行豁免（前提是該效果可以透過豁免來解除）。

heroes.actions.hide.rules.en:
Hide

Using the Hide maneuver, a creature attempts to hide from other creatures who aren’t observing them while they have cover or concealment. See Hide and Sneak in Chapter 9: Tests for full details.

fs.en: Using the Hide maneuver, a creature attempts to hide from other creatures who aren’t observing them while they have cover or concealment.
fs.zh: 若你具有掩護或遮蔽，你可以使用躲藏機動動作，嘗試躲避沒有觀察到你的其他生物。

heroes.actions.hide.rules.zh:
躲藏

若你具有掩護或遮蔽，你可以使用躲藏機動動作，嘗試躲避沒有觀察到你的其他生物。完整規則請見第 9 章〈考驗〉的「躲藏與潛行」。

heroes.actions.knockback.rules.en:
Knockback

A creature wanting to push an adjacent creature away from them can attempt to shove that creature using the following ability.

Knockback
Melee, Weapon Maneuver
Melee 1 | One creature
Power Roll + Might:
≤11 Push 1
12–16 Push 2
17+ Push 3
Effect: You can usually target only creatures of your size or smaller. If your Might score is 2 or higher, you can target any creature with a size equal to or less than your Might score.

fs.en: You can usually target only creatures of your size or smaller. If your Might score is 2 or higher, you can target any creature with a size equal to or less than your Might score.
fs.zh: 你通常只能擊退體型 ≦ 你的生物。若你的力量為 2 以上，則可以擊退體型 ≦ 你力量的生物。

heroes.actions.knockback.rules.zh:
擊退

若你想要推開相鄰的生物，你可以使用以下招式來嘗試推撞該生物。

擊退
近戰、武器　機動動作
近戰 1｜1 個生物
檢定 + 力量：
T1：推動 1
T2：推動 2
T3：推動 3
效果：你通常只能擊退體型 ≦ 你的生物。若你的力量為 2 以上，則可以擊退體型 ≦ 你力量的生物。

heroes.actions.main-actions.rules.en:
Main Actions

When you take a main action, you most often do so to use a unique ability granted by your class, kit, or a treasure (see Abilities in Chapter 5: Classes). These abilities represent the most unique, flavorful, and impactful things you can do with your main action.

You can also use your main action to help another creature regain Stamina, charge into battle, defend yourself, or make a free strike.

You can convert your main action into a maneuver or a move action, allowing you to take two maneuvers or move actions on your turn.
heroes.actions.main-actions.rules.zh:
主要動作

當你執行主要動作時，最常見的用途是發動由職業、套裝或寶物賦予的特殊招式（詳見第 5 章〈職業〉的「招式」）。這些招式可以讓你執行最獨特、最具特色且最有影響力的動作。

你也可以使用主要動作來幫助其他生物恢復體力、衝鋒陷陣、保護自己，或發動基礎打擊。

你可以將主要動作轉換成機動動作或移動動作，讓你在自己的回合中使用 2 個機動動作或 2 個移動動作。

heroes.actions.make-or-assist-test.rules.en:
Make or Assist a Test

Many tests are maneuvers if made in combat. Searching a chest with a Reason test, picking a door’s lock with an Agility test, or lifting a portcullis with a Might test would all be maneuvers. Assisting a test is also a maneuver in combat (see Assist a Test in Chapter 9: Tests).

Complex or time-consuming tests might require a main action if made in combat—or could take so long that they can’t be made during combat at all. Other tests that take no time at all, such as a Reason test to recall lore about mummies, are usually free maneuvers in combat. The Director has the final say regarding which tests can be made as maneuvers.

fs.en:
Many tests are maneuvers if made in combat. Searching a chest with a Reason test, picking a door’s lock with an Agility test, or lifting a portcullis with a Might test would all be maneuvers. Assisting a test is also a maneuver in combat.

Complex or time-consuming tests might require a main action if made in combat—or could take so long that they can’t be made during combat at all. Other tests that take no time at all, such as a Reason test to recall lore about mummies, are usually free maneuvers in combat. The Director has the final say regarding which tests can be made as maneuvers.
fs.zh:
在戰鬥中，許多考驗都屬於機動動作。例如用理智考驗來搜索寶箱、用敏捷考驗來打開門鎖，或用力量考驗來抬起閘門等，都算是機動動作。在戰鬥中協助他人進行考驗同樣也是機動動作。

在戰鬥中，較複雜或耗時的考驗可能需要使用主要動作來執行，甚至可能耗時太久而根本無法在戰鬥中完成。另一方面，幾乎不花時間的考驗通常屬於免費機動動作（例如用理智考驗來回想木乃伊的相關知識）。哪些考驗可以作為機動動作進行，最終由導演決定。

heroes.actions.make-or-assist-test.rules.zh:
進行或協助考驗

在戰鬥中，許多考驗都屬於機動動作。例如用理智考驗來搜索寶箱、用敏捷考驗來打開門鎖，或用力量考驗來抬起閘門等，都算是機動動作。在戰鬥中協助他人進行考驗同樣也是機動動作（詳見第 9 章〈考驗〉的「協助考驗（Assist a Test）」）。

在戰鬥中，較複雜或耗時的考驗可能需要使用主要動作來執行，甚至可能耗時太久而根本無法在戰鬥中完成。另一方面，幾乎不花時間的考驗通常屬於免費機動動作（例如用理智考驗來回想木乃伊的相關知識）。哪些考驗可以作為機動動作進行，最終由導演決定。

heroes.actions.maneuvers.rules.en:
Maneuvers

A maneuver typically involves less focus and exertion than a main action (see below). It can be an opportunity to move other creatures, drink a potion, or undertake similar activities.

Sometimes you might not have anything you can do with your maneuver. That’s totally fine! Often, the best thing to do on your turn is take a main action and move on.
heroes.actions.maneuvers.rules.zh:
機動動作

機動動作需要的專注力和體能消耗比主要動作更少（詳見下文）。你可以使用機動動作來移動其他生物、飲用藥水或進行類似的行為。

有時候，你可能沒有適合的機動動作可以執行，這完全沒問題！很多時候，你的回合只要進行主要動作就夠了。

heroes.actions.move-actions.rules.en:
Move Actions

A move action allows a creature to move around the battlefield. Sometimes you’ll already be exactly where you want to be so that you don’t need to use a move action on your turn. That’s okay! The decision to not move is just as tactical as the decision to move.
heroes.actions.move-actions.rules.zh:
移動動作

移動動作可以讓你在戰場上移動。有時候，你可能已經處於理想位置，不需要在回合中使用移動動作，這完全沒問題！選擇停留或移動都是同樣重要的戰術決定。

heroes.actions.movement.rules.en:
Movement

During combat, creatures can employ multiple mechanics that allow them to move around the battlefield. The most common of those mechanics is the Advance or Disengage move action (detailed under Move Actions below), but abilities granted by your class, equipment, ancestry, title, or other options might allow you other ways to move.

Your hero starts with a speed granted by their ancestry—usually 5. This represents the maximum number of squares you can move when you take the Advance move action or when another effect allows you to move. Your speed can be increased by your kit and other game options.

All squares adjacent to your character cost 1 movement to move into. No, there’s no Pythagorean theorem on the grid. It’s a game, don’t overthink it.

Your hero can move freely through an ally’s space. You can move through an enemy’s space, but that space is difficult terrain (see below). You can’t stop moving in any other creature’s space, including to make a strike or use a main action or maneuver while in that space and then continuing your move, unless that creature’s size is two or more sizes greater or smaller than your own.

At the Director’s discretion, you can be forced into the same space as another creature whose size is within 1 of yours, such as by falling down a narrow shaft with such a creature already at the bottom. When you are squeezed into the same space as another creature whose size is within 1 of yours, your ability rolls and tests take a bane.
heroes.actions.movement.rules.zh:
移動

在戰鬥中，生物可以透過許多機制在戰場上移動，其中最常見的是行進與撤離移動動作（詳見下文「移動動作」）。此外，你的職業、裝備、族裔、稱號或其他選項所賦予的招式，也可能提供額外的移動方式。

英雄的族裔會決定起始移動速度，通常是 5。這代表當你執行行進移動動作或其他效果允許你移動時，你最多可以移動的格數。速度可以透過套裝和其他遊戲選項來提升。

若想移動到相鄰的任何方格，包括斜向方格，都只需要花費 1 格移動力。沒錯，方格地圖上不需要套用畢氏定理。這是遊戲，別想太多。

你的英雄可以自由穿過盟友的空間。你也可以穿過敵人的空間，但這些空間會視為困難地形（詳見下文）。除非該生物的體型與你相差至少 2 階，否則你不能在該生物的空間停下來，也不能在該空間內發動打擊、使用主要動作或機動動作後再繼續移動。

在導演裁定下，你可能會被迫和體型與你相差不超過 1 階的生物共占 1 格，例如掉進有其他生物占據的狹窄豎井。在這種情況下，你的招式檢定與考驗都會承受 1 個劣勢。

heroes.actions.no-action-activities.rule.en:
No-Action Activities

Free maneuvers cover most of the simple activities you might want to undertake on your turn. When it isn’t your turn, you can typically undertake even simpler activities requiring no action with the Director’s approval. For instance, shouting out a warning to an ally or dropping an item so another creature can pick it up require no action.

The Director can limit what kinds of no-action activities you can attempt when it isn’t your turn. For instance, shouting out a warning about an unseen foe to an ally on the ally’s or the foe’s turn requires no action. But the Director might stop you from giving that ally complex tactical advice when it isn’t your turn, saying that doing so instead requires a free maneuver on your turn.
heroes.actions.no-action-activities.rule.zh:
無需動作的行為

免費機動動作涵蓋了你在回合中想進行的大多數簡單行為。在不是你的回合時，若經過導演同意，你通常可以執行更簡單的免動作行為。例如，大聲向盟友發出警告，或是丟下道具讓其他生物撿取，這些都不需要動作。

導演可以限制你在非自己回合時能執行的免動作行為。例如，當盟友或敵人的回合正在進行時，你可以不需要使用動作就向盟友大喊提醒有看不見的敵人，但若你想在別人的回合中給予盟友複雜的戰術建議，導演可能會要求你必須在自己的回合使用免費機動動作才能這麼做。

heroes.actions.ride.rules.en:
Ride

A creature can take the Ride move action only while mounted on another creature (see Mounted Combat below). When a creature takes the Ride move action, they cause their mount to move up to the mount’s speed, taking the rider with them. Alternatively, a creature can use the Ride move action to have their mount use the Disengage move action as a free triggered action. A creature can use the Ride move action only once per round. A mounted creature can only have this move action applied to them once per round. This movement can be broken up with the rider’s maneuver and main action however they wish.

fs.en: A creature can take the Ride move action only while mounted on another creature. When a creature takes the Ride move action, they cause their mount to move up to the mount’s speed, taking the rider with them. Alternatively, a creature can use the Ride move action to have their mount use the Disengage move action as a free triggered action. A creature can use the Ride move action only once per round. A mounted creature can only have this move action applied to them once per round. This movement can be broken with the rider’s maneuver and main action however they wish.
fs.zh: 你必須騎乘在其他生物身上才能使用騎乘移動動作。當你使用騎乘移動動作時，坐騎可以載你移動最多等於坐騎速度的格數。或者，你也可以使用騎乘移動動作，讓坐騎以免費反應動作執行撤離移動動作。你每輪只能使用 1 次騎乘移動動作，而坐騎每輪也只能被施加此移動動作 1 次。你可以隨意將這段騎乘拆分到其他機動動作和主要動作之間。

heroes.actions.ride.rules.zh:
騎乘

你必須騎乘在其他生物身上才能使用騎乘移動動作（詳見下文「騎乘戰鬥」）。當你使用騎乘移動動作時，坐騎可以載你移動最多等於坐騎速度的格數。或者，你也可以使用騎乘移動動作，讓坐騎以免費反應動作執行撤離移動動作。你每輪只能使用 1 次騎乘移動動作，而坐騎每輪也只能被施加此移動動作 1 次。你可以隨意將這段騎乘拆分到其他機動動作和主要動作之間。

heroes.actions.search-for-hidden-creatur.en:
Search for Hidden Creatures

The Search for Hidden Creatures maneuver allows a creature to attempt to locate creatures hidden from them (see Hide and Sneak in Chapter 9: Tests).

fs.en: The Search for Hidden Creatures maneuver allows a creature to attempt to locate creatures hidden from them.
fs.zh: 你可以使用搜索隱藏生物機動動作來嘗試尋找對你隱藏的生物。

heroes.actions.search-for-hidden-creatur.zh:
搜索隱藏生物

你可以使用搜索隱藏生物機動動作來嘗試尋找對你隱藏的生物（詳見第 9 章〈考驗〉的「躲藏與潛行」）。

heroes.actions.stand-up.rules.en:
Stand Up

A creature can use the Stand Up maneuver to stand up if they are prone, ending that condition. Alternatively, they can use this maneuver to make a willing adjacent prone creature stand up.
heroes.actions.stand-up.rules.zh:
起身

若你處於伏地狀態，你可以使用起身機動動作站起來並解除伏地狀態。此外，你也可以使用此機動動作讓 1 個相鄰且自願的伏地生物站起來。

heroes.actions.triggered-actions.rules.en:
Triggered Actions and Free Triggered Actions

Your hero might have one or more unique triggered actions, each of which has a specified trigger that allows the action to be used. You can use one triggered action per round, either on your turn or another creature’s turn, but only when the action’s trigger occurs. For instance, a fury hero can use the Lines of Force triggered action to force move a target, but only after an enemy has first tried to force move the fury or another nearby creature.

A free triggered action follows the same rules as a triggered action, but it doesn’t count against your limit of one triggered action per round. For instance, a shadow hero can use their Hesitation Is Weakness ability to take their turn in response to the trigger of another hero ending their turn. But because that ability is a free triggered action, the shadow can still use their In All This Confusion triggered action later in the round.

If multiple triggered actions occur in response to the same trigger, any heroes and other player-controlled creatures taking a triggered action or a free triggered action decide among themselves which of those triggered actions are resolved first. Then the Director decides the same for creatures they control.

Any effect that prevents you from using triggered actions also prevents you from using free triggered actions.
heroes.actions.triggered-actions.rules.zh:
反應動作與免費反應動作

你的英雄可能擁有 1 個或多個獨特的反應動作，每個都有特定的觸發條件。無論是在自己的回合或其他生物的回合，你每輪只能使用 1 次反應動作，而且只有在該反應動作的觸發條件發生時才能使用。例如，熾怒者可以使用【Lines of Force】反應動作來強制移動目標，但只有在敵人先嘗試強制移動熾怒者或附近另一個生物後才能使用。

免費反應動作遵循反應動作的相同規則，但不會計入每輪只能使用 1 次反應動作的限制。例如，影舞者可以在另一名英雄結束回合時，以【Hesitation Is Weakness】招式回應該觸發條件並進行自己的回合。不過，由於這個招式是免費反應動作，影舞者在該輪稍後仍然可以使用【In All This Confusion】反應動作。

若有某個觸發條件同時觸發多個反應動作，英雄和任何由玩家控制的生物可以自行決定這些反應動作的執行順序。之後，導演再為他控制的生物決定執行順序。

任何會禁止你使用反應動作的效果，同樣也會禁止你使用免費反應動作。

heroes.actions.turn.rules.en:
Taking a Turn

Each creature in combat—whether hero, adversary, or something in between—gets to take a main action, a maneuver, and a move action on their turn (explained later in this chapter). Each combatant can perform their maneuver and main action in any order, and can break up the movement granted by their move action before, after, or between their maneuver and main action however they like. You can also turn your main action into a move action or a maneuver, so that your turn can alternatively consist of two move actions and a maneuver, or two maneuvers and a move action.

The Movement section below breaks down how your move action works, while the Maneuvers and Main Actions sections break down the baseline maneuvers and main actions your character can undertake. For any activities not specifically covered in those rules, such as cutting down a chandelier to drop on enemies, the Director decides whether such an activity is a maneuver or a main action.
heroes.actions.turn.rules.zh:
進行回合

戰鬥中的每個生物，無論是英雄、敵人或其他生物，在各自的回合中都能進行 1 個主要動作、1 個機動動作，以及 1 個移動動作。每個參戰者都可以自由決定機動動作和主要動作的執行順序，也可以在機動動作和主要動作之前、之後或之間，靈活運用移動動作提供的移動距離。

你也可以將主要動作轉換成移動動作或機動動作，這樣你就可以在自己的回合執行 2 個移動動作 + 1 個機動動作，或是 2 個機動動作 + 1 個移動動作。

下文會詳細說明移動動作如何運作，以及你的英雄可以使用哪些通用的機動動作和主要動作。對於規則中沒有特別列出的行為（例如砍斷吊燈讓它砸向敵人），由導演決定該行為屬於機動動作或主要動作。

heroes.actions.use-consumable.rules.en:
Use Consumable

Unless otherwise noted in its description, a creature can activate a consumable treasure such as a potion with the Use Consumable maneuver. A creature can use this maneuver to administer a consumable treasure that benefits the user either to themself or to a willing adjacent creature. See Consumables in Chapter 13: Rewards.

fs.en: Unless otherwise noted in its description, a creature can activate a consumable treasure such as a potion with the Use Consumable maneuver. A creature can use this maneuver to administer a consumable treasure that benefits the user either to themself or to a willing adjacent creature.
fs.zh: 除非另有說明，否則你可以透過使用消耗品機動動作來啟動消耗品（例如藥水）。若某件消耗品能讓使用者受益，你可以使用此機動動作將該消耗品使用在自己身上，或是使用在相鄰且自願的生物身上。

heroes.actions.use-consumable.rules.zh:
使用消耗品

除非另有說明，否則你可以透過使用消耗品機動動作來啟動消耗品（例如藥水）。若某件消耗品能讓使用者受益，你可以使用此機動動作將該消耗品使用在自己身上，或是使用在相鄰且自願的生物身上。詳見第 13 章〈獎勵〉的「消耗品」。

heroes.ancestries.devil.description.1.en: The native ancestry of the Seven Cities of Hell, devils are humanoids with red or blue skin expressed in a wide variety of hues, from bright crimson to deep purple. Each devil is born with some hellmark—horns, a tail, cloven hooves, a forked tongue, fanged incisors, or even wings.
heroes.ancestries.devil.description.1.zh: 魔鬼是地獄七城的原生族裔，是皮膚呈紅色或藍色的類人生物，色澤從鮮豔的深紅到深紫不等。每個魔鬼天生都帶有某種地獄特徵，例如犄角、尾巴、偶蹄、叉舌、尖牙或翅膀。

heroes.ancestries.devil.description.2.en: Hell is dominated by the Seven Cities of Hell, each ruled by a different archdevil who constantly plots and schemes against the others in the hope of ascending to the Throne of Hell.
heroes.ancestries.devil.description.2.zh: 地獄被七座城市所統治，每座城市由不同的大魔鬼掌管。這些大魔鬼不斷互相謀算，只盼有朝一日能登上地獄王座。

heroes.ancestries.devil.description.3.en: Those devils who join “the trade,” as their civil service is called, spend their days in bureaucratic service hoping or scheming for promotion. Devils looking for a quick path up the bureaucratic ladder sign up for the Exchange, whereby mortals in the mundane world who perform the right rituals can summon a devil, who bargains with the supplicant on behalf of their archdevil. Archdevils can grant temporary worldly power in exchange for a supplicant’s soul, with the summoned devil acting as the broker.
heroes.ancestries.devil.description.3.zh: 那些成為「商人」（魔鬼對公務員的稱呼）的魔鬼，每天都在官僚體系中服務，希望能夠不斷晉升。渴望快速攀升官階的魔鬼會報名參加「交易計畫」。透過這種方式，在凡間中執行正確儀式的凡人可以召喚魔鬼，而該魔鬼會代表大魔鬼與召喚者進行談判。大魔鬼能以召喚者的靈魂作為代價，提供暫時的強大力量，而被召喚的魔鬼則扮演仲介的角色。

heroes.ancestries.devil.description.4.en: On rare occasions, though, the summoning goes wrong and the supplicant dies before the deal can be struck, stranding the summoned devil on Orden permanently. Some stranded devils seek to return to Hell, but most prefer life in Orden, where the phrase “stabbed in the back by a colleague” is usually a metaphor.
heroes.ancestries.devil.description.4.zh: 不過，這個過程偶爾也會出錯：召喚者在交易完成前就死亡，導致被召喚的魔鬼永久滯留在歐爾登。有些滯留的魔鬼會設法返回地獄，但大多數更喜歡留在歐爾登過生活，因為在這裡，「被同事從背後捅刀」這句話通常只是個比喻而已。

heroes.ancestries.devil.description.5.en: The majority of devils in Orden are not from, nor have ever been to, the Seven Cities. They are descendants of devils who were stranded in the mundane world decades, centuries, even millennia ago.
heroes.ancestries.devil.description.5.zh: 居住在歐爾登的大多數魔鬼既非來自七城，也從未踏足那裡。他們是數十年、數百年，甚至數千年前滯留在凡間的魔鬼後裔。

heroes.ancestries.devil.purchased.intro.en: You have 3 ancestry points to spend on the following traits.
heroes.ancestries.devil.purchased.intro.zh: 你有 3 點族裔點數，可以用來購買以下特性。

heroes.ancestries.devil.quick-build.en: Quick Build: Beast Legs, Impressive Horns.

heroes.ancestries.devil.signature.silver.en: Your innate magic allows you to twist how your words are perceived to get a better read on people and convince them to see things your way. You have one skill of your choice from the interpersonal skill group (see Skills in Chapter 9: Tests), and you gain an edge on tests when attempting to discover an NPC’s motivations and pitfalls during a negotiation (see Chapter 11: Negotiation).
heroes.ancestries.devil.signature.silver.zh: 你與生俱來的魔法能夠扭轉他人對你言語的理解，讓你更容易解讀他人並說服對方接受你的觀點。你獲得自選的 1 項交涉類技能。此外，在談判中，當你嘗試識破 NPC 的動機與雷點時，相關考驗會獲得 1 個優勢。

heroes.ancestries.devil.summary.en: Devils originated in the Seven Cities of Hell and have a supernatural charisma that helps them persuade others. They are similar in stature to humans, and their skin tones include deep blues, purples, and reds. They sport horns, eyes of all shades (including gold and red), and tails, and some have feathered or leathery wings.
heroes.ancestries.devil.summary.zh: 魔鬼起源於地獄七城，擁有能夠說服他人的超常魅力。他們的身形與人類相近，膚色包括深藍、紫色和紅色。他們長有犄角、各種顏色的眼睛（包括金色和紅色）與尾巴，有些魔鬼還有羽毛或皮革般的翅膀。

heroes.ancestries.devil.trait.barbed-tai.en: Your pointy tail allows you to punctuate all your actions. Once per round when you make a melee strike, you can deal extra damage with the strike equal to your highest characteristic score.

calculationDisplay.target: 等於你最高屬性值的傷害

fs.en: Your pointy tail allows you to punctuate all your actions. Once per round when you make a melee strike, you can deal extra damage with the strike equal to your highest characteristic score.
fs.zh: 你尖銳的尾巴能為所有行動錦上添花。每輪 1 次，當你發動近戰打擊時，你可以額外造成等於你最高屬性值的傷害。

heroes.ancestries.devil.trait.barbed-tai.zh: 你尖銳的尾巴能為所有行動錦上添花。每輪 1 次，當你發動近戰打擊時，你可以額外造成等於你最高屬性值的傷害。

heroes.ancestries.devil.trait.beast-legs.en: Your powerful legs make you faster. You have speed 6.

fs.en: Your powerful legs improve your speed. Your Speed is 6.
fs.zh: 你強壯的雙腿能讓你跑得更快。你的速度為 6。

heroes.ancestries.devil.trait.beast-legs.zh: 你強壯的雙腿能讓你跑得更快。你的速度為 6。

heroes.ancestries.devil.trait.glowing-ey.en: Your eyes are a solid, vibrant color that flares to show your excitement or rage. Whenever you take damage from a creature, you can use a triggered action to deal that creature psychic damage equal to 1d10 + your level.

fs.en: Whenever you take damage from a creature, you can use a triggered action to deal that creature psychic damage equal to 1d10 + your level.
fs.zh: 每當你受到生物造成的傷害時，你可以使用反應動作，對該生物造成等於 1d10 + 你等級的心靈傷害。

heroes.ancestries.devil.trait.glowing-ey.zh: 你的雙眼呈現單一的鮮艷顏色，當你感到興奮或憤怒時會閃爍發光。每當你受到生物造成的傷害時，你可以使用反應動作，對該生物造成等於 1d10 + 你等級的心靈傷害。

heroes.ancestries.devil.trait.hellsight..en: Your eyes let you see through darkness, fog, and other obscuring effects. You don’t take a bane on strikes made against creatures with concealment.
heroes.ancestries.devil.trait.hellsight..zh: 你的雙眼能看穿黑暗、霧氣和其他遮蔽視線的效果。當你對具有遮蔽的生物發動打擊時，不會承受 1 個劣勢。

heroes.ancestries.devil.trait.impressive.en: Your cherished horns are larger than the average devil’s, and a hardened representation of your force of will. Whenever you make a saving throw, you succeed on a roll of 5 or higher.

fs.en: Your cherished horns are larger than your average devil’s, and a hardened representation of your force of will. Whenever you make a saving throw, you succeed on a roll of 5 or higher.
fs.zh: 你珍愛的雙角比一般魔鬼的更大，是你堅定意志力的象徵。每當你進行豁免時，擲出 5 以上就算成功。

heroes.ancestries.devil.trait.impressive.zh: 你珍愛的雙角比一般魔鬼的更大，是你堅定意志力的象徵。每當你進行豁免時，擲出 5 以上就算成功。

heroes.ancestries.devil.trait.prehensile.en: Your prehensile tail allows you to challenge foes on all sides. You can’t be flanked.
heroes.ancestries.devil.trait.prehensile.zh: 你的靈活尾巴能讓你同時對付四面八方的敵人。你不會被夾擊。

heroes.ancestries.devil.trait.wings.effe.en: You possess wings powerful enough to take you airborne. While using your wings to fly, you can stay aloft for a number of rounds equal to your Might score (minimum 1 round) before you fall. While using your wings to fly at 3rd level or lower, you have damage weakness 5.

fs.en: You possess wings powerful enough to take you airborne. While using your wings to fly, you can stay aloft for a number of rounds equal to your Might score (minimum 1 round) before you fall. While using your wings to fly at 3rd level or lower, you have damage weakness 5.
fs.zh: 你強壯的翅膀能帶你飛上天空。當你使用翅膀飛行時，你最多可以在空中停留等於你力量的輪數（至少 1 輪），之後就會墜落。若你在 3 級以下使用翅膀飛行，你會擁有傷害弱點 5。

heroes.ancestries.devil.trait.wings.effe.zh: 你強壯的翅膀能帶你飛上天空。當你使用翅膀飛行時，你最多可以在空中停留等於你力量的輪數（至少 1 輪），之後就會墜落。若你在 3 級以下使用翅膀飛行，你會擁有傷害弱點 5。

heroes.ancestries.devil.traits.intro.en: Devil heroes have access to the following traits.
heroes.ancestries.devil.traits.intro.zh: 魔鬼英雄可以獲得以下特性。

heroes.ancestries.dragon-knight.descript.en: The ritual of Dracogenesis that grants the power to create a generation of dragon knights—also known as draconians or wyrmwights—is obscure and supremely difficult for even an experienced sorcerer to master. Small populations of draconians in Khemhara, Higara, and Khoursir attest to this. Descendants of original generations created millennia ago by powerful wizards, they have never been numerous. A typical clutch yields only a single egg. After only a few generations, these draconians begin to show new adaptations like feathers or frilled ridges.
heroes.ancestries.dragon-knight.descript.zh: 能夠創造龍騎士（又名為龍人或龍裔）的龍生儀式極為晦澀，即使是經驗豐富的術士也難以掌握。即使在凱姆哈拉、希伽拉和科爾瑟地區也只有少數龍人出沒，證明了這種儀式有多困難。這些龍人源自強大巫師於千年前創造的原始世代，生育率極低，一窩只會產下一顆蛋，因此族群數量一直未能壯大。短短幾代後，這些龍人便開始展現新的適應特徵，例如羽毛或突脊。

heroes.ancestries.dragon-knight.descript.en: The largest extant population of draconians is the remnants of the Dragon Phalanx in Vasloria. Created by Good King Omund’s wizard Vitae, the Dragon Phalanx once numbered several thousand of the king’s greatest knights, ensuring the rule of law across the land.
heroes.ancestries.dragon-knight.descript.zh: 現存規模最大的龍裔族群，是華斯洛里亞境內龍衛方陣的殘部。這支部隊由賢王歐蒙的法師維泰創造，曾有數千名最精銳的騎士，在全國維護法治。

heroes.ancestries.dragon-knight.descript.en: Knighthood was a title carried by every member of that first generation of dragon knights. Within the Dragon Phalanx were shadows, censors, tacticians, and elementalists. Members of virtually every heroic vocation could be found in one of the eight dragonflights that made up the phalanx. For over 30 years, these heroes were symbols of justice, protecting the weak from the strong, and standing between the common folk and those who sought power over others. Those who grew up in that place and time could not imagine any other way of life.
heroes.ancestries.dragon-knight.descript.zh: 初代龍騎士的每位成員都擁有騎士頭銜。龍衛方陣中包括了影舞者、懲戒者、戰術家與元素師，在組成方陣的八支翔龍軍團中，幾乎能找到各種英雄職業的代表。三十多年來，這些英雄一直是正義的象徵，保護弱者免受強者欺凌，守護平民不被追求權力者的迫害。在那個時代和那片土地長大的人們，甚至無法想像還有其他生活方式。

heroes.ancestries.dragon-knight.purchase.en: You have 3 ancestry points to spend on the following traits.
heroes.ancestries.dragon-knight.purchase.zh: 你有 3 點族裔點數，可以用來購買以下特性。

heroes.ancestries.dragon-knight.quick-bu.en: Quick Build: Dragon Breath, Prismatic Scales.

heroes.ancestries.dragon-knight.signatur.en: Your hardened scales grant you damage immunity equal to your level to one of the following damage types: acid, cold, corruption, fire, lightning, or poison. You can change your damage immunity type when you finish a respite.

fs.en: Your hardened scales grant you damage immunity equal to your level to one of the following damage types: acid, cold, corruption, fire, lightning, or poison. You can change your damage immunity type when you finish a respite.
fs.zh: 你堅硬的鱗片會提供以下其中 1 種傷害類型的免疫（免疫值等於你的等級）：酸蝕、寒冷、腐朽、火焰、閃電、毒素。每次完成休整時，你可以更改傷害免疫的類型。

heroes.ancestries.dragon-knight.signatur.zh: 你堅硬的鱗片會提供以下其中 1 種傷害類型的免疫（免疫值等於你的等級）：酸蝕、寒冷、腐朽、火焰、閃電、毒素。每次完成休整時，你可以更改傷害免疫的類型。

heroes.ancestries.dragon-knight.summary.en: Dragon knights are muscled draconic humanoids who stand between 6 and 7 feet tall. The scales covering their reptilian heads, bodies, and tails can be almost any color. All dragon knights have wings, but on only a few are those wings big enough to let them fly.
heroes.ancestries.dragon-knight.summary.zh: 龍騎士是肌肉發達的龍形類人生物，身高介於 6 到 7 呎之間。他們頭部、身軀和尾巴上的鱗片可以呈現各種顏色。所有龍騎士都有翅膀，但只有少數人的翅膀大到足以飛行。

heroes.ancestries.dragon-knight.trait.dr.en: Whenever you or an adjacent creature takes damage from a strike, you can use a triggered action to guard against the blow. You reduce any damage from the strike by an amount equal to your level.

fs.en: You can swing your wings around and guard against a blow.
fs.zh: 你可以揮動雙翼抵擋打擊。

heroes.ancestries.dragon-knight.trait.dr.zh: 每當你自己或 1 個相鄰生物受到打擊造成的傷害時，你可以使用反應動作進行防護，讓該次打擊減少等於你等級的傷害。

fs.en: Draconic Pride
fs.zh: 龍人霸氣

heroes.ancestries.dragon-knight.trait.dr.en: You let loose a mighty roar to shake your foes’ spirits.
heroes.ancestries.dragon-knight.trait.dr.zh: 你發出震天怒吼，撼動敵人的心志。

heroes.ancestries.dragon-knight.trait.dr.en: You choose the ability’s damage type from acid, cold, corruption, fire, lightning, or poison.
heroes.ancestries.dragon-knight.trait.dr.zh: 你可以為招式選擇以下 1 種傷害類型：酸蝕、寒冷、腐朽、火焰、閃電、毒素。

heroes.ancestries.dragon-knight.trait.dr.en: A furious exhalation of energy washes over your foes.
heroes.ancestries.dragon-knight.trait.dr.zh: 狂怒的能量噴湧而出，席捲你的敵人。

heroes.ancestries.dragon-knight.trait.pr.en: Select one damage immunity granted by your Wyrmplate trait. You always have this immunity, in addition to the immunity granted by Wyrmplate.
heroes.ancestries.dragon-knight.trait.pr.zh: 從你的【龍鱗】特性中選擇 1 種傷害免疫。你始終擁有此免疫（此外仍保有【龍鱗】賦予的免疫）。

fs.en: Prismatic Scales (acid)
fs.zh: 虹彩鱗片（酸蝕）

fs.en: Prismatic Scales (cold)
fs.zh: 虹彩鱗片（寒冷）

fs.en: Prismatic Scales (corruption)
fs.zh: 虹彩鱗片（腐朽）

fs.en: Prismatic Scales (fire)
fs.zh: 虹彩鱗片（火焰）

fs.en: Prismatic Scales (lightning)
fs.zh: 虹彩鱗片（閃電）

fs.en: Prismatic Scales (poison)
fs.zh: 虹彩鱗片（毒素）

heroes.ancestries.dragon-knight.trait.re.en: As a maneuver, you can recite the following oath. Until the start of your next turn, whenever you make a saving throw, you succeed on a 4 or higher.

fs.en:
As a maneuver, you can recite the following oath.

> Even should the sun stop in the sky
> Even should the night last a thousand years
> I will stand forever
> I shall not yield
> Those who suffer and yearn for justice
> I am your sword and shield
> I will yield no ground
> I will speak no lies
> I will stand against all tyrants
> Until the last villain dies.
 
Until the start of your next turn, whenever you make a saving throw, you succeed on a 4 or higher.
fs.zh:
你可以使用機動動作誦讀以下誓言。

> 縱使太陽停在天際，
> 就算黑夜千年不息，
> 我會永遠屹立，
> 絕不退縮逃避。
> 渴望正義的受苦之人啊，
> 我就是你的劍與盾。
> 寸步不讓，一字不虛，
> 我會挺身對抗每個暴君，
> 直到所有惡徒伏誅殞命。

直到你下個回合開始前，每當你進行豁免時，擲出 4 以上就算成功。

heroes.ancestries.dragon-knight.trait.re.zh: 你可以使用機動動作誦讀以下誓言。直到你下個回合開始前，每當你進行豁免時，擲出 4 以上就算成功。

fs.en: Remember your Oath
fs.zh: 銘記誓言

heroes.ancestries.dragon-knight.trait.re.en:
Even should the sun stop in the sky
Even should the night last a thousand years
I will stand forever
I shall not yield
Those who suffer and yearn for justice
I am your sword and shield
I will yield no ground
I will speak no lies
I will stand against all tyrants
Until the last villain dies
heroes.ancestries.dragon-knight.trait.re.zh:
縱使太陽停在天際，
就算黑夜千年不息，
我會永遠屹立，
絕不退縮逃避。
渴望正義的受苦之人啊，
我就是你的劍與盾。
寸步不讓，一字不虛，
我會挺身對抗每個暴君，
直到所有惡徒伏誅殞命。

heroes.ancestries.dragon-knight.trait.wi.en: You possess wings powerful enough to take you airborne. While using your wings to fly, you can stay aloft for a number of rounds equal to your Might score (minimum 1 round) before you fall. While using your wings to fly at 3rd level or lower, you have damage weakness 5.

fs.en: You possess wings powerful enough to take you airborne. While using your wings to fly, you can stay aloft for a number of rounds equal to your Might (minimum of 1 round) before you fall prone. While using your wings to fly at 1st, 2nd, and 3rd level, you have damage weakness 5.
fs.zh: 你強壯的翅膀能帶你飛上天空。當你使用翅膀飛行時，你最多可以在空中停留等於你力量的輪數（至少 1 輪），之後就會墜落。若你在 3 級以下使用翅膀飛行，你會擁有傷害弱點 5。

heroes.ancestries.dragon-knight.trait.wi.zh: 你強壯的翅膀能帶你飛上天空。當你使用翅膀飛行時，你最多可以在空中停留等於你力量的輪數（至少 1 輪），之後就會墜落。若你在 3 級以下使用翅膀飛行，你會擁有傷害弱點 5。

heroes.ancestries.dragon-knight.traits.i.en: Dragon knight heroes have access to the following traits.
heroes.ancestries.dragon-knight.traits.i.zh: 龍騎士英雄可以獲得以下特性。

heroes.ancestries.dwarf.description.1.en: Possessed of a strength that belies their size, dwarves have flesh infused with stone—a silico-organic hybrid making them physically denser than other humanoids. They enjoy a reputation in Orden as savvy engineers and technologists thanks to the lore they inherited from their elder siblings, the long-extinct steel dwarves.
heroes.ancestries.dwarf.description.1.zh: 矮人雖然體型矮小，卻擁有驚人的力量。他們的血肉與岩石融為一體，這種矽基有機混合體讓他們的身軀比其他類人生物更為堅實。矮人在歐爾登因精湛的工程科技和專業知識而聞名，這些寶貴技術源自他們已滅絕的古老親族——鐵矮人。

heroes.ancestries.dwarf.description.2.en: Dwarves are the children of the elder god Ord, and a common phrase among dwarves is “Ord made the world”—their way of saying, “What will be, will be.” They take great pride in knowing that along with Aan, Eth, and Kul, their god created the mundane world, and many dwarves leave their homes to see the world and seek glory in Ord’s name.
heroes.ancestries.dwarf.description.2.zh: 矮人是古神歐德的子嗣，他們常用俗語「世界是歐德創造的」來表達「順其自然」的意思。他們對自己的神明深以為榮，因為歐德與安恩、伊斯、庫爾共同創造了凡人的世界，許多矮人也因此離開家園，以歐德之名探索世界、尋求榮耀。

heroes.ancestries.dwarf.purchased.intro.en: You have 3 ancestry points to spend on the following traits.
heroes.ancestries.dwarf.purchased.intro.zh: 你有 3 點族裔點數，可以用來購買以下特性。

heroes.ancestries.dwarf.quick-build.en: Quick Build: Grounded, Spark Off Your Skin.
heroes.ancestries.dwarf.quick-build.zh: 速選：腳踏實地、堅硬石膚

heroes.ancestries.dwarf.signature.runic-.en: Pick a specific type of creature (such as goblins or humans) or object (such as gems or potions). Your rune glows softly when you are within 20 squares of any creature or object of that type, even if you don’t have line of effect to the creature or object. You can change the type of creature or object as a maneuver.
heroes.ancestries.dwarf.signature.runic-.zh: 選擇 1 種特定的生物類型（例如哥布林或人類）或物體（例如寶石或藥水）。當該類型的任何生物或物體位於你 20 格以內時，即使你對該生物或物體沒有效果線，你的符文也會發出微光。你可以使用機動動作更改偵測目標的類型。

heroes.ancestries.dwarf.signature.runic-.en: You can carve a rune onto your skin with 10 uninterrupted minutes of work, which is activated by the magic within your body. The rune you carve determines the benefit you receive, chosen from among the following:

fs.en:
You can carve a rune onto your skin with 10 uninterrupted minutes of work, which is activated by the magic within your body. The rune you carve determines the benefit you receive.

You can have one rune active at a time, and can change or remove a rune with 10 uninterrupted minutes of work.
fs.zh:
你可以花費不間斷的 10 分鐘在皮膚上銘刻符文，這些符文會透過你體內的魔力啟動。你銘刻的符文類型會決定你獲得的效果。

你同時只能啟動 1 種符文。更改或移除符文都需要不間斷的 10 分鐘。

heroes.ancestries.dwarf.signature.runic-.zh: 你可以花費不間斷的 10 分鐘在皮膚上銘刻符文，這些符文會透過你體內的魔力啟動。你銘刻的符文類型會決定你獲得的效果。從以下選擇 1 項：

heroes.ancestries.dwarf.signature.runic-.en: Your skin sheds light for 10 squares. You can turn this light on and off as a maneuver.

fs.en: Your skin sheds light for 10 squares. You can turn this on and off as a maneuver.
fs.zh: 你的皮膚會發出照亮 10 格範圍的光芒。你可以使用機動動作開啟或關閉這道光芒。

heroes.ancestries.dwarf.signature.runic-.zh: 你的皮膚會發出照亮 10 格範圍的光芒。你可以使用機動動作開啟或關閉這道光芒。

heroes.ancestries.dwarf.signature.runic-.en: You can have one rune active at a time, and can change or remove a rune with 10 uninterrupted minutes of work.
heroes.ancestries.dwarf.signature.runic-.zh: 你同時只能啟動 1 種符文。更改或移除符文都需要不間斷的 10 分鐘。

heroes.ancestries.dwarf.signature.runic-.en: As a maneuver, you can communicate telepathically with a willing creature you have met before and who is within 1 mile of you. You must know the creature’s name, and they must speak and understand a language you know. You and the creature can respond to one another as if having a spoken conversation. You can communicate with a different creature by changing the rune.
heroes.ancestries.dwarf.signature.runic-.zh: 使用機動動作，你可以與 1 個曾經見過且位於 1 哩內的自願生物進行心靈溝通。你必須知道該生物的名字，而且對方必須會說並理解你已知的 1 種語言。你們可以像當面交談一樣互相對話。你可以透過更改符文與不同的生物對話。

heroes.ancestries.dwarf.summary.en: Humanoids with stony skin, dwarves have short and stout bodies. Many carve supernatural runes into their flesh, and some have beards made of crystals.
heroes.ancestries.dwarf.summary.zh: 矮人是擁有岩石皮膚的類人生物，身材矮壯。許多矮人會在自己的皮膚刻下超常符文，有些人的鬍鬚甚至由水晶構成。

heroes.ancestries.dwarf.trait.great-fort.en: Your hearty constitution prevents you from losing strength. You can’t be made weakened.

fs.en: Your hearty constitution prevents you from losing strength.
fs.zh: 你強健的體魄讓你不會失去力量。

heroes.ancestries.dwarf.trait.great-fort.zh: 你強健的體魄讓你不會失去力量。你不會陷入虛弱狀態。

heroes.ancestries.dwarf.trait.grounded.e.en: Your heavy stone body and connection to the earth make it difficult for others to move you. You have a +1 bonus to stability.

fs.en: Your heavy stone body and connection to the earth make it difficult for others to move you.
fs.zh: 你岩石般的厚重身軀與大地緊密相連，讓他人難以移動你。

heroes.ancestries.dwarf.trait.grounded.e.zh: 你岩石般的厚重身軀與大地緊密相連，讓他人難以移動你。你的穩度 +1。

heroes.ancestries.dwarf.trait.spark-off-.en: Your stone skin affords you potent protection. You have a +6 bonus to Stamina, and that bonus increases by 6 at 4th, 7th, and 10th levels.

fs.en: Your stone skin affords you potent protection.
fs.zh: 你的石質皮膚能為你提供強大的防護。

heroes.ancestries.dwarf.trait.spark-off-.zh: 你的石質皮膚能為你提供強大的防護。你的體力 +6，並在 4 級、7 級和 10 級時再 +6。

heroes.ancestries.dwarf.trait.stand-toug.en: Your body is made to withstand the blows of your enemies. Your Might score is treated as 1 higher for the purpose of resisting potencies, and you gain an edge on Might tests when called for to resist environmental effects or a creature’s traits or abilities.

fs.en: Your body is made to withstand the blows of your enemies.
fs.zh: 你的身軀天生能承受敵人的猛烈攻擊。

heroes.ancestries.dwarf.trait.stand-toug.zh: 你的身軀天生能承受敵人的猛烈攻擊。抵抗效力時，你的力量會視為提高 1 點。此外，當你需要進行力量考驗來抵抗環境效果或生物的特性與招式時，你會獲得 1 個優勢。

heroes.ancestries.dwarf.trait.stone-sing.en: You have a magic connection to the earth. When you spend 1 uninterrupted hour singing, you can reshape any unworked mundane stone within 3 squares. You can’t destroy this stone, but you can move each square of it anywhere within 3 squares, piling it off to one side to dig a hole or building it up to create a wall.

fs.en: You have a magic connection to the earth. When you spend 1 uninterrupted hour singing, you can reshape any unworked mundane stone within 3 squares. You can’t destroy this stone, but you can move each square of it anywhere within 3 squares of you, piling it off to one side to dig a hole or building it up to create a wall.
fs.zh: 你與大地有著魔法的連結。若你花費 1 小時不間斷地歌唱，你可以重塑 3 格內任何未加工的尋常石材。你無法摧毀這些石材，但可以將每 1 格的石材移動到 3 格內的任意位置。例如將岩石搬到旁邊來挖出坑洞，或堆疊起來建造牆壁。

heroes.ancestries.dwarf.trait.stone-sing.zh: 你與大地有著魔法的連結。若你花費 1 小時不間斷地歌唱，你可以重塑 3 格內任何未加工的尋常石材。你無法摧毀這些石材，但可以將每 1 格的石材移動到 3 格內的任意位置。例如將岩石搬到旁邊來挖出坑洞，或堆疊起來建造牆壁。

heroes.ancestries.dwarf.traits.intro.en: Dwarf heroes have access to the following traits.
heroes.ancestries.dwarf.traits.intro.zh: 矮人英雄可以獲得以下特性。

heroes.ancestries.hakaan.description.1.en: In spite of their friendly, outgoing nature, the rare presence of a hakaan in human society is considered a harbinger. An omen of dark times.

fs.en: In spite of their friendly, outgoing nature, the rare presence of a hakaan in human society is considered a harbinger - an omen of dark times. Descended from a tribe of giants in upper Vanigar, the original Haka’an tribe made a bargain with Holkatja the Vanigar trickster god. They traded some of their gigantic size and strength for the ability to see the future.
fs.zh: 儘管哈肯人天性友善外向，但只要他們罕見地出現在人類社會中，都會被視為黑暗的預兆。哈肯人源自北方華尼伽的巨人部落，最早的哈肯人部落與華尼伽的詭計之神霍卡提雅達成交易，用部分體型和力量換取了預見未來的能力。

heroes.ancestries.hakaan.description.1.zh: 儘管哈肯人天性友善外向，但只要他們罕見地出現在人類社會中，都會被視為黑暗的預兆。

heroes.ancestries.hakaan.description.2.en: Descended from a tribe of giants in upper Vanigar, the original Haka’an tribe made a bargain with Holkatya the Vanigar trickster god. They traded some of their gigantic size and strength for the ability to see the future.
heroes.ancestries.hakaan.description.2.zh: 哈肯人源自北方華尼伽的巨人部落，最早的哈肯人部落與華尼伽的詭計之神霍卡提雅達成交易，用部分體型和力量換取了預見未來的能力。

heroes.ancestries.hakaan.description.3.en: But Holkatya betrayed them, and the only future a hakaan is allowed to see is the moment and nature of their own death. These visions are never of some mundane tragedy. No hakaan ever received a vision of dying from choking on a grape. This Doomsight is always momentous. Always dramatic.
heroes.ancestries.hakaan.description.3.zh: 但是霍卡提雅背叛了他們，哈肯人唯一能夠預見的未來就是自己死亡的時刻與方式。這些異象都不是一些平凡瑣碎的悲劇，沒有哈肯人曾預見自己會被葡萄噎死。這種「命定末視」總是意義重大，總是戲劇性十足。

heroes.ancestries.hakaan.description.4.en: The Doomsight can happen at any moment. It does not come for all or even most hakaan, but when it comes, it is considered an act of overwhelming hubris to ignore it. Trying to escape the Doomsight means a painful, tragic death, and cursing your family to live with shame.
heroes.ancestries.hakaan.description.4.zh: 命定末視可能會在任何時刻降臨，而且只有少數哈肯人擁有，但當它來臨時，置之不理被認為是極度狂妄自大的行為。試圖逃避命定末視不僅會導致痛苦與悲慘的死亡，還會讓你的家族蒙受永遠的恥辱。

heroes.ancestries.hakaan.description.5.en: But the only hakaan the average human meets is one trying to fulfill their doom. The human superstition—that the arrival of one or more hakaan in human lands is a sign of great forces acting in the world, auspicious times—is literally true. In dark times, many hakaan experience the Doomsight and leave their communities to venture out into the mundane world, in search of their destiny.
heroes.ancestries.hakaan.description.5.zh: 一般人類所遇見的哈肯人，通常都是正在試圖實現自身命運的人。人類的迷信認為哈肯人的出現是世界大勢正在轉變的徵兆，這點其實完全符合事實。在黑暗時期，許多哈肯人會經歷命定末視，離開自己的社區，踏入凡人的世界，尋找命中注定的結局。

heroes.ancestries.hakaan.description.6.en: Humans in Vanigar have their own word for this concept of a personal fate. “Wyrd.” Traditional hakaan sometimes refer to the Doomsight as “wyrdken.”
heroes.ancestries.hakaan.description.6.zh: 華尼伽的人類有個特定的詞語來描述個人宿命的概念：「Wyrd」，所以傳統哈肯人有時也會稱命定末視為「Wyrdken」。

heroes.ancestries.hakaan.purchased.intro.en: You have 3 ancestry points to spend on the following traits.
heroes.ancestries.hakaan.purchased.intro.zh: 你有 3 點族裔點數，可以用來購買以下特性。

heroes.ancestries.hakaan.quick-build.zh: 速選：命定末視、強而有力

heroes.ancestries.hakaan.signature.big.e.en: Your stature reflects your giant forebears. Your size is 1L.
heroes.ancestries.hakaan.signature.big.e.zh: 你的身形反映了巨人祖先的血統。你的體型為 1L。

heroes.ancestries.hakaan.summary.en: Descended from stone giants, the mighty hakaan stand over 9 feet tall and have well-muscled bodies made of organic stone. They are the largest ancestry in this book!
heroes.ancestries.hakaan.summary.zh: 強壯的哈肯人是石巨人的後裔，身高超過 9 呎，擁有肌肉發達、由有機岩石構成的身軀。他們是核心規則中體型最大的族裔！

heroes.ancestries.hakaan.trait.all-is-a-.en: You are exceptionally strong. You gain an edge on tests made to lift and haul heavy objects.
heroes.ancestries.hakaan.trait.all-is-a-.zh: 你力大無窮。當你進行舉起和搬運重物的考驗時，你會獲得 1 個優勢。

heroes.ancestries.hakaan.trait.doomsight.en: Working with your Director, you can predetermine an encounter in which you will die. When that encounter begins, you become doomed. While doomed, you automatically obtain a tier 3 outcome on tests and ability rolls, and you don’t die no matter how low your Stamina falls. You then die immediately at the end of the encounter, and can’t be returned to life by any means.

fs.en:
Working with your Director, you can predetermine an encounter in which you will die. When that encounter begins, you become doomed. While doomed, you automatically obtain a tier 3 outcome on tests and ability rolls, and you don’t die no matter how low your Stamina falls. You then die immediately at the end of the encounter, and can’t be returned to life by any means.

If you don’t predetermine your death encounter, you can choose to become doomed while you are dying with the Director’s approval (no action required). Doing so should be reserved for encounters in which you are dying as a result of suitable heroism, such as making a last stand against a boss or saving civilians, or when the consequences of your actions have finally caught up to you — not because you’re playing a one-shot and have nothing to lose, Hacaarl.

Additionally, when your Stamina reaches the negative of your winded value and you are not doomed, you turn to rubble instead of experiencing death. You are unaware of your surroundings in this state, and you can’t regain Stamina or have this effect undone in any way. After 12 hours, you regain Stamina equal to your Recovery value.
fs.zh:
與你的導演合作，你可以預先決定哪場遭遇你將會死亡。當該遭遇開始時，你會進入「命定」狀態。處於命定狀態時，你進行的任何考驗和招式檢定都會自動獲得 T3 結果，而且無論你的體力降到多低都不會死亡。然而，你會在遭遇結束時立刻死亡，而且無法透過任何方式復活。

若你沒有預先決定死亡遭遇，你也可以在陷入瀕死時進入命定狀態（無需動作，但需經導演同意）。這種選擇應該保留給因為英勇行為而瀕死的情況，例如與首領殊死一戰、拯救平民，或因為先前的行為而遭遇相應的後果，而不是單純因為你只玩一場冒險而沒有顧忌。

此外，若你的體力降至疲態值的負數，但未處於命定狀態，你會變成碎石，而非死亡。在這種情況下，你無法感知周圍環境，也無法以任何方式恢復體力或復原。在 12 小時後，你會恢復等於你復元值的體力。

heroes.ancestries.hakaan.trait.doomsight.zh: 與你的導演合作，你可以預先決定哪場遭遇你將會死亡。當該遭遇開始時，你會進入「命定」狀態。處於命定狀態時，你進行的任何考驗和招式檢定都會自動獲得 T3 結果，而且無論你的體力降到多低都不會死亡。然而，你會在遭遇結束時立刻死亡，而且無法透過任何方式復活。

Doing so should be reserved for encounters in which you are dying as a result of suitable heroism, such as making a last stand against a boss or saving civilians, or when the consequences of your actions have finally caught up to you—not because you’re playing a one-shot and have nothing to lose, Hacaarl.
heroes.ancestries.hakaan.trait.doomsight.zh: 若你沒有預先決定死亡遭遇，你也可以在陷入瀕死時進入命定狀態（無需動作，但需經導演同意）。這種選擇應該保留給因為英勇行為而瀕死的情況，例如與首領殊死一戰、拯救平民，或因為先前的行為而遭遇相應的後果，而不是單純因為你只玩一場冒險而沒有顧忌。

You are unaware of your surroundings in this state, and you can’t regain Stamina or have this effect undone in any way. After 12 hours, you regain Stamina equal to your recovery value.

heroes.ancestries.hakaan.trait.forceful..en: Whenever you force move a creature or object, the forced movement distance gains a +1 bonus.
heroes.ancestries.hakaan.trait.forceful..zh: 每當你強制移動 1 個生物或物體時，強制移動的距離 +1。

heroes.ancestries.hakaan.trait.great-for.en: Your hearty constitution prevents you from losing strength. You can’t be made weakened.

fs.en: Your hearty constitution prevents you from losing strength.
fs.zh: 你強健的體魄讓你不會失去力量。

heroes.ancestries.hakaan.trait.great-for.zh: 你強健的體魄讓你不會失去力量。你不會陷入虛弱狀態。

heroes.ancestries.hakaan.trait.stand-tou.en: Your body is made to withstand the blows of your enemies. Your Might score is treated as 1 higher for the purpose of resisting potencies, and you gain an edge on Might tests when called for to resist environmental effects or a creature’s traits or abilities.

fs.en: Your body is made to withstand the blows of your enemies.
fs.zh: 你的身軀天生能承受敵人的猛烈攻擊。

heroes.ancestries.hakaan.trait.stand-tou.zh: 你的身軀天生能承受敵人的猛烈攻擊。抵抗效力時，你的力量會視為提高 1 點。此外，當你需要進行力量考驗來抵抗環境效果或生物的特性與招式時，你會獲得 1 個優勢。

heroes.ancestries.hakaan.traits.intro.en: Hakaan heroes have access to the following traits.
heroes.ancestries.hakaan.traits.intro.zh: 哈肯人英雄可以獲得以下特性。

heroes.ancestries.high-elf.description.1.en: Children of the solar celestials created to tend their libraries and attend to the true elves as heralds, high elf history describes a better age, before the coming of humans and war. A time when the celestials were still in the world, and all that mattered was art and beauty.
heroes.ancestries.high-elf.description.1.zh: 高等精靈是玄暉天靈後裔，負責管理圖書館並擔任僕從與使者。高等精靈的歷史記載著一個更美好的時代——在人類與戰爭尚未到來、天靈仍在凡間、萬物只追求藝術與美麗的時代。

heroes.ancestries.high-elf.description.2.en: In the millennia since their creators retired to Arcadia, the high elves built a civilization for themselves, primarily living in and among the fallen celestial sky cities. With no creators left to please, the elves continue as they did before—collecting lore and knowledge, worshipping art, and turning more inward and distrusting of outsiders with each generation.
heroes.ancestries.high-elf.description.2.zh: 在創造者退隱至阿卡迪亞的千年歲月中，高等精靈建立了自己的文明，主要居住在已經從空中墜落的天靈城市裡。雖然沒有了需要服侍的創造者，但精靈們仍然延續以前的生活方式，收集典籍和知識，追求藝術。然而，隨著世代更迭，他們變得越來越封閉，也越來越不信任外來者。

fs.en: Elf (high)
fs.zh: 高等精靈

heroes.ancestries.high-elf.purchased.int.en: You have 3 ancestry points to spend on the following traits.
heroes.ancestries.high-elf.purchased.int.zh: 你有 3 點族裔點數，可以用來購買以下特性。

heroes.ancestries.high-elf.quick-build.en: Quick Build: High Senses, Otherworldly Grace.
heroes.ancestries.high-elf.quick-build.zh: 速選：敏銳感官、非凡優雅。

heroes.ancestries.high-elf.signature.hig.en: A magic glamor makes others perceive you as interesting and engaging, granting you an edge on Presence tests using the Flirt or Persuade skills. This glamor makes you appear and sound slightly different to each creature you meet, since what is engaging to one might be different for another. However, you never appear to be anyone other than yourself.

fs.en: A magic glamor makes others perceive you as interesting and engaging. This glamor makes you appear and sound slightly different to each creature you meet, since what is engaging differs from creature to creature.
fs.zh: 你的魔法魅力會讓人不自覺地被你吸引。由於每個人喜歡的特徵不盡相同，這種魔法魅力會讓你在每個生物眼中呈現出略為不同的外表與聲音。

heroes.ancestries.high-elf.signature.hig.zh: 你的魔法魅力會讓人不自覺地被你吸引。每當你使用魅惑或遊說技能進行氣場考驗時，你會獲得 1 個優勢。由於每個人喜歡的特徵不盡相同，這種魔法魅力會讓你在每個生物眼中呈現出略為不同的外表與聲音。不過，你看起來仍然是自己的模樣，不會被誤認為其他人。

heroes.ancestries.high-elf.summary.en: Stately and graceful, high elves have tall, willowy bodies, pointed ears, and smoother skin than most other humanoids. Rare metal inlays such as gold, platinum, palladium, and iridium act as organic components within their skin. The truest form of any high elf is hidden from most—sometimes even from themself—thanks to a supernatural glamor that makes them more attractive to others, whatever that might mean to an individual. This glamor transcends physical appearance, also slightly altering a high elf’s tone and smell.
heroes.ancestries.high-elf.summary.zh: 高等精靈端莊優雅，擁有高挑纖細的身軀、尖耳，以及比大多數類人生物更光滑的皮膚。金、鉑、鈀、銥等稀有金屬鑲嵌物會成為他們皮膚中的有機構造。由於超常魅術的影響，多數人看不見高等精靈最真實的模樣（有時甚至連他們自己也看不見），這種魅術會讓高等精靈在他人眼中更具吸引力，而每個人對「吸引力」的理解可能各不相同。魅術不只影響外表，也會稍微改變高等精靈的聲音和氣味。

heroes.ancestries.high-elf.trait.glamor-.en: When a foe strikes, you reverse the magic of your glamor to instill fear into their heart. Whenever you take damage from a creature, you can use a triggered action to make that creature frightened of you until the end of their next turn.

fs.en: Whenever you take damage from a creature, you can use a triggered action to make that creature frightened of you until the end of their next turn.
fs.zh: 每當你受到生物造成的傷害時，你可以使用反應動作讓該生物對你陷入畏縮狀態，直到他下個回合結束。

heroes.ancestries.high-elf.trait.glamor-.zh: 當敵人攻擊你時，你可以反轉魅術的魔力，將恐懼注入對方心中。每當你受到生物造成的傷害時，你可以使用反應動作讓該生物對你陷入畏縮狀態，直到他下個回合結束。

heroes.ancestries.high-elf.trait.gracefu.en: You gain a +1 bonus to the distance you can shift when you take the Disengage move action.
heroes.ancestries.high-elf.trait.gracefu.zh: 當你執行撤離移動動作時，你的遁移距離 +1。

heroes.ancestries.high-elf.trait.high-se.en: Your senses are especially keen and perceptive. You gain an edge on tests made to notice threats.
heroes.ancestries.high-elf.trait.high-se.zh: 你擁有非常敏銳的感知能力。當你進行察覺威脅的考驗時，你會獲得 1 個優勢。

heroes.ancestries.high-elf.trait.otherwo.en: Your elf body and mind can’t be contained for long. Whenever you make a saving throw, you succeed on a roll of 5 or higher.
heroes.ancestries.high-elf.trait.otherwo.zh: 你的精靈身軀與心智難以被拘束。每當你進行豁免時，擲出 5 以上就算成功。

heroes.ancestries.high-elf.trait.revisit.en: Accessing memories is as easy as living in the present for you. You gain an edge on tests made to recall lore.
heroes.ancestries.high-elf.trait.revisit.zh: 對你而言，重拾記憶就像活在當下一樣自然。當你進行回想知識的考驗時，你會獲得 1 個優勢。

heroes.ancestries.high-elf.trait.unstopp.en: Your mind allows you to maintain your focus in any situation. You can’t be made dazed.

fs.en: Your mind allows you to maintain your focus in any situation.
fs.zh: 你的心智能讓你在任何情況下保持專注。

heroes.ancestries.high-elf.trait.unstopp.zh: 你的心智能讓你在任何情況下保持專注。你不會陷入暈眩狀態。

heroes.ancestries.high-elf.traits.intro.en: High elf heroes have access to the following traits.
heroes.ancestries.high-elf.traits.intro.zh: 高等精靈英雄可以獲得以下特性。

heroes.ancestries.human.description.1.en: Humans belong to the world in a way the other speaking peoples do not. You can sense the presence of the supernatural—that … oily smell in the air, as I’ve heard it described. And the presence of deathless causes the hairs on the back of your neck to stand up. Or why do you think graveyards affect you so? Whatever magic is, its grip on you is light. Whatever drives the deathless, your nature rebels against it.
heroes.ancestries.human.description.1.zh: 人類與這個世界的連結，與其他會說話的族群截然不同。你可以感知超自然的存在，據說就像空氣中瀰漫著油膩的氣味。不死者一靠近，你後頸的寒毛就會豎起，這也解釋了墓地為何會對你們產生如此強烈的影響。無論是哪種魔法，都無法完全束縛你；無論是什麼力量在驅使著不死者，你都會本能地抗拒。

heroes.ancestries.human.description.2.en: “No one knows why this should be. We elves have no such senses. Nor do the elementals or the kanin … the dwarves and the orcs as you say. What is it that sets humans apart? I am an historian, not a physician. I cannot say. Perhaps some of you will one day find out and teach us all the reason.”
heroes.ancestries.human.description.2.zh: 「沒有人知道為什麼會這樣。我們精靈並不具備這種感知能力，元素生物、矮人和歐克也沒有。究竟是什麼讓人類如此特別？我是歷史學家，不是醫生，無法給你答案。或許有朝一日，你們當中的某個人會找出真相，並向所有人揭示其中的奧祕。」

heroes.ancestries.human.purchased.intro.en: You have 3 ancestry points to spend on the following traits.
heroes.ancestries.human.purchased.intro.zh: 你有 3 點族裔點數，可以用來購買以下特性。

heroes.ancestries.human.signature.detect.en: As a maneuver, you can open your awareness to detect supernatural creatures and phenomena. Until the end of your next turn, you know the location of any supernatural object, or any undead, construct, or creature from another world within 5 squares, even if you don’t have line of effect to that object or creature. You know if you’re detecting an item or a creature, and you know the nature of any creature you detect.

fs.en: Until the end of your next turn, you know the location of any supernatural object, undead, construct, or creature from another world within 5 squares, even if you don’t have line of effect to that object or creature. You know if you’re detecting an item or a creature, and you know the nature of any creature you detect.
fs.zh: 直到你下個回合結束前，你知道 5 格內任何超常物體、亡靈、構裝體或異界生物的位置，即使你對他們沒有效果線也能如此。你能分辨偵測到的是物體還是生物，並且能知道那些生物的本質。

heroes.ancestries.human.signature.detect.zh: 使用機動動作，你可以啟動感知能力來偵測超常生物和現象。直到你下個回合結束前，你知道 5 格內任何超常物體、亡靈、構裝體或異界生物的位置，即使你對他們沒有效果線也能如此。你能分辨偵測到的是物體還是生物，並且能知道那些生物的本質。

heroes.ancestries.human.summary.en: Humans are the most numerous people in Orden and many other fantasy worlds! In Draw Steel, humans have all the diversity that our species displays in real life—and they can sense the presence of supernatural energy!
heroes.ancestries.human.summary.zh: 人類是歐爾登及許多奇幻世界中人口最多的族群！《Draw Steel》中的人類與現實世界的人類一樣，具有豐富的多樣性，甚至還能感知超常能量的存在！

heroes.ancestries.human.trait.cant-take-.en: Your connection to the natural world allows you to resist certain supernatural effects. You ignore temporary difficult terrain created by magic and psionic abilities. Additionally, when you are force moved by a magic or psionic ability, you can reduce the forced movement distance by 1.
heroes.ancestries.human.trait.cant-take-.zh: 你與大自然的連結能讓你抵抗某些超常效果。你可以無視魔法或靈能招式所創造的臨時困難地形。此外，當你被魔法或靈能招式強制移動時，你可以將強制移動的距離 -1。

heroes.ancestries.human.trait.determinat.en: A tolerance for pain and distress allows you to push through difficult situations. If you are frightened, slowed, or weakened, you can use a maneuver to immediately end one of those conditions.

fs.en: A tolerance for pain and distress allows you to push through difficult situations.
fs.zh: 你可以忍受痛苦和壓力，在困境中堅持前行。

heroes.ancestries.human.trait.determinat.zh: 你可以忍受痛苦和壓力，在困境中堅持前行。若你處於畏縮、緩速或虛弱狀態，你可以使用機動動作立刻解除其中 1 種狀態。

heroes.ancestries.human.trait.perseveran.en: Giving up is for other people. You gain an edge on tests made using the Endurance skill. Additionally, when you are slowed, your speed is reduced to 3 instead of 2.

fs.en: When you are slowed, your speed is reduced to 3 instead of 2.
fs.zh: 若你處於緩速狀態，你的速度會降至 3，而非 2。

heroes.ancestries.human.trait.perseveran.zh: 你絕不輕言放棄。當你使用耐力技能進行考驗時，你會獲得 1 個優勢。此外，若你處於緩速狀態，你的速度會降至 3，而非 2。

fs.en: Perseverence
fs.zh: 堅持不懈

heroes.ancestries.human.trait.resist-the.en: Your instinctive resilience protects you from injuries beyond the routine. Whenever you take damage that isn’t untyped, you can use a triggered action to take half the damage.

fs.en: Your instinctive resilience protects you from injuries beyond the routine.
fs.zh: 你與生俱來的韌性會保護你免受異常傷害。

heroes.ancestries.human.trait.resist-the.zh: 你與生俱來的韌性會保護你免受異常傷害。每當你受到任何傷害時，只要不是普通傷害，你可以使用反應動作將該傷害減半。

heroes.ancestries.human.trait.staying-po.en: Your human physiology allows you to fight, run, and stay awake longer than others. You increase your number of Recoveries by 2.

fs.en: Your human physiology allows you to fight, run, and stay awake longer than others.
fs.zh: 人類的生理構造能讓你比其他族群更持久地戰鬥、奔跑和保持清醒。

heroes.ancestries.human.trait.staying-po.zh: 人類的生理構造能讓你比其他族群更持久地戰鬥、奔跑和保持清醒。你的復元力 +2。

heroes.ancestries.human.traits.intro.en: Human heroes have access to the following traits.
heroes.ancestries.human.traits.intro.zh: 人類英雄可以獲得以下特性。

heroes.ancestries.memonek.description.1.en: The native denizens of Axiom, the Plane of Uttermost Law, memonek dwell in a land with lakes and trees and birds and flowers. But on this alien world, the lakes are seas of mercury, the birds glitter with wings of glass stretched gossamer thin, and the flowers’ petals are iridescent metal as flexible and fragile as any earthly rose.
heroes.ancestries.memonek.description.1.zh: 梅莫人是「至律位面」公理界的原生族裔。他們居住的土地一樣有湖泊、樹木、飛鳥和花朵，但在這個異世界中，湖泊是由水銀構成、鳥兒拍打著薄如蟬翼的玻璃翅膀，而花瓣雖然是虹彩金屬，卻如同塵世的玫瑰般柔軟易碎。

heroes.ancestries.memonek.description.2.en: The minds of memonek are highly ordered. Their reason is their great pride. But when descending to the lower planes, including a manifold like Orden where law and chaos mix, a sickness comes over them—an uncontrollable sensation called emotion.
heroes.ancestries.memonek.description.2.zh: 梅莫人的思維極度有序，理性是他們最引以為傲的特質。然而，當他們來到較低層的位面時（尤其是像歐爾登這樣秩序與混亂交織的衍界），他們便會遭受一種病症的侵襲，讓他們難以控制自己。那種病叫作「情緒」。

heroes.ancestries.memonek.purchased.intr.en: You have 4 ancestry points to spend on the following traits.
heroes.ancestries.memonek.purchased.intr.zh: 你有 4 點族裔點數，可以用來購買以下特性。

heroes.ancestries.memonek.quick-build.zh: 速選：疾如雷電、奔騰不息

heroes.ancestries.memonek.signature.fall.en: Your silicone body is low in density. Whenever you fall, you reduce the distance of the fall by 2 squares.
heroes.ancestries.memonek.signature.fall.zh: 你的矽質身體密度極低。每當你墜落時，實際墜落距離會減少 2 格。

heroes.ancestries.memonek.signature.ligh.en: Your body is light for a creature of your height. Whenever another creature attempts to force move you, you treat your size as one size smaller than it is.
heroes.ancestries.memonek.signature.ligh.zh: 以你的身高而言，你的體重異常輕盈。每當其他生物嘗試強制移動你時，你的體型會視為比實際小 1 級。

heroes.ancestries.memonek.summary.en: Originating on Axiom, the Plane of Uttermost Law, memonek are a machine people made of metal, marble, glass, and other inorganic materials. Their bodies are lightweight, making them easier to move and letting them fall at slower speeds.
heroes.ancestries.memonek.summary.zh: 梅莫人源自「至律位面」公理界，是由金屬、大理石、玻璃和其他無機材料構成的機械族群。他們的身體很輕，因此更容易被移動，墜落速度也較慢。

heroes.ancestries.memonek.trait.i-am-law.en: Your lawful nature and quick reflexes mean you give no quarter to creatures trying to get past you. Enemies can’t move through your space unless you allow them to do so.
heroes.ancestries.memonek.trait.i-am-law.zh: 憑藉你守序的天性和敏捷的反應，你絕對不會對試圖穿過你的生物手下留情。除非你允許，否則敵人無法穿越你占據的空間。

heroes.ancestries.memonek.trait.keeper-o.en: Your connection to Axiom, the plane of Uttermost Law, allows you to manage chaos around you. Once per round when you or an adjacent creature makes a power roll, you can use a free triggered action to remove an edge or a bane on the roll, to turn a double edge into an edge, or to turn a double bane into a bane.

fs.en: Your connection to Axiom, the plane of Uttermost Law, allows you to manage chaos around you.
fs.zh: 你與「至律位面」公理界的連結能讓你控制周圍的混亂。

heroes.ancestries.memonek.trait.keeper-o.zh: 你與「至律位面」公理界的連結能讓你控制周圍的混亂。每輪 1 次，當你自己或 1 個與你相鄰的生物進行檢定時，你可以使用免費反應動作，移除該次檢定的 1 個優勢或劣勢、將雙優勢轉為單優勢，或將雙劣勢轉為單劣勢。

heroes.ancestries.memonek.trait.lightnin.en: You can push your body to move at incredible speeds. Your speed is 7.

fs.en: You can push your body to move at incredible speeds. Your Speed is 7.
fs.zh: 你的身體可以達到驚人的移動速度。你的速度為 7。

heroes.ancestries.memonek.trait.lightnin.zh: 你的身體可以達到驚人的移動速度。你的速度為 7。

heroes.ancestries.memonek.trait.nonstop..en: Your connection to Axiom allows you to regulate your movement. You can’t be made slowed.

fs.en: Your connection to Axiom allows you to regulate your movement.
fs.zh: 你與公理界的連結能讓你調節自身的移動力。

heroes.ancestries.memonek.trait.nonstop..zh: 你與公理界的連結能讓你調節自身的移動力。你不會陷入緩速狀態。

heroes.ancestries.memonek.trait.systemat.en: You gain an edge on tests made to parse schematics, maps, and other systematic documents that aren’t inherently chaotic. In addition, you treat any language you don’t know as if you know a related language.

fs.en: You treat any language you don’t know as if you know a related language.
fs.zh: 對於任何你不懂的語言，你都視為懂得某種與之相關的語言。

heroes.ancestries.memonek.trait.systemat.zh: 當你嘗試解析藍圖、地圖和其他有條理的系統化文件時，相關考驗會獲得 1 個優勢。此外，對於任何你不懂的語言，你都視為懂得某種與之相關的語言。

heroes.ancestries.memonek.trait.unphased.en: Your ordered mind can’t be caught off guard. You can’t be made surprised.
heroes.ancestries.memonek.trait.unphased.zh: 你有條不紊的心智讓你不會驚慌失措。你不會措手不及。

heroes.ancestries.memonek.trait.useful-e.en: Velloparatha—the worldsickness—might hinder you, but you know how to turn your pain into something your enemies feel. At the start of any combat, you gain 1 surge.

fs.en: Velloparatha - the worldsickness - might hinder, but you know how to turn your pain into something your enemies feel.
fs.zh: 維洛帕拉症（俗稱躍界病）或許會妨礙你，但你也知道如何將自己的痛苦轉化為敵人能夠感受到的力量。

heroes.ancestries.memonek.trait.useful-e.zh: 維洛帕拉症（俗稱躍界病）或許會妨礙你，但你也知道如何將自己的痛苦轉化為敵人能夠感受到的力量。每場戰鬥開始時，你會獲得 1 點鬥志。

heroes.ancestries.memonek.traits.intro.en: Memonek heroes have access to the following traits.
heroes.ancestries.memonek.traits.intro.zh: 梅莫人英雄可以獲得以下特性。

heroes.ancestries.orc.description.1.en: An anger that cannot be hidden. A fury that drives them in battle. Orcs are famed throughout the world as consummate warriors—a reputation that the peace-loving orcs find distasteful.
heroes.ancestries.orc.description.1.zh: 歐克擁有無法掩藏的憤怒，以及驅使他們作戰的狂暴，以稱霸沙場的精銳戰士聞名於世，但這支愛好和平的族裔卻不喜歡承擔這樣的名聲。

heroes.ancestries.orc.description.2.en: The fifth of the speaking peoples, orcs arrived on Orden after humans and elves. They made their homes in the borderlands between those two cultures, preferring the natural forests and avoiding the elf-haunted wodes. For generations, this put them directly in the path of humans who cut down the trees and built roads and farms.
heroes.ancestries.orc.description.2.zh: 作為第五支會說話的族群，歐克在人類與精靈之後來到歐爾登。他們在兩種文明的邊境地帶建立家園，喜愛自然森林，也懂得迴避精靈盤據的幻林。然而，儘管他們再怎麼小心，幾個世代之後，人類開墾的道路與建設的農場，仍然不可避免地連接到他們聚落的外牆。

heroes.ancestries.orc.description.3.en: Each orc has within them a fire that causes their veins to glow once blood is drawn. This anger propels them right to the edge of death. The dichotomy between their desire to be left alone and their zeal in battle is summarized in a dwarf proverb:
heroes.ancestries.orc.description.3.zh: 每個歐克體內都蘊藏著一團火焰，一旦流血，就會讓他們的血管發光，這股憤怒會驅使他們戰鬥到生命的盡頭。他們既渴望平靜，又在戰鬥中展現熱情，這種矛盾被一句矮人諺語恰如其分地概括：

heroes.ancestries.orc.description.4.en: “Be thankful orcs do not hold grudges.”

heroes.ancestries.orc.purchased.intro.en: You have 3 ancestry points to spend on the following traits.
heroes.ancestries.orc.purchased.intro.zh: 你有 3 點族裔點數，可以用來購買以下特性。

heroes.ancestries.orc.quick-build.zh: 速選：熾熱復元、腳踏實地

heroes.ancestries.orc.signature.relentle.en: Whenever a creature deals damage to you that leaves you dying, you can make a free strike against any creature. If the creature is reduced to 0 Stamina by your strike, you can spend a Recovery.
heroes.ancestries.orc.signature.relentle.zh: 每當 1 個生物造成的傷害讓你陷入瀕死時，你可以對任意生物發動 1 次基礎打擊。若該生物因為你的打擊而體力歸 0，你可以花費 1 點復元力。

heroes.ancestries.orc.summary.en: Orcs have skin in green tones and stand slightly taller and wider than humans. A supernatural energy they call “the blood fire” flows through their veins, igniting colorful lines in an orc’s skin during life-or-death battles.
heroes.ancestries.orc.summary.zh: 歐克的膚色呈現各種綠色調，身形比人類略高，也更寬壯。他們的血液中流淌著一種名為「血焰」的超常能量，當歐克面臨存亡之際，這股能量會點亮皮膚上的彩色紋路。

heroes.ancestries.orc.trait.bloodfire-ru.en: The magic coursing through your veins makes you run faster in the heat of battle. The first time in any combat round that you take damage, you gain a +2 bonus to speed until the end of the round.
heroes.ancestries.orc.trait.bloodfire-ru.zh: 你體內奔流的魔力能讓你在戰鬥狂潮中跑得更快。每輪 1 次，當你首次受到傷害時，你的速度會 +2，直到該輪結束。

heroes.ancestries.orc.trait.glowing-reco.en: Your bloodfire allows you to regain your strength quicker than others. Whenever you use the Catch Breath maneuver, you can spend as many Recoveries as you like.
heroes.ancestries.orc.trait.glowing-reco.zh: 你的血焰能讓你比其他人更快恢復體力。每當你使用喘息機動動作時，你可以花費任意數量的復元力。

heroes.ancestries.orc.trait.grounded.eff.en: The magic in your blood makes it difficult for others to move you. You have a +1 bonus to stability.

fs.en: The magic in your blood makes it difficult for others to move you.
fs.zh: 你血液中的魔力讓他人難以移動你。

heroes.ancestries.orc.trait.grounded.eff.zh: 你血液中的魔力讓他人難以移動你。你的穩度 +1。

heroes.ancestries.orc.trait.nonstop.effe.en: Your bloodfire supplies you with a constant rush of adrenaline. You can’t be made slowed.

fs.en: Your bloodfire supplies you with a constant rush of adrenaline.
fs.zh: 你的血焰讓你的腎上腺素持續翻湧。

heroes.ancestries.orc.trait.nonstop.effe.zh: 你的血焰讓你的腎上腺素持續翻湧。你不會陷入緩速狀態。

heroes.ancestries.orc.trait.passionate-a.en: When you are stirred by a passion for creation, your bloodfire allows you to work longer and harder. When you gain your initial skills from your career, culture, class, or other source, choose two skills from the crafting skill group, whether you have those skills or not. Whenever you make a project roll for a crafting project that uses these skills, you gain a +2 bonus to the roll.
heroes.ancestries.orc.trait.passionate-a.zh: 當你因為創作的靈感而振奮時，你的血焰能讓你更持久且更努力地工作。當你從生涯、文化、職業或其他來源獲得初始技能時，從工藝類技能中選擇 2 項技能（無論你是否已經擁有該技能）。每當你使用所選技能進行工藝類專案時，專案檢定會 +2。

heroes.ancestries.orc.traits.intro.en: Orc heroes have access to the following traits.
heroes.ancestries.orc.traits.intro.zh: 歐克英雄可以獲得以下特性。

heroes.ancestries.polder.description.1.en: After humans, polders are the most numerous and diverse ancestry in Orden. They are not humans, but they live in and among humans and share their gods and culture. Almost every human culture in Orden has a polder saint or a human saint venerated by polder.
heroes.ancestries.polder.description.1.zh: 在歐爾登，波德人的數量與多元性僅次於人類。雖然他們不是人類，卻與人類共同生活，共享同樣的神明與文化。幾乎在每一種人類文化中，都能找到波德人聖者，或是受到波德人敬奉的人類聖者。

heroes.ancestries.polder.description.2.en: Short, averaging 3-1/2 feet tall, the polders’ origins are obscure. They are a young species who, like humans, have no single patron god. Their ability to shadowmeld means they enjoy a reputation as excellent spies and thieves. Many polders consider this a base slander and point out they’re also famed as chefs, though polders can be found in every profession, especially in cities.
heroes.ancestries.polder.description.2.zh: 波德人身材矮小，平均身高僅 3 呎半，起源也撲朔迷離。作為一支年輕的族裔，他們和人類一樣沒有專屬的守護神。他們天生擁有融入陰影的能力，因此獲得了優秀間諜和盜賊的名聲。然而，許多波德人認為這是一種污衊，並強調他們同樣以精湛的廚藝聞名。實際上，波德人遍布各行各業，尤其活躍於城市之中。

heroes.ancestries.polder.purchased.intro.en: You have 4 ancestry points to spend on the following traits.
heroes.ancestries.polder.purchased.intro.zh: 你有 4 點族裔點數，可以用來購買以下特性。

heroes.ancestries.polder.quick-build.en: Quick Build: Corruption Immunity, Fearless, Graceful Retreat.
heroes.ancestries.polder.quick-build.zh: 速選：腐朽免疫、無所畏懼、優雅撤離

heroes.ancestries.polder.signature.shado.en: You flatten yourself into a shadow against a wall or floor you are touching, and become hidden from any creature you have cover or concealment from or who isn’t observing you. While in shadow form, you have full awareness of your surroundings, and strikes made against you and tests made to search for you take a bane. You can’t move or be force moved, and you can’t take main actions or maneuvers except to exit this form or to direct creatures under your control, such as one you summon using an ability. Any ability or effect that targets more than 1 square affects you in this form only if it explicitly affects the surface you are flattened against. You can exit this form as a maneuver. If the surface you are flattened against is destroyed, this ability ends and you take 1d6 damage that can’t be reduced in any way.

fs.en:
You flatten yourself into a shadow against a wall or floor you are touching, and become hidden from any creature you have cover or concealment from or who isn’t observing you. While in shadow form, you have full awareness of your surroundings, and strikes against you and tests made to search for you take a bane. You can’t move or be force moved, and you can’t take main actions or maneuvers except to exit this form or to direct creates under your control, such as one you summon using an ability. Any ability or effect that targets more than 1 square affects you in this form only if it explicitly affects the surface you are flattened against. You can exit this form as a maneuver.

If the surface you are flattened against is destroyed, this ability ends and you take 1d6 damage that can’t be reduced in any way.
fs.zh:
你將自己化為平貼於牆面或地面的影子。此時，若你對 1 個生物具有掩護或遮蔽，或該生物觀察不到你，你就會對他處於隱藏。在影子形態中，你能完全感知周遭的環境，而且對你發動的任何打擊和搜索考驗都會承受 1 個劣勢。你無法移動或被強制移動，也無法執行主要動作和機動動作（除了脫離此形態或指揮受你控制的生物，例如你發動招式召喚的生物）。影響多格的招式或效果，只有在明確影響你所貼附的表面時，你才會受到影響。你可以使用機動動作脫離此形態。

若你所貼附的表面被摧毀，此招式會立刻終止，而且你會受到 1d6 點傷害（無法以任何方式減免）。

heroes.ancestries.polder.signature.shado.zh:
你將自己化為平貼於牆面或地面的影子。此時，若你對 1 個生物具有掩護或遮蔽，或該生物觀察不到你，你就會對他處於隱藏。在影子形態中，你能完全感知周遭的環境，而且對你發動的任何打擊和搜索考驗都會承受 1 個劣勢。你無法移動或被強制移動，也無法執行主要動作和機動動作（除了脫離此形態或指揮受你控制的生物，例如你發動招式召喚的生物）。影響多格的招式或效果，只有在明確影響你所貼附的表面時，你才會受到影響。你可以使用機動動作脫離此形態。

若你所貼附的表面被摧毀，此招式會立刻終止，而且你會受到 1d6 點傷害（無法以任何方式減免）。
你化為一道真正的影子。

heroes.ancestries.polder.signature.small.en: Your diminutive stature lets you easily get out of—or into—trouble. Your size is 1S.

fs.en: Your diminutive stature lets you easily get out of — or into — trouble.
fs.zh: 你嬌小的身材能讓你更輕易地擺脫（或陷入）麻煩。

heroes.ancestries.polder.signature.small.zh: 你嬌小的身材能讓你更輕易地擺脫（或陷入）麻煩。你的體型為 1S。

heroes.ancestries.polder.summary.en: The smallest of the ancestries in this book, polders stand no taller than 3-1/2 feet. They look like smaller humans, and they have the ability to blend in with the shadows.
heroes.ancestries.polder.summary.zh: 波德人是核心規則中體型最小的族裔，身高不超過 3.5 呎。他們看起來像較矮小的人類，並且擁有融入陰影的能力。

heroes.ancestries.polder.trait.corruptio.en: Your innate shadow magic grants you resilience against the unnatural. You have corruption immunity equal to your level + 2.

calculationDisplay.target: 等於你等級 +2 的腐朽免疫

fs.en: Your innate shadow magic grants you resilience against the unnatural. You have corruption immunity equal to your level + 2.
fs.zh: 你與生俱來的暗影魔法能讓你抵抗異常傷害。你擁有等於你等級 +2 的腐朽免疫。

heroes.ancestries.polder.trait.corruptio.zh: 你與生俱來的暗影魔法能讓你抵抗異常傷害。你擁有等於你等級 +2 的腐朽免疫。

heroes.ancestries.polder.trait.fearless..en: Courage is all you know. You can’t be made frightened.

fs.en: Courage is all you know.
fs.zh: 你天生勇敢無懼。

heroes.ancestries.polder.trait.fearless..zh: 你天生勇敢無懼。你不會陷入畏縮狀態。

heroes.ancestries.polder.trait.graceful-.en: Your small size makes it easier for you to slip away from the fray. You gain a +1 bonus to the distance you can shift when you take the Disengage move action.

fs.en: Your small size makes it easier for you to slip away from the fray.
fs.zh: 你矮小的體型能讓你更容易從混戰中溜走。

heroes.ancestries.polder.trait.graceful-.zh: 你矮小的體型能讓你更容易從混戰中溜走。當你執行撤離移動動作時，你的遁移距離 +1。

heroes.ancestries.polder.trait.nimbleste.en: A light step serves you well when speed is of the essence. You ignore the effects of difficult terrain and can move at full speed while sneaking.
heroes.ancestries.polder.trait.nimbleste.zh: 輕盈的步伐能在關鍵時刻派上用場。你無視困難地形的影響，並能在潛行時保持全速移動。

heroes.ancestries.polder.trait.polder-ge.en: Evading others’ notice gives you freedom to move. At the start of each of your turns during combat, if no enemy has line of effect to you or if you are hidden from or have concealment from any enemy with line of effect to you, you gain a +3 bonus to speed until the end of your turn.
heroes.ancestries.polder.trait.polder-ge.zh: 避開他人的注意力能讓你的行動更加自由。在戰鬥中，每當你的回合開始時，若沒有任何敵人對你有效果線，或你對任何有效果線的敵人處於隱藏或具有遮蔽，你的速度會 +3，直到你當前回合結束。

heroes.ancestries.polder.trait.reactive-.en: Staying light on your feet lets you quickly get back into position. Whenever you are force moved, you can use a free triggered action to shift 1 square after the forced movement is resolved.

fs.en: Staying light on your feet lets you quickly get back into position.
fs.zh: 保持輕盈的步伐能讓你快速回到有利位置。
