heroes.ancestries.polder.trait.reactive-.zh: 保持輕盈的步伐能讓你快速回到有利位置。每當你被強制移動時，在該次強制移動結算後，你可以使用免費反應動作遁移 1 格。

heroes.ancestries.polder.traits.intro.en: Polder heroes have access to the following traits.
heroes.ancestries.polder.traits.intro.zh: 波德人英雄可以獲得以下特性。

heroes.ancestries.revenant.description.1.en: The dead walk among us. Some of them are happier about it than others.

fs.en: The dead walk among us. Some of them are happier about it than others. Unlike the necromantic rituals that produce wights and wraiths and zombies, revenants rise from the grave through a combination of an unjust death and a burning desire for vengeance. Creatures sustained on pure will, they have no need of food or water or air - and, unlike their zombified cousins, they retain all their memories and personality from life.
fs.zh: 死者行走在我們之間，但不是所有死者都樂於接受這種情況。不同於製造屍妖、怨靈和殭屍的死靈儀式，還魂屍是因為枉死與強烈的復仇心而從墳墓中爬出來。他們之所以能夠存在於世上，不是依靠食物、水或空氣，而是純粹的意志力。與殭屍不同的是，還魂屍保留了生前的所有記憶和個性。

heroes.ancestries.revenant.description.1.zh: 死者行走在我們之間，但不是所有死者都樂於接受這種情況。

heroes.ancestries.revenant.description.2.en: Unlike the necromantic rituals that produce wights and wraiths and zombies, revenants rise from the grave through a combination of an unjust death and a burning desire for vengeance. Creatures sustained on pure will, they have no need of food or water or air—and, unlike their zombified cousins, they retain all their memories and personality from life.
heroes.ancestries.revenant.description.2.zh: 不同於製造屍妖、怨靈和殭屍的死靈儀式，還魂屍是因為枉死與強烈的復仇心而從墳墓中爬出來。他們之所以能夠存在於世上，不是依靠食物、水或空氣，而是純粹的意志力。與殭屍不同的是，還魂屍保留了生前的所有記憶和個性。

heroes.ancestries.revenant.description.3.en: These revenants are rare. Many are hunted by ignorant villagers who see only their dead flesh and assume the worst. Those who survive the pitchfork brigade either choose a solitary life, often as a wandering soul seeking out living company yet constantly in fear of it, or they migrate to a metropolis such as Blackbottom or Capital, where lost souls gather to make a home.
heroes.ancestries.revenant.description.3.zh: 還魂屍極為罕見。許多還魂屍遭到無知村民的獵殺，一看到死亡的軀體就設想了最壞的情況。從拿著乾草叉的村民手中倖存下來的還魂屍，要麼選擇孤獨流浪，既渴望又恐懼活人的陪伴；要麼搬遷到黑淵城或元城等大都市，與其他迷失的還魂屍們一起建立家園。

heroes.ancestries.revenant.purchased.int.en: You have 2 ancestry points to spend on the following traits, or 3 ancestry points if your size is 1S.
heroes.ancestries.revenant.purchased.int.zh: 你有 2 點族裔點數，可以用來購買以下特性；若你的體型為 1S，則有 3 點族裔點數。

heroes.ancestries.revenant.quick-build.en: Quick Build: Bloodless, plus Undead Influence if size 1S.
heroes.ancestries.revenant.quick-build.zh: 速選：無血之軀；若體型為 1S，再選亡靈威儀。

heroes.ancestries.revenant.signature.for.en: Choose the ancestry you were before you died. Your size is that ancestry’s size and your speed is 5. Unless you select one of the Previous Life traits (see below), you don’t receive any other ancestral traits from your original ancestry.
heroes.ancestries.revenant.signature.for.zh: 選擇你死前的族裔。你的體型與原族裔相同，速度為 5。除非你選擇【前世特性】，否則你不會獲得原族裔的任何族裔特性。

heroes.ancestries.revenant.signature.tou.en: Your undead body grants you immunity to cold, corruption, lightning, and poison damage equal to your level, but you have fire weakness 5. You can’t suffocate, and you don’t need to eat or drink to stay alive.
heroes.ancestries.revenant.signature.tou.zh: 你的亡靈軀體讓你擁有等於你等級的寒冷、腐朽、閃電和毒素傷害免疫，但你也擁有火焰弱點 5。你不會窒息，也不需要進食或飲水來維持生命。

heroes.ancestries.revenant.signature.tou.en: Additionally, when your Stamina reaches the negative of your winded value, you become inert instead of dying. You fall prone and can’t stand. You continue to observe your surroundings, but you can’t speak, take main actions, maneuvers, move actions, or triggered actions. While inert this way, if you take any fire damage, your body is destroyed and you die. Otherwise, after 12 hours, you regain Stamina equal to your recovery value.

fs.en: When your Stamina reaches the negative of your winded value, you become inert instead of dying. You fall prone and can’t stand. You continue to observe your surroundings, but you can’t speak, take main actions, maneuvers, move actions, or triggered actions. While inert this way, if you take any fire damage, your body is destroyed and you die. Otherwise, after 12 hours, you regain Stamina equal to your recovery value.
fs.zh: 當你的體力降至疲態值的負數時，你會陷入呆滯，而非死亡。你會伏地且無法起身。你能繼續觀察周圍環境，但無法說話，也無法執行主要動作、機動動作、移動動作和反應動作。在這種呆滯狀態下，若你受到任何火焰傷害，你的軀體就會被摧毀，你也會真正死亡。否則，在 12 小時後，你會恢復等於你復元值的體力。

heroes.ancestries.revenant.signature.tou.zh: 此外，當你的體力降至疲態值的負數時，你會陷入呆滯，而非死亡。你會伏地且無法起身。你能繼續觀察周圍環境，但無法說話，也無法執行主要動作、機動動作、移動動作和反應動作。在這種呆滯狀態下，若你受到任何火焰傷害，你的軀體就會被摧毀，你也會真正死亡。否則，在 12 小時後，你會恢復等於你復元值的體力。

heroes.ancestries.revenant.summary.en: No hero starts their life as a revenant. Rather, these undead creatures return to the world of the living because they have dire business that must be finished. A character of any ancestry can become a revenant.
heroes.ancestries.revenant.summary.zh: 沒有英雄生來就是還魂屍。這些亡靈之所以重返活人的世界，是因為還有非完成不可的緊要之事。任何族裔的角色都能成為還魂屍。

heroes.ancestries.revenant.trait.bloodle.en: For you, an open wound is indistinguishable from a scratch. You can’t be made bleeding even while dying.

fs.en: For you, an open wound is indistinguishable from a scratch.
fs.zh: 對你而言，開放性傷口與輕微擦傷沒有區別。

heroes.ancestries.revenant.trait.bloodle.zh: 對你而言，開放性傷口與輕微擦傷沒有區別。你不會陷入出血狀態（即使瀕死也不會）。

heroes.ancestries.revenant.trait.previou.en: You select a purchased trait that costs 1 ancestry point from your previous ancestry. You can take this trait multiple times, selecting a different 1 point trait from your previous ancestry each time.
heroes.ancestries.revenant.trait.previou.zh: 你可以選擇 1 個來自原族裔且耗費 1 點族裔點數的自購特性。你可以多次選擇此特性，但每次都必須選擇不同的 1 費特性。

heroes.ancestries.revenant.trait.previou.en: You select a purchased trait that costs 2 ancestry points from your previous ancestry.
heroes.ancestries.revenant.trait.previou.zh: 你可以選擇 1 個來自原族裔且耗費 2 點族裔點數的自購特性。

heroes.ancestries.revenant.trait.undead-.en: Your supernatural gifts allow you to influence other undead. You gain an edge on Reason, Intuition, and Presence tests made to interact with undead creatures.
heroes.ancestries.revenant.trait.undead-.zh: 你的超常天賦能讓你影響其他亡靈。當你與亡靈生物互動時，你的理智、直覺和氣場考驗會獲得 1 個優勢。

heroes.ancestries.revenant.trait.vengean.en: The sigil disappears from the creature.
heroes.ancestries.revenant.trait.vengean.zh: 生物身上的符印隨即消失。

heroes.ancestries.revenant.trait.vengean.en: A magic sigil you placed on a creature explodes with energy.
heroes.ancestries.revenant.trait.vengean.zh: 你放在生物身上的魔法符印爆散出一股能量。

heroes.ancestries.revenant.trait.vengean.en: As a maneuver, you place a magic sigil on a creature within 10 squares. When you place a sigil, you decide where it appears on the creature’s body, and whether the sigil is visible to only you or to all creatures.

calculationDisplay.target: 數量等於你等級的符印

fs.en:
As a maneuver, you place a magic sigil on a creature within 10 squares of you. When you place a sigil, you can decide where it appears on the creature’s body, and whether the sigil is visible to only you or to all creatures.

You always know the direction to the exact location of a creature who bears one of your sigils and is on the same world. You can have an active number of sigils equal to your level, and can remove a sigil from a creature at will (no action required). If you already have the maximum number of sigils activated and you place a new one, your oldest sigil disappears with no other effect.
fs.zh:
使用機動動作，你可以在 10 格內的 1 個生物身上放置 1 個魔法符印。放置符印時，你可以決定符印出現在生物身體的哪個位置，以及符印是只有你看得見，還是所有生物都看得見。

你始終知道相同世界中帶有你符印之生物的位置方向。你最多可以擁有數量等於你等級的符印，並且可以隨意解除生物身上的符印（無需動作）。若你在符印數量已滿的情況下放置新的符印，最舊的符印就會消失，不會產生任何效果。

heroes.ancestries.revenant.trait.vengean.zh: 使用機動動作，你可以在 10 格內的 1 個生物身上放置 1 個魔法符印。放置符印時，你可以決定符印出現在生物身體的哪個位置，以及符印是只有你看得見，還是所有生物都看得見。

heroes.ancestries.revenant.trait.vengean.en: You always know the direction to the exact location of a creature who bears one of your sigils and is on the same world. You can have a number of active sigils equal to your level, and can remove a sigil from a creature at will (no action required). If you already have the maximum number of sigils activated and you place a new one, your oldest sigil disappears with no other effect.
heroes.ancestries.revenant.trait.vengean.zh: 你始終知道相同世界中帶有你符印之生物的位置方向。你最多可以擁有數量等於你等級的符印，並且可以隨意解除生物身上的符印（無需動作）。若你在符印數量已滿的情況下放置新的符印，最舊的符印就會消失，不會產生任何效果。

heroes.ancestries.revenant.trait.vengean.en: Additionally, you have the following signature ability. Signature abilities can be used at will.
heroes.ancestries.revenant.trait.vengean.zh: 此外，你獲得以下招牌招式。

heroes.ancestries.revenant.traits.intro.en: Revenant heroes have access to the following traits.
heroes.ancestries.revenant.traits.intro.zh: 還魂屍英雄可以獲得以下特性。

heroes.ancestries.time-raider.descriptio.en: The original servitor species of the synliroi—evil psions with near godlike power—the kuran’zoi liberated themselves during the First Psychic War. In the centuries since, they built their own culture and civilization as nomads of the timescape. The exonym “time raiders” was given to them by denizens of the lower worlds who, seeing the advanced technology the kuran’zoi wield, concluded they must be from the future.
heroes.ancestries.time-raider.descriptio.zh: 庫蘭佐伊最初是心語者（擁有近乎神級力量的邪惡靈能者）的奴隸種族，他們在第一次靈能大戰期間成功解放了自己。在之後的數百年間，他們作為時界的遊牧民族，建立了自己的文化和文明。「時空獵手」這個稱呼是下層界域的居民賦予的，因為他們看到庫蘭佐伊所使用的先進科技，認為他們必定來自未來。

heroes.ancestries.time-raider.descriptio.en: Extraordinarily rare in Orden, time raiders thrive on the Sea of Stars, the Sea Between Worlds, where the winds of limbo roar.
heroes.ancestries.time-raider.descriptio.zh: 時空獵手在歐爾登極為罕見，但在靈薄風暴肆虐的浩瀚星海之中茁壯成長。

heroes.ancestries.time-raider.descriptio.en: In place of eyes, kuran’zoi possess crystalline ocular sensors that grant them high-spectral vision and which are hardened against the extreme radiations encountered in the Sea of Stars, permitting them to operate freely outside their vessels with only their portable rebreathers. Time raiders also have two sets of arms, allowing them to wield melee weapons at the same time as ranged weapons. A single well-trained kuran’zoi is like a squad unto themself.
heroes.ancestries.time-raider.descriptio.zh: 庫蘭佐伊沒有眼睛，而是擁有晶體光學感應器，賦予他們高光譜視覺，並能抵禦浩瀚星海的極端輻射。因此，他們只需要戴上便攜式呼吸器就能在星艦外自由活動。時空獵手還具有兩對手臂，能同時使用近戰與遠程武器。一名訓練有素的庫蘭佐伊，就足以抗衡一支完整的作戰小隊。

heroes.ancestries.time-raider.purchased..en: You have 3 ancestry points to spend on the following traits.
heroes.ancestries.time-raider.purchased..zh: 你有 3 點族裔點數，可以用來購買以下特性。

heroes.ancestries.time-raider.quick-buil.en: Quick Build: Beyondsight, Psionic Gift with Psionic Bolt.
heroes.ancestries.time-raider.quick-buil.zh: 速選：透視力、靈能天賦（靈能射線）

heroes.ancestries.time-raider.signature..en: Your mind is a formidable layer of defense. You have psychic immunity equal to your level.

calculationDisplay.target: 等於你等級的心靈免疫

fs.en: Your mind is a formidable layer of defense. You have psychic immunity equal to your level.
fs.zh: 你的心智本身就是一道強大的防護罩。你擁有等於你等級的心靈免疫。

heroes.ancestries.time-raider.signature..zh: 你的心智本身就是一道強大的防護罩。你擁有等於你等級的心靈免疫。

heroes.ancestries.time-raider.summary.en: Travelers of the timescape, the time raiders (or kuran’zoi as they call themselves) have four arms and a single ocular sensor instead of a pair of eyes. Many have innate psionic abilities that make them capable warriors.
heroes.ancestries.time-raider.summary.zh: 時空獵手是時界中的旅人，他們自稱庫蘭佐伊，擁有四隻手臂，並以光學感應器取代眼睛。許多時空獵手天生具有靈能力，讓他們成為強悍的戰士。

heroes.ancestries.time-raider.trait.beyo.en: As a maneuver, you can adjust your vision to allow you to see through mundane obstructions that are 1 square thick or less. While your vision is adjusted this way, you can’t see the area within 1 square of you and you don’t have line of effect to any creature or object in that area. You can restore your usual vision as a maneuver.

fs.en: You adjust your vision to allow you to see through mundane obstructions.
fs.zh: 你調整視覺能力，讓你看穿尋常障礙物。

heroes.ancestries.time-raider.trait.beyo.zh: 你可以使用機動動作調整視覺能力，讓你看穿厚度不超過 1 格的尋常障礙物。在你啟動透視力的期間，你無法看到 1 格內的區域，而且對 1 格內的任何生物或物體都沒有效果線。你可以使用機動動作恢復成正常視覺。

heroes.ancestries.time-raider.trait.fore.en: Your senses extend past mundane obscuration and the veil of the future alike. You automatically know the location of any creature with concealment who isn’t hidden from you within 20, and you negate the usual bane on strikes against such creatures. Additionally, whenever you are targeted by a strike, you can use a triggered action to impose a bane on the power roll.

fs.en: You automatically know the location of any creature with concealment who isn’t hidden from you within 20, and you negate the usual bane on strikes against such creatures.
fs.zh: 你會自動知道 20 格內任何對你具有遮蔽但並未處於隱藏的生物位置，而且當你對這些生物發動打擊時，你會無視通常需要承受的 1 個劣勢。

heroes.ancestries.time-raider.trait.fore.zh: 你的感官能夠穿越世俗的阻礙與未來的帷幕。你會自動知道 20 格內任何對你具有遮蔽但並未處於隱藏的生物位置，而且當你對這些生物發動打擊時，你會無視通常需要承受的 1 個劣勢。此外，每當你成為打擊的目標時，你可以使用反應動作，讓該次檢定承受 1 個劣勢。

heroes.ancestries.time-raider.trait.four.en: Your unique physiology enhances your movement. You gain an edge on tests that use the Climb, Gymnastics, or Swim skills when you can use all your arms in the attempt.
heroes.ancestries.time-raider.trait.four.zh: 你獨特的生理構造增強了你的運動能力。當你使用攀爬、體操或游泳技能進行考驗時，若你能夠運用所有手臂，你會獲得 1 個優勢。

heroes.ancestries.time-raider.trait.four.en: Your multiple arms let you take on multiple tasks at the same time. Whenever you use the Grab or Knockback maneuver against an adjacent creature, you can target one additional adjacent creature, using the same power roll for both targets. Additionally, you can have up to two creatures grabbed at a time.
heroes.ancestries.time-raider.trait.four.zh: 你的多隻手臂能讓你同時對付多個目標。每當你對 1 個相鄰生物使用擒抱或擊退機動動作時，你可以指定另 1 個相鄰生物作為額外目標，然後對這 2 個目標進行 1 次檢定。此外，你最多可以同時擒抱 2 個生物。

heroes.ancestries.time-raider.trait.psio.en: You slam an invisible force down upon the target.
heroes.ancestries.time-raider.trait.psio.zh: 你將一股無形的力量猛烈砸向目標。

heroes.ancestries.time-raider.trait.psio.en: Choose one signature ability from the following options. Signature abilities can be used at will.
heroes.ancestries.time-raider.trait.psio.zh: 從以下選項中選擇 1 個招牌招式。

heroes.ancestries.time-raider.trait.psio.en: The target gains a bonus to speed equal to your Reason, Intuition, or Presence score (your choice) until the start of your next turn.
heroes.ancestries.time-raider.trait.psio.zh: 目標的速度獲得等於你理智、直覺或氣場的加值（由你選擇），直到你下個回合開始。

heroes.ancestries.time-raider.trait.psio.en: You fill yourself or an ally with a burst of speed.
heroes.ancestries.time-raider.trait.psio.zh: 你讓自己或盟友瞬間爆發出更快的速度。

heroes.ancestries.time-raider.trait.psio.en: You shoot forth a purple beam of psychic force that moves your target.

fs.en: You shoot forth a purple beam of psychic force that grips your target.
fs.zh: 你射出一道能強制移動目標的紫色靈能光束。

heroes.ancestries.time-raider.trait.psio.zh: 你射出一道能強制移動目標的紫色靈能光束。

heroes.ancestries.time-raider.trait.unst.en: Your mind allows you to maintain your focus in any situation. You can’t be made dazed.

fs.en: Your mind allows you to maintain your focus in any situation.
fs.zh: 你的心智能讓你在任何情況下保持專注。

heroes.ancestries.time-raider.trait.unst.zh: 你的心智能讓你在任何情況下保持專注。你不會陷入暈眩狀態。

heroes.ancestries.time-raider.traits.int.en: Time raider heroes have access to the following traits.
heroes.ancestries.time-raider.traits.int.zh: 時空獵手英雄可以獲得以下特性。

heroes.ancestries.wode-elf.description.1.en: Children of the sylvan celestials and masters of the elf-haunted forests called wodes, wode elves see all forests as their domain by birthright. They know and enjoy their reputation among humans for snatching children who wander too far into the woods. Humans should fear the trees.
heroes.ancestries.wode-elf.description.1.zh: 幻林精靈是幽木天靈的後裔，掌管著妖精盤據的「幻林」，並將所有森林視為他們與生俱來的領地。他們知道自己在人類之間的不良名聲（會擄走深入樹林的孩童），也樂於維持那種恐怖形象。因為在幻林精靈看來，人類理應畏懼樹林。

heroes.ancestries.wode-elf.description.2.en: The wode elves’ natural ability to mask their presence, called glamor, complements their guerilla style of fighting, letting them strike quickly from cover and then meld back into the underbrush. These traits also make the relatively few wode elves who dwell in cities naturally adept at urban warfare.
heroes.ancestries.wode-elf.description.2.zh: 幻林精靈天生善於隱匿行蹤（這種能力稱為魅術），這與他們的游擊戰術相得益彰：他們能從掩蔽處迅速發動襲擊，隨後悄然融入灌木叢裡。這些特質也讓少數居住在都市中的幻林精靈天生就擅長錯綜複雜的城鎮巷戰。

fs.en: Elf (wode)
fs.zh: 幻林精靈

heroes.ancestries.wode-elf.purchased.int.en: You have 3 ancestry points to spend on the following traits.
heroes.ancestries.wode-elf.purchased.int.zh: 你有 3 點族裔點數，可以用來購買以下特性。

heroes.ancestries.wode-elf.quick-build.zh: 速選：迅捷步伐、非凡優雅。

heroes.ancestries.wode-elf.signature.wod.en: You can magically alter your appearance to better blend in with your surroundings. You gain an edge on tests made to hide and sneak, and tests made to search for you while you are hidden take a bane.

fs.en: Tests made to search for you while you are hidden take a bane.
fs.zh: 當你處於隱藏時，其他生物試圖搜索你的考驗都會承受 1 個劣勢。

heroes.ancestries.wode-elf.signature.wod.zh: 你可以運用魔法改變外表，讓自己更容易融入周遭環境。當你進行躲藏和潛行的考驗時，你會獲得 1 個優勢。此外，當你處於隱藏時，其他生物試圖搜索你的考驗都會承受 1 個劣勢。

heroes.ancestries.wode-elf.summary.en: Lithe humanoids with finely furred skin in all shades of blue, wode elves have angular features and large, pointed ears akin to a bat’s. They possess a supernatural glamor that allows them to blend in with their surroundings when they wish to hide.
heroes.ancestries.wode-elf.summary.zh: 幻林精靈是身形修長的類人生物，皮膚覆蓋各種藍色調的細毛，輪廓分明，長有蝙蝠般的大型尖耳。他們擁有超常的魅術，能融入周遭環境而不被察覺。

heroes.ancestries.wode-elf.trait.forest-.en: You can shift into and while within difficult terrain.
heroes.ancestries.wode-elf.trait.forest-.zh: 你可以遁移進入困難地形，也可以在困難地形中遁移。

heroes.ancestries.wode-elf.trait.otherwo.en: Your elf body and mind can’t be contained for long. Whenever you make a saving throw, you succeed on a roll of 5 or higher.
heroes.ancestries.wode-elf.trait.otherwo.zh: 你的精靈身軀與心智難以被拘束。每當你進行豁免時，擲出 5 以上就算成功。

heroes.ancestries.wode-elf.trait.quick-a.en: Whenever you score a critical hit, you can take an additional main action and an additional move action instead of just a main action.
heroes.ancestries.wode-elf.trait.quick-a.zh: 每當你造成暴擊時，你不僅能額外執行 1 個主要動作，還能額外執行 1 個移動動作。

heroes.ancestries.wode-elf.trait.revisit.en: Accessing memories is as easy as living in the present for you. You gain an edge on tests made to recall lore.
heroes.ancestries.wode-elf.trait.revisit.zh: 對你而言，重拾記憶就像活在當下一樣自然。當你進行回想知識的考驗時，你會獲得 1 個優勢。

heroes.ancestries.wode-elf.trait.the-wod.en: You have the following signature ability. Signature abilities can be used at will.
Thorny vines erupt from every surface and attempt to bind your foe.

fs.en: Thorny vines erupt into existence and attempt to bind your foe.
fs.zh: 尖刺藤蔓從四周地表竄出，試圖纏繞你的敵人。

heroes.ancestries.wode-elf.trait.the-wod.zh: 尖刺藤蔓從四周地表竄出，試圖纏繞你的敵人。

heroes.ancestries.wode-elf.traits.intro.en: Wode elf heroes have access to the following traits.
heroes.ancestries.wode-elf.traits.intro.zh: 幻林精靈英雄可以獲得以下特性。

heroes.background.career.agent.benefit.p.en: Perk: One intrigue perk (Quick Build: Forgettable Face.)
heroes.background.career.agent.benefit.p.zh: 專長：1 項諜報類專長（速選：平凡容貌）。

heroes.background.career.agent.benefit.s.en: Skills: The Sneak skill from the intrigue skill group, plus one skill from the interpersonal group and one other skill from the intrigue group (Quick Build: Disguise, Lie, Sneak.)
heroes.background.career.agent.benefit.s.zh: 技能：獲得「潛行」（諜報類技能），另從交涉類技能組選擇 1 項技能，並從諜報類技能組再選擇 1 項技能（速選：易容、欺瞞、潛行）。

heroes.background.career.agent.descripti.en: You worked as a spy for a government or organization.
heroes.background.career.agent.descripti.zh: 你曾經為政府或組織擔任間諜。

heroes.background.career.agent.inciting..en: While on a dangerous espionage assignment, things went sideways. Although you escaped with your life, the mission was a public failure thanks to bad information your agency gave you. They denied you work for them, and you went on the run. Hero work will let you survive and clear your name.

fs.en: While on a dangerous espionage assignment, things went sideways. Although you escaped with your life, the mission was a public failure thanks to bad information your agency gave you. They denied you work for them, and you went on the run. Hero work will let you survive and clear your name.
fs.zh: 在一次危險的間諜任務中，事情出了差錯。你雖然保住了性命，但由於機構提供的情報有誤，任務的失敗也公諸於世。機構否認你曾為他們工作，迫使你開始逃亡。成為英雄不僅能讓你維持生計，還能幫你洗清名譽。

heroes.background.career.agent.inciting..zh: 在一次危險的間諜任務中，事情出了差錯。你雖然保住了性命，但由於機構提供的情報有誤，任務的失敗也公諸於世。機構否認你曾為他們工作，迫使你開始逃亡。成為英雄不僅能讓你維持生計，還能幫你洗清名譽。

fs.en: Disavowed
fs.zh: 被迫除名

heroes.background.career.agent.inciting..en: Your identity was always hidden. It was your way of protecting those around you because the work you did spying on powerful entities came with dangers. Then your world came crashing down when an enemy agent unmasked you, causing you to lose everything—your privacy, livelihood, loved ones, all gone in the blink of an eye. Instead of going into hiding, you became a public hero to protect the innocent in the name of those you lost.

fs.en: Your identity was always hidden. It was your way of protecting those around you because the work you did spying on powerful entities came with dangers. Then your world came crashing down when an enemy agent unmasked you, causing you to lose everything - your privacy, livelihood, loved ones, all gone in the blink of an eye. Instead of going into hiding, you became a public hero to protect the innocent in the name of those you lost.
fs.zh: 監視大人物的工作充滿危險，你始終隱藏自己的身分，這是你保護親朋好友的方式。但一名敵方特務揭穿了你的身分，你的世界就此崩塌，你的隱私、生計、摯愛，一瞬間全都消失了。面對這樣的打擊，你沒有選擇躲藏，而是成為一名公開的英雄，以逝者之名保護無辜者。

heroes.background.career.agent.inciting..zh: 監視大人物的工作充滿危險，你始終隱藏自己的身分，這是你保護親朋好友的方式。但一名敵方特務揭穿了你的身分，你的世界就此崩塌，你的隱私、生計、摯愛，一瞬間全都消失了。面對這樣的打擊，你沒有選擇躲藏，而是成為一名公開的英雄，以逝者之名保護無辜者。

fs.en: Faceless
fs.zh: 揭露身分

heroes.background.career.agent.inciting..en: There was a time in your life when you used to sell information to the highest bidder. Your acts were unsanctioned by any one organization, but you were well-connected enough to trade in secrets. Politics never mattered much to you until the information you sold wound up causing a ripple effect of harm that eventually destroyed the place you once called home. You became a hero to make up for your past.

fs.en: There was a time in your life when you used to sell information to the highest bidder. Your acts were unsanctioned by any one organization, but you were well-connected enough to trade in secrets. Politics never mattered much to you until the information you sold wound up causing a ripple effect of harm that eventually destroyed the place you once called home. You became a hero to make up for your past.
fs.zh: 你曾經將情報賣給出價最高的買家。你不隸屬於任何組織，但憑藉廣闊的人脈進行情報交易。政治曾對你毫無意義，直到你販賣的情報引發了連鎖反應，最終摧毀你視為家園的地方。你成為英雄，就是為了彌補過去的錯誤。

heroes.background.career.agent.inciting..zh: 你曾經將情報賣給出價最高的買家。你不隸屬於任何組織，但憑藉廣闊的人脈進行情報交易。政治曾對你毫無意義，直到你販賣的情報引發了連鎖反應，最終摧毀你視為家園的地方。你成為英雄，就是為了彌補過去的錯誤。

fs.en: Free Agent
fs.zh: 自由特務

heroes.background.career.agent.inciting..en: After years of cultivating a rich list of informants, one of those informants risked everything to expose the heinous plans of powerful individuals. You promised to protect your informant, but your agency left them hanging—literally. You cut ties with your employer and swore to always make good on your word as a hero.

fs.en: After years of cultivating a rich list of informants, one of those informants risked everything to expose the heinous plans of powerful individuals. You promised to protect your informant, but your agency left them hanging - literally. You cut ties with your employer and swore to always make good on your word as a hero.
fs.zh: 在多年培養大量的線人名單後，其中一位冒著生命危險揭露了權貴的邪惡計畫。你承諾保護這位線人，但你的機構卻背棄了他，任由他被吊死。你因此與雇主徹底斷絕關係，並立誓成為一名英雄，永遠信守自己的承諾。

heroes.background.career.agent.inciting..zh: 在多年培養大量的線人名單後，其中一位冒著生命危險揭露了權貴的邪惡計畫。你承諾保護這位線人，但你的機構卻背棄了他，任由他被吊死。你因此與雇主徹底斷絕關係，並立誓成為一名英雄，永遠信守自己的承諾。

fs.en: Informed
fs.zh: 線人情報

heroes.background.career.agent.inciting..en: While embedded in an undercover assignment, you fell for someone on the other side. They discovered you were a double agent, and though you insisted your feelings were real, the deceit cut too deep for your love interest to ignore. They exposed you, spurned you, or died because of their closeness to you. You left the espionage business to become a hero with nothing to hide.

fs.en: While embedded in an undercover assignment, you fell for someone on the other side. They discovered you were a double-agent and though you insisted your feelings were real, the deceit cut too deep for your love interest to ignore. They exposed you, spurned you, or died because of their closeness to you. You left the espionage business to become a hero with nothing to hide.
fs.zh: 在執行臥底任務時，你愛上了對方陣營的某人。當他發現你是雙重間諜時，即使你真誠地表明自己的真實感情，但這種欺騙對你的愛人來說傷害太深，無法被原諒。他可能因此揭發了你的身分、拒絕你的愛，或因為你的關係而喪命。這段經歷讓你決定離開間諜事業，轉而成為一名不再需要隱藏真實自我的英雄。

heroes.background.career.agent.inciting..zh: 在執行臥底任務時，你愛上了對方陣營的某人。當他發現你是雙重間諜時，即使你真誠地表明自己的真實感情，但這種欺騙對你的愛人來說傷害太深，無法被原諒。他可能因此揭發了你的身分、拒絕你的愛，或因為你的關係而喪命。這段經歷讓你決定離開間諜事業，轉而成為一名不再需要隱藏真實自我的英雄。

fs.en: Spies and Lovers
fs.zh: 間諜與情人

heroes.background.career.agent.inciting..en: You spent your life in service of your country or an organization that upheld your values. During your undercover operations, you discovered that everything you had been told was a lie. Whether you confronted your superiors or were exposed, you were stripped of your service medals before you left to become a true hero.

fs.en: You spent your life in service of your country or an organization that upheld your values. During your undercover operations, you discovered everything you were told was a lie. Whether you confronted your superiors or were exposed, you were stripped of your service medals before you left to become a true hero.
fs.zh: 你畢生都為祖國或與你價值觀相符的組織服務。在執行臥底任務期間，你發現你所知的一切都是謊言。無論你是質問上級，還是身分曝光，在你離開並成為真正的英雄之前，你的功勳獎章全都被剝奪了。

heroes.background.career.agent.inciting..zh: 你畢生都為祖國或與你價值觀相符的組織服務。在執行臥底任務期間，你發現你所知的一切都是謊言。無論你是質問上級，還是身分曝光，在你離開並成為真正的英雄之前，你的功勳獎章全都被剝奪了。

fs.en: Turncoat
fs.zh: 叛變

heroes.background.career.agent.question..en: Who shouldn’t know your true identity and allegiance but does?
heroes.background.career.agent.question..zh: 誰不該知道你的真實身分和效忠對象，現在卻知道了？

heroes.background.career.agent.question..en: Who did you burn or leave behind to get a job done?
heroes.background.career.agent.question..zh: 為了完成任務，你曾背叛或拋棄過誰？

heroes.background.career.aristocrat.bene.en: Perk: One lore perk (Quick Build: I’ve Read About This Place.)
heroes.background.career.aristocrat.bene.zh: 專長：1 項學識類專長（速選：我知道這地方）。

heroes.background.career.aristocrat.bene.en: Skills: One skill from the interpersonal skill group and one skill from the lore group (Quick Build: Brag, Society.)
heroes.background.career.aristocrat.bene.zh: 技能：從交涉類技能組和學識類技能組各選擇 1 項技能（速選：誇耀、社會）。

heroes.background.career.aristocrat.desc.en: Career? Who needs a career when you’re born into money! Or marry into it! Or con your way into it! Whatever the case, you didn’t need to work thanks to (someone’s) generational wealth.
heroes.background.career.aristocrat.desc.zh: 職涯？若你含著金湯匙出生、透過婚姻進入豪門，或是巧妙地騙取財富，誰還需要一技之長？無論方式如何，多虧了（某人）世代傳承的財富，你完全不需要工作。

heroes.background.career.aristocrat.inci.en: When you entered adulthood, you heard unsavory whispers about your family’s fortune before learning that their wealth came at the cost of others’ suffering. Whether you shed light on the secret or not, you left to become a hero stripped of noble title.

fs.en: When you entered adulthood, you heard unsavory whispers about your family’s fortune before learning that their wealth came at the cost of others’ suffering. Whether you shed light on the secret or not, you left to become a hero stripped of noble title.
fs.zh: 在你成年後，你聽聞關於家族財富的不光彩傳言，後來發現這些財富確實建立在他人的痛苦之上。不管你是否選擇揭露這個祕密，你最終都離開了家族，成為一位失去貴族頭銜的英雄。

heroes.background.career.aristocrat.inci.zh: 在你成年後，你聽聞關於家族財富的不光彩傳言，後來發現這些財富確實建立在他人的痛苦之上。不管你是否選擇揭露這個祕密，你最終都離開了家族，成為一位失去貴族頭銜的英雄。

fs.en: Blood Money
fs.zh: 不義之財

heroes.background.career.aristocrat.inci.en: Whether through some supernatural power or your innate persuasiveness, you were able to defraud other aristocrats. You did it for fun. And when you were found out, you lost your status. Whether you served time or escaped punishment, you decided to rehabilitate yourself and became a hero.

fs.en: Through some treasure or innate ability, you were able to defraud other aristocrats. You did it for fun. When you were found out, you lost your status. Whether you served time or escaped from punishment, you decided to rehabilitate yourself and became a hero.
fs.zh: 無論是藉由超自然力量還是天生的說服技巧，你成功欺騙了其他貴族，而且你是純粹為了樂趣而這麼做。當行為敗露後，你喪失了貴族身分。不管最終是服刑還是逃過懲罰，你決定洗心革面，成為一位英雄。

heroes.background.career.aristocrat.inci.zh: 無論是藉由超自然力量還是天生的說服技巧，你成功欺騙了其他貴族，而且你是純粹為了樂趣而這麼做。當行為敗露後，你喪失了貴族身分。不管最終是服刑還是逃過懲罰，你決定洗心革面，成為一位英雄。

fs.en: Charmed Life
fs.zh: 魅力人生

heroes.background.career.aristocrat.inci.en: The guardians who instilled in you the virtues of doing the right thing were murdered in a senseless petty robbery. Though their wealth was bequeathed to you, it did little to assuage the guilt you felt for being unable to stop the deadly crime. You decided to use your riches to fund your life as a hero, whether publicly or using an alter ego.

fs.en: The guardians who instilled in you the virtues of doing the right thing were murdered in a senseless petty robbery. Though their wealth was bequeathed to you, it did little to assuage the guilt you felt for being unable to stop the deadly crime. You decided to use your riches to fund your life as a hero, whether publicly or using an alter ego.
fs.zh: 那些曾教導你正義美德的監護人，在一場無意義的小型搶劫中遭到殺害。雖然你繼承了他們的財富，但這完全無法減輕你因為無力阻止那場悲劇而感到的愧疚。你決定用這筆財富資助自己成為英雄，無論是以真實身分公開行動，還是以另一個身分隱藏行蹤。

heroes.background.career.aristocrat.inci.zh: 那些曾教導你正義美德的監護人，在一場無意義的小型搶劫中遭到殺害。雖然你繼承了他們的財富，但這完全無法減輕你因為無力阻止那場悲劇而感到的愧疚。你決定用這筆財富資助自己成為英雄，無論是以真實身分公開行動，還是以另一個身分隱藏行蹤。

fs.en: Inheritance
fs.zh: 繼承正義

heroes.background.career.aristocrat.inci.en: Life outside the manor never piqued your interest. You had everything you wanted. It thus came as a surprise when the peasants came to overthrow your family. You narrowly escaped, and for the first time witnessed the world. It caused you to become a hero for the people, fighting against inequities.

fs.en: Life outside the manor never piqued your interest. You had everything you wanted. It came as a surprise when the peasants came to overthrow your family. You narrowly escaped, and for the first time witnessed the world. It caused you to become a hero for the people, fighting against inequities.
fs.zh: 莊園外的生活從未吸引過你，你擁有一切想要的東西，生活無憂無慮。所以，當農民突然前來推翻你的家族時，你感到無比震驚。僥倖逃脫後，你首次看見了外面的世界。這次經歷徹底改變了你，讓你決定成為為人民而戰的英雄，致力對抗社會的不平等。

heroes.background.career.aristocrat.inci.zh: 莊園外的生活從未吸引過你，你擁有一切想要的東西，生活無憂無慮。所以，當農民突然前來推翻你的家族時，你感到無比震驚。僥倖逃脫後，你首次看見了外面的世界。這次經歷徹底改變了你，讓你決定成為為人民而戰的英雄，致力對抗社會的不平等。

fs.en: Privileged Position
fs.zh: 特權地位

heroes.background.career.aristocrat.inci.en: Seeking a break from noble duties, you sought a lookalike to switch identities with. It went so well that you made a habit of switching whenever you were bored. Unfortunately, your counterpart became so good at imitating you that they convinced all those around you that you were an impostor. You lost contact with your family, but now pursue a heroic path free of the pomp of your old life.

fs.en: Seeking a break from noble duties, you sought a lookalike to switch identities with. It went so well that you made a habit of switching whenever bored. Unfortunately, your counterpart became so good at imitating you that they convinced everyone you were an impostor. You lost contact with your family, but pursue a heroic path free of the pomp of your old life.
fs.zh: 你厭倦了貴族的職責，找到一位外貌相似的人交換身分。此舉效果極佳，你甚至養成了在無聊時就互換身分的習慣。不幸的是，替身的模仿技巧過於精湛，最終說服了所有人你才是冒牌貨。雖然與家人失去了聯繫，但你如今擺脫了過往生活的虛華，自由地追尋英雄之路。

heroes.background.career.aristocrat.inci.zh: 你厭倦了貴族的職責，找到一位外貌相似的人交換身分。此舉效果極佳，你甚至養成了在無聊時就互換身分的習慣。不幸的是，替身的模仿技巧過於精湛，最終說服了所有人你才是冒牌貨。雖然與家人失去了聯繫，但你如今擺脫了過往生活的虛華，自由地追尋英雄之路。

fs.en: Royal Pauper
fs.zh: 貴族乞丐

heroes.background.career.aristocrat.inci.en: One parent passed away when you were a baby and the other remarried years later. Then that parent died under suspicious circumstances. Their spouse ousted you, and you were banished (and possibly hunted). Rising from tragedy, you now seek to right the wrongs of the world.

fs.en: One parent passed away when you were a baby and the other remarried years later. Then that parent died under suspicious circumstances. Their spouse ousted you, and you were banished (and possibly hunted). Rising from tragedy, you now seek to right the wrongs of the world.
fs.zh: 你父母的其中一位在你嬰兒時期就去世了，另一位則在多年後再婚。隨後，那位生父（母）在可疑的情況下死亡。繼父（母）將你趕出家門（甚至追殺你）。你從這場悲劇中崛起，如今致力於糾正世界的不公。

heroes.background.career.aristocrat.inci.zh: 你父母的其中一位在你嬰兒時期就去世了，另一位則在多年後再婚。隨後，那位生父（母）在可疑的情況下死亡。繼父（母）將你趕出家門（甚至追殺你）。你從這場悲劇中崛起，如今致力於糾正世界的不公。

fs.en: Wicked Secret
fs.zh: 邪惡祕密

heroes.background.career.aristocrat.ques.en: How did you become an aristocrat?
What did you do to fill your days?
heroes.background.career.aristocrat.ques.zh: 你平時如何打發閒暇時光？

heroes.background.career.aristocrat.ques.en: Which aristocrats and people who worked for you were your best friends and greatest enemies?
heroes.background.career.aristocrat.ques.zh: 哪些貴族和曾為你工作的人，是你最親密的朋友或最大的敵人？

heroes.background.career.aristocrat.ques.en: What sentimental heirloom from your old estate do you carry, and what does it mean to you?
heroes.background.career.aristocrat.ques.zh: 你隨身攜帶了哪件來自舊莊園、具有紀念意義的傳家寶？它對你有什麼特殊意義？

heroes.background.career.artisan.benefit.en: Perk: One crafting perk (Quick Build: Area of Expertise.)
heroes.background.career.artisan.benefit.zh: 專長：1 項工藝類專長（速選：專業領域）。

heroes.background.career.artisan.benefit.en: Skills: Two skills from the crafting skill group (Quick Build: Blacksmithing, Carpentry.)
heroes.background.career.artisan.benefit.zh: 技能：從工藝類技能組選擇 2 項技能（速選：鍛造、木工）。

heroes.background.career.artisan.descrip.en: You made and sold useful wares.
heroes.background.career.artisan.descrip.zh: 你負責製作並販售實用的產品。

heroes.background.career.artisan.incitin.en: A great hero was a fan of the things you created and gave you a generous commission to create your best work for them. While working on this commission, you and the hero became close friends. The day you finished the work was the same day they disappeared. To honor their legacy, you took up the mantle of a hero with the intent of finishing your friend’s work.

fs.en: A great hero was a fan of the things you created, and gave you a generous commission to create your best work for them. While working on this commission, you and the hero became close friends. The day you finished the work was the same day they disappeared. To honor their legacy, you took up the mantle of a hero with the intent of finishing your friend’s work.
fs.zh: 一位偉大的英雄十分欣賞你的作品，並慷慨委託你為他打造最精湛的傑作。在製作過程中，你們建立了深厚的友誼。然而，就在你完成作品的那天，這位英雄突然消失了。為了紀念他的遺志，你決定披上英雄的斗篷，完成你朋友未竟的志業。

heroes.background.career.artisan.incitin.zh: 一位偉大的英雄十分欣賞你的作品，並慷慨委託你為他打造最精湛的傑作。在製作過程中，你們建立了深厚的友誼。然而，就在你完成作品的那天，這位英雄突然消失了。為了紀念他的遺志，你決定披上英雄的斗篷，完成你朋友未竟的志業。

fs.en: Continue the Work
fs.zh: 延續使命

heroes.background.career.artisan.incitin.en: As you traveled the road selling your wares, troll bandits attacked you. One of the bandits claimed an item belonging to someone precious to you—or perhaps claimed that person’s life—but the rest were driven off or slain by a group of heroes. Seeing the quick work those heroes made of the bandits inspired you to follow in their footsteps.

fs.en: As you traveled the road selling your wares, troll bandits attacked you. One of the bandits claimed an item belonging to someone precious to you - or perhaps claimed that person’s life - but the rest were driven off or slain by a group of heroes. Seeing the quick work these heroes made of the bandits inspired you to follow in their footsteps.
fs.zh: 當你在路上販售商品時，遭到醜魔盜匪襲擊。一名盜匪搶走了你珍視之人的物品（甚至奪取了那人的性命）。幸好，其餘盜匪被一群英雄擊退或擊斃。目睹這些英雄俐落地解決了盜匪，你深受鼓舞，決心追隨他們的腳步。

heroes.background.career.artisan.incitin.zh: 當你在路上販售商品時，遭到醜魔盜匪襲擊。一名盜匪搶走了你珍視之人的物品（甚至奪取了那人的性命）。幸好，其餘盜匪被一群英雄擊退或擊斃。目睹這些英雄俐落地解決了盜匪，你深受鼓舞，決心追隨他們的腳步。

fs.en: Inspired
fs.zh: 深受啟發

heroes.background.career.artisan.incitin.en: A criminal gang stole your goods and harmed a number of people who worked for you. You became a hero to prevent such indignities from being visited upon others, to seek revenge for the assault, or to find the thieves and get your stuff back.

fs.en: A criminal gang stole your goods and harmed a number of people who worked for you. You became a hero to prevent such indignities from being visited upon others, to seek revenge for the assault, or to find the thieves and get your stuff back.
fs.zh: 一夥犯罪團夥偷走了你的貨物，並傷害了許多為你工作的人。你決心成為英雄，可能是為了防止他人遭受相同的不幸、對這次襲擊展開復仇，或是找回被盜的物品。

heroes.background.career.artisan.incitin.zh: 一夥犯罪團夥偷走了你的貨物，並傷害了許多為你工作的人。你決心成為英雄，可能是為了防止他人遭受相同的不幸、對這次襲擊展開復仇，或是找回被盜的物品。

fs.en: Robbery
fs.zh: 搶劫

heroes.background.career.artisan.incitin.en: Your parents discouraged your artistic talents, instead trying to focus your passions on the family business. You refused to dim your spark and continued your work in secret. Enraged at discovering your disobedience, they sold your work to a traveling merchant. You left your hometown, seeking your lost art and encouraging others to live freely.

fs.en: Your parents discouraged your artistic talents, instead trying to focus your passions on the family business. You refused to dim your spark and continued your work in secret. Enraged at discovering your disobedience, they sold your work to a traveling merchant. You left your hometown, seeking your lost art and encouraging others to live freely.
fs.zh: 你的父母不支持你的藝術天賦，而是試圖讓你承接家族事業。你拒絕讓自己的創意之火熄滅，繼續在暗地裡創作。他們發現後勃然大怒，將你的作品賣給了一位旅行商人。你因此離開了家鄉，踏上尋回失落作品的旅程，同時鼓勵他人追求自由的生活。

heroes.background.career.artisan.incitin.zh: 你的父母不支持你的藝術天賦，而是試圖讓你承接家族事業。你拒絕讓自己的創意之火熄滅，繼續在暗地裡創作。他們發現後勃然大怒，將你的作品賣給了一位旅行商人。你因此離開了家鄉，踏上尋回失落作品的旅程，同時鼓勵他人追求自由的生活。

fs.en: Stolen Passions
fs.zh: 失竊熱情

heroes.background.career.artisan.incitin.en: A new patron commissioned some art, but on completion, they refused to pay you and claimed the work as their own. You were accused of plagiarism and run out of town. For you, heroics are about restoring your name and honor.

fs.en: A new patron commissioned some art, but on completion, they refused to pay you and claimed the work as their own. You were accused of plagiarism and run out of town. For you, heroics are about restoring your name and honor.
fs.zh: 一位新贊助人委託你製作藝術品，但作品完成後，對方卻拒絕付款，並聲稱這是他們自己的創作。你被誣告抄襲，被迫離開城鎮。對你來說，成為英雄就是為了重建自己的名譽。

heroes.background.career.artisan.incitin.zh: 一位新贊助人委託你製作藝術品，但作品完成後，對方卻拒絕付款，並聲稱這是他們自己的創作。你被誣告抄襲，被迫離開城鎮。對你來說，成為英雄就是為了重建自己的名譽。

fs.en: Tarnished Honor
fs.zh: 名譽蒙羞

heroes.background.career.artisan.incitin.en: You had great success that caused an unscrupulous rival to curse you. For a time, everything you tried to create turned to ruin. You broke the curse through adventuring, and in doing so, discovered a new joy and purpose that now defines you.

fs.en: You had great success that caused an unscrupulous rival to curse you. For a time, everything you tried to create turned to ruin. You broke the curse through adventuring, and in doing so discovered a new joy and purpose that now defines you.
fs.zh: 你曾取得巨大的成功，卻引來了一位無良對手的詛咒。在一段時間內，你創作的每件作品都變成垃圾。透過冒險旅程，你成功打破詛咒，並在這過程中發現新的喜悅與人生目標，而這些如今已成為你生命的核心。

heroes.background.career.artisan.incitin.zh: 你曾取得巨大的成功，卻引來了一位無良對手的詛咒。在一段時間內，你創作的每件作品都變成垃圾。透過冒險旅程，你成功打破詛咒，並在這過程中發現新的喜悅與人生目標，而這些如今已成為你生命的核心。

fs.en: Twisted Skill
fs.zh: 捲土重來

heroes.background.career.artisan.questio.zh: 你曾經製作過什麼產品？

heroes.background.career.artisan.questio.en: Was there any particular creation you were known for?
heroes.background.career.artisan.questio.zh: 你有沒有因為某項特別的創作而出名？

heroes.background.career.artisan.questio.en: Did you have a shop, or did you travel to sell your wares?
heroes.background.career.artisan.questio.zh: 你是否擁有自己的店鋪，還是四處旅行販售你的產品？

heroes.background.career.beggar.benefit..en: Perk: One interpersonal perk (Quick Build: Spot the Tell.)
heroes.background.career.beggar.benefit..zh: 專長：1 項交涉類專長（速選：發現破綻）。

heroes.background.career.beggar.benefit..en: Skills: The Rumors skill (from the lore skill group), plus one skill from the exploration group and one skill from the interpersonal group (Quick Build: Empathize, Endurance, Rumors.)
heroes.background.career.beggar.benefit..zh: 技能：獲得「傳聞」（學識類技能），另從探索類技能組及交涉類技能組各選擇 1 項技能（速選：共感、耐力、傳聞）。

heroes.background.career.beggar.descript.en: You lived by going to a tavern, crossroads, city street, or other busy area and begging passersby for money or food.
heroes.background.career.beggar.descript.zh: 你以前在酒館、十字路口、城市街道或其他人潮擁擠的地方，向路人乞討金錢或食物維生。

heroes.background.career.beggar.inciting.en: You were never content with your lot. Watching yet another friend fall to preventable circumstances was your last straw. You gathered up what little you had and set off to become a hero, determined to make real change for those society forgot.

fs.en: You were never content with your lot. Watching yet another friend fall to preventable circumstances was your last straw. You gathered up what little you had and set off to become a hero, determined to make real change for those society forgot.
fs.zh: 你從來都不安於現狀。看著又一位朋友因為本可避免的情況而倒下，這成了壓垮你的最後一根稻草。你收拾僅有的一點家當，踏上成為英雄的旅程，決心為那些被社會遺忘的人們帶來真正的改變。

heroes.background.career.beggar.inciting.zh: 你從來都不安於現狀。看著又一位朋友因為本可避免的情況而倒下，這成了壓垮你的最後一根稻草。你收拾僅有的一點家當，踏上成為英雄的旅程，決心為那些被社會遺忘的人們帶來真正的改變。

fs.en: Champion
fs.zh: 鬥士

heroes.background.career.beggar.inciting.en: Something killed the other beggars. It came in the night. You barely saw it, but what you did see of it wasn’t natural. You survived by hiding, or perhaps it simply passed you over for reasons unknown to you. It still haunts your nightmares, and you kill monsters so no one else has to experience such horrors.

fs.en: Something killed the other beggars. It came in the night. You barely saw it, but what you did see of it wasn’t natural. You survived by hiding, or perhaps it simply passed you over for reasons unknown to you. It still haunts your nightmares, and you kill monsters so no one else has to experience such horrors.
fs.zh: 某種東西在夜裡出現並殺死了其他乞丐。你幾乎沒見過它的真面目，但你知道它絕非自然之物。你靠躲藏活了下來，又或者它因為某個你不知道的原因而放過了你。那段恐怖經歷至今仍糾纏著你的夢境，所以你開始獵殺怪物，不讓他人經歷相同的恐怖。

heroes.background.career.beggar.inciting.zh: 某種東西在夜裡出現並殺死了其他乞丐。你幾乎沒見過它的真面目，但你知道它絕非自然之物。你靠躲藏活了下來，又或者它因為某個你不知道的原因而放過了你。那段恐怖經歷至今仍糾纏著你的夢境，所以你開始獵殺怪物，不讓他人經歷相同的恐怖。

fs.en: Night Terrors
fs.zh: 夜間恐懼

heroes.background.career.beggar.inciting.en: You ran afoul of the local watch by being in the wrong place when they were in a bad mood. A passing hero intervened on your behalf, shaming the guards into moving on, then gave you enough gold to get you back on your feet. Their kindness kindled a spark in you. You took the gold, bought some secondhand gear, and went to pay that hero’s kindness forward.

fs.en: You ran afoul of the local watch by being in the wrong place when they were in a bad mood. A passing hero intervened on your behalf, shaming the guards into moving on, then gave you enough gold to get you back on your feet. Their kindness kindled a spark in you. You took the gold, bought some secondhand gear, and went to pay that hero’s kindness forward.
fs.zh: 你在錯誤的時間出現在錯誤的地點，惹上了心情不好的當地警衛。一位路過的英雄挺身而出，讓那些警衛羞愧離開，並給了你足夠的金幣重新站起來。這份善良在你心中點燃了一絲火花，你拿著金幣買了些二手裝備，開始將那位英雄的善意傳遞下去。

heroes.background.career.beggar.inciting.zh: 你在錯誤的時間出現在錯誤的地點，惹上了心情不好的當地警衛。一位路過的英雄挺身而出，讓那些警衛羞愧離開，並給了你足夠的金幣重新站起來。這份善良在你心中點燃了一絲火花，你拿著金幣買了些二手裝備，開始將那位英雄的善意傳遞下去。

fs.en: One Good Deed
fs.zh: 一個善舉

heroes.background.career.beggar.inciting.en: No matter how far you’d fallen, there was one belonging you would never part with, no matter how much money it would bring you. When a pickpocket stole that object, you chased them until you were in a part of the city you no longer recognized. With a jolt, you realized you had no desire to return to your previous stomping grounds. You kept going, and you haven’t looked back.

fs.en: No matter how far you’d fallen, there was one belonging you would never part with, no matter how much money it would bring you. When a pickpocket stole it, you chased them until you were in a part of the city you no longer recognized. With a jolt, you realized you had no desire to return to your previous stomping grounds. You kept going, and you haven’t looked back.
fs.zh: 無論你窮困潦倒至何種境地，總有一件物品是你絕不願放棄的，不管它能換來多少金錢。所以，當一名扒手偷走了那件寶物，你一路追趕，來到了陌生的城市角落。突然間，你意識到自己不想再回到過去那個熟悉的地方。就這樣，你繼續前行，再也沒有回頭。

heroes.background.career.beggar.inciting.zh: 無論你窮困潦倒至何種境地，總有一件物品是你絕不願放棄的，不管它能換來多少金錢。所以，當一名扒手偷走了那件寶物，你一路追趕，來到了陌生的城市角落。突然間，你意識到自己不想再回到過去那個熟悉的地方。就這樣，你繼續前行，再也沒有回頭。

fs.en: Precious
fs.zh: 珍貴之物

heroes.background.career.beggar.inciting.en: A passerby dropped something in your cup. When you counted your day’s collections, you found a magic coin among the coppers. You knew immediately that it was special. When the other beggars—your friends, you thought—showed that they were ready to murder you for it, you killed several of them in self-defense before you fled, leaving behind the only semblance of community you had.

fs.en: A passerby dropped something in your cup. When you counted your day’s collections, you found a magic coin among the coppers. You knew immediately that it was special. When the other beggars - your friends, you thought - were ready to murder you for it, you killed several of them in self- defense before you fled, leaving behind the only semblance of community you had.
fs.zh: 一位路人往你的杯子扔了一些東西。當你清點當天的收入時，在一堆銅幣中發現了一枚魔法硬幣，你立刻感覺到它非比尋常。當其他乞丐（那些你曾視為朋友的人）展現出願意為這枚硬幣殺死你的意圖時，你被迫自衛，殺了其中幾人，然後逃離你唯一能感到歸屬感的社區。

heroes.background.career.beggar.inciting.zh: 一位路人往你的杯子扔了一些東西。當你清點當天的收入時，在一堆銅幣中發現了一枚魔法硬幣，你立刻感覺到它非比尋常。當其他乞丐（那些你曾視為朋友的人）展現出願意為這枚硬幣殺死你的意圖時，你被迫自衛，殺了其中幾人，然後逃離你唯一能感到歸屬感的社區。

fs.en: Strange Charity
fs.zh: 奇怪施捨

heroes.background.career.beggar.inciting.en: You witnessed something you weren’t meant to. Others would kill you if they knew, and they might be searching for you even now. You remain on the move, terrified of remaining in one place too long lest it all catch up to you. Perhaps if you make a big enough name for yourself, you can become untouchable and finally speak of what happened without fear.

fs.en: You saw something you weren’t meant to see. Others would kill you if they knew, and they might be searching for you even now. You remain on the move, terrified of remaining in one place too long lest it all catch up to you. Perhaps if you make a big enough name for yourself, you can become untouchable and can finally speak of what you saw without fear.
fs.zh: 你無意中目睹了不該看到的事情。若有人知道你看到什麼，他們會殺你滅口，而且現在可能正在追查你。你被迫不斷移動，擔心在一處停留太久會被追上。也許，如果你能為自己累積足夠響亮的名聲，你就能成為無人敢動的大人物，最終無所畏懼地揭露真相。

heroes.background.career.beggar.inciting.zh: 你無意中目睹了不該看到的事情。若有人知道你看到什麼，他們會殺你滅口，而且現在可能正在追查你。你被迫不斷移動，擔心在一處停留太久會被追上。也許，如果你能為自己累積足夠響亮的名聲，你就能成為無人敢動的大人物，最終無所畏懼地揭露真相。

fs.en: Witness
fs.zh: 目擊者

heroes.background.career.beggar.question.en: What unfortunate circumstances led you to become a beggar?
heroes.background.career.beggar.question.zh: 什麼不幸的際遇讓你淪為乞丐？
你通常在哪些地方乞討？

heroes.background.career.beggar.question.en: Who made sport out of bullying you?
heroes.background.career.beggar.question.zh: 誰曾經把欺負你當作娛樂？

heroes.background.career.beggar.question.en: Who showed you the most kindness?
heroes.background.career.beggar.question.zh: 誰對你展現過最多的善意？

heroes.background.career.criminal.benefi.en: Perk: One intrigue perk (Quick Build: Criminal Contacts.)
heroes.background.career.criminal.benefi.zh: 專長：1 項諜報類專長（速選：江湖人脈）。

heroes.background.career.criminal.benefi.en: Skills: The Criminal Underworld skill (from the lore skill group), plus two skills from the intrigue group (Quick Build: Criminal Underworld, Pick Lock, Pick Pocket.)
heroes.background.career.criminal.benefi.zh: 技能：獲得「江湖」（學識類技能），另從諜報類技能組選擇 2 項技能（速選：江湖、開鎖、扒竊）。

heroes.background.career.criminal.descri.en: You once worked as a bandit, insurgent, smuggler, outlaw, or even as an assassin.
heroes.background.career.criminal.descri.zh: 你曾是一名盜匪、叛亂分子、走私犯、亡命之徒，甚至是刺客。

heroes.background.career.criminal.inciti.en: You stole, smuggled, and sold antiquities. In your haste to make a quick sale, you didn’t fully vet a client and they subsequently robbed your warehouse. When the items you had stolen were taken from you, you realized the harm you had caused. Now you adventure to find those items you lost and return them to where they belong.

fs.en: You stole, smuggled, and sold antiquities. In your haste to make a quick sale, you didn’t fully vet a client and they subsequently robbed your warehouse. When the items you had stolen were taken from you, you realized the harm you had caused. Now you adventure to find those items you lost and return them where they belong.
fs.zh: 你曾偷竊、走私和販賣古董。在急於成交的情況下，你沒有徹底檢查某位客戶，結果他們洗劫了你的倉庫。當那些被你偷來的物品被奪走時，你終於意識到自己造成的傷害。為了找到那些寶物並將它們歸還原處，你踏上了冒險之路。

heroes.background.career.criminal.inciti.zh: 你曾偷竊、走私和販賣古董。在急於成交的情況下，你沒有徹底檢查某位客戶，結果他們洗劫了你的倉庫。當那些被你偷來的物品被奪走時，你終於意識到自己造成的傷害。為了找到那些寶物並將它們歸還原處，你踏上了冒險之路。

fs.en: Antiquity Procurement
fs.zh: 古董採購

heroes.background.career.criminal.inciti.en: The last criminal job you pulled led to the death of someone or the destruction of something you love. To make up for the loss you caused, you left your criminal ways behind and became a hero.

fs.en: The last criminal job you pulled led to the death of someone or the destruction of something you love. To make up for the loss you caused, you left your criminal ways behind and became a hero.
fs.zh: 你最後一次的犯罪行動導致某人死亡或毀掉你的珍愛之物。為了彌補這個損失，你放棄了犯罪生活，轉而成為英雄。

heroes.background.career.criminal.inciti.zh: 你最後一次的犯罪行動導致某人死亡或毀掉你的珍愛之物。為了彌補這個損失，你放棄了犯罪生活，轉而成為英雄。

fs.en: Atonement
fs.zh: 贖罪

heroes.background.career.criminal.inciti.en: You went to prison for your crimes and eventually escaped. An elderly priest took you in and shielded you from the law, convinced that your soul wasn’t corrupt. They never judged you for your past, speaking only of the future. Eventually, the priest died, imparting final words that inspired you to become a hero.

fs.en: You went to prison for your crimes and eventually escaped. An elderly priest took you in and shielded you from the law, convinced that your soul wasn’t corrupt. They never judged you for your past, speaking only of the future. Eventually, the priest died, imparting final words that inspired you to become a hero.
fs.zh: 你因罪入獄，最終逃脫。一位年邁的祭司收留了你，並保護你免受法律追捕，因為他深信你的靈魂未被腐化。他從來都不會因為你的過去評判你，只談論未來。最終，祭司去世，他的臨終遺言激勵了你成為一名英雄。

heroes.background.career.criminal.inciti.zh: 你因罪入獄，最終逃脫。一位年邁的祭司收留了你，並保護你免受法律追捕，因為他深信你的靈魂未被腐化。他從來都不會因為你的過去評判你，只談論未來。最終，祭司去世，他的臨終遺言激勵了你成為一名英雄。

fs.en: Friendly Priest
fs.zh: 友善神父

heroes.background.career.criminal.inciti.en: You spent years blackmailing and manipulating nobles for influence and wealth until a scheme went wrong. You were publicly exposed, and after a narrow escape, you reevaluated your life. Under a new identity, you work as a hero and hope no one looks at your past too closely.

fs.en: You spent years blackmailing and manipulating nobles for influence and wealth until a scheme went wrong. You were publicly exposed, and after a narrow escape, you reevaluated your life. Under a new identity, you work as a hero and hope no one looks at your past too closely.
fs.zh: 你曾花了數年時間勒索和操控貴族，獲取權勢與財富，直到一個計畫出了差錯。你的所作所為遭到公開揭露，在驚險逃脫後，你重新審視了自己的人生。現在，你以新的身分成為英雄，希望沒人會仔細追查你的過去。

heroes.background.career.criminal.inciti.zh: 你曾花了數年時間勒索和操控貴族，獲取權勢與財富，直到一個計畫出了差錯。你的所作所為遭到公開揭露，在驚險逃脫後，你重新審視了自己的人生。現在，你以新的身分成為英雄，希望沒人會仔細追查你的過去。

fs.en: Shadowed Influence
fs.zh: 陰影操縱

heroes.background.career.criminal.inciti.en: Stealing was a matter of survival for you and not what defined you—at least in your mind. But when your thieving actions led to innocent folk being harmed, you knew you could be better. You turned your back on your old life, though your old skills still come in handy.

fs.en: Stealing was a matter of survival for you and not what defined you - at least in your mind. But when your thieving actions lead to innocent folk being harmed, you knew you could be better. You turned your back on your old life, though your old skills come in handy.
fs.zh: 對你而言，偷竊只是生存手段，而非你的本質（至少在你心目中是如此）。然而，當你的竊盜行為傷害了無辜之人時，你很清楚自己能夠做得更好。你最終背棄了過去的生活，但你的舊技能仍然可以派上用場。

heroes.background.career.criminal.inciti.zh: 對你而言，偷竊只是生存手段，而非你的本質（至少在你心目中是如此）。然而，當你的竊盜行為傷害了無辜之人時，你很清楚自己能夠做得更好。你最終背棄了過去的生活，但你的舊技能仍然可以派上用場。

fs.en: Simply Survival
fs.zh: 純粹求生

heroes.background.career.criminal.inciti.en: When a tyrant rose to power in your homeland, they began cracking down on all criminals with deadly raids and public executions. The nature of the crime didn’t matter, with pickpockets and beggars made to kneel before the axe alongside murderers. After losing enough friends, you stood up and joined the resistance—not just against this tyrant, but against authoritarians anywhere.

fs.en: When a tyrant rose to power in your homeland, they began cracking down on all criminals with deadly raids and public executions. The nature of the crime didn’t matter - pickpockets and beggars were made to kneel before the axe alongside murderers. After losing enough friends, you stood up and joined the resistance - not just against this tyrant, but against authoritarians anywhere.
fs.zh: 當暴君在你的祖國掌權時，他開始以致命突襲和公開處決鎮壓所有罪犯。罪行輕重不再重要，扒手和乞丐與殺人兇手一樣被迫在斧頭前跪下。在失去太多朋友後，你挺身而出，加入了抵抗行動。你不只反抗這個暴君，更要對抗世界各地的獨裁者。

heroes.background.career.criminal.inciti.zh: 當暴君在你的祖國掌權時，他開始以致命突襲和公開處決鎮壓所有罪犯。罪行輕重不再重要，扒手和乞丐與殺人兇手一樣被迫在斧頭前跪下。在失去太多朋友後，你挺身而出，加入了抵抗行動。你不只反抗這個暴君，更要對抗世界各地的獨裁者。

fs.en: Stand Against Tyranny
fs.zh: 反抗暴政

heroes.background.career.criminal.questi.en: What crimes did you commit, and why?
heroes.background.career.criminal.questi.zh: 你犯下了什麼罪行？你為什麼要這麼做？

heroes.background.career.criminal.questi.en: Did anyone help you perform your illicit activities?
heroes.background.career.criminal.questi.zh: 有人協助你進行這些非法活動嗎？

heroes.background.career.criminal.questi.en: What is one crime you botched?
heroes.background.career.criminal.questi.zh: 你曾經搞砸過的一次犯罪是什麼？

heroes.background.career.criminal.questi.en: Who was your nemesis while you were a criminal?

heroes.background.career.disciple.benefi.en: Perk: One supernatural perk (Quick Build: Ritualist.)
heroes.background.career.disciple.benefi.zh: 專長：1 項超常類專長（速選：儀式師）。

heroes.background.career.disciple.benefi.en: Skills: The Religion skill (from the lore skill group), plus two more skills from the lore group (Quick Build: Culture, Magic, Religion.)
heroes.background.career.disciple.benefi.zh: 技能：獲得「宗教」（學識類技能），另從學識類技能組選擇 2 項其他技能（速選：文化、魔法、宗教）。

heroes.background.career.disciple.descri.en: You worked in a church, temple, or other religious institution as part of the clergy.
heroes.background.career.disciple.descri.zh: 你曾在教會、神殿或其他宗教機構中擔任神職人員。

heroes.background.career.disciple.inciti.en: Swayed by an evil faith, your cult was about to unleash horrors upon the world when an angel (figurative or literal) intervened. They convinced you to stop your cult’s plots. Now you follow in the footsteps of the angel who showed you the righteous path.

fs.en: Swayed by an evil faith, your cult was about to unleash horrors upon the world when an angel (figurative or literal) intervened. They convinced you to stop your cult’s efforts. Now you follow in the footsteps of the angel who showed you the righteous path.
fs.zh: 當你的教派被邪惡信仰誘惑，準備向世界釋放恐怖之物時，一位天使介入了（無論是比喻或實際的），並說服你阻止了邪教的陰謀。如今，你追隨著那位天使的腳步，走在正義的道路上。

heroes.background.career.disciple.inciti.zh: 當你的教派被邪惡信仰誘惑，準備向世界釋放恐怖之物時，一位天使介入了（無論是比喻或實際的），並說服你阻止了邪教的陰謀。如今，你追隨著那位天使的腳步，走在正義的道路上。

fs.en: Angel's Advocate
fs.zh: 天使信徒

heroes.background.career.disciple.inciti.en: Although you joined your religious institution under the guidance of a kind mentor, others within the house of worship became increasingly fanatical in their convictions. Your mentor sought to be a voice of reason in the rising tide of hatred and was tried as a heretic before being executed. Leaving the institution behind, you became a hero to uphold the beliefs you hold dear.

fs.en: Although you joined the religious institution under the guidance of a kind mentor, others within the house of worship became increasingly fanatical in their convictions. Your mentor sought to be a voice of reason in the rising tide of hatred and was tried as a heretic before being executed. Leaving the institution behind, you became a hero to uphold the beliefs you hold dear.
fs.zh: 你在一位善良導師的指引下加入了宗教機構，但隨著時間推移，教派內其他成員的信念變得越來越狂熱。當仇恨情緒日益高漲時，你的導師試圖以理性之聲勸說眾人，卻以異端罪名受審，隨後遭到處決。離開這個機構後，你成為了一名英雄，繼續堅守著你所珍視的信念。

heroes.background.career.disciple.inciti.zh: 你在一位善良導師的指引下加入了宗教機構，但隨著時間推移，教派內其他成員的信念變得越來越狂熱。當仇恨情緒日益高漲時，你的導師試圖以理性之聲勸說眾人，卻以異端罪名受審，隨後遭到處決。離開這個機構後，你成為了一名英雄，繼續堅守著你所珍視的信念。

fs.en: Dogma
fs.zh: 教條

heroes.background.career.disciple.inciti.en: Your temple was destroyed in a religious conflict. The institution’s leaders sought retaliation, but you saw in these actions a ceaseless cycle of destruction that would lead to more conflict. Instead, you became a hero to protect religious freedoms, so all worshippers might practice their faith without fear.

fs.en: Your temple was destroyed in a religious conflict. The institution’s leaders sought retaliation, but you saw in these actions a ceaseless cycle of destruction that would lead to more conflict. Instead, you became a hero to protect religious freedoms, so all worshipers could practice their faith without fear.
fs.zh: 你的神殿在一場宗教衝突中被摧毀。機構的領導者尋求報復，但你意識到這只會導致無盡的惡性循環，引發更多衝突。因此，你成為了英雄，致力保護宗教自由，讓所有信徒能夠無懼地實踐自己的信仰。

heroes.background.career.disciple.inciti.zh: 你的神殿在一場宗教衝突中被摧毀。機構的領導者尋求報復，但你意識到這只會導致無盡的惡性循環，引發更多衝突。因此，你成為了英雄，致力保護宗教自由，讓所有信徒能夠無懼地實踐自己的信仰。

fs.en: Freedom to Worship
fs.zh: 信仰自由

heroes.background.career.disciple.inciti.en: You devoted your life to ministering to the sick and needy, alongside other charitable work. Time and time again, tragedy struck those you served without rhyme or reason. Your prayers went unanswered, and your efforts went thankless. Eventually, you lost your faith in a higher power, and you left your church or temple to do good outside of any religious affiliation.

fs.en: You devoted your life to ministering to the sick and needy and other charitable work. Time and time again, tragedy struck those you served without rhyme or reason. Your prayers went unanswered, and your efforts went thankless. Eventually, you lost your faith in a higher power, and you left your church or temple to do good outside of any religious affiliation.
fs.zh: 你曾獻身於照料病患和窮人，並從事各種慈善工作。然而，災難卻一次又一次毫無理由地降臨在你服務的人們身上。你的祈禱始終無人回應，你的付出也從未獲得任何感謝。最終，你對神明的信仰逐漸消逝，於是離開了教會或神殿，決定在宗教組織之外繼續行善。

heroes.background.career.disciple.inciti.zh: 你曾獻身於照料病患和窮人，並從事各種慈善工作。然而，災難卻一次又一次毫無理由地降臨在你服務的人們身上。你的祈禱始終無人回應，你的付出也從未獲得任何感謝。最終，你對神明的信仰逐漸消逝，於是離開了教會或神殿，決定在宗教組織之外繼續行善。

fs.en: Lost Faith
fs.zh: 失去信仰

heroes.background.career.disciple.inciti.en: While serving at a religious institution, you almost died in an accident. When you woke, you had lost all memory of ever having worked for the church or temple. Though the clergy encouraged you to stay, you left to forge a new path. Your sense of altruism—whether instilled in you by your past work or a part of who you naturally are—guides you in your life.

fs.en: While serving at a religious institution, you almost died in an accident. When you woke, you had lost all memory of ever having worked for the church or temple. Though the clergy encouraged you to stay, you left to forge a new path. Your sense of altruism - whether instilled in you by your past work or a part of who you naturally are - guides you in your life.
fs.zh: 在宗教機構服務期間，你因為一場意外而幾乎喪命。醒來後，你完全忘記曾在教會或神殿工作的記憶。儘管神職人員勸你留下，你還是選擇離開，開創新的人生道路。然而，你的奉獻精神（無論是源自過去的工作，還是你與生俱來的本性）如今依然指引著你的生活。

heroes.background.career.disciple.inciti.zh: 在宗教機構服務期間，你因為一場意外而幾乎喪命。醒來後，你完全忘記曾在教會或神殿工作的記憶。儘管神職人員勸你留下，你還是選擇離開，開創新的人生道路。然而，你的奉獻精神（無論是源自過去的工作，還是你與生俱來的本性）如今依然指引著你的生活。

fs.en: Near-Death Experience
fs.zh: 瀕死體驗

heroes.background.career.disciple.inciti.en: The faith-based organization you were once part of became corrupt. It used its status in the community to accumulate wealth through tithes, while its leaders sought political appointments. During a season of drought, the institution stockpiled resources and refused to give aid, resulting in the deaths of many. You became a hero to fight against such corruption and to honor those you lost.

fs.en: The faith-based organization you were once part of became corrupt. It used its status in the community to accumulate wealth through tithes and its leaders sought political appointments. During a season of drought, the institution stockpiled resources and refused to give aid, resulting in the deaths of many. You became a hero to fight against such corruption and to honor your dearly departed.
fs.zh: 你曾經效力的宗教組織已經腐敗。領導者濫用自己在社區中的地位，透過收取什一奉獻來累積財富，積極謀求政治職位。在某次乾旱期間，該組織顧著囤積資源並拒絕提供援助，導致多人喪生。你挺身成為英雄，對抗這種腐敗之舉，並紀念那些逝去的生命。

heroes.background.career.disciple.inciti.zh: 你曾經效力的宗教組織已經腐敗。領導者濫用自己在社區中的地位，透過收取什一奉獻來累積財富，積極謀求政治職位。在某次乾旱期間，該組織顧著囤積資源並拒絕提供援助，導致多人喪生。你挺身成為英雄，對抗這種腐敗之舉，並紀念那些逝去的生命。

fs.en: Taxing Times
fs.zh: 苛捐雜稅

heroes.background.career.disciple.questi.en: What gods or saints did your institution venerate?
heroes.background.career.disciple.questi.zh: 你的機構崇拜哪些神明或聖者？

heroes.background.career.disciple.questi.en: What initiation rites did you undergo to get the job?
heroes.background.career.disciple.questi.zh: 你為了取得這份職務，經歷過哪些入門儀式？

heroes.background.career.disciple.questi.en: What were your responsibilities as a disciple?
heroes.background.career.disciple.questi.zh: 作為門徒，你的職責是什麼？

heroes.background.career.disciple.questi.en: How was your institution viewed by members of the local culture?
heroes.background.career.disciple.questi.zh: 當地人如何看待你所屬的宗教機構？

heroes.background.career.explorer.benefi.en: Perk: One exploration perk (Quick Build: Wood Wise.)
heroes.background.career.explorer.benefi.zh: 專長：1 項探索類專長（速選：林野智慧）。

heroes.background.career.explorer.benefi.en: Skills: The Navigate skill (from the exploration skill group), plus two more skills from the exploration group (Quick Build: Climb, Heal, Navigate.)
heroes.background.career.explorer.benefi.zh: 技能：獲得「導航」（探索類技能），另從探索類技能組選擇 2 項其他技能（速選：攀爬、醫療、導航）。

heroes.background.career.explorer.descri.en: You ventured into uncharted areas and made your living as a cartographer, researcher, resource seeker, or treasure hunter.
heroes.background.career.explorer.descri.zh: 你曾冒險前往未知區域，靠著繪製地圖、進行研究、尋找資源或寶藏為生。

heroes.background.career.explorer.inciti.en: In an uncharted area, you awakened some fell horror. You subsequently turned to the life of a hero to put an end to the dread you unleashed and keep other hidden dangers at bay.

fs.en: In an uncharted area, you awakened some dark horror. You have turned to the life of a hero to put an end to the horror you unleashed and keep other hidden dangers at bay.
fs.zh: 在一處未知區域，你意外喚醒了某種可怕的存在。此後，你踏上了英雄的道路，致力於終結你所釋放的恐怖，同時防範其他潛藏的危險。

heroes.background.career.explorer.inciti.zh: 在一處未知區域，你意外喚醒了某種可怕的存在。此後，你踏上了英雄的道路，致力於終結你所釋放的恐怖，同時防範其他潛藏的危險。

fs.en: Awakening
fs.zh: 甦醒

heroes.background.career.explorer.inciti.en: You made an important but dangerous discovery about a treasure or ancient ritual that could spell mass destruction. Then the unthinkable happened when an unscrupulous colleague, spy, or treasure hunter stole your research notes. You’re looking for the thief now, and anyone else who might use such discoveries for ill.

fs.en: You made an important but dangerous discovery about a treasure or ancient ritual that could spell mass destruction. Then the unthinkable happened when an unscrupulous colleague, spy, or treasure hunter stole your research notes. You’re looking for them now, and anyone else who might use such discoveries for ill.
fs.zh: 你發現了一個關於寶藏或古老儀式的重要線索，但這項發現十分危險，甚至可能引發大規模毀滅。然後，難以想像的事情發生了。一位不道德的同事、間諜或尋寶獵人偷走了你的研究筆記。現在你正在追尋這個竊賊，以及任何可能濫用這項發現的人。

heroes.background.career.explorer.inciti.zh: 你發現了一個關於寶藏或古老儀式的重要線索，但這項發現十分危險，甚至可能引發大規模毀滅。然後，難以想像的事情發生了。一位不道德的同事、間諜或尋寶獵人偷走了你的研究筆記。現在你正在追尋這個竊賊，以及任何可能濫用這項發現的人。

fs.en: Missing Piece
fs.zh: 遺失線索

heroes.background.career.explorer.inciti.en: Exploring distant lands to collect valuable artifacts for cultural institutions was once your way of life. But when people died trying to reclaim one of the objects you took, you realized the truth. Your work was part of a larger problem of cultural theft, and the best place for these significant objects wasn’t in a museum but with the people who created them. Setting out to return what had been taken and to protect others from theft set you on the path to become a hero.

fs.en: Traversing seas and mountains to collect valuable artifacts for cultural institutions was once your way of life. When people died trying to reclaim one of the objects you took, you realized the truth. Your work was part of a larger problem of misappropriation and the best place for these significant objects wasn’t in a museum but with the people who created them. You set out to return what had been taken and to protect others from theft.
fs.zh: 探索遙遠土地，並為文化機構收集珍貴文物曾是你的生活方式。然而，當人們為了奪回你帶走的一件物品而犧牲生命時，你領悟了真相，你的工作實際上是文化掠奪的一部分。這些重要物品的最佳歸屬並非博物館，而是創造它們的人民。你決心歸還被奪走之物，並保護他人免受竊盜，這段旅程引領你成為了一名英雄。

heroes.background.career.explorer.inciti.zh: 探索遙遠土地，並為文化機構收集珍貴文物曾是你的生活方式。然而，當人們為了奪回你帶走的一件物品而犧牲生命時，你領悟了真相，你的工作實際上是文化掠奪的一部分。這些重要物品的最佳歸屬並非博物館，而是創造它們的人民。你決心歸還被奪走之物，並保護他人免受竊盜，這段旅程引領你成為了一名英雄。

fs.en: Nothing Belongs in a Museum
fs.zh: 物歸原主

heroes.background.career.explorer.inciti.en: You delved into dungeons and far-off places by studying them in books. You were an explorer who never felt the need to experience the dangers your peers did. Then your theory about a lost world cost you your reputation, and gave you the impetus to go on adventures and stand up for those with different ideas.

fs.en: You delved into dungeons and far-off places by studying them in books. You were an explorer who never felt the need to experience the dangers your peers did. However, your theory about a lost world cost you your reputation. It gave you the impetus to go on adventures and stand up for those with different ideas.
fs.zh: 你只透過書本來研究地下城和遠方世界。作為一名探險家，你從來都不認為自己需要像同儕那樣親身體驗各種危險。然而，你提出的失落世界理論最終讓你聲譽掃地，但同時也給了你動力，促使你踏上真正的冒險之旅，並為那些抱持不同觀點的人挺身而出。

heroes.background.career.explorer.inciti.zh: 你只透過書本來研究地下城和遠方世界。作為一名探險家，你從來都不認為自己需要像同儕那樣親身體驗各種危險。然而，你提出的失落世界理論最終讓你聲譽掃地，但同時也給了你動力，促使你踏上真正的冒險之旅，並為那些抱持不同觀點的人挺身而出。

fs.en: Unschooled
fs.zh: 紙上談兵

heroes.background.career.explorer.inciti.en: You saw yourself as an observer and operated within a code of conduct. You swore to never interfere with a group by exposing them to your technology, knowledge, or values. But when faced with a moral conundrum, you either broke your code or stood idly by—and suffered the consequences. During this incident, you lost your observation journal but became a hero who refuses to let evil stand unchecked.

fs.en: You saw yourself as an observer and operated within a code of conduct. You swore to never interfere with a group by exposing them to your technology, knowledge, or values. When faced with a moral conundrum, you either broke your code or stood idly by - and suffered the consequences. During this incident, you lost your observation journal but became a hero who refuses to let evil stand unchecked.
fs.zh: 你將自己視為一名觀察者，嚴格遵循行為準則。你發誓絕不會展示自己的技術、知識或價值觀來干擾任何群體。然而，當面臨道德困境時，你要麼打破自己的原則，要麼袖手旁觀，而無論選擇哪一條路，都得承擔後果。在此事件中，你雖然失去了珍貴的觀察日誌，卻成為了一位堅決對抗邪惡的英雄。

heroes.background.career.explorer.inciti.zh: 你將自己視為一名觀察者，嚴格遵循行為準則。你發誓絕不會展示自己的技術、知識或價值觀來干擾任何群體。然而，當面臨道德困境時，你要麼打破自己的原則，要麼袖手旁觀，而無論選擇哪一條路，都得承擔後果。在此事件中，你雖然失去了珍貴的觀察日誌，卻成為了一位堅決對抗邪惡的英雄。

fs.en: Wanderlust
fs.zh: 流浪慾望

heroes.background.career.explorer.inciti.en: As a seafaring explorer, you lived to chart unknown courses. Though travel on the high seas was fraught with danger, the destination was always rewarding in riches, knowledge, or some other meaningful benefit. But your luck ran out when your ship was destroyed by pirates or other enemy forces. Now you’ve taken to protecting those who seek safe passage while also hoping to avenge your crew.

fs.en: As a seafaring explorer, you lived to chart unknown courses. Though travel on the high seas was fraught with danger, the destination was always rewarding in riches, knowledge, or some other way that was meaningful to you. Your luck ran out when your ship was destroyed by pirates or other enemy forces. You’ve taken to protecting those who seek safe passage while also hoping to avenge your crew.
fs.zh: 作為一名航海探險家，你活著就是為了繪製未知的航線。雖然公海航行充滿危險，但每個目的地都能帶來財富、知識或其他寶貴的收穫。不幸的是，當你的船被海盜或敵對勢力摧毀時，你的好運到此為止。如今，你不僅致力於保護尋求安全通行的人們，同時也希望為你的船員復仇。

heroes.background.career.explorer.inciti.zh: 作為一名航海探險家，你活著就是為了繪製未知的航線。雖然公海航行充滿危險，但每個目的地都能帶來財富、知識或其他寶貴的收穫。不幸的是，當你的船被海盜或敵對勢力摧毀時，你的好運到此為止。如今，你不僅致力於保護尋求安全通行的人們，同時也希望為你的船員復仇。

fs.en: Wind in your Sails
fs.zh: 乘風破浪

heroes.background.career.explorer.questi.en: For what purpose did you explore the unknown?
heroes.background.career.explorer.questi.zh: 讓你探索未知領域的動機是什麼？

heroes.background.career.explorer.questi.en: Who else was part of your exploration team?
heroes.background.career.explorer.questi.zh: 你的探險隊伍還有哪些成員？

heroes.background.career.explorer.questi.en: What types of environments did you explore?
heroes.background.career.explorer.questi.zh: 你探索過什麼類型的環境？

heroes.background.career.explorer.questi.en: What legend or rumor did you search for but never found?
heroes.background.career.explorer.questi.zh: 有什麼傳說或傳聞你一直在尋找卻從未發現？
你最偉大的發現是什麼？

heroes.background.career.farmer.benefit..en: Perk: One exploration perk (Quick Build: Monster Whisperer.)
heroes.background.career.farmer.benefit..zh: 專長：1 項探索類專長（速選：怪物溝通師）。

heroes.background.career.farmer.benefit..en: Skills: The Handle Animals skill (from the interpersonal skill group), plus two skills from the exploration group (Quick Build: Drive, Handle Animals, Lift.)
heroes.background.career.farmer.benefit..zh: 技能：獲得「馴獸」（交涉類技能），另從探索類技能組選擇 2 項技能（速選：駕駛、馴獸、舉重）。

heroes.background.career.farmer.descript.en: You grew crops or cared for livestock.
heroes.background.career.farmer.descript.zh: 你曾經以種植農作物或照顧牲畜為生。

heroes.background.career.farmer.inciting.en: A horrible blight swept over your homeland, sickening the livestock and causing crops to rot. No one knows whether the blight is of natural origin or something more malevolent, but you set out in search of a way to cleanse the land of this affliction.

fs.en: A horrible blight swept over your homeland, sickening the livestock and causing crops to rot. No one knows whether the blight is of natural origin or something more malevolent, but you set out in search of a way to cleanse the land of this affliction.
fs.zh: 一場可怕的疾病席捲你的家鄉，導致牲畜染病，農作物腐爛。沒有人知道這場瘟疫是自然現象，還是某種更為惡毒的東西，但你已經踏上旅程，尋找淨化這片土地的方法。

heroes.background.career.farmer.inciting.zh: 一場可怕的疾病席捲你的家鄉，導致牲畜染病，農作物腐爛。沒有人知道這場瘟疫是自然現象，還是某種更為惡毒的東西，但你已經踏上旅程，尋找淨化這片土地的方法。

fs.en: Blight
fs.zh: 瘟疫

heroes.background.career.farmer.inciting.en: You’ve always wanted so much more than gathering eggs and milking cows. You kept a secret journal of your dreams, filled with all the things you wanted. When your parent found the journal, they burned it and told you to keep your head out of the clouds. In response, you gathered what you could in a pack and left everything else behind, seeking a life of adventure.

fs.en: You’ve always wanted so much more than gathering eggs and milking cows. You kept a secret journal of your dreams, filled with all the things you wanted. When your parent found the journal, they burned it and told you to keep your head out of the clouds. In response, you gathered what you could in a pack and left everything else behind, seeking a life of adventure.
fs.zh: 你渴望的生活遠遠不只是收集雞蛋和擠牛奶。你偷偷寫了一本夢想日記，記錄著所有你嚮往的事物。當父親或母親發現這本日記時，便將它付之一炬，並告訴你別做白日夢。於是，你收拾了能帶走的物品，拋下了其他的一切，踏上追尋冒險生活的旅程。

heroes.background.career.farmer.inciting.zh: 你渴望的生活遠遠不只是收集雞蛋和擠牛奶。你偷偷寫了一本夢想日記，記錄著所有你嚮往的事物。當父親或母親發現這本日記時，便將它付之一炬，並告訴你別做白日夢。於是，你收拾了能帶走的物品，拋下了其他的一切，踏上追尋冒險生活的旅程。

fs.en: Bored
fs.zh: 無聊

heroes.background.career.farmer.inciting.en: While tilling your fields, you found something in the dirt. Perhaps it was a chipped and dented weapon, a piece of ancient jewelry, or something altogether unique. Excited by your find, you showed it to a loved one, but when they touched it, something happened. You now know it was a curse conveyed by the item, though you don’t know why it affected them and not you. You left your old life in search of answers.

fs.en: While tilling your fields, you found something in the dirt. Perhaps it was a chipped and dented weapon, a piece of ancient jewelry, or something altogether unique. Excited by your find, you showed it to a loved one, but when they touched it, something happened. You now know it was a curse conveyed by the item, though you don’t know why it affected them and not you. You left your old life in search of answers.
fs.zh: 在耕種田地時，你在泥土中發現了某樣東西。也許是一把有缺口又凹陷的武器、一件古老的珠寶，或是某種完全獨特的物品。你興奮地將發現展示給一位你珍視的人，但當對方碰觸它時，意外發生了。如今，你明白那是物品傳遞的詛咒，卻不知為何它影響了對方，而不是你自己。為了尋找答案，你離開了過去的生活。

heroes.background.career.farmer.inciting.zh: 在耕種田地時，你在泥土中發現了某樣東西。也許是一把有缺口又凹陷的武器、一件古老的珠寶，或是某種完全獨特的物品。你興奮地將發現展示給一位你珍視的人，但當對方碰觸它時，意外發生了。如今，你明白那是物品傳遞的詛咒，卻不知為何它影響了對方，而不是你自己。為了尋找答案，你離開了過去的生活。

fs.en: Cursed
fs.zh: 詛咒

heroes.background.career.farmer.inciting.en: Your farm had always been prosperous, until the last few years. Changes in the weather caused smaller yields until you could no longer pay your tithe to the local noble. Her soldiers took what items of value they found, including a precious family heirloom. You left the struggling farm behind to find a better life.

fs.en: Your farm had always been prosperous, until the last few years. Changes in the weather caused smaller yields until you could no longer pay your tithe to the local noble. Her soldiers took what items of value they found, including a precious family heirloom. You left the struggling farm behind to find a better life.
fs.zh: 你的農場曾經繁榮興盛，直到近年情況急轉直下。氣候變化導致收成逐年減少，最終你無法向當地貴族繳納什一稅。她派來的士兵拿走了能找到的值錢物品，甚至奪走了你珍貴的傳家寶。面對這般窘境，你決定離開經營困難的農場，尋找更好的生活。

heroes.background.career.farmer.inciting.zh: 你的農場曾經繁榮興盛，直到近年情況急轉直下。氣候變化導致收成逐年減少，最終你無法向當地貴族繳納什一稅。她派來的士兵拿走了能找到的值錢物品，甚至奪走了你珍貴的傳家寶。面對這般窘境，你決定離開經營困難的農場，尋找更好的生活。

fs.en: Hard Times
fs.zh: 艱難時期

heroes.background.career.farmer.inciting.en: Your animals were killed, your crops and home set ablaze. The culprits might have been wandering bandits, raiders from a nearby kingdom, or hired thugs sent by a rival farm. Whoever they were, they left you with nothing. You couldn’t face the thought of starting again from scratch, so you took up a life of heroism to protect others from such villainy.

fs.en: Your animals were killed, your crops and home set ablaze. The culprits might have been wandering bandits, raiders from a nearby kingdom, or hired thugs sent by a rival farm. Whoever they were, they left you with nothing. You couldn’t face the thought of starting again from scratch, so you took up a life of heroism to protect others from such villainy.
fs.zh: 你的牲畜慘遭屠殺，農作物與家園被大火吞噬。兇手可能是流浪盜匪、鄰國掠奪者，或競爭農場雇用的打手。無論他們是誰，你已一無所有。你放棄了重新開始的想法，選擇了英雄之路，保護他人免受類似的惡行侵害。

heroes.background.career.farmer.inciting.zh: 你的牲畜慘遭屠殺，農作物與家園被大火吞噬。兇手可能是流浪盜匪、鄰國掠奪者，或競爭農場雇用的打手。無論他們是誰，你已一無所有。你放棄了重新開始的想法，選擇了英雄之路，保護他人免受類似的惡行侵害。

fs.en: Razed
fs.zh: 惡意破壞

heroes.background.career.farmer.inciting.en: Your family bred horses—beautiful creatures that few could rival on the track and in the jousting lists. When a local noble arrived with an offer to buy your prized stallion, your father refused. The noble struck him down where he stood and stole the horse. Without that stallion, the renowned bloodline would end. You intend to get them back—and get revenge.

fs.en: Your family bred horses - beautiful creatures that few could rival on the track and in the jousting lists. When a local noble arrived with an offer to buy your prized stallion, your father refused. The noble struck him down where he stood and stole the horse. Without that stallion, the renowned bloodline would end. You intend to get them back - and get revenge.
fs.zh: 你的家族以飼養馬匹為業，這些俊美的生物在賽道和比武場上幾乎無人能敵。當一位地方貴族前來提議收購你家珍貴的種馬時，你的父親斷然拒絕。那名貴族憤怒地將他當場殺害，並強行奪走那匹種馬。失去這匹種馬，你家族那著名的馬匹血統將會斷絕。你決心奪回馬匹，同時為父親報仇雪恨。

heroes.background.career.farmer.inciting.zh: 你的家族以飼養馬匹為業，這些俊美的生物在賽道和比武場上幾乎無人能敵。當一位地方貴族前來提議收購你家珍貴的種馬時，你的父親斷然拒絕。那名貴族憤怒地將他當場殺害，並強行奪走那匹種馬。失去這匹種馬，你家族那著名的馬匹血統將會斷絕。你決心奪回馬匹，同時為父親報仇雪恨。

fs.en: Stolen
fs.zh: 遭竊

heroes.background.career.farmer.question.en: Did you own the land you farmed, or did you farm for another?
heroes.background.career.farmer.question.zh: 你擁有自己耕種的土地，還是為他人耕作？

heroes.background.career.farmer.question.en: What crops or livestock did you cultivate?
heroes.background.career.farmer.question.zh: 你培育了哪些農作物，或飼養了什麼牲畜？

heroes.background.career.farmer.question.en: Who else worked on the farm with you?
heroes.background.career.farmer.question.zh: 誰與你一起在農場工作？

heroes.background.career.farmer.question.en: What ill omen did you witness that caused you to have a poor season of farming?
heroes.background.career.farmer.question.zh: 你曾目睹什麼不祥之兆，導致你經歷了糟糕的農耕季節？

heroes.background.career.gladiator.benef.en: Perk: One exploration perk (Quick Build: Friend Catapult.)
heroes.background.career.gladiator.benef.zh: 專長：1 項探索類專長（速選：投擲盟友）。

heroes.background.career.gladiator.benef.en: Skills: Two skills from the exploration skill group (Quick Build: Gymnastics, Jump.)
heroes.background.career.gladiator.benef.zh: 技能：從探索類技能組選擇 2 項技能（速選：體操、跳躍）。

heroes.background.career.gladiator.descr.en: In the past, you entertained the masses with flashy displays of violence in the arena.
heroes.background.career.gladiator.descr.zh: 你曾經以華麗的暴力表演在競技場中娛樂大眾。

heroes.background.career.gladiator.incit.en: A local crime lord offered you money to throw your last bout, promising that you’d live through the ordeal and get a cut of all the wagers placed on the match. You upheld your end of the deal—which made the knife in your back after the bout so surprising. You woke in a shallow grave, barely alive, and ready to mete out justice.

fs.en: A local crime lord offered you money to throw your last bout, promising that you’d live through the ordeal and get a cut of all the wagers placed on the match. You upheld your end of the deal - which made the knife in your back after the bout so surprising. You woke in a shallow grave, barely alive, and ready to mete out justice.
fs.zh: 一位當地的犯罪頭目給你一筆錢，要你放水輸掉最後一場比賽，承諾你能安然無恙並從所有賭注中分得一杯羹。你履行了承諾，卻在比賽後被人從背後捅了一刀。你從隨便亂挖的墳塚中醒來，奄奄一息，決心要討回公道。

heroes.background.career.gladiator.incit.zh: 一位當地的犯罪頭目給你一筆錢，要你放水輸掉最後一場比賽，承諾你能安然無恙並從所有賭注中分得一杯羹。你履行了承諾，卻在比賽後被人從背後捅了一刀。你從隨便亂挖的墳塚中醒來，奄奄一息，決心要討回公道。

fs.en: Betrayed
fs.zh: 背叛

heroes.background.career.gladiator.incit.en: As you stood victorious on the arena sands, a voice cried out among the cheering. “This violence is only for show. You should be ashamed. There are people who need you—who need your skills!” Why did that voice ring so clear? And why did it sound so familiar? You never saw the face of the person who uttered those words, but they weighed heavy on you. The next day, you fled the arena to begin a hero’s life.

fs.en: As you stood victorious on the arena sands, a voice cried out among the cheering. “This violence is just for show. You should be ashamed. There are people who need you - who need your skills!” Why did that voice ring so clear? And why did it sound so familiar? You never saw the face of the person who uttered those words, but they weighed heavy on you. The next day, you fled the arena to begin a hero’s life.
fs.zh: 當你以勝利者之姿站在競技場的沙地上時，一個聲音從歡呼聲中響起：「這暴力不過是場表演。你應該感到羞恥！有人需要你，需要你的武藝！」為何那聲音如此清晰？為何它聽起來如此熟悉？你從未見過說那些話的人，但那些話深埋在你的心中。隔天，你逃離了競技場，展開了英雄的生涯。

heroes.background.career.gladiator.incit.zh: 當你以勝利者之姿站在競技場的沙地上時，一個聲音從歡呼聲中響起：「這暴力不過是場表演。你應該感到羞恥！有人需要你，需要你的武藝！」為何那聲音如此清晰？為何它聽起來如此熟悉？你從未見過說那些話的人，但那些話深埋在你的心中。隔天，你逃離了競技場，展開了英雄的生涯。

fs.en: Heckler
fs.zh: 挑釁

heroes.background.career.gladiator.incit.en: As a child, you loved gladiatorial matches, captivated by the fierce displays of bravery and bravado, never giving much thought to how the competitors ended up in the ring. Then your friend was wrongly accused of a crime and sentenced to compete. You went in their place. After viewing what life was like for those forced to fight, you survived your sentence and resolved to protect the unfairly condemned.

fs.en: As a child, you loved gladiatorial matches, captivated by the fierce displays of showmanship, never giving much thought to how the competitors ended up in the ring. Then your friend was wrongly accused of a crime and sentenced to compete. You went in their place.
