After viewing what life was like for those forced to fight, you survived your sentence and resolved to protect the unfairly condemned.
fs.zh: 小時候，你熱愛角鬥士比賽，被那些勇敢和豪邁的激烈表演所吸引，卻從未思考過參賽者如何走上角鬥場。後來，你的朋友被錯誤指控犯罪並被判處參賽，而你挺身替他上場。在親眼目睹那些戰士被迫戰鬥的生活後，你熬過了刑期，並發誓要保護那些被誣陷判罪的人。

heroes.background.career.gladiator.incit.zh: 小時候，你熱愛角鬥士比賽，被那些勇敢和豪邁的激烈表演所吸引，卻從未思考過參賽者如何走上角鬥場。後來，你的朋友被錯誤指控犯罪並被判處參賽，而你挺身替他上場。在親眼目睹那些戰士被迫戰鬥的生活後，你熬過了刑期，並發誓要保護那些被誣陷判罪的人。

fs.en: Joined the Arena
fs.zh: 加入競技場

heroes.background.career.gladiator.incit.en: You earned every title you could. You beat every opponent willing to face you in the arena. Your final battle with your rival ended with you victorious—and still you were unsatisfied. Other, greater foes are out there. And you mean to find them.

fs.en: You earned every title you could. You beat every opponent willing to face you in the arena. Your final battle with your rival ended with you victorious - and still you were unsatisfied. There are other, greater foes out there - and you mean to find them.
fs.zh: 你已贏得所有可能獲得的頭銜，打敗了每一位願意在競技場上與你交鋒的對手。與宿敵的最終決戰也以你的勝利告終，然而你依然感到不滿足。你知道外面還有更強大的敵人存在，而你決心要找到他們。

heroes.background.career.gladiator.incit.zh: 你已贏得所有可能獲得的頭銜，打敗了每一位願意在競技場上與你交鋒的對手。與宿敵的最終決戰也以你的勝利告終，然而你依然感到不滿足。你知道外面還有更強大的敵人存在，而你決心要找到他們。

fs.en: New Challenges
fs.zh: 全新挑戰

heroes.background.career.gladiator.incit.en: You were born a noble, but the duplicitous and power-hungry nature of your family had you seeking your own fortune in the arena. You saw that competitors brought there by circumstance and not choice suffered. You gave all you could of your family money to those lessfortunate folk, and then set out to make a real difference in this cruel world.

fs.en: You were born a noble, but the duplicitous and power-hungry nature of your family had you seeking your own fortune in the arena. You saw that competitors brought there by circumstance and not choice suffered. You gave all you could of your family money to those less fortunate folk and then set out to make a real difference in this cruel world.
fs.zh: 你出身貴族，但家族中充滿詭計和權力爭奪，讓你決定在競技場上尋求自己的命運。你目睹那些被迫參賽的人所遭受的痛苦。你將家族財富盡可能地分給這些不幸之人，然後踏上旅程，決心在這個殘酷的世界中創造真正的改變。

heroes.background.career.gladiator.incit.zh: 你出身貴族，但家族中充滿詭計和權力爭奪，讓你決定在競技場上尋求自己的命運。你目睹那些被迫參賽的人所遭受的痛苦。你將家族財富盡可能地分給這些不幸之人，然後踏上旅程，決心在這個殘酷的世界中創造真正的改變。

fs.en: Scion's Compassion
fs.zh: 貴族憐憫

heroes.background.career.gladiator.incit.en: The orphanage you grew up in secretly supplied gladiators to the arena. Forced to fight against many childhood friends as an adult, you vowed to dismantle the arena and free other victims. You became a liberator, dedicated to ending the oppression of others until your dying breath.

fs.en: The orphanage you grew up in secretly supplied gladiators to the arena. Forced to fight against many childhood friends as an adult, you vowed to dismantle the arena and free other victims. You became a liberator, dedicating to ending the oppression of others until your dying breath.
fs.zh: 你從小住的孤兒院暗中向競技場輸送角鬥士。成年後，你被迫與童年好友在場上廝殺，這段經歷讓你立誓摧毀競技場並解救其他受害者。從此，你成為一名解放者，立志終結他人所受的壓迫，直到生命的最後一刻。

heroes.background.career.gladiator.incit.zh: 你從小住的孤兒院暗中向競技場輸送角鬥士。成年後，你被迫與童年好友在場上廝殺，這段經歷讓你立誓摧毀競技場並解救其他受害者。從此，你成為一名解放者，立志終結他人所受的壓迫，直到生命的最後一刻。

fs.en: Warrior's Home
fs.zh: 戰士之家

heroes.background.career.gladiator.quest.en: What led you to this life of violent entertainment?
heroes.background.career.gladiator.quest.zh: 是什麼原因讓你走上暴力娛樂這條路？

heroes.background.career.gladiator.quest.en: What was your gladiator name and persona?
heroes.background.career.gladiator.quest.zh: 你的角鬥士名號和形象是什麼？

heroes.background.career.gladiator.quest.en: What happened during your most famous match?
heroes.background.career.gladiator.quest.zh: 在你最著名的比賽中發生了什麼事？

heroes.background.career.laborer.benefit.en: Perk: One exploration perk (Quick Build: Brawny.)
heroes.background.career.laborer.benefit.zh: 專長：1 項探索類專長（速選：肌肉發達）。

heroes.background.career.laborer.benefit.en: Skills: The Endurance skill (from the exploration skill group), plus two skills from either the crafting group or the exploration group (Quick Build: Blacksmithing, Endurance, Lift.)
heroes.background.career.laborer.benefit.zh: 技能：獲得「耐力」（探索類技能），另從工藝類或探索類技能組選擇 2 項技能（速選：鍛造、耐力、舉重）。

heroes.background.career.laborer.descrip.en: You worked as a farmer, builder, clothes washer, forester, miner, or some other profession engaged in hard manual labor.
heroes.background.career.laborer.descrip.zh: 你曾經擔任農夫、建築工人、洗衣工、林務員、礦工或其他需要繁重體力勞動的職業。

heroes.background.career.laborer.incitin.en: Spending your days cleaning and maintaining the sewers doesn’t make you many friends. But you found companionship among the rats. You fought the monsters that hunted your friends, and which others ignored. After making the sewers safe for the rats, you decided to take your talents to the surface and serve other humanoids who might appreciate your efforts in the same way.

fs.en: Spending your days cleaning and maintaining the sewers doesn’t make you many friends. But you found friendship among the rats. You fought the monsters that hunted your friends, and which everyone else ignored. After making the sewers safe for the rats, you decided to take your talents to the surface and serve other humanoids who might appreciate your efforts in the same way.
fs.zh: 在清潔和維護下水道的工作並沒有為你贏得多少朋友，但是你在老鼠群中建立了深刻的友誼。你勇敢對抗那些獵殺你朋友的怪物，儘管其他人對這些怪物視而不見。成功為老鼠們打造安全的下水道環境後，你決定將這份才華帶到地面上，為其他可能同樣感激你付出的類人生物服務。

heroes.background.career.laborer.incitin.zh: 在清潔和維護下水道的工作並沒有為你贏得多少朋友，但是你在老鼠群中建立了深刻的友誼。你勇敢對抗那些獵殺你朋友的怪物，儘管其他人對這些怪物視而不見。成功為老鼠們打造安全的下水道環境後，你決定將這份才華帶到地面上，為其他可能同樣感激你付出的類人生物服務。

fs.en: Deep Sentinel
fs.zh: 地底哨兵

heroes.background.career.laborer.incitin.en: A disaster, such as a cave-in, wildfire, or tidal wave, hit the work crew you were in charge of. You saved as many as you could, but the ones you couldn’t save weigh heavily on your mind. You took up the life of a hero to save as many people as possible, vowing that what happened to you then won’t happen again.

fs.en: A disaster, such as a cave-in, wildfire, or tidal wave, hit your crew while you were working. You saved as many as you could, but the ones you couldn’t save weigh heavily on your mind. You took up the life of a hero to save as many people as possible, vowing that what happened to you won’t happen again.
fs.zh: 你負責帶領的工作隊伍遭遇了一場災難，例如塌方、野火或海嘯。你救了許多人，但不是所有人，那些死者在你心中留下了沉重的負擔。因此，你選擇了英雄的道路，立志拯救更多生命，並發誓不讓這樣的悲劇再次發生。

heroes.background.career.laborer.incitin.zh: 你負責帶領的工作隊伍遭遇了一場災難，例如塌方、野火或海嘯。你救了許多人，但不是所有人，那些死者在你心中留下了沉重的負擔。因此，你選擇了英雄的道路，立志拯救更多生命，並發誓不讓這樣的悲劇再次發生。

fs.en: Disaster
fs.zh: 災難

heroes.background.career.laborer.incitin.en: A noble you worked for admonished you publicly for work done poorly—and more than once. Finally, you’d had enough. You vowed to take up a new path and show this noble you’re far more than what they make you out to be.

fs.en: A noble you worked for admonished you publicly for work done poorly - and more than once. Finally, you’d had enough. You vowed to take up a new path and show this noble you’re far more than what they make you out to be.
fs.zh: 你服務的貴族曾多次在公開場合指責你的工作表現不佳。最終，你無法再忍受這種羞辱。你決心走上嶄新的道路，向這位貴族證明你的價值遠超過他們的輕視。

heroes.background.career.laborer.incitin.zh: 你服務的貴族曾多次在公開場合指責你的工作表現不佳。最終，你無法再忍受這種羞辱。你決心走上嶄新的道路，向這位貴族證明你的價值遠超過他們的輕視。

fs.en: Embarrassment
fs.zh: 尷尬經歷

heroes.background.career.laborer.incitin.en: You worked with a good friend, and on the job, you would always fantasize about what it would be like to hit the road as adventuring heroes … someday. You didn’t expect that your friend would fall ill and pass away. Now it’s time to live out that dream for both of you.

fs.en: You worked with a good friend, and on the job, you would always fantasize about what it would be like to hit the road as adventuring heroes … someday. You didn’t count on your friend falling ill and passing away. Now it’s time to live out that dream for both of you.
fs.zh: 你和一位好朋友一起工作。在工作期間，你們總是幻想著有朝一日能夠踏上英雄之路。你沒想到的是，朋友會突然病倒並離世。現在，是時候為你們兩人實現那個共同的夢想了。

heroes.background.career.laborer.incitin.zh: 你和一位好朋友一起工作。在工作期間，你們總是幻想著有朝一日能夠踏上英雄之路。你沒想到的是，朋友會突然病倒並離世。現在，是時候為你們兩人實現那個共同的夢想了。

fs.en: Live the Dream
fs.zh: 實現夢想

heroes.background.career.laborer.incitin.en: You kept a lighthouse along the constantly stormy cliffs of your village with your mentor. On a clear and sunny day, your mentor vanished. Finding only a cryptic notebook filled with his musings on the supernatural, you left to find out what really happened. The trail has gone cold for now, and you’re helping others find their loved ones in the meantime.

fs.en: You kept a lighthouse along the constantly stormy cliffs of your village with your mentor. On a clear and sunny day, your mentor vanished. Finding only a cryptic notebook filled with his musings on the supernatural, you left to find what really what happened. The trail has gone cold for now, and you’re helping others find their loved ones in the meantime.
fs.zh: 你與你的導師共同守護著村莊懸崖上的燈塔，那裡常年風暴肆虐。在一個難得晴朗的日子，你的導師神祕失蹤了。你只找到一本筆記本，上面記錄著他對超自然現象的思考，所以你決定離開家鄉尋找真相。然而，目前追查導師下落的線索已經中斷，在此期間，你也會幫助其他人尋找失蹤的親友。

heroes.background.career.laborer.incitin.zh: 你與你的導師共同守護著村莊懸崖上的燈塔，那裡常年風暴肆虐。在一個難得晴朗的日子，你的導師神祕失蹤了。你只找到一本筆記本，上面記錄著他對超自然現象的思考，所以你決定離開家鄉尋找真相。然而，目前追查導師下落的線索已經中斷，在此期間，你也會幫助其他人尋找失蹤的親友。

fs.en: Shining Light
fs.zh: 光明燈塔

heroes.background.career.laborer.incitin.en: You labored silently as an uncaring boss drove those around you into the ground, pushing you to work harder to lessen the burden on your companions. But when the boss pushed too far and killed a friend of yours, you led an uprising against them. That was the start of your adventuring life.

fs.en: You labored silently as an uncaring boss drove those around you into the ground, pushing you to work harder to lessen the burden on your companions. But when the boss pushed too far and killed a friend of yours, you led an uprising against them. That was the start of your adventuring life.
fs.zh: 你默默忍受著你的工作，而那位冷漠的老闆不斷壓榨你周圍的同事，迫使你更加努力工作來減輕同伴的負擔。當老闆過度施壓導致你的一位朋友喪命時，你最終帶領眾人起身反抗。這起事件成為了你冒險生涯的起點。

heroes.background.career.laborer.incitin.zh: 你默默忍受著你的工作，而那位冷漠的老闆不斷壓榨你周圍的同事，迫使你更加努力工作來減輕同伴的負擔。當老闆過度施壓導致你的一位朋友喪命時，你最終帶領眾人起身反抗。這起事件成為了你冒險生涯的起點。

fs.en: Slow and Steady
fs.zh: 緩慢而堅定

heroes.background.career.laborer.questio.en: What type of manual labor did you do?
heroes.background.career.laborer.questio.zh: 你從事過哪種類型的體力勞動？

heroes.background.career.laborer.questio.en: What important friendship did you make on the job?
heroes.background.career.laborer.questio.zh: 你在工作中建立了什麼重要的友誼？

heroes.background.career.laborer.questio.en: Where did you go with your coworkers to blow off steam when the job was done?
heroes.background.career.laborer.questio.zh: 工作結束後，你和同事通常會去哪裡放鬆紓壓？

heroes.background.career.laborer.questio.en: What aspect of the job was most difficult for you?
heroes.background.career.laborer.questio.zh: 在這份工作中，哪方面對你來說最具挑戰性？

heroes.background.career.mages-apprentic.en: Languages: One language
heroes.background.career.mages-apprentic.zh: 語言：1 種語言

heroes.background.career.mages-apprentic.en: Perk: One supernatural perk (Quick Build: Arcane Trick.)
heroes.background.career.mages-apprentic.zh: 專長：1 項超常類專長（速選：奧術戲法）。

heroes.background.career.mages-apprentic.en: Renown: +1
heroes.background.career.mages-apprentic.zh: 聲望：+1

heroes.background.career.mages-apprentic.en: Skills: The Magic skill (from the lore skill group), plus two other skills from the lore group (Quick Build: Magic, Monsters, Timescape.)
heroes.background.career.mages-apprentic.zh: 技能：獲得「魔法」（學識類技能），另從學識類技能組選擇 2 項其他技能（速選：魔法、怪物、時界）。

heroes.background.career.mages-apprentic.en: For long years, you studied magic under the mentorship of a more experienced mage.
heroes.background.career.mages-apprentic.zh: 多年以來，你在一位經驗豐富的法師指導下學習魔法。

heroes.background.career.mages-apprentic.en: While practicing a spell, your inexperience caused the magic to backfire and your memories were wiped, leaving you with only fragments of who you once were. Determined to recall your past, you now dedicate yourself to helping others, hoping your actions will spark some remembrance or lead you to a way to reverse the magic.

fs.en: While practicing a spell, your inexperience caused the magic to backfire and your memories were wiped, leaving you with only fragments of who you once were. Determined to recall your past, you now dedicate yourself to helping others, hoping your actions will spark some remembrance or lead you to a way to reverse the magic.
fs.zh: 在練習一道法術時，你因為經驗不足而導致魔法反噬，你的記憶被清除，只留下過去自我的片段。你決心找回失去的記憶，現在致力於幫助他人，希望你的行動能喚醒一些回憶，或引導你找到逆轉這魔法的方法。

heroes.background.career.mages-apprentic.zh: 在練習一道法術時，你因為經驗不足而導致魔法反噬，你的記憶被清除，只留下過去自我的片段。你決心找回失去的記憶，現在致力於幫助他人，希望你的行動能喚醒一些回憶，或引導你找到逆轉這魔法的方法。

heroes.background.career.mages-apprentic.en: Forgotten Memories

fs.en: Forgotten Memories
fs.zh: 遺忘記憶

heroes.background.career.mages-apprentic.zh: 遺忘記憶

heroes.background.career.mages-apprentic.en: As a sign of your status as a star pupil, your mentor gifted you a familiar as a magic pet. Another jealous apprentice captured the familiar and slipped away in the night. Haunted by your pet’s absence, you adventure to find your kidnapped friend and prevent others from feeling your loss.

fs.en: As a sign of your status as star pupil, your mentor gifted you a familiar as a magic pet. Another jealous apprentice captured the familiar and slipped away in the night. Haunted by your pet’s absence, you adventure to find your kidnapped friend and prevent others from feeling your loss.
fs.zh: 為了表彰你是得意門生，導師送給你一隻魔寵。另一位嫉妒的學徒捕捉了這隻魔寵並在夜裡悄悄溜走。魔寵的失蹤一直令你牽掛，於是你踏上冒險之旅，尋找這位被綁架的朋友，同時努力防止他人經歷你所感受的失落。

heroes.background.career.mages-apprentic.zh: 為了表彰你是得意門生，導師送給你一隻魔寵。另一位嫉妒的學徒捕捉了這隻魔寵並在夜裡悄悄溜走。魔寵的失蹤一直令你牽掛，於是你踏上冒險之旅，尋找這位被綁架的朋友，同時努力防止他人經歷你所感受的失落。

heroes.background.career.mages-apprentic.en: Magic of Friendship

fs.en: Magic of Friendship
fs.zh: 友誼魔法

heroes.background.career.mages-apprentic.zh: 友誼魔法

heroes.background.career.mages-apprentic.en: One day you woke up and the mage you worked for was gone. They didn’t take any of their belongings and there was no sign of any foul play—only the scent of sulfur in their bedchamber. You set out on your heroic journey in the aftermath and have been looking for them ever since.

fs.en: One day you woke up and the mage you worked for was just gone. They didn’t take any of their belongings and there was no sign of any foul play - just the scent of sulfur in their bedchamber. You set out on your heroic journey in the aftermath and have been looking for them ever since.
fs.zh: 某天早晨醒來，你發現你的導師消失了。他的所有物品都還在原處，現場也沒有任何遭到加害的跡象，只留下臥室中的硫磺氣味。從那天起，你踏上了英雄之旅，決心找到你失蹤的導師。

heroes.background.career.mages-apprentic.zh: 某天早晨醒來，你發現你的導師消失了。他的所有物品都還在原處，現場也沒有任何遭到加害的跡象，只留下臥室中的硫磺氣味。從那天起，你踏上了英雄之旅，決心找到你失蹤的導師。

heroes.background.career.mages-apprentic.en: Missing Mage

fs.en: Missing Mage
fs.zh: 失蹤導師

heroes.background.career.mages-apprentic.zh: 失蹤導師

heroes.background.career.mages-apprentic.en: Your attempts at magic have always been unpredictable. A powerful mage promised to help you gain control. During your training, a terrible nightmare caused your body to flare with magic and pull the monster of your nightmare into the waking world. The horror escaped. You left, seeking to vanquish their vileness.

fs.en: Your attempts at magic have always been unpredictable. A powerful mage promised to help you gain control. During your training, a terrible nightmare caused your body to flare with magic and pull the monster of your nightmare into the waking world. The horror escaped. You left, seeking to vanquish their terrible vileness.
fs.zh: 你的魔法一直都很不穩定，而一位強大的法師承諾幫你加強控制能力。在訓練中，一場可怕的惡夢讓你體內的魔法爆發，將惡夢中的怪物釋放到現實世界。這恐怖生物逃脫了，你因此離開，決心尋找並消滅那個邪惡存在。

heroes.background.career.mages-apprentic.zh: 你的魔法一直都很不穩定，而一位強大的法師承諾幫你加強控制能力。在訓練中，一場可怕的惡夢讓你體內的魔法爆發，將惡夢中的怪物釋放到現實世界。這恐怖生物逃脫了，你因此離開，決心尋找並消滅那個邪惡存在。

fs.en: Nightmares Made Flesh
fs.zh: 肉身惡夢

heroes.background.career.mages-apprentic.zh: 肉身惡夢

heroes.background.career.mages-apprentic.en: While studying magic, you accidentally sent yourself from your original world to this one. Now you’re stranded here, hoping to find ancient texts or powerful magic treasures that might transport you back home. A life of adventure it is!

fs.en: While studying magic, you accidentally sent yourself from your original world to this one. Now you’re stranded here, hoping to find ancient texts or powerful magic treasures that might transport you back home. A life of adventure it is!
fs.zh: 在學習魔法時，你意外地將自己從原本的世界傳送到了這個世界。如今你被困在此地，希望找到古老文獻或強大魔法寶物來送你回家。一段冒險的生活就此展開！

heroes.background.career.mages-apprentic.zh: 在學習魔法時，你意外地將自己從原本的世界傳送到了這個世界。如今你被困在此地，希望找到古老文獻或強大魔法寶物來送你回家。一段冒險的生活就此展開！

heroes.background.career.mages-apprentic.en: Otherworldly

fs.en: Otherworldly
fs.zh: 異世界

heroes.background.career.mages-apprentic.zh: 異世界

heroes.background.career.mages-apprentic.en: The mage you worked for was a kindly old soul, but the basic magic they taught you always seemed like a small part of something bigger. It wasn’t until you met an adventuring elementalist that you realized hitting the road as a hero was the only way to truly improve and hone your skills. You resigned your apprenticeship and found yourself walking the path of a hero the next day.

fs.en: The mage you worked for was a kindly old soul, but the basic magic they taught you always seemed like a small part of something bigger. It wasn’t until you met an adventuring elementalist that you realized hitting the road as a hero was the only way to truly improve and hone your skills. You resigned your apprenticeship and found yourself walking the path of a hero the next day.
fs.zh: 你曾經的導師是位和藹可親的老人，但他教給你的基礎魔法似乎始終只是某種更宏大奧祕的一小部分。直到有一天，你遇見了一位正在旅行的元素師，那時你才明白：只有踏上英雄之路，才能真正提升和磨練你的能力。於是你辭去學徒身分，隔天就踏上了成為英雄的旅程。

heroes.background.career.mages-apprentic.zh: 你曾經的導師是位和藹可親的老人，但他教給你的基礎魔法似乎始終只是某種更宏大奧祕的一小部分。直到有一天，你遇見了一位正在旅行的元素師，那時你才明白：只有踏上英雄之路，才能真正提升和磨練你的能力。於是你辭去學徒身分，隔天就踏上了成為英雄的旅程。

fs.en: Ultimate Power
fs.zh: 終極力量

heroes.background.career.mages-apprentic.zh: 終極力量

heroes.background.career.mages-apprentic.en: Inciting Incident
heroes.background.career.mages-apprentic.zh: 關鍵事件

heroes.background.career.mages-apprentic.en: Mage’s Apprentice
heroes.background.career.mages-apprentic.zh: 法師學徒

heroes.background.career.mages-apprentic.en: Who did you study under, and what kind of person were they?
heroes.background.career.mages-apprentic.zh: 你師從何人？對方是怎樣的人？

heroes.background.career.mages-apprentic.en: What were your mentor’s areas of expertise?
heroes.background.career.mages-apprentic.zh: 你的導師專精於哪些魔法領域？

heroes.background.career.mages-apprentic.en: What aspects of magic did you struggle to comprehend?
heroes.background.career.mages-apprentic.zh: 你對魔法的哪些方面感到難以理解？

heroes.background.career.mages-apprentic.en: What is your current relationship with your mentor?
heroes.background.career.mages-apprentic.zh: 你現在與導師的關係如何？

heroes.background.career.performer.benef.en: Perk: One interpersonal perk (Quick Build: Harmonizer.)
heroes.background.career.performer.benef.zh: 專長：1 項交涉類專長（速選：和諧之音）。

heroes.background.career.performer.benef.en: Skills: The Music or Perform skill (from the interpersonal skill group), plus two more skills from the interpersonal group (Quick Build: Flirt, Music, Perform.)
heroes.background.career.performer.benef.zh: 技能：從交涉類技能組選擇「音樂」或「表演」，另選 2 項其他交涉類技能（速選：魅惑、音樂、表演）。

heroes.background.career.performer.descr.en: You can sing, act, or dance well enough that people actually pay you to do it. Imagine that!

fs.en: You can sing, act, or dance well enough that people actually pay to see you do it. Imagine that!
fs.zh: 你擁有出色的歌唱、演戲或舞蹈技巧，讓人們願意為了觀賞你的表演而付錢。真不錯！

heroes.background.career.performer.descr.zh: 你擁有出色的歌唱、演戲或舞蹈技巧，讓人們願意為了觀賞你的表演而付錢。真不錯！

heroes.background.career.performer.incit.en: During a performance, you watched in horror as the audience was suddenly overcome by a curse that caused them to disintegrate before your eyes. You aren’t sure what happened, but seeking an answer quickly led you to places where only heroes dare to go.

fs.en: During a performance, you watched in horror as the audience was suddenly overcome by a curse that caused them to disintegrate before your eyes. You aren’t sure what happened, but seeking an answer quickly led you to places where only heroes dare to go.
fs.zh: 在一場表演中，你驚恐地目睹觀眾突然被詛咒侵襲，在你眼前逐漸分崩離析。你不清楚究竟發生了什麼事，但為了尋找答案，你願意冒險前往只有英雄才敢踏足的地方。

heroes.background.career.performer.incit.zh: 在一場表演中，你驚恐地目睹觀眾突然被詛咒侵襲，在你眼前逐漸分崩離析。你不清楚究竟發生了什麼事，但為了尋找答案，你願意冒險前往只有英雄才敢踏足的地方。

fs.en: Cursed Audience
fs.zh: 被詛咒的觀眾

heroes.background.career.performer.incit.en: After a poor performance, you found a script to a wellwritten play left in your dressing room. The accompanying note asked that if you performed the play, you should give the author credit. But after a commanding performance, you claimed to be star and playwright both— and the curse hidden on those pages activated. A small portion of your skin has begun to transform into undead flesh, and the only cure is to prove you have become selfless.

fs.en: After a poor performance, you found a script to a well-written play left in your dressing room. The accompanying note asked that if you performed the play, you should give the author credit. But after a commanding performance, you claimed to be star and playwright both - and the curse hidden on those pages activated. A small portion of your skin has begun to transform into undead flesh, and the only cure is to prove you have become selfless.
fs.zh: 在一場表現不佳的演出後，你在更衣室發現了一份精彩的劇本。附帶的便條紙要求你，如果要演出這齣戲，就必須註明原作者。然而，在一場精彩的演出後，你卻宣稱自己既是主演又是作者，進而觸發隱藏在劇本中的詛咒。你有一小塊皮膚開始變成不死生物的皮肉，唯一的解藥就是證明你已經學會無私二字。

heroes.background.career.performer.incit.zh: 在一場表現不佳的演出後，你在更衣室發現了一份精彩的劇本。附帶的便條紙要求你，如果要演出這齣戲，就必須註明原作者。然而，在一場精彩的演出後，你卻宣稱自己既是主演又是作者，進而觸發隱藏在劇本中的詛咒。你有一小塊皮膚開始變成不死生物的皮肉，唯一的解藥就是證明你已經學會無私二字。

fs.en: False Accolades
fs.zh: 虛假名聲

heroes.background.career.performer.incit.en: You thought you were famous—then that hero came to your show. Suddenly, all eyes were on the dragon-slaying brute instead of on the stage where they belonged. The audience even gave them a standing ovation when they entered the room. All you got was polite applause. Fine. If people want a hero so much, then a hero you shall be.

fs.en: You thought you were famous - then that hero came to your show. Suddenly, all eyes were on the dragon-slaying brute instead of on the stage where they belonged. The audience even gave them a standing ovation when they entered the room. All you got was polite applause. Fine. If people want a hero so much, then a hero you shall be.
fs.zh: 你曾以為自己很出名，直到那位英雄出現在你的表演中。突然間，所有目光都轉向那位屠龍莽漢，而非該受關注的舞台。觀眾甚至在他進場時起立歡呼，而你只獲得了禮貌性的掌聲。好吧，既然人們如此渴望英雄，那麼你決定要成為一位真正的英雄。

heroes.background.career.performer.incit.zh: 你曾以為自己很出名，直到那位英雄出現在你的表演中。突然間，所有目光都轉向那位屠龍莽漢，而非該受關注的舞台。觀眾甚至在他進場時起立歡呼，而你只獲得了禮貌性的掌聲。好吧，既然人們如此渴望英雄，那麼你決定要成為一位真正的英雄。

fs.en: Fame and Fortune
fs.zh: 聲望與財富

heroes.background.career.performer.incit.en: Your performances have always been tinged with a bit of melancholy. During a particularly soulful performance, spirits disturbed the living audience and sat in their chairs. They begged you to prevent their demise, providing no other details before disappearing. You set out to determine if you could help your most dedicated fans.

fs.en: Your performances have always been tinged with a bit of melancholy. During a particularly soulful performance, spirits disturbed the living audience and sat in their chairs. They begged you to prevent their demise, providing no other details before disappearing. You set out to see if you could help your most dedicated fans.
fs.zh: 你的表演總是帶有一絲憂傷。在一場特別動人的演出中，幽靈擾亂了現場觀眾，並占據他們的座位。這些幽靈懇求你阻止他們的死亡，卻沒留下任何其他線索就消失了。你決定踏上旅程，希望能幫助這些最忠實的粉絲。

heroes.background.career.performer.incit.zh: 你的表演總是帶有一絲憂傷。在一場特別動人的演出中，幽靈擾亂了現場觀眾，並占據他們的座位。這些幽靈懇求你阻止他們的死亡，卻沒留下任何其他線索就消失了。你決定踏上旅程，希望能幫助這些最忠實的粉絲。

fs.en: Songs to the Dead
fs.zh: 死者之歌

heroes.background.career.performer.incit.en: A heckler’s mocking words left you utterly speechless during a performance, stinging your pride and stirring your arrogance. The incident strained your legendary voice, and you could speak only in soft whispers. The heckler was a fey trickster who stole your voice, promising to give it back after you accomplished real good in the world.

fs.en: A heckler’s mocking words left you utterly speechless during a performance, stinging your pride and stirring your arrogance. The incident strained your legendary voice, and you could only speak in soft whispers. The heckler was a fey trickster who stole your voice, promising to give it back after you accomplished real good in the world.
fs.zh: 在一場表演中，一位鬧場者的冷嘲熱諷讓你完全說不出話來，刺痛你的自尊並激起你的傲慢。這次事件損傷了你那傳奇的嗓音，讓你只能用微弱的氣音說話。原來，那鬧場者是個搗蛋的妖精，偷走了你的聲音，並承諾只有當你完成真正的善行後，才會將聲音歸還給你。

heroes.background.career.performer.incit.zh: 在一場表演中，一位鬧場者的冷嘲熱諷讓你完全說不出話來，刺痛你的自尊並激起你的傲慢。這次事件損傷了你那傳奇的嗓音，讓你只能用微弱的氣音說話。原來，那鬧場者是個搗蛋的妖精，偷走了你的聲音，並承諾只有當你完成真正的善行後，才會將聲音歸還給你。

fs.en: Speechless
fs.zh: 無語

heroes.background.career.performer.incit.en: When a producer who once shortchanged you shouted out on the street for you to stop a thief who had picked their pocket, your spite toward them inspired you to let the thief run right on by. But that decision led to tragedy when the thief later harmed someone you loved. From that moment on, you made it your responsibility to protect others.

fs.en: When a producer who once shortchanged you shouted out on the street for you to stop a thief who had picked their pocket, your spite toward the producer inspired you to let the thief run right on by. But that decision led to tragedy when the thief later harmed someone you loved. From that moment on, you made it your responsibility to protect others.
fs.zh: 當一位曾經少付你報酬的製作人在街上大喊，要你攔住剛剛扒竊他的扒手時，你對他的怨恨讓你刻意放任扒手逃跑。然而，這個決定後來釀成悲劇，那個扒手傷害了你所愛的人。從那一刻起，你立志將保護他人視為自己的責任。

heroes.background.career.performer.incit.zh: 當一位曾經少付你報酬的製作人在街上大喊，要你攔住剛剛扒竊他的扒手時，你對他的怨恨讓你刻意放任扒手逃跑。然而，這個決定後來釀成悲劇，那個扒手傷害了你所愛的人。從那一刻起，你立志將保護他人視為自己的責任。

fs.en: Tragic Lesson
fs.zh: 慘痛教訓

heroes.background.career.performer.quest.en: What is the tone of your performances?
heroes.background.career.performer.quest.zh: 你的表演通常帶有什麼樣的風格？

heroes.background.career.performer.quest.en: What song, role, or dance are you most known for?
heroes.background.career.performer.quest.zh: 哪首歌曲、哪個角色或哪支舞蹈讓你最為人所知？

heroes.background.career.performer.quest.en: Did you perform in the same place throughout your career, or did you travel?
heroes.background.career.performer.quest.zh: 在你的職業生涯中，你是固定在一處表演，還是到處巡迴？

heroes.background.career.performer.quest.en: Were you part of a troupe, or were you a solo act?
heroes.background.career.performer.quest.zh: 你是表演團體的一員，還是獨立藝人？

heroes.background.career.politician.bene.en: Perk: One interpersonal perk (Quick Build: Engrossing Monologue.)
heroes.background.career.politician.bene.zh: 專長：1 項交涉類專長（速選：聚焦獨白）。

heroes.background.career.politician.bene.en: Skills: Two skills from the interpersonal skill group (Quick Build: Lead, Lie.)
heroes.background.career.politician.bene.zh: 技能：從交涉類技能組選擇 2 項技能（速選：領導、欺瞞）。

heroes.background.career.politician.desc.en: You worked as a leader within a formal, bureaucratic organization or government. You might have been appointed, born, or elected into your position, but getting people to agree and making decisions for the people you serve (or who served you) was your job.
heroes.background.career.politician.desc.zh: 你曾在正式的官僚組織或政府中擔任領導者。你可能是透過任命、世襲或選舉獲得該職位，但你的工作是促使人們達成共識，並為你服務的人民（或服侍你的人）做出決策。

heroes.background.career.politician.inci.en: Your political power allowed you to be foolish without consequence. Through sheer carelessness or on a dare, you accidentally harmed or killed an innocent bystander. Due to your position as an official, you faced no consequences. But this event was the final straw for the person you loved or respected most, and they turned away from you. You left the world of political machinations behind to earn back their trust.

fs.en: Your political power allowed you to be foolish without consequence. Through sheer carelessness or on a dare, you accidentally harmed or killed an innocent bystander. Due to your position as an official, you faced no consequences. But this event was the final straw for the person you loved or respected most, and they turned away from you. You left the world of political machinations behind to earn back their trust.
fs.zh: 你的政治權力讓你無需承擔魯莽行為的後果。由於一時大意，或是在接受他人的挑戰時，你意外傷害甚至殺死了一名無辜旁觀者。由於你的官方身分，你規避了所有責任。然而，這起事件成為你最愛或最尊敬的人所能容忍的最後一根稻草，他們因此離你而去。你最終選擇離開政治權謀的世界，希望能重新贏得他們的信任。

heroes.background.career.politician.inci.zh: 你的政治權力讓你無需承擔魯莽行為的後果。由於一時大意，或是在接受他人的挑戰時，你意外傷害甚至殺死了一名無辜旁觀者。由於你的官方身分，你規避了所有責任。然而，這起事件成為你最愛或最尊敬的人所能容忍的最後一根稻草，他們因此離你而去。你最終選擇離開政治權謀的世界，希望能重新贏得他們的信任。

fs.en: Diplomatic Immunity
fs.zh: 外交豁免

heroes.background.career.politician.inci.en: You secretly funded a rebel organization intent on overthrowing the corrupt establishment. Someone discovered your treason, and you were forced to flee or risk execution. You became a hero to live and fight another day on behalf of those who have no power.

fs.en: You secretly funded a rebel organization intent on overthrowing the corrupt establishment. Someone discovered your treason, and you were forced to leave or risk execution. You became a hero to live and fight another day on behalf of those who have no power.
fs.zh: 你祕密資助了一支意圖推翻腐敗體制的反抗組織。有人發現了你的叛國行為，於是你被迫逃亡，否則就可能面臨處決。為了替那些無權無勢的人奮鬥，你成為了英雄，決心繼續生存並戰鬥下去。

heroes.background.career.politician.inci.zh: 你祕密資助了一支意圖推翻腐敗體制的反抗組織。有人發現了你的叛國行為，於是你被迫逃亡，否則就可能面臨處決。為了替那些無權無勢的人奮鬥，你成為了英雄，決心繼續生存並戰鬥下去。

fs.en: Insurrectionist
fs.zh: 叛國

heroes.background.career.politician.inci.en: You were a seneschal to a leader, able to sway their opinions. But gossip convinced the leader you were plotting a coup, and you were ousted from their circle of influence. You became a hero to continue your work making meaningful change in the world.

fs.en: You were seneschal to a leader, able to sway their opinions, but gossip convinced the monarch you were plotting a coup, and you were ousted from court. You became a hero to continue your work making meaningful change in the world.
fs.zh: 你曾是一位領導者的總管，能夠影響他的決策。然而，流言蜚語讓領導者誤以為你正在策劃政變，你因此被逐出了權力中心。為了繼續在世界上推動有意義的變革，你選擇成為一名英雄。

heroes.background.career.politician.inci.zh: 你曾是一位領導者的總管，能夠影響他的決策。然而，流言蜚語讓領導者誤以為你正在策劃政變，你因此被逐出了權力中心。為了繼續在世界上推動有意義的變革，你選擇成為一名英雄。

fs.en: Respected Consul
fs.zh: 高階總管

heroes.background.career.politician.inci.en: You tried to work on policy change from the inside of a bureaucratic organization. There were others like you who were more vocal. You started to notice those colleagues were disappearing overnight. Not wanting to find out if you were next on the list, you left to enact change in more direct ways.

fs.en: You tried to work on policy change from the inside of a bureaucratic organization. There were others like you who were more vocal. You started to notice those colleagues were disappearing overnight. Not wanting to find out if you were next on the list, you left to enact change in more direct ways.
fs.zh: 你曾嘗試從官僚組織內部推動政策變革。有其他人和你持相同立場，但他們的表達更為直接。你漸漸發現這些直言不諱的同事們開始在一夜之間消失。為了避免成為名單上的下一個目標，你決定離開體制，轉而以更直接的方式實現變革。

heroes.background.career.politician.inci.zh: 你曾嘗試從官僚組織內部推動政策變革。有其他人和你持相同立場，但他們的表達更為直接。你漸漸發現這些直言不諱的同事們開始在一夜之間消失。為了避免成為名單上的下一個目標，你決定離開體制，轉而以更直接的方式實現變革。

fs.en: Right Side of History
fs.zh: 正確的一方

heroes.background.career.politician.inci.en: You used your skills to collect incriminating or scandalous information about your opponents to blackmail them. A rival got one step ahead of you and stole your book of dirty secrets. But instead of using it against you, they gave you an opportunity to leave the world of politics behind. Saved from public humiliation, you now use your skills for the greater good.

fs.en: You used your skills to collect incriminating or scandalous information about your opponents to blackmail them. A rival got one step ahead of you and stole your book of dirty secrets, but instead of using it against you, they gave you an opportunity to leave the world of politics behind. Saved from public humiliation, you now use your skills for the greater good.
fs.zh: 你曾利用自己的能力收集對手的犯罪或醜聞資訊來進行勒索。一位競爭對手卻搶先一步，偷走你的骯髒祕密檔案。不過，他們並未用這些資訊對付你，而是給了你離開政治舞台的機會。避免被公開羞辱後，你現在將能力用在更崇高的目標。

heroes.background.career.politician.inci.zh: 你曾利用自己的能力收集對手的犯罪或醜聞資訊來進行勒索。一位競爭對手卻搶先一步，偷走你的骯髒祕密檔案。不過，他們並未用這些資訊對付你，而是給了你離開政治舞台的機會。避免被公開羞辱後，你現在將能力用在更崇高的目標。

fs.en: Self-Serving
fs.zh: 自私自利

heroes.background.career.politician.inci.en: The red tape required to achieve anything through your political position resulted in a crisis being mishandled and countless people harmed or killed. After that unfortunate event, you resolved to live unfettered by bureaucratic interference, seeking to do good through action, not paperwork.

fs.en: The red tape required to achieve anything through your political position resulted in a crisis being mishandled and countless people harmed or killed. After that unfortunate event, you resolved to be unfettered by bureaucratic interference and sought to do good through action, not paperwork.
fs.zh: 你政治職位上的繁文縟節導致了一場處理不當的危機，造成無數人傷亡。在這場悲劇過後，你決心擺脫官僚體制的束縛，選擇透過實際行動而非冗長的文書工作來造福他人。

heroes.background.career.politician.inci.zh: 你政治職位上的繁文縟節導致了一場處理不當的危機，造成無數人傷亡。在這場悲劇過後，你決心擺脫官僚體制的束縛，選擇透過實際行動而非冗長的文書工作來造福他人。

fs.en: Unbound
fs.zh: 不受約束

heroes.background.career.politician.ques.en: Who were you responsible for ruling or representing?
What was your official title and how did you earn it?
heroes.background.career.politician.ques.zh: 你的官方頭銜是什麼？你如何獲得這個頭銜？

heroes.background.career.politician.ques.en: Who was your greatest political rival?
heroes.background.career.politician.ques.zh: 誰是你最大的政治對手？

heroes.background.career.politician.ques.en: What secret do you know that could tear apart the entire system you worked within?
heroes.background.career.politician.ques.zh: 你知道什麼祕密可能會摧毀你所在的整個體系？

heroes.background.career.sage.benefit.pe.en: Perk: One lore perk (Quick Build: Expert Sage.)
heroes.background.career.sage.benefit.pe.zh: 專長：1 項學識類專長（速選：學術專家）。

heroes.background.career.sage.benefit.sk.en: Skills: Two skills from the lore skill group (Quick Build: History, Magic.)
heroes.background.career.sage.benefit.sk.zh: 技能：從學識類技能組選擇 2 項技能（速選：歷史、魔法）。

heroes.background.career.sage.descriptio.en: From an early age, you dedicated yourself to learning, whether you shared the knowledge of the world with others or sought out secret lore only for yourself.
heroes.background.career.sage.descriptio.zh: 從小時候起，你就致力於學習各種知識，無論是與他人分享世界的奧祕，還是純粹為了自己而尋求祕密的學問。

heroes.background.career.sage.inciting.1.en: You were always content to live a peaceful life in your library, until you found that one book—the one that told the tale of heroes who had saved the timescape. They didn’t spend their days behind a desk. They made a real difference. It was time for you to do the same.

fs.en: You were always content to live a peaceful life in your library, until you found that one book - the one that told the tale of heroes who had saved the timescape. They didn’t spend their days behind a desk. They made a real difference. It was time for you to do the same.
fs.zh: 你一直很滿足於在圖書館過著平靜的生活，直到你發現了那本特別的書，一本講述英雄拯救時界的故事。這些英雄不是整天坐在辦公桌後面，而是真正改變了世界。現在，是時候讓你也踏上同樣的旅程了。

heroes.background.career.sage.inciting.1.zh: 你一直很滿足於在圖書館過著平靜的生活，直到你發現了那本特別的書，一本講述英雄拯救時界的故事。這些英雄不是整天坐在辦公桌後面，而是真正改變了世界。現在，是時候讓你也踏上同樣的旅程了。

fs.en: Bookish Ideas
fs.zh: 讀書養性

heroes.background.career.sage.inciting.2.en: You used to think knowledge could fix everything. You were wrong. When someone you loved fell under a curse, the means to cure them couldn’t be found in any of the books you owned. But that wasn’t going to stop you. The answers are out there, and you’ll find them even if you have to face down death to do so.

fs.en: You used to think knowledge could fix everything. You were wrong. When someone you loved fell under a curse, the means to cure them couldn’t be found in any of the books you owned. But that wasn’t going to stop you. The answers are out there, and you’ll find them even if you have to face down death to do so.
fs.zh: 你曾以為知識能解決一切，但你錯了。當你心愛的人陷入詛咒時，你所有的書籍都無法提供治癒方法，但這不會阻止你。答案就在外面某處，即使必須面對死亡，你也決心找到它。

heroes.background.career.sage.inciting.2.zh: 你曾以為知識能解決一切，但你錯了。當你心愛的人陷入詛咒時，你所有的書籍都無法提供治癒方法，但這不會阻止你。答案就在外面某處，即使必須面對死亡，你也決心找到它。

fs.en: Cure the Curse
fs.zh: 解除詛咒

heroes.background.career.sage.inciting.3.en: An evil mage took all your books for themself, cackling at your impotence as they raided your shelves. Now, you’re off to search through ancient ruins and secret libraries to rebuild your collection of rare tomes— and to find the mage who stole from you.

fs.en: An evil mage took all your books for themself, cackling at your impotence as they raided your shelves. Now, you’re off to search through ancient ruins and secret libraries to rebuild your collection of rare tomes - and to find the mage who stole from you.
fs.zh: 一名邪惡的魔導師搶走了你所有的書籍，還嘲笑你的無能為力。如今，你踏上探索古代遺跡和隱密圖書館的旅程，決心重建你珍貴典籍的收藏，同時追尋那個偷書的魔導師。

heroes.background.career.sage.inciting.3.zh: 一名邪惡的魔導師搶走了你所有的書籍，還嘲笑你的無能為力。如今，你踏上探索古代遺跡和隱密圖書館的旅程，決心重建你珍貴典籍的收藏，同時追尋那個偷書的魔導師。

fs.en: Lost Library
fs.zh: 失落圖書館

heroes.background.career.sage.inciting.4.en: While transcribing ancient texts, you and another scribe discovered a shelf of long-forgotten books. At your suggestion, your companion started work on one and vanished along with the tome. Your guilt drove you to seek out your still-missing friend and prevent others from falling to similar dangers.

fs.en: While transcribing ancient texts, you and another scribe discovered a shelf of long-forgotten books. At your suggestion, your companion started work on one and vanished along with the tome. Your guilt drove you to seek out your friend and prevent others from falling to similar dangers.
fs.zh: 在抄寫古代文獻時，你和另一位抄寫員發現了一整架早已被遺忘的書籍。在你的建議下，你的同伴開始研究其中一本，卻與那本書一同消失了。你的愧疚感驅使你尋找下落不明的朋友，同時致力防止他人遭遇類似的危險。

heroes.background.career.sage.inciting.4.zh: 在抄寫古代文獻時，你和另一位抄寫員發現了一整架早已被遺忘的書籍。在你的建議下，你的同伴開始研究其中一本，卻與那本書一同消失了。你的愧疚感驅使你尋找下落不明的朋友，同時致力防止他人遭遇類似的危險。

fs.en: Paper Guilt
fs.zh: 愧疚之情

heroes.background.career.sage.inciting.5.en: In your pursuit of ancient knowledge, you discovered a prophecy that has yet to come to pass. And that prophecy involves someone who might be … you. Since your discovery, strange dreams have plagued you, driving you to seek out your destiny.

fs.en: In your pursuit of ancient knowledge, you discovered a prophecy that has yet to come to pass. And that prophecy involves someone who might be … you. Since your discovery, strange dreams have plagued you, driving you to seek out your destiny.
fs.zh: 在追尋古老知識的過程中，你發現了一個尚未實現的預言。那個預言提到了一個人，而那個人可能就是……你。自從發現這個預言後，奇怪的夢境開始不斷困擾著你，驅使你踏上尋找自己命運的旅程。

heroes.background.career.sage.inciting.5.zh: 在追尋古老知識的過程中，你發現了一個尚未實現的預言。那個預言提到了一個人，而那個人可能就是……你。自從發現這個預言後，奇怪的夢境開始不斷困擾著你，驅使你踏上尋找自己命運的旅程。

fs.en: Unforeseen Futures
fs.zh: 神祕預言

heroes.background.career.sage.inciting.6.en: At first you thought it was your imagination, and you brushed off the disappearance of random sentences in historical books. Then as the books changed to entirely blank pages, the disappearances became difficult to ignore, particularly those involving ancient or critical text. Driven by the desire to preserve knowledge, you have made it your purpose to restore and reverse those vanishing texts before they forever disappear.

fs.en: At first you thought it was your imagination, and you brushed off the disappearance of random sentences in historical books. Then as the books changed to entirely blank pages, the disappearances became difficult to ignore, particularly those involving ancient or critical text. Driven by the desire to preserve knowledge, you have made it your purpose to restore and reverse those vanishing texts before they forever disappear.
fs.zh: 起初，你將歷史書籍中隨機消失的句子視為自己的幻想，但當書頁逐漸變成一片空白時，這種消失現象變得無法忽視，尤其是那些涉及古代或關鍵文本的部分。為了保存知識，你立志恢復並逆轉這種情況，防止它們永遠消失。

heroes.background.career.sage.inciting.6.zh: 起初，你將歷史書籍中隨機消失的句子視為自己的幻想，但當書頁逐漸變成一片空白時，這種消失現象變得無法忽視，尤其是那些涉及古代或關鍵文本的部分。為了保存知識，你立志恢復並逆轉這種情況，防止它們永遠消失。

fs.en: Vanishing
fs.zh: 消失文字

heroes.background.career.sage.question.2.en: Where did your studies take place?

heroes.background.career.sage.question.3.en: How did you acquire the books and other materials you needed for work?
heroes.background.career.sage.question.3.zh: 你如何獲取工作所需的書籍和其他材料？

heroes.background.career.sage.question.4.en: Who benefited most from your research?
heroes.background.career.sage.question.4.zh: 誰從你的研究中獲益最多？

heroes.background.career.sailor.benefit..en: Perk: One exploration perk (Quick Build: Put Your Back Into It!)
heroes.background.career.sailor.benefit..zh: 專長：1 項探索類專長（速選：全力以赴！）。

heroes.background.career.sailor.benefit..en: Skills: Swim (from the exploration skill group), plus two more skills from the exploration group (Quick Build: Climb, Gymnastics, Swim.)
heroes.background.career.sailor.benefit..zh: 技能：獲得「游泳」（探索類技能），另從探索類技能組選擇 2 項其他技能（速選：攀爬、體操、游泳）。

heroes.background.career.sailor.descript.en: You worked on a ship, whether a merchant cog, a mercenary or military craft, or a pirate vessel. You might have been a deckhand, a mate, or even the captain.

fs.en: You worked on a ship that might have been a merchant cog, a mercenary or military craft, or a pirate vessel. You might have been a deckhand, a mate, or even the captain.
fs.zh: 你曾在船上工作，無論是商船、傭兵船、軍艦，還是海盜船。你可能是甲板水手、大副，甚至是船長。

heroes.background.career.sailor.descript.zh: 你曾在船上工作，無論是商船、傭兵船、軍艦，還是海盜船。你可能是甲板水手、大副，甚至是船長。

heroes.background.career.sailor.inciting.en: You joined up with your best friend, sibling, or other loved one, the culmination of a lifelong dream to sail the high seas together. When they died, you lost your taste for the seafaring life. You left at the first opportunity and haven’t looked back since.

fs.en: You joined up with your best friend, sibling, or other loved one, the culmination of a lifelong dream to sail the high seas together. When they died, you lost your taste for the seafaring life. You left at the first opportunity and haven’t looked back since.
fs.zh: 你與最好的朋友、兄弟姐妹或摯愛一同加入船隊，實現航行公海的畢生夢想。在他們死後，你對航海生活徹底失去興趣。你找到機會就立刻離開，再也沒有回頭。

heroes.background.career.sailor.inciting.zh: 你與最好的朋友、兄弟姐妹或摯愛一同加入船隊，實現航行公海的畢生夢想。在他們死後，你對航海生活徹底失去興趣。你找到機會就立刻離開，再也沒有回頭。

fs.en: Alone
fs.zh: 孤獨

heroes.background.career.sailor.inciting.en: It was in the middle of a pirate raid (whether you were part of it or targeted by it) that you realized you no longer yearned for a sailor’s life. You used the chaos of the moment to slip away unnoticed. You now work as a hero in an effort to either end the piracy of others or atone for your past deeds, but you fear the day your old crew finds you and punishes you for your desertion.

fs.en: It was in the middle of a pirate raid (whether you were part of it or targeted by it) that you realized you no longer yearned for a sailor’s life. You used the chaos of the moment to slip away unnoticed. You now work as a hero in an effort to either end the piracy of others or atone for your past deeds, but you fear the day your old crew finds you and punishes you for your desertion.
fs.zh: 在一次海盜襲擊中（無論你是加害者還是受害者），你意識到自己不再渴望水手的生活，你趁亂悄然離開。如今你成為了一名英雄，致力於終止他人的海盜行徑或為自己的過去贖罪。然而，你始終害怕前船員有朝一日會找到你，並因為你的逃逸行為而懲罰你。

heroes.background.career.sailor.inciting.zh: 在一次海盜襲擊中（無論你是加害者還是受害者），你意識到自己不再渴望水手的生活，你趁亂悄然離開。如今你成為了一名英雄，致力於終止他人的海盜行徑或為自己的過去贖罪。然而，你始終害怕前船員有朝一日會找到你，並因為你的逃逸行為而懲罰你。

fs.en: Deserter
fs.zh: 逃離

heroes.background.career.sailor.inciting.en: You awoke aboard your ship with no memory of who you were. Though the other sailors insisted they knew you, you didn’t know them. The next time you went ashore, you decided to stay, determined to find out who you really are.

fs.en: You awoke aboard your ship with no memory of who you were. Though the other sailors insisted they knew you, you didn’t know them. The next time you went ashore, you decided to stay, determined to find out who you really are.
fs.zh: 你在船上醒來，對自己的身分毫無記憶。雖然其他水手聲稱認識你，但你對他們沒有絲毫印象。在下次靠岸時，你決定留在陸地上，決心發掘自己的真正身分。

heroes.background.career.sailor.inciting.zh: 你在船上醒來，對自己的身分毫無記憶。雖然其他水手聲稱認識你，但你對他們沒有絲毫印象。在下次靠岸時，你決定留在陸地上，決心發掘自己的真正身分。

fs.en: Forgotten
fs.zh: 失憶

heroes.background.career.sailor.inciting.en: You had the favor of your captain, which earned you many rivals aboard your ship. One night, your fellow sailors pulled you from your bunk and threw you overboard. By some miracle, you were scooped from the waters by a passing vessel. You worked off your debt to them, then set out on a new life involving less pettiness.

fs.en: You had the favor of your captain, which earned you many rivals aboard your ship. One night, your fellow sailors pulled you from your bunk and threw you overboard. By some miracle, you were scooped from the waters by a passing vessel. You worked off your debt to them, then set out on a new life with less pettiness.
fs.zh: 你擁有船長的青睞，這讓你在船上招來許多競爭對手。在一個夜晚，你的同伴將你從床鋪中拖出來並丟進海裡。幸運的是，一艘路過的船隻救了你。你透過工作償還了欠他們的恩情，然後展開一段遠離瑣碎糾紛的新生活。

heroes.background.career.sailor.inciting.zh: 你擁有船長的青睞，這讓你在船上招來許多競爭對手。在一個夜晚，你的同伴將你從床鋪中拖出來並丟進海裡。幸運的是，一艘路過的船隻救了你。你透過工作償還了欠他們的恩情，然後展開一段遠離瑣碎糾紛的新生活。

fs.en: Jealousy
fs.zh: 嫉妒

heroes.background.career.sailor.inciting.en: There was a mutiny, and you were on the losing side. You were marooned on an island and escaped when a merchant vessel was blown off course by a storm and found you. Your reputation is ruined among sailors, so you seek adventure elsewhere.

fs.en: There was a mutiny, and you were on the losing side. You were marooned on an island and escaped when a merchant vessel was blown off course by a storm and found you. Your reputation is ruined among sailors, so you seek adventure elsewhere.
fs.zh: 船上發生了叛變，你不幸站在失敗的一方。你被拋棄在一座孤島上，直到一艘被風暴吹離航道的商船發現你，才讓你得以脫險。如今你在水手圈中的聲譽已毀，因此只能在別處尋求冒險。

heroes.background.career.sailor.inciting.zh: 船上發生了叛變，你不幸站在失敗的一方。你被拋棄在一座孤島上，直到一艘被風暴吹離航道的商船發現你，才讓你得以脫險。如今你在水手圈中的聲譽已毀，因此只能在別處尋求冒險。

fs.en: Marooned
fs.zh: 受困孤島

heroes.background.career.sailor.inciting.en: A catastrophic storm hit while you were at sea, destroying your ship and leaving you as the only survivor. Once you recovered, you tried to sign on with another ship, but the thought of the open water turned your legs to jelly. Instead, you’ve taken on the role of a traveling hero to make ends meet.

fs.en: A catastrophic storm hit while you were at sea, destroying your ship and leaving you as the only survivor. Once you recovered, you tried to sign on with another ship, but the thought of the open water turned your legs to jelly. Instead, you’ve taken on the role of a traveling hero to make ends meet.
fs.zh: 一場風暴災難在海上襲擊了你的船隻，將其摧毀，只留下你一人倖存。康復後，你嘗試重新上船工作，但一想到茫茫大海就讓你雙腿發軟。因此，你轉而成為一名旅行英雄來維持生計。

heroes.background.career.sailor.inciting.zh: 一場風暴災難在海上襲擊了你的船隻，將其摧毀，只留下你一人倖存。康復後，你嘗試重新上船工作，但一想到茫茫大海就讓你雙腿發軟。因此，你轉而成為一名旅行英雄來維持生計。

fs.en: Water Fear
fs.zh: 懼怕大海

heroes.background.career.sailor.question.en: What is the name of the vessel you sailed on, and what type of business was the crew engaged in?
heroes.background.career.sailor.question.zh: 你的船隻叫什麼名字？你們從事什麼類型的業務？

heroes.background.career.sailor.question.en: What was your job aboard the ship?
heroes.background.career.sailor.question.zh: 你在船上擔任什麼工作？

heroes.background.career.sailor.question.en: What’s the longest amount of time you’ve spent at sea?
heroes.background.career.sailor.question.zh: 你在海上停留過最長的時間是多久？

heroes.background.career.sailor.question.en: Who or what did you lose on your maritime journeys?
heroes.background.career.sailor.question.zh: 在海上旅程中，你失去了什麼人或什麼事物？

heroes.background.career.soldier.benefit.en: Perk: One exploration perk (Quick Build: Teamwork.)
heroes.background.career.soldier.benefit.zh: 專長：1 項探索類專長（速選：團隊合作）。

heroes.background.career.soldier.benefit.en: Skills: One skill from the exploration skill group and one skill from the intrigue group (Quick Build: Alertness, Endurance.)
heroes.background.career.soldier.benefit.zh: 技能：從探索類技能組和諜報類技能組各選擇 1 項技能（速選：警覺、耐力）。

heroes.background.career.soldier.descrip.en: In your formative years, you fought tirelessly in skirmishes and campaigns against enemy forces.
heroes.background.career.soldier.descrip.zh: 在你的成長歲月中，你不知疲倦地參與了無數次與敵軍的衝突與征戰。

heroes.background.career.soldier.incitin.en: You enlisted in the military to protect others, but your commander ordered you to beat and kill civilians. When you refused, things got violent. You barely escaped the brawl that ensued, but now you vow to help people on your own terms.

fs.en: You enlisted in the military to protect others, but your commander ordered you to beat and kill civilians. When you refused, things got violent. You barely escaped the brawl that ensued, but now you vow to help people on your own terms.
fs.zh: 你入伍從軍是為了保護他人，但你的指揮官卻命令你毆打並殺害平民。你拒絕執行，但事情變得暴力，你勉強從隨後的混戰中逃脫，如今立誓要以自己的方式幫助他人。

heroes.background.career.soldier.incitin.zh: 你入伍從軍是為了保護他人，但你的指揮官卻命令你毆打並殺害平民。你拒絕執行，但事情變得暴力，你勉強從隨後的混戰中逃脫，如今立誓要以自己的方式幫助他人。

fs.en: Dishonorable Discharge
fs.zh: 不名譽退伍

heroes.background.career.soldier.incitin.en: You had a long and storied career as a soldier before deciding to retire to a simpler life. But when you returned to your old home, you found your enemies had laid waste to it. Now the skills you earned on the battlefield are helping you as you become a different kind of warrior— one seeking to save others from the fate you suffered.

fs.en: You had a long and storied career as a soldier before deciding to retire to a simpler life. But when you returned to your old home, you found your enemies had laid waste to it. Now the skills you earned on the battlefield are helping you as you become a different kind of warrior - one seeking to save others from the fate you suffered.
fs.zh: 你曾有過漫長而輝煌的士兵生涯，最終決定退休過上簡單生活。然而，當你回到家鄉時，卻發現故鄉已被敵人夷為平地。如今，你憑藉戰場上習得的技能致力於拯救他人，避免他們遭受你所經歷的悲劇。

heroes.background.career.soldier.incitin.zh: 你曾有過漫長而輝煌的士兵生涯，最終決定退休過上簡單生活。然而，當你回到家鄉時，卻發現故鄉已被敵人夷為平地。如今，你憑藉戰場上習得的技能致力於拯救他人，避免他們遭受你所經歷的悲劇。

fs.en: Out of Retirement
fs.zh: 退役生活

heroes.background.career.soldier.incitin.en: Living with constant bloodshed took its toll on you. You seek peace through healing and have dedicated yourself to ending wars before they begin, to spare those around you from the horror.

fs.en: The sight of constant bloodshed took its toll on you. You seek peace through healing and dedicated yourself to ending wars before they begin, to spare those around you from the horror.
fs.zh: 長期身處血腥戰場已經對你造成沉重的負擔。你透過治療他人來尋求平靜，並致力於在戰爭爆發前阻止衝突，讓你身邊的人免於戰爭帶來的恐怖與苦難。

heroes.background.career.soldier.incitin.zh: 長期身處血腥戰場已經對你造成沉重的負擔。你透過治療他人來尋求平靜，並致力於在戰爭爆發前阻止衝突，讓你身邊的人免於戰爭帶來的恐怖與苦難。

fs.en: Peace Through Healing
fs.zh: 和平療癒

heroes.background.career.soldier.incitin.en: You were the last surviving member of your unit after an arduous battle or monstrous assault, surviving only through luck. You turned away from the life of a soldier then, seeking to become a hero who could stand against such threats.

fs.en: You were the last surviving member of your unit after an arduous battle or monstrous assault, surviving only through luck. You turned away from the life of a soldier then, seeking to become a hero who could stand against such threats.
fs.zh: 在一場艱苦的戰役或可怕的怪物襲擊後，你成為你的單位中唯一的倖存者，純粹靠運氣活了下來。此後，你告別了士兵的生涯，立志成為能夠對抗這類威脅的英雄。

heroes.background.career.soldier.incitin.zh: 在一場艱苦的戰役或可怕的怪物襲擊後，你成為你的單位中唯一的倖存者，純粹靠運氣活了下來。此後，你告別了士兵的生涯，立志成為能夠對抗這類威脅的英雄。

fs.en: Sole Survivor
fs.zh: 唯一倖存者

heroes.background.career.soldier.incitin.en: Tired of eking out an existence on the streets, you enrolled in the military. However, you were unable to escape your lower-status background until the officer leading your unit fell in battle. In the chaos that ensued, you assumed their identity and returned home a hero. But when suspicion arose, you took on the life of an adventurer, staying always on the move.

fs.en: Tired of eking out an existence on the streets, you enrolled in the military. However, you were unable to escape your lower-status background until the officer leading your unit fell in battle. In the chaos that ensued, you assumed their identity and returned home a hero. To avoid suspicion, you took on the life of an adventurer, staying always on the move.
fs.zh: 你厭倦了街頭掙扎求生的日子，加入了軍隊。然而，你始終無法擺脫低微的出身，直到你部隊的軍官在戰鬥中陣亡。在隨後的混亂中，你假冒了該軍官的身分，以英雄之姿返鄉。但是懷疑聲四起，你決定踏上冒險的生活，不斷遷徙，保持流動。

heroes.background.career.soldier.incitin.zh: 你厭倦了街頭掙扎求生的日子，加入了軍隊。然而，你始終無法擺脫低微的出身，直到你部隊的軍官在戰鬥中陣亡。在隨後的混亂中，你假冒了該軍官的身分，以英雄之姿返鄉。但是懷疑聲四起，你決定踏上冒險的生活，不斷遷徙，保持流動。

fs.en: Stolen Valor
fs.zh: 冒名英雄

heroes.background.career.soldier.incitin.en: You promised a fellow soldier that you’d protect his family if he ever fell in battle. When he did, you traveled to his village, but found its people slain or scattered by war. Driven by your vow, you have dedicated your life to finding any survivors and protecting others from a similar fate.

fs.en: You promised a fellow soldier that you’d protect his family if he ever fell in battle. When he did, you traveled to his village, but found its people slain or scattered by war. Driven by your vow, you have dedicated your life to finding any survivors and protecting others from a similar fate.
fs.zh: 你曾向戰友承諾，若他戰死沙場，你會保護他的家人。當他真的犧牲後，你前往他的村莊，卻發現村民因為戰爭而被殺害或驅散。你受到誓言的驅使，致力於尋找倖存者，並保護他人免受相似的命運。

heroes.background.career.soldier.incitin.zh: 你曾向戰友承諾，若他戰死沙場，你會保護他的家人。當他真的犧牲後，你前往他的村莊，卻發現村民因為戰爭而被殺害或驅散。你受到誓言的驅使，致力於尋找倖存者，並保護他人免受相似的命運。

fs.en: Vow of Sacrifice
fs.zh: 犧牲的誓言

heroes.background.career.soldier.questio.en: In which army and company did you serve?
heroes.background.career.soldier.questio.zh: 你曾效力於哪支軍隊？隸屬哪個連隊？

heroes.background.career.soldier.questio.en: What conflicts were you a part of?
What heroics did you perform in the heat of battle?
heroes.background.career.soldier.questio.zh: 你在戰場上展現過哪些英勇事蹟？

heroes.background.career.warden.benefit..en: Perk: One exploration perk (Quick Build: Camouflage Hunter.)
heroes.background.career.warden.benefit..zh: 專長：1 項探索類專長（速選：迷彩獵人）。

heroes.background.career.warden.benefit..en: Skills: Nature (from the lore skill group), plus one skill from the exploration group and one skill from the intrigue group (Quick Build: Nature, Navigate, Track.)
heroes.background.career.warden.benefit..zh: 技能：獲得「自然」（學識類技能），另從探索類技能組和諜報類技能組各選擇 1 項技能（速選：自然、導航、追蹤）。

heroes.background.career.warden.descript.en: You protected a wild region from those who sought to harm it, such as poachers and cultists bent on the destruction of the natural world. Knowing your land well, you could also serve as a guide or the leader of a rescue party for those wandering the wilds.
heroes.background.career.warden.descript.zh: 你保護著一片荒野，抵禦意圖破壞之人，包括盜獵者和企圖毀滅大自然的邪教徒。因為你非常熟悉這片土地，你也可以承擔嚮導和救援隊長的工作，幫助行經荒野的人們。

heroes.background.career.warden.inciting.en: When outsiders arrived in your lands with the intent to exploit the wilds for their resources, you spoke out against them. However, several other wardens spoke in favor of these outsiders, and allowed them in to despoil nature. Refusing to watch your homeland destroyed, you left. Now you help others avoid such a fate.

fs.en: When outsiders arrived in your lands with the intent to exploit the wilds for their resources, you spoke out against them. However, several other wardens spoke in favor of these outsiders and allowed them in to despoil nature. Refusing to watch your homeland destroyed, you left. Now you help others avoid such a fate.
fs.zh: 外來者帶著開採自然資源的意圖進入你的領地，而你公開表示反對，但其他幾位守望者卻支持這些外來者，並允許他們破壞自然環境。你無法忍受眼睜睜地看著家園被毀滅，因此選擇離開。如今，你致力於幫助他人避免遭遇相同的命運。

heroes.background.career.warden.inciting.zh: 外來者帶著開採自然資源的意圖進入你的領地，而你公開表示反對，但其他幾位守望者卻支持這些外來者，並允許他們破壞自然環境。你無法忍受眼睜睜地看著家園被毀滅，因此選擇離開。如今，你致力於幫助他人避免遭遇相同的命運。

fs.en: Betrayed
fs.zh: 背叛

heroes.background.career.warden.inciting.en: A disease has infected the lands you protect, causing animals to become violent and twisting plants into something sinister. You’ve tried everything, magical and mundane, to stop the scourge, but it continues to spread. As such, you’ve set out in search of a cure or an unblighted land to protect.

fs.en: A disease has infected the lands you protect, causing animals to become violent and twisting plants into something dark and sinister. You’ve tried everything, magical and mundane, to stop the scourge, but it continues to spread. As such, you’ve set out in search of a cure or an unblighted land to protect.
fs.zh: 一種疾病感染了你所保護的土地，導致動物變得暴力，植物扭曲成邪惡形態。你嘗試了各種魔法和非魔法手段，卻無法阻止這場災難蔓延。因此，你踏上旅程，尋找解藥，或尋找一片尚未受污染、可供你守護的土地。

heroes.background.career.warden.inciting.zh: 一種疾病感染了你所保護的土地，導致動物變得暴力，植物扭曲成邪惡形態。你嘗試了各種魔法和非魔法手段，卻無法阻止這場災難蔓延。因此，你踏上旅程，尋找解藥，或尋找一片尚未受污染、可供你守護的土地。

fs.en: Corruption
fs.zh: 腐化

heroes.background.career.warden.inciting.en: You made a mistake that could not be forgiven. The other wardens of the region decided your fate, exiling you from your lands with an order never to return.

fs.en: You made a mistake that could not be forgiven. The other wardens of the region decided your fate, exiling you from your lands with an order never to return.
fs.zh: 你犯下了不可饒恕的過錯。這片地區的其他守望者決定了你的命運，將你驅逐，並命令你永遠不得歸返。

heroes.background.career.warden.inciting.zh: 你犯下了不可饒恕的過錯。這片地區的其他守望者決定了你的命運，將你驅逐，並命令你永遠不得歸返。

fs.en: Exiled
fs.zh: 放逐

heroes.background.career.warden.inciting.en: A group of heroes arrived in your territory with trouble close on their heels. You fought alongside them to turn back the evil, but it was too much. The heroes fell, and your wilderness was forever altered. Though your lands are beyond saving, there are other lands you can help.

fs.en: A group of heroes arrived in your territory with trouble close on their heels. You fought alongside them to turn back the evil, but it was too much. The heroes fell, and your wilderness was forever altered. Though your lands are beyond saving, there are other lands you can help.
fs.zh: 一群英雄抵達了你的領地，但麻煩也緊隨其後。你與他們並肩作戰抵抗邪惡，但敵人實在太過強大。英雄們犧牲了，你的荒野也永遠改變。儘管你的土地已經無法挽救，但世上還有其他地方需要你的幫助。

heroes.background.career.warden.inciting.zh: 一群英雄抵達了你的領地，但麻煩也緊隨其後。你與他們並肩作戰抵抗邪惡，但敵人實在太過強大。英雄們犧牲了，你的荒野也永遠改變。儘管你的土地已經無法挽救，但世上還有其他地方需要你的幫助。

fs.en: Honor the Fallen
fs.zh: 追悼英雄

heroes.background.career.warden.inciting.en: There were signs. You tried to ignore them, but when a great beast died at your feet, you had to recognize the truth. You were meant to leave your home territory, meant to fight a battle for the fate of all lands—and so you gave up the only life you’ve ever known.

fs.en: There were signs. You tried to ignore them, but when a great beast died at your feet, you had to recognize the truth. You were meant to leave your home territory, meant to fight a battle for the fate of all lands - and so you gave up the only life you’ve ever known.
fs.zh: 你試圖忽視曾經出現過的徵兆，但當一頭巨獸死在你腳邊時，你不得不承認事實。你命中註定要離開家園，註定要為所有土地的命運而戰，因此你放棄了唯一熟悉的生活方式。

heroes.background.career.warden.inciting.zh: 你試圖忽視曾經出現過的徵兆，但當一頭巨獸死在你腳邊時，你不得不承認事實。你命中註定要離開家園，註定要為所有土地的命運而戰，因此你放棄了唯一熟悉的生活方式。

fs.en: Portents
fs.zh: 預兆

heroes.background.career.warden.inciting.en: You were responsible for guarding something precious, something vital to your region’s survival. But you let someone in, and they betrayed your trust by stealing the thing you were meant to guard. You left your chosen territory to atone for your mistake.

fs.en: You were responsible for guarding something precious, something vital to your region’s survival. But you let someone in, and they betrayed your trust by stealing the thing you were meant to guard. You left your chosen territory to atone for your mistake.
fs.zh: 你負責守護一件珍貴之物，它對你所在地區的生存至關重要。你讓某人進入領地，對方卻背叛了你的信任，偷走你本應保護的寶物。為了彌補自己的過錯，你離開了自己守護的領地。

heroes.background.career.warden.inciting.zh: 你負責守護一件珍貴之物，它對你所在地區的生存至關重要。你讓某人進入領地，對方卻背叛了你的信任，偷走你本應保護的寶物。為了彌補自己的過錯，你離開了自己守護的領地。

fs.en: Theft
fs.zh: 竊盜

heroes.background.career.warden.question.en: Were you part of a formal group of wardens or did you take the job upon yourself?
heroes.background.career.warden.question.zh: 你是正式守望組織的成員，還是自己主動承擔這個責任？

heroes.background.career.warden.question.en: Which animal became your constant companion while you worked in the wild?
heroes.background.career.warden.question.zh: 在野外工作時，哪種動物始終陪伴在你身邊？

heroes.background.career.warden.question.en: What mysterious creature or wanderer did you meet in the forest, and what prophecy did they share with you?
heroes.background.career.warden.question.zh: 你在森林中遇見了什麼神祕生物或流浪者？他們向你分享了什麼預言？

heroes.background.career.watch-officer.b.en: Perk: One exploration perk (Quick Build: Team Leader.)
heroes.background.career.watch-officer.b.zh: 專長：1 項探索類專長（速選：團隊領袖）。

heroes.background.career.watch-officer.b.en: Skills: Alertness (from the intrigue skill group), plus two more skills from the intrigue group (Quick Build: Alertness, Search, Track.)
heroes.background.career.watch-officer.b.zh: 技能：獲得「警覺」（諜報類技能），另從諜報類技能組選擇 2 項其他技能（速選：警覺、搜索、追蹤）。

heroes.background.career.watch-officer.d.en: You served as an officer of the law for a local government. You might have been a single person in a much larger city watch or the only constable patrolling a small village.
heroes.background.career.watch-officer.d.zh: 你曾在地方政府擔任執法人員，可能是大城市警衛的一員，或是小村莊唯一的治安官。

heroes.background.career.watch-officer.i.en: You grew bored and disillusioned with chasing down petty thieves and imprisoning folks just trying to survive. Surely there are greater threats in the world. You will find that evil wherever it may lurk, and you’ll be the one to stop it.

fs.en: You grew bored and disillusioned with chasing down petty thieves and imprisoning folks just trying to survive. Surely there are greater threats in the world. You will find that evil wherever it may lurk, and you’ll be the one to stop it.
fs.zh: 你對追捕小偷，以及將那些僅為求生而掙扎的人關進牢裡的工作感到厭倦與失望。世界上肯定存在著更大的威脅。你決心找出那些潛伏的真正邪惡，並成為終結它們的人。

heroes.background.career.watch-officer.i.zh: 你對追捕小偷，以及將那些僅為求生而掙扎的人關進牢裡的工作感到厭倦與失望。世界上肯定存在著更大的威脅。你決心找出那些潛伏的真正邪惡，並成為終結它們的人。

fs.en: Bigger Fish
fs.zh: 更大的魚

heroes.background.career.watch-officer.i.en: You joined the force to help the helpless and bring justice to those wronged. You weren’t prepared for the rampant corruption reaching the top of your organization. You refused to cover for your fellow officers and were told in no uncertain terms to leave town or face the consequences. Now you travel as a hero, acting as the protector you always wanted to be.

fs.en: You joined the force to help the helpless and bring justice to those wronged. You weren’t prepared for the rampant corruption reaching the top of your organization. You refused to cover for your fellow officers and were told in no simple terms to leave town or face the consequences. Now you travel as a hero, acting as the protector you always wanted to be.
fs.zh: 你加入守望隊是為了幫助弱者，為受害者伸張正義，但你沒有料到組織高層是多麼猖獗腐敗。當你拒絕掩飾同僚的不法行為時，你收到了明確的警告：馬上離開城鎮，否則後果自負。如今，你以英雄身分遊歷四方，終於成為了你一直嚮往的守護者。

heroes.background.career.watch-officer.i.zh: 你加入守望隊是為了幫助弱者，為受害者伸張正義，但你沒有料到組織高層是多麼猖獗腐敗。當你拒絕掩飾同僚的不法行為時，你收到了明確的警告：馬上離開城鎮，否則後果自負。如今，你以英雄身分遊歷四方，終於成為了你一直嚮往的守護者。

fs.en: Corruption Within
fs.zh: 內部腐敗

heroes.background.career.watch-officer.i.en: Your partner was murdered. That much is irrefutable. But you didn’t do it, despite what the evidence implies. When it became clear you’d take the fall, you fled, leaving everything behind. Not content to cower in the shadows, you decided to adventure under a new name while you work to clear your own.

fs.en: Your partner was murdered. That much is irrefutable. But you didn’t do it, despite what the evidence implies. When it became clear you’d take the fall, you fled, leaving everything behind. Not content to cower in the shadows, you decided to adventure under a new name while you work to clear your own.
fs.zh: 你的夥伴被謀殺了，而這是無可爭辯的事實。儘管證據都指向你，但你並非兇手。當你意識到自己將成為代罪羔羊時，你逃亡了，拋下了一切。你不願躲藏在陰影中度日，決定以新的名字踏上冒險之路，同時致力於洗清自己的罪名。

heroes.background.career.watch-officer.i.zh: 你的夥伴被謀殺了，而這是無可爭辯的事實。儘管證據都指向你，但你並非兇手。當你意識到自己將成為代罪羔羊時，你逃亡了，拋下了一切。你不願躲藏在陰影中度日，決定以新的名字踏上冒險之路，同時致力於洗清自己的罪名。

fs.en: Frame Job
fs.zh: 陷害

heroes.background.career.watch-officer.i.en: You learned everything you know about the job from someone you always looked up to in a corrupt organization. One night, they sent you a cryptic message saying they had discovered “something big,” but before you could find out more, they disappeared. No longer sure who you could trust, you slipped away and sought a new life. Now you do what good you can and search to find the truth.

fs.en: You learned everything you know about the job from someone you always looked up to in a corrupt organization. One night, they sent you a cryptic message saying they had discovered “something big,” but before you found out more, they disappeared. No longer sure who you could trust, you slipped away and sought a new life. Now you do what good you can and search to find the truth.
fs.zh: 你這份工作的所有知識都來自一位你深深敬仰的導師，但他身處一個腐敗的組織。一天晚上，你收到他發來的一條神祕訊息，聲稱發現了「重大的事情」，但在你能了解詳情前，他就突然消失了。你不知道還能信任誰，於是悄悄離開，踏上了新的旅程。如今，你一邊盡力行善，一邊尋找真相。

heroes.background.career.watch-officer.i.zh: 你這份工作的所有知識都來自一位你深深敬仰的導師，但他身處一個腐敗的組織。一天晚上，你收到他發來的一條神祕訊息，聲稱發現了「重大的事情」，但在你能了解詳情前，他就突然消失了。你不知道還能信任誰，於是悄悄離開，踏上了新的旅程。如今，你一邊盡力行善，一邊尋找真相。

fs.en: Missing Mentor
fs.zh: 失蹤導師

heroes.background.career.watch-officer.i.en: A violent or depraved criminal began targeting you— perhaps stealing something personal or hurting someone you love—after slipping through your grasp. You left your career to pursue the criminal, but the trail has gone cold … for now. Might as well help folk in the meantime.

fs.en: A particularly violent or depraved criminal began targeting you - perhaps stealing something personal or hurting someone you love - after slipping through your grasp. You left your career to pursue the criminal, but the trail has gone cold … for now. Might as well help folk in the meantime.
fs.zh: 一名暴力或墮落的罪犯從你手中逃脫後就開始針對你，他可能偷走了你的重要物品，或傷害了你所愛的人。為了抓住這個罪犯，你放棄了原本的職業，但目前線索已經斷了。既然如此，你決定在繼續追查的同時，幫助那些有需要的人。

heroes.background.career.watch-officer.i.zh: 一名暴力或墮落的罪犯從你手中逃脫後就開始針對你，他可能偷走了你的重要物品，或傷害了你所愛的人。為了抓住這個罪犯，你放棄了原本的職業，但目前線索已經斷了。既然如此，你決定在繼續追查的同時，幫助那些有需要的人。

fs.en: One That Got Away
fs.zh: 逃脫的罪犯

heroes.background.career.watch-officer.i.en: You made it your responsibility to root out and bring down the region’s foremost crime syndicate. They sent goons to burn down your home and teach you a lesson, leaving you bleeding in the street with nothing left except your life. You’ve since taken on the life of a hero to gain the power and influence you need to destroy the syndicate once and for all.

fs.en: You made it your responsibility to root out and bring down the region’s foremost crime syndicate. They sent goons to burn down your home and teach you a lesson, leaving you bleeding in the street with nothing left except your life. You’ve since taken on the life of a hero to gain the power and influence you need to destroy the syndicate once and for all.
fs.zh: 你肩負了根除該地區主要犯罪集團的責任，但他們派打手燒毀你的家，並痛打你一頓，讓你血流不止地躺在街頭，除了性命以外已經一無所有。此後，你選擇了英雄之路，致力於獲得足夠的力量和影響力，徹底摧毀這個犯罪集團。

heroes.background.career.watch-officer.i.zh: 你肩負了根除該地區主要犯罪集團的責任，但他們派打手燒毀你的家，並痛打你一頓，讓你血流不止地躺在街頭，除了性命以外已經一無所有。此後，你選擇了英雄之路，致力於獲得足夠的力量和影響力，徹底摧毀這個犯罪集團。

fs.en: Powerful Enemies
fs.zh: 強大敵人

heroes.background.career.watch-officer.q.en: What type of settlement did you protect?
heroes.background.career.watch-officer.q.zh: 你保護的是哪種類型的聚落？

heroes.background.career.watch-officer.q.en: What was your law enforcement style like? Were you a by-the-book officer, a more lenient-but-fair type, or totally corrupt?
heroes.background.career.watch-officer.q.zh: 你的執法風格如何？你是照章辦事、寬容但公正，還是完全腐敗？

heroes.background.career.watch-officer.q.en: What criminal still eludes your grasp to this day?
heroes.background.career.watch-officer.q.zh: 有哪位罪犯至今你仍未追捕到案？

heroes.background.career.watch-officer.q.en: Whose life did you save in the line of duty?
heroes.background.career.watch-officer.q.zh: 你在執勤時救過誰的性命？

heroes.background.career.watch-officer.q.en: What is the most absurd call you ever responded to and how did you handle it?
heroes.background.career.watch-officer.q.zh: 你曾接獲並處理過最荒謬的報案是什麼？你如何應對？

heroes.background.culture.alertness-side.en: If the culture you create doesn’t grant a skill that you want, check with your Director about modifying what the culture’s aspects offer. For instance, you can easily make the case that a culture with the noble upbringing aspect should give a character access to the Alertness skill, given that living among those who covet your power means always being aware of your surroundings.
heroes.background.culture.alertness-side.zh: 如果你建立的文化沒有提供你想要的技能，可以詢問導演是否能修改各文化面向所提供的選項。例如，你完全可以主張，擁有「貴族」成長經歷的文化應該讓角色可以選擇「警覺」技能；畢竟，生活在那些覬覦你權力的人群之中，就代表你必須時時留意周遭。
