heroes.background.culture.benefits.rules.en: The culture you choose or create grants you the following benefits: ¥ You know the language of your culture, in addition to knowing Caelian. ¥ From the environment, organization, and upbringing aspects of your culture, you gain access to skills. You can select one skill from each aspect’s list of options. (Skills in Chapter 9: Tests has information on the part skills play in the game.) ¥ You gain an edge on tests made to recall lore about your culture, and on tests made to influence and interact with people of your culture. (See Edges and Banes in Chapter 1: The Basics.)
heroes.background.culture.benefits.rules.zh:
你選擇或創建的文化會給你以下好處：
• 除了凱利安語（通用語），你還會說自己文化的語言。
• 你可以從文化的 3 個面向——生活環境、組織型態和成長經歷——所提供的技能選項中，各選擇 1 項技能（關於技能在遊戲中的作用，請參閱第 9 章〈考驗〉的「技能」）。
• 當你需要回憶自己文化的知識，或影響及與同文化的人互動時，你的考驗會獲得 1 個優勢（參閱第 1 章〈基礎〉的「優勢與劣勢」）。

heroes.background.culture.environment.de.en: Your culture’s environment aspect describes where the people of that culture spend most of their time. Is your culture centered in a bustling city or a small village? Did you spend your early life in an isolated monastery? Or did you wander the wilderness, never staying in one place for long?
heroes.background.culture.environment.de.zh: 生活環境是指你的文化通常待在什麼地方。你是住在熱鬧的城市，還是小村莊？也許你在偏遠的修道院長大，或是像流浪者一樣在荒野中到處旅行，從不在同一個地方久留？

heroes.background.culture.environment.no.en: A nomadic culture travels from place to place to survive. Members of a nomadic culture might follow animal migrations or the weather, travel to sell their wares or services, or simply enjoy a restless lifestyle full of new experiences and peoples. Those who grow up in nomadic cultures learn to navigate the wilderness and work closely with others to survive.

fs.en: A nomadic culture travels from place to place to survive.
fs.zh: 遊牧文化為了生存而不斷從一個地方遷移到另一個地方。

heroes.background.culture.environment.no.zh: 遊牧文化為了生存而不斷從一個地方遷移到另一個地方。遊牧文化的成員可能會跟隨動物遷徙或氣候變化而四處旅行，販售商品或服務，或單純享受充滿全新體驗與形形色色人群的流浪生活方式。在遊牧文化中成長的人會學習如何在荒野中導航，並與他人緊密合作，以求生存。

heroes.background.culture.environment.no.en: Skill Options: One skill from the exploration or interpersonal skill groups. (Quick Build: Navigate.)
heroes.background.culture.environment.no.zh: 技能選項：從探索類技能或交涉類技能中選擇 1 項技能（速選：導航）。

heroes.background.culture.environment.ru.en: When you build a culture, select its environment aspect from the following options: nomadic, rural, secluded, urban, or wilderness. You gain skill options from your chosen environment. All of these environments can be found in any sort of terrain, whether aboveground, in subterranean caverns, deep in trackless forest, or even underwater.
heroes.background.culture.environment.ru.zh: 建立文化時，從以下選項中選擇你「生活環境」的面向：遊牧、鄉村、隱居、城市或荒野。你會根據所選的生活環境獲得技能選項。這些生活環境可以出現在任何類型的地形中，無論是地表、地下洞窟、杳無人跡的森林深處，甚至水下。

heroes.background.culture.environment.ru.en: A rural culture is one located in a town, village, or smaller settled enclave. People dwelling in such places often cultivate the land, trade goods or services with travelers passing through, harvest fish from the sea, or mine metals and gems from the earth. Living among a small population, most folks in a rural community learn a trade and are handed down bits of essential knowledge to help their community survive. For example, when a rural culture has only one blacksmith, it’s important to have an apprentice already learning at the anvil well before that smith starts to get old. If the only priest in town gets the sniffles, folks want an acolyte ready to wear the fancy robes should the worst occur.

fs.en: A rural culture is one located in a town, village, or smaller settled enclave.
fs.zh: 鄉村文化存在於小鎮、村莊或更小的聚落。

heroes.background.culture.environment.ru.zh:
鄉村文化存在於小鎮、村莊或更小的聚落。住在這些地方的人們通常會耕種土地、與過路旅人交易商品或服務、從海裡捕魚，或從地底開採金屬和寶石。

在人口稀少的環境中，鄉村社區的大多數居民都會學習一門手藝，並傳承對社區生存至關重要的基本知識。例如，如果鄉村只有一名鐵匠，在這位鐵匠年老之前，必須找個學徒在鐵砧旁學習。如果鎮上唯一的祭司感冒了，居民們會希望有位侍僧能在最壞情況發生時穿上那華麗的長袍。

heroes.background.culture.environment.ru.en: Skill Options: One skill from the crafting or lore skill groups. (Quick Build: Nature.)
heroes.background.culture.environment.ru.zh: 技能選項：從工藝類技能或學識類技能中選擇 1 項技能（速選：自然）。

heroes.background.culture.environment.se.en: A secluded culture is based in one relatively close-quarters structure—a building, a cavern, and so forth—and interacts with other cultures only rarely. Such places are often buildings or complexes such as monasteries, castles, or prisons. Folk in a secluded culture have little or no reason to leave their home or interact with other cultures on the outside, but might have an awareness of those cultures and of events happening beyond their enclave. When people live together in close quarters, they typically learn to get along. They often spend much time in study or introspection, as there is not much else to do in seclusion.

fs.en: A secluded culture is based in one relatively close-quarters structure — a building, a cavern, and so forth — and interacts with other cultures only rarely.
fs.zh: 隱居文化存在於單一且相對狹小的結構中（例如建築物或洞穴），幾乎不會與外界文化有所互動。

heroes.background.culture.environment.se.zh:
隱居文化存在於單一且相對狹小的結構中（例如建築物或洞穴），幾乎不會與外界文化有所互動。這類場所大多為修道院、城堡或監獄等建築物或建築群。生活在隱居文化中的人很少有離開家園或與外界文化往來的需求，但他們仍然可以察覺外界文化的存在，以及了解家鄉之外發生的事情。

在狹小空間中共同生活的人，往往會培養出和睦相處的能力。由於隱居環境的活動受限，他們大多將時間投注在學習和自我反思上。

heroes.background.culture.environment.se.en: Skill Options: One skill from the interpersonal or lore skill groups. (Quick Build: Read Person.)
heroes.background.culture.environment.se.zh: 技能選項：從交涉類技能或學識類技能中選擇 1 項技能（速選：觀色）。

heroes.background.culture.environment.ur.en: An urban culture is always centered in a city. Such a culture might arise within the walls of Capital, a massive metropolis with a cosmopolitan population; within a network of caverns that hold an underground city; or in any other place where a large population lives relatively close together. The people of urban cultures often learn to effectively misdirect others in order to navigate the crowds and the political machinations that can come with city life.

fs.en: An urban culture is always centered in a city.
fs.zh: 城市文化始終以城市為中心。

heroes.background.culture.environment.ur.zh: 城市文化始終以城市為中心。這種文化可能會出現在元城的城牆之內（那是一座擁有多元人口的巨大都市）；或在容納地下城市的洞穴網路中形成；又或是在任何人口密集且緊密居住的地方自然發展。城市文化的居民通常善於誤導他人、在人群中自由穿行，以及應對城市生活中無所不在的政治角力。

heroes.background.culture.environment.ur.en: Skill Options: One skill from the interpersonal or intrigue skill groups. (Quick Build: Alertness.)
heroes.background.culture.environment.ur.zh: 技能選項：從交涉類技能或諜報類技能中選擇 1 項技能（速選：警覺）。

heroes.background.culture.environment.wi.en: A wilderness culture doesn’t try to tame the terrain in which its people live, whether desert, forest, swamp, tundra, ocean, or more exotic climes. Instead, the folk of such a culture thrive amid nature, taking their sustenance and shelter from the land. A wilderness culture might be a circle of druids protecting a remote wode, a band of brigands hiding out in desert caves, or a camp of orc mercenaries who call the trackless mountains home. People in a wilderness culture learn how to use the land for all they need to live, typically crafting their own tools, clothing, and more.

fs.en: A wilderness culture doesn’t try to tame the terrain in which its people live, whether desert, forest, swamp, tundra, ocean, or more exotic climes.
fs.zh: 荒野文化的人民不會試圖征服他們居住的地方，無論是沙漠、森林、沼澤、凍原、海洋，還是更特殊的環境。

heroes.background.culture.environment.wi.zh: 荒野文化的人民不會試圖征服他們居住的地方，無論是沙漠、森林、沼澤、凍原、海洋，還是更特殊的環境。相反地，荒野文化與大自然和諧共生，從土地獲取食物與庇護。荒野文化可能是守護偏僻幻林的德魯伊結社、潛居在沙漠洞穴中的盜匪隊伍，或是將無路可循的群山視為家園的歐克傭兵團。在荒野文化中成長的人們懂得如何善用土地來滿足生活所需，通常也會親手製作工具與衣物等用品。

heroes.background.culture.environment.wi.en: Skill Options: One skill from the crafting or exploration skill groups. (Quick Build: Endurance.)
heroes.background.culture.environment.wi.zh: 技能選項：從工藝類技能或探索類技能中選擇 1 項技能（速選：耐力）。

heroes.background.culture.language.descr.en: Your culture’s language aspect determines how the people of your culture communicate. Languages in Orden below discusses the many languages of the world of Orden, including Caelian—the language of the fallen empire that once dominated that world.
heroes.background.culture.language.descr.zh: 語言決定了你文化中的人們如何交流。下方的「歐爾登的語言」會介紹歐爾登世界中的眾多語言，其中包括凱利安語——曾經統治這個世界、如今已滅亡之帝國所使用的語言。

heroes.background.culture.organization.b.en: Bureaucratic cultures are steeped in official leadership and formally recorded laws. Members of such a culture are often ranked in power according to those laws, with a small group of people holding the power to rule according to birthright, popular vote, or some other official and measurable standard. Many bureaucratic communities have one person at the top, though others might be ruled by a council. A trade guild with a guildmaster, treasurer, secretary, and a charter of rules and regulations for membership; a feudal lord who rules over a group of knights who in turn rule over peasants working the land; and a militaristic society with ranks and rules that its people must abide are all examples of bureaucratic cultures. Those who thrive in bureaucratic cultures don’t simply follow the rules. They know how to use those rules to their advantage, either bending, changing, or reinterpreting policy to advance their own interests. Schmoozing with those who make the laws is often key to this approach. Others in a bureaucratic culture might specialize in operating outside the strict regulations that govern the culture without getting caught.

fs.en: Bureaucratic cultures are steeped in official leadership and formally recorded laws.
fs.zh: 官僚文化深深根植於正式的領導制度與成文法律。

heroes.background.culture.organization.b.zh:
官僚文化深深根植於正式的領導制度與成文法律。在這種文化中，成員依據法律獲得不同的權力階級，而統治權則掌握在少數人手中，他們透過血統繼承、民眾投票或其他正式且可量化的標準來獲得權力。大多數官僚社群由一位最高統治者領導，但有些則採用議會制。官僚文化的典型例子包括：設有公會長、司庫、祕書，並訂有會員規章的商業公會；統治一群騎士，而這些騎士又統治農民的封建領主；以及設有階級與成員必須遵守之規則的軍事社會。

在官僚文化中茁壯成長的人並非只是盲目遵守規則。無論是透過曲解、修改或重新詮釋政策，他們都善於運用這些規則來謀取私利並達成個人目標，與立法者建立良好的關係更是成功的關鍵。此外，官僚文化中也有一群人專門在不引人注目的情況下，在嚴格的體制外靈活運作。

heroes.background.culture.organization.b.en: Skill Options: One skill from the interpersonal or intrigue skill groups. (Quick Build: Persuade.)
heroes.background.culture.organization.b.zh: 技能選項：從交涉類技能或諜報類技能中選擇 1 項技能（速選：遊說）。

heroes.background.culture.organization.c.en: A communal culture is a place where all members of the culture are considered equal. The community works together to make important decisions that affect the majority of the culture. While they elect leaders to carry out these decisions and organize their efforts, each person has a relatively equal say in how the culture operates, and everyone contributes to help their people survive and thrive. Individuals often share the burdens of governing, physical labor, childcare, and other duties. A collective of farmers who work together to cultivate and protect their land without a noble, a city of pirates where each person can do as they wish, and a traveling theatrical troupe whose members vote on every artistic and administrative decision are all communal cultures. Many communal cultures operate outside settled lands, sticking to the wilds, a specific district in a larger settlement, city sewers, forgotten ruins, or other isolated places. For even when such cultures are harmless, their members know that outsiders might try to impose rules upon them if they live in the same place. As such, many folks in communal cultures focus on fending for themselves while avoiding the danger that other groups can represent.

fs.en: A communal culture is a place where all members of the culture are considered equal.
fs.zh: 平權文化是一個所有成員皆平等的地方。

heroes.background.culture.organization.c.zh:
平權文化是一個所有成員皆平等的地方，社群會共同做出影響多數成員的重要決策。雖然他們會選出領袖來執行決策並組織事務，但每個人都有相對平等的發言權來決定文化的運作方向，且人人都會為社群的生存與茁壯貢獻心力。成員會分擔治理、勞動、育兒及其他職責。平權文化的典型例子包括：沒有貴族管轄、共同耕作並守護土地的農民團體；人人自由的海盜城市；以及所有成員都能對藝術和行政決策投票的巡迴劇團。

許多平權文化選擇不在已開發地區之內活動，而是主要活躍於荒野、大型聚落的特定區域、城市下水道、被遺忘的廢墟，或其他與世隔絕的地方。即使這些文化本身無害，成員也知道，如果與外人住在同一個地方，外人可能會試圖把規則強加在他們身上。因此，平權文化的人們大多專注於自給自足的生活，同時謹慎地避開其他群體可能帶來的威脅。

heroes.background.culture.organization.c.en: Skill Options: One skill from the crafting or exploration skill groups. (Quick Build: Jump.)
heroes.background.culture.organization.c.zh: 技能選項：從工藝類技能或探索類技能中選擇 1 項技能（速選：跳躍）。

heroes.background.culture.organization.d.en: Your culture’s organization aspect determines the functioning and leadership of your community. You might come from a place with an officially recognized government and a system of laws. Or your culture might have enjoyed a less-formal organization, with the people in charge having naturally gravitated toward their positions without any official offices or oaths.
heroes.background.culture.organization.d.zh: 組織型態決定了你社區的運作和領導方式。你可能來自有正式政府和法律的地方，或者你的文化可能比較不正式，領導者是自然產生的，沒有官方職位或誓言。

heroes.background.culture.organization.r.en: When you build a culture, select its organization aspect from the following options: bureaucratic or communal. You gain skill options from your chosen system of organization.
heroes.background.culture.organization.r.zh: 建立文化時，從以下選項中選擇你「組織型態」的面向：官僚或平權。你會根據所選的組織型態獲得技能選項。

heroes.background.culture.overview.1.en: A hero’s culture describes the beliefs, customs, values, and way of life held by the community in which they were raised. This community provides life experiences that give a character some of their game statistics. Even if a hero doesn’t share their culture’s values, those values shaped their early development and way of life. In fact, some people become heroes primarily from the rejection of the ways of their culture.
heroes.background.culture.overview.1.zh: 英雄的文化是他們在成長過程中的信仰、習俗、價值觀和生活方式。這些生活經驗決定了英雄在遊戲中的一些數據。就算英雄不認同自己文化的價值觀，這些價值觀仍然影響了他們的早期發展。有些人甚至是因為反抗自己的文化而成為英雄。

heroes.background.culture.overview.2.en: For our purposes, a hero’s culture represents people, not a place. Yes, you might have grown up in the great city of Capital, but your culture is more specific than that. One hero’s culture might be House Alvaro, a noble house in Capital where they were raised. Another’s culture could be a group or organization that moves around, such as a band of pirates or a secret order of sorcerers sworn to protect books of fell magic. It helps to get specific when thinking about your culture, and working with the four aspects of a culture can help you do that: language, environment, organization, and upbringing.
heroes.background.culture.overview.2.zh: 在遊戲中，英雄的文化指的是人群，而不是地點。你可能在元城長大，但你的文化比這更具體。例如，一名英雄的文化可能是元城的貴族「奧瓦羅家族」，也就是他成長的家族；另一名英雄的文化則可能是四處移動的團體或組織，例如海盜團，或立誓守護邪異魔法典籍的祕密巫師組織。思考你的文化時，具體一些會很有幫助，而文化的 4 個面向可以協助你做到這點：語言、生活環境、組織型態與成長經歷。

fs.en: Devil
fs.zh: 魔鬼

heroes.background.culture.typical.devil.zh: 魔鬼｜安賈利語｜城市｜官僚｜學術

heroes.background.culture.typical.dragon.zh: 龍騎士｜華斯塔里亞語｜隱居｜官僚｜尚武

fs.zh: 矮人

heroes.background.culture.typical.dwarf.zh: 矮人｜札力語｜隱居｜官僚｜創作

fs.en: Hakaan
fs.zh: 哈肯人

heroes.background.culture.typical.hakaan.zh: 哈肯人｜沃瑞語｜鄉村｜平權｜勞動

heroes.background.culture.typical.high-e.zh: 高等精靈｜赫拉語｜隱居｜官僚｜尚武

fs.zh: 人類

heroes.background.culture.typical.human.zh: 人類｜華斯洛里亞語｜城市｜平權｜勞動

heroes.background.culture.typical.memone.zh: 梅莫人｜公理語｜遊牧｜平權｜學術

fs.zh: 歐克

heroes.background.culture.typical.orc.zh: 歐克｜卡力語｜荒野｜平權｜創作

heroes.background.culture.typical.wode-e.zh: 幻林精靈｜伊林語｜荒野｜官僚｜尚武

heroes.background.culture.upbringing.aca.en: Your hero was raised by people who collect, study, and share books and other records. Some academics focus on one area of study, such as a college for wizards dedicated to the study of magic, or a church that teaches the word of one deity. People in an academic culture learn how to wield the power that is knowledge.

fs.en: Your hero was raised by people who collect, study, and share books and other records.
fs.zh: 你的英雄由那些收藏、研讀並分享書籍與其他紀錄的人們撫養長大。

heroes.background.culture.upbringing.aca.zh: 你的英雄由那些收藏、研讀並分享書籍與其他紀錄的人們撫養長大。有些學者專精於特定領域，例如致力於魔法研究的法師學院，或是專門傳授某位神明教義的教會。在學術環境中成長的人，都懂得如何運用知識的力量。

heroes.background.culture.upbringing.aca.en: Skill Options: One skill from the lore skill group. (Quick Build: History.)
heroes.background.culture.upbringing.aca.zh: 技能選項：從學識類技能中選擇 1 項技能（速選：歷史）。

heroes.background.culture.upbringing.cre.en: A hero with a creative upbringing was raised among folk who create art or other works valuable enough to trade. A creative culture might produce fine art such as dance, music, or sculpture, or more practical wares such as wagons, weapons, tools, or buildings. People in such cultures learn the value of quality crafting and attention to detail.

fs.en: A hero with a creative upbringing was raised among folk who create art or other works valuable enough to trade.
fs.zh: 擁有創作成長經歷的英雄是在善於創作藝術或其他具有交易價值作品的群體中長大的。

heroes.background.culture.upbringing.cre.zh: 擁有創作成長經歷的英雄是在善於創作藝術或其他具有交易價值作品的群體中長大的。創作文化可能會創作出舞蹈、音樂、雕塑等精緻藝術，或製造馬車、武器、工具、建築等實用物品。在這樣的文化薰陶下，人們自然會培養出對精湛工藝和細節的重視。

heroes.background.culture.upbringing.cre.en: Skill Options: The Music or Perform skill (from the interpersonal skill group), or one skill from the crafting group. (Quick Build: Perform.)
heroes.background.culture.upbringing.cre.zh: 技能選項：從「音樂」、「表演」（交涉類技能）或工藝類技能中選擇 1 項技能（速選：表演）。

heroes.background.culture.upbringing.des.en: Your culture’s upbringing aspect is a more specific and personal part of your hero’s story, describing how you were raised within your culture. Were you trained to become the newest archmage in a secret order of wizards, or to be a sword-wielding bodyguard who protected that arcane organization? Did you learn to delve deep into mines looking for ore in a mountain kingdom, or did you build machines meant to dig faster and deeper than any person could alone? Whatever your culture, your upbringing makes you special within that culture.
heroes.background.culture.upbringing.des.zh: 成長經歷是指你在文化中如何被撫養長大。這是英雄故事中更具體、更個人的部分。你可能被訓練成祕密巫師組織的新任大法師，或是持劍保護該祕法組織的護衛。也許你在山地王國學會深入礦坑尋找礦石，或是製造能比任何人單獨挖得更快、更深的機械。無論你的文化是什麼，你的成長經歷都會讓你在其中變得與眾不同。

heroes.background.culture.upbringing.lab.en: Your hero came of age in a culture where people labored for a living. They might have been cultivators, typically raising crops or livestock on a farm. They might have harvested natural resources, whether by hunting, trapping, logging, or mining. Or they might have excelled at manual labor tied to settlement and trade, such as construction, carting, loading cargo, and so forth. People with a labor upbringing know the value of hard work.

fs.en: Your hero came of age in a culture where people labored for a living.
fs.zh: 你的英雄成長於一個靠勞動為生的文化中。

heroes.background.culture.upbringing.lab.zh: 你的英雄成長於一個靠勞動為生的文化中。勞動文化的人可能是耕作者，在農場裡種植作物或飼養牲畜；也可能是透過狩獵、設陷阱、伐木或採礦等方式採集自然資源的人；又或是在與聚落及貿易相關的勞力工作上表現出色，例如建築、運輸、裝卸貨物等。具有勞動成長經歷的人，深知辛勤工作的價值。

heroes.background.culture.upbringing.lab.en: Skill Options: The Blacksmithing skill (from the crafting skill group), the Handle Animals skill (from the interpersonal group), or a skill from the exploration group. (Quick Build: Lift.)
heroes.background.culture.upbringing.lab.zh: 技能選項：從「鍛造」（工藝類技能）、「馴獸」（交涉類技能）或探索類技能中選擇 1 項技能（速選：舉重）。

heroes.background.culture.upbringing.law.en: Your hero grew up among folk who performed activities that other people—whether within or outside their culture—considered unlawful. A band of pirates, a guild of assassins, or an organization of spies all commit unlawful acts for money. And under tyranny, people engaged in rebellion are often considered lawless in their actions and activities. People brought up in a lawless culture typically don’t mind breaking the rules when it suits them—and are good at making sure no one finds out they did.

fs.en: Your hero grew up among folk who performed activities that other people — whether within or outside their culture — considered unlawful.
fs.zh: 你的英雄在一群從事被他人（無論在其文化內外）視為非法活動的人們中長大。

heroes.background.culture.upbringing.law.zh: 你的英雄在一群從事被他人（無論在其文化內外）視為非法活動的人們中長大。海盜團、刺客公會或間諜組織都為金錢而進行非法行為。在暴政統治下，參與叛亂的人們也常被視為法外之徒。在這種文化中成長的人通常不介意為了私利而違反規則，而且還很擅長確保沒人發現自己的所作所為。

heroes.background.culture.upbringing.law.en: Skill Options: One skill from the intrigue skill group. (Quick Build: Sneak.)
heroes.background.culture.upbringing.law.zh: 技能選項：從諜報類技能中選擇 1 項技能（速選：潛行）。

heroes.background.culture.upbringing.mar.en: A hero with a martial upbringing was raised by warriors. These might have been the soldiers of an established army, a band of mercenaries, a guild of monster-slaying adventurers, or any other folk whose lives revolve around combat. Heroes with a martial upbringing are always ready for a fight—and they know how to finish that fight.

fs.en: A hero with a martial upbringing was raised by warriors.
fs.zh: 擁有尚武成長經歷的英雄從小在戰士的薰陶下成長。

heroes.background.culture.upbringing.mar.zh: 擁有尚武成長經歷的英雄從小在戰士的薰陶下成長。這些戰士可能來自正規軍隊、傭兵團、專門獵殺怪物的冒險者公會，或其他生活圍繞著戰鬥的人們。擁有尚武成長經歷的英雄隨時準備迎戰，更重要的是，他們知道如何結束戰鬥。

heroes.background.culture.upbringing.mar.en: Skill Options: One of the following: Blacksmithing or Fletching from the crafting skill group; Climb, Endurance, or Ride from the exploration group; Intimidate from the interpersonal group; Alertness or Track from the intrigue group; or Monsters or Strategy from the lore skill group (Quick Build: Intimidate.)
heroes.background.culture.upbringing.mar.zh: 技能選項：從以下技能中選擇 1 項：工藝類技能的「鍛造」或「製箭」；探索類技能的「攀爬」、「耐力」或「騎術」；交涉類技能的「威嚇」；諜報類技能的「警覺」或「追蹤」；或學識類技能的「怪物」或「戰略」（速選：威嚇）。

heroes.background.culture.upbringing.nob.en: Your hero grew up among leaders who rule over others and play the games of politics to maintain power. Many families are nobles by birthright, but some cultures have noble titles earned through deeds or popularity. Whatever the case, heroes with this background understand why the whispered words in the right ear can sometimes be more powerful than any army.

fs.en: Your hero grew up among leaders who rule over others and play the games of politics to maintain power.
fs.zh: 你的英雄成長於那些統治他人並運用政治手段維持權力的領導者之中。

heroes.background.culture.upbringing.nob.zh: 你的英雄成長於那些統治他人並運用政治手段維持權力的領導者之中。許多家族世代皆為貴族，但在某些文化中，貴族頭銜是透過功績或聲望獲得的。無論如何，擁有這種背景的英雄都明白，對適當之人的耳語，有時比任何軍隊都更為強大。

heroes.background.culture.upbringing.nob.en: Skill Options: One skill from the interpersonal skill group. (Quick Build: Lead.)
heroes.background.culture.upbringing.nob.zh: 技能選項：從交涉類技能中選擇 1 項技能（速選：領導）。

heroes.background.culture.upbringing.rul.en: Pick your upbringing aspect from the following list: academic, creative, labor, lawless, martial, or noble. You gain skill options from your chosen aspect.
heroes.background.culture.upbringing.rul.zh: 從以下選項中選擇你「成長經歷」的面向：學術、創作、勞動、法外、尚武或貴族。你會根據所選的成長經歷獲得技能選項。

heroes.background.culture.using.1.en: Directors can use the rules in this section to build cultures that players can choose for their characters. Players can use these rules to build a unique culture or modify an existing culture for their character, working with the Director to find the right place for that culture within the world of the campaign.
heroes.background.culture.using.1.zh: 導演可以使用本節規則建立文化，供玩家為角色選擇。玩家也可以運用這些規則為自己的角色建立獨特文化，或修改既有文化，並與導演合作，找出最適合這個文化存在於戰役世界中的位置。

heroes.background.culture.using.2.en: In many worlds, at least some cultures have a majority ancestry. The people of Bedegar, a duchy in the region of Vasloria on Orden, are mostly humans. The folk dwelling in the Great Wode, a forest realm north of Bedegar, are primarily wode elves. However, you can always choose to be from one of these cultures and take a different ancestry. A dwarf raised in the culture of the Great Wode speaks Yllyric and probably knows a lot about nature, while a dwarf raised in the dwarf thanedom of Kal Kalavar speaks Zaliac and might know a good deal about smithing.
heroes.background.culture.using.2.zh: 在很多世界中，至少有些文化主要由特定族裔組成。例如，在歐爾登的華斯洛里亞地區，貝德伽公國的居民大多是人類；而貝德伽北方的森林王國「大幻林」，居民主要是幻林精靈。不過，你仍然可以選擇來自這些文化，卻屬於不同的族裔。例如，在大幻林文化中長大的矮人會說伊林語，也可能很了解大自然；而在矮人領地「卡爾·卡拉瓦」文化中長大的矮人則會說札力語，也可能很熟悉鍛造技藝。

heroes.background.culture.using.3.en: You can build your culture one aspect at a time, or you can use the following tables if you want to assess sample cultures or make your own culture quickly. To create an archetypical culture for a hero who grew up surrounded mostly by other members of their ancestry, use or modify the aspect options on the Typical Ancestry Cultures table. (Revenants are missing from this table because they don’t gain their ancestry until after they die.) If you’d rather quickly create a culture based on a cultural archetype, such as a noble house or a pirate crew, use the Archetypical Cultures table, then add a language that fits the culture’s concept.
heroes.background.culture.using.3.zh: 你可以一步一步地建立文化，或者使用下面的表格快速評估範例文化或建立自己的文化。如果你的英雄主要是與同族人一起長大，可以使用或修改「典型族裔文化」表格中的面向選項（還魂屍沒有列在這張表中，因為他們是在死後才獲得自己的族裔）。如果你想基於某種文化類型快速建立文化（例如貴族世家或海盜團），可以使用「文化範例」表格，然後添加符合該文化概念的語言。

heroes.background.culture.why-build.rule.en: Building a character is about more than adding up your stats, picking skills and abilities, and recording that information on a character sheet. You’re building a hero—a main character in a story, be it a one-shot or a heroic campaign. Think about the personality and the past of who you are creating. That’s why the game lets you build a culture rather than simply saying, “Pick three skills and a bonus language.” We want players to imagine their heroes as complex and intricate characters.
heroes.background.culture.why-build.rule.zh: 創建角色不只是計算數據、選擇技能與招式，再把這些資訊記錄在角色表上。你是在創造英雄——故事中的主角，無論是一場單次冒險，還是一段英雄戰役。好好思考你所創造角色的性格和過往。這就是為什麼遊戲讓你建立文化，而不只是說：「選擇 3 項技能和 1 種額外語言。」我們希望玩家能將自己的英雄想像成複雜而細膩的角色。

heroes.background.languages.caelian-empi.en: The Caelian Empire dominated five of the eight regions of Orden 3,000 years ago. During the height of this most recent human empire, all humans (including folks from Vanigar in the far north, but not folks from the islands of Ix) learned to speak the Caelian tongue. For many, especially the noble classes and the well-to-do, Caelian effectively replaced their native language.
heroes.background.languages.caelian-empi.zh: 凱利安帝國在三千年前統治了歐爾登八個地區中的五個。在這個人類帝國的鼎盛時期，所有人類（包括極北方華尼伽的居民，但不包括伊蘇群島的居民）都學會了凱利安語。對許多人來說，尤其是貴族和富人階層，凱利安語實際上取代了他們的母語。

heroes.background.languages.caelian-empi.en: Some 1,300 years after the fall of the Caelian Empire, the languages of the different regions of the empire are enjoying a resurgence. Still, the Caelian tongue is spoken by most humans in most regions to one extent or another.
heroes.background.languages.caelian-empi.zh: 凱利安帝國滅亡約一千三百年後，帝國各地區的語言正在復興。儘管如此，大多數地區的大多數人類仍多少會說凱利安語。

heroes.background.languages.caelian-empi.en: Most people in Orden can speak and understand some Caelian, simply because the empire was so powerful and so widespread. Anyone trading with the empire or living near its borders or under its influence eventually learned to speak Caelian, including dwarves, dragon knights, elves, hakaan, orcs, polders, lizardfolk, and goblins. If a person speaks more than one language in Orden, the second language is almost always Caelian. All player characters know Caelian! As a result, that language of empire is now colloquially referred to as “the common tongue”—the language that most folk of Orden have in common.
heroes.background.languages.caelian-empi.zh: 由於凱利安帝國曾經如此強大，且勢力範圍極為廣闊，歐爾登大多數人都會說和聽懂一些凱利安語。任何與帝國有貿易往來、生活在帝國邊界附近，或受帝國影響的人，最終都學會了凱利安語，包括矮人、龍騎士、精靈、哈肯人、歐克、波德人、蜥蜴人和哥布林。在歐爾登，若有人會說多種語言，第二語言幾乎必定是凱利安語。所有玩家角色都懂凱利安語！正因如此，這種帝國語言如今被俗稱為「通用語」——也就是歐爾登大多數人共同使用的語言。

heroes.background.languages.dead.1.en: For an adventuring hero with an ambition to create great works or unlock deep lore, being able to read ancient writing is most useful. Much deep lore is attested only in ancient tomes and scrolls written in languages that no modern culture uses.
heroes.background.languages.dead.1.zh: 對於有志於創造偉大作品或揭開深層知識的英雄來說，能夠閱讀古代文字是極為重要的。許多珍貴的知識只存在於古代典籍和卷軸中，而這些文獻都是以現代文化不再使用的語言所書寫。

heroes.background.languages.dead.2.en: Most of these ancient writings were written by people who expected other people to read it. The lore might have been kept secret by not sharing it with anyone outside the college or cult whose members originally wrote it, but the actual writing was not intended to be difficult to read or understand. It wasn’t written in code—just in a language that people stopped speaking long ago.
heroes.background.languages.dead.2.zh: 這些古代文獻大多由預期會有其他人閱讀的人所寫。雖然這些知識可能藉由不與最初撰寫它們的學院或教派之外的人分享而保持神祕，但文字本身並非刻意設計成難以理解的形式。這些文獻不是用密碼撰寫，只是使用了人們早已不再使用的語言。

heroes.background.languages.dead.3.en: Sages can reconstruct many of these languages by learning which modern languages descended from them, then comparing them to related languages from the same time period that might have survived. Translating such ancient languages has been extremely useful for crafting and research.
heroes.background.languages.dead.3.zh: 學者能先找出哪些現代語言源自這些古代語言，再將它們與同一時期可能留存至今的相關語言進行比較，從而重建許多已失傳的語言。這些古代語言的翻譯對工藝製作和學術研究都有極大的價值。

heroes.background.languages.dead.4.en: The Dead Languages table shows some of the dead languages of Orden, and the modern languages related to those ancient languages.
heroes.background.languages.dead.4.zh: 「絕跡語言」表格展示了歐爾登一些已消亡的語言，以及與這些古代語言相關的現代語言。

heroes.background.languages.dead.khamish.en: Khamish is still spoken by lizardfolk and other creatures connected to the beast lords. However, the forms spoken today only vaguely resemble their original tongues and have been adapted for use within their speakers’ own circles.
heroes.background.languages.dead.khamish.zh: 卡米希語仍被蜥蜴人和其他與獸王有關聯的生物使用。不過，現今使用的形式與原始語言只有模糊的相似之處，而且為了適應使用者自身社群的需求而調整過。

heroes.background.languages.dead.table.c.en: Language | Ancestry | Related Languages | Common Topics
heroes.background.languages.dead.table.c.zh: 語言｜族裔｜關聯語言｜常見主題

heroes.background.languages.extant.1.en: Folk have been speaking, signing, and writing in Orden for at least thirty thousand years, but most of the world’s ancient languages are now dead. Many have been forgotten. Others were spoken by peoples who never developed writing, preventing those languages from being preserved. And many languages that were preserved in writing left no related descendants, so that no one now knows what sounds that writing represented.
heroes.background.languages.extant.1.zh: 歐爾登的居民至少在三萬年前就開始口語交流、手語溝通和文字書寫，但世界上大多數古老語言如今已經消亡。許多已被徹底遺忘；有些語言來自未發展出文字系統的民族，因此無法被保存；另有許多語言雖留下文字記錄，卻沒有相關的後裔語言，導致現今沒有人知道這些文字實際代表的發音。

heroes.background.languages.extant.2.en: The languages on the Languages by Ancestry table are the most common languages actively spoken and signed by significant populations of people in Orden. The Vaslorian Human Languages table shows the dominant languages in that region’s human-centric territories. Most languages are associated with a specific ancestry and its culture, but being a member of an ancestry doesn’t automatically make you part of the associated culture the language is tied to. For example, if your orc hero was raised in a culture of elves, you probably speak one of the elf languages, and might never have learned Kalliak.
heroes.background.languages.extant.2.zh: 「依族裔分類的語言」表格列出了歐爾登最常見、由大量人口積極用於口語和手語交流的語言。「華斯洛里亞人類語言」表格則顯示了該地區以人類為主之領土的主要語言。雖然大多數語言與特定族裔及文化相關，但成為某個族裔並不會自動讓你融入與該語言相關的文化。例如，如果你的歐克英雄在精靈文化中長大，你可能會說某種精靈語言，但可能從未學過卡力語。

heroes.background.languages.extant.3.en: Most languages have colloquial or casual names. For instance, many people in Orden call Kalliak “Orcish” and Hyrallic “Elvish,” but any sage knows there are lots of orcish and elf languages, just as there are multiple human languages.
heroes.background.languages.extant.3.zh: 大多數語言都有通俗或日常的名稱。例如，在歐爾登，許多人會將卡力語稱為「歐克語」，將赫拉語稱為「精靈語」，但任何學者都明白，就如同人類擁有多種語言一樣，歐克和精靈也各自發展了許多語言。

heroes.background.languages.extant.4.en: Each extant language has a spoken, signed, and written version. When you learn a language, you know how to speak, sign, and read it.
heroes.background.languages.extant.4.zh: 每種現存語言都有口語、手語和書面形式。若你學會一種語言，你就能夠說這種語言、使用該語言的手語，以及閱讀該語言的文字。

heroes.background.languages.overview.1.en: The languages granted by your hero’s culture shape their understanding of the world and their relationship to the creatures within it. The following section details the languages of Orden, the baseline world of the game, but the Director can use these languages in their own campaign world or can swap this list with their own list of languages.
heroes.background.languages.overview.1.zh: 你英雄的文化所賦予的語言，塑造了他對世界的理解，以及與其他生物的關係。以下會詳細介紹遊戲基準世界「歐爾登」的語言；不過，導演可以在自己的戰役世界使用這些語言，也可以用自己的語言列表替換這份列表。

heroes.background.languages.overview.2.en: If your hero knows a language, they can speak, read, write, and understand it.
heroes.background.languages.overview.2.zh: 如果你的英雄掌握了某種語言，他就能夠說、讀、寫，並理解該語言。

heroes.background.languages.usage.1.en: Hyrallic is the primary language of the high elves in Orden. Although young for an elf language, Hyrallic is older than almost all other modern cultural languages, save those of the dwarves. As a result, while anyone who lives near or trades with a human culture probably speaks at least a little Caelian, most nobles across all ancestries make sure their children or offspring speak Hyrallic. Caelian is new from many cultures’ point of view, while Hyrallic as a language for diplomacy is considered cultured and traditional.
heroes.background.languages.usage.1.zh: 赫拉語是歐爾登高等精靈的主要語言。雖然赫拉語在精靈語言中較為年輕，但仍然比幾乎所有其他現代文化語言還要古老（除了矮人的語言）。因此，雖然住在人類文化附近或與其貿易的人大多至少會說一點凱利安語，各族裔的大多數貴族仍會確保子女或後代學習赫拉語。從許多文化的觀點來看，凱利安語是新興語言，而赫拉語作為外交語言則被視為高雅且傳統的選擇。

heroes.background.languages.usage.2.en: Yllyric is the cultural language of wode elves, and also the common language among those who defend and protect the natural forests of Orden.
heroes.background.languages.usage.2.zh: 伊林語是幻林精靈的文化語言，也是守護歐爾登自然森林之人的共同溝通方式。

heroes.background.languages.usage.3.en: Within any document concerning the workings of machines, masonry, or geology, you are likely to find a healthy supply of jargon using Zaliac, the most popular dwarf language. Even when such texts aren’t fully written in Zaliac, they use a lot of dwarf language when describing esoteric, complex ideas.
heroes.background.languages.usage.3.zh: 在任何關於機械運作、石工或地質學的文件中，你很可能會發現大量札力語（最常見的矮人語）的專業術語。即使這些文本並非完全用札力語撰寫，但在描述深奧或複雜的概念時，人們仍廣泛採用矮人的語言。

heroes.background.languages.usage.4.en: Just as Zaliac is used in engineering, contract law isn’t written purely in Anjali, the dominant language of the Seven Cities of Hell. But a lot of the legal jargon in any contract, as well as some of the language of trial courts, features many Anjali words. People are sticklers for detail in the Seven Cities, and this makes their language popular among lawyers.
heroes.background.languages.usage.4.zh: 正如札力語在工程領域廣泛應用，契約法也不完全以安賈利語寫成；安賈利語是地獄七城的主要語言。不過，許多契約中的法律術語，以及審判法庭中的部分用語，也大量採用安賈利語。地獄七城的居民極為重視細節，所以他們的語言在律師圈中備受推崇。

heroes.background.languages.usage.5.en: In the same way that intelligent creatures in Orden who live near or trade with other cultures use Caelian as a common language, the denizens of the World Below, the Dark Under All, often speak Variac, the language of the voiceless talkers.
heroes.background.languages.usage.5.zh: 如同歐爾登中住在其他文化附近或與其貿易的智慧生物會使用凱利安語作為通用語，「至深之暗」玄冥界的居民也經常使用華里亞語，也就是心語者的語言。

heroes.background.languages.vaslorian-hu.zh: 華斯洛里亞｜華斯洛里亞語

heroes.conditions.bleeding.rules.en:
Bleeding

While a creature is bleeding, whenever they use a main action, use a triggered action, or make a test or ability roll using Might or Agility, they lose Stamina equal to 1d6 + their level after the main action, triggered action, or power roll is resolved. This Stamina loss can’t be prevented in any way, and only happens once per action.

You take damage from this condition when you use a main action off your turn. For example, a signature ability used as a free triggered action with the assistance of the tactician’s Strike Now ability triggers the damage from the bleeding condition.
heroes.conditions.bleeding.rules.zh:
出血

若你處於出血狀態，每當你使用主要動作或反應動作，或使用力量或敏捷進行考驗或招式檢定時，在動作或檢定結算後，你會失去 1d6 + 等級的體力（無法以任何方式避免，每個動作只會失去 1 次體力）。

若你在自己的回合外使用主要動作，你也會受到此狀態的傷害。例如，若你在戰術家的【快出手】招式協助下使用免費反應動作發動招牌招式，你也會觸發出血狀態的傷害。

heroes.conditions.dazed.rules.en:
Dazed

A creature who is dazed can do only one thing on their turn: use a main action, use a maneuver, or use a move action. A dazed creature also can’t use triggered actions, free triggered actions, or free maneuvers.
heroes.conditions.dazed.rules.zh:
暈眩

若你處於暈眩狀態，你在自己回合中只能執行其中 1 種動作：主要動作、機動動作，或移動動作。你也無法使用反應動作、免費反應動作，以及免費機動動作。

heroes.conditions.frightened.rules.en:
Frightened

When a creature is frightened, any ability roll they make against the source of their fear takes a bane. If that source is a creature, their ability rolls made against the frightened creature gain an edge. A frightened creature can’t willingly move closer to the source of their fear if they know the location of that source. If a creature gains the frightened condition from one source while already frightened by a different source, the new condition replaces the old one.
heroes.conditions.frightened.rules.zh:
畏縮

若你處於畏縮狀態，你對恐懼來源進行的任何招式檢定都會承受 1 個劣勢。若恐懼來源為生物，該來源對你進行的招式檢定會獲得 1 個優勢。你若知道恐懼來源的位置，你就無法主動接近該來源。若你已經因為某個來源而陷入畏縮，然後又從其他來源陷入畏縮，則新的畏縮狀態會取代舊的狀態。

heroes.conditions.grabbed.rules.en:
Grabbed

A creature who is grabbed has speed 0, can’t be force moved except by a creature, object, or effect that has them grabbed, can’t use the Knockback maneuver (see Maneuvers in Chapter 10: Combat), and takes a bane on abilities that don’t target the creature, object, or effect that has them grabbed. If a creature is grabbed by another creature and that creature moves, they bring the grabbed creature with them. If a creature’s size is equal to or less than the size of a creature they have grabbed, their speed is halved while they have that creature grabbed.

A creature who has another creature grabbed can use a maneuver to move the grabbed creature into an unoccupied space adjacent to them.

A creature can release a creature they have grabbed at any time to end that condition (no action required). A grabbed creature can attempt to escape being grabbed using the Escape Grab maneuver (see Chapter 10: Combat). If a grabbed creature teleports, or if either the grabbed creature or the creature grabbing them is force moved so that both creatures are not adjacent to each other, that creature is no longer grabbed.

A creature can grab only creatures of their size or smaller. If a creature’s Might score is 2 or higher, they can grab any creature larger than them with a size equal to or less than their Might score.

Unless otherwise indicated, a creature can grab only one creature at a time.
heroes.conditions.grabbed.rules.zh:
擒制

若你被擒制，你的速度歸 0，而且只能被擒抱者（生物、物體或效果）強制移動。你無法使用擊退機動動作（詳見第 10 章〈戰鬥〉的「機動動作」），而且對擒抱者以外的目標進行的任何招式檢定都會承受 1 個劣勢。當擒抱者移動時，你會一起移動。若擒抱者的體型 ≦ 你，則擒抱者在擒抱期間的速度會減半。

擒抱者可以使用機動動作將你移動至相鄰的未占據空間。

擒抱者可以隨時釋放你來解除該狀態（無需動作）。你可以使用掙脫機動動作（詳見第 10 章〈戰鬥〉）來嘗試脫離。若你進行傳送，或你與擒抱者任一方被強制移動到雙方不相鄰的位置，擒制狀態就會立刻解除。

生物只能擒抱體型 ≦ 自己的生物。若生物的力量為 2 以上，則可以擒抱體型 ≦ 其力量的生物。

除非另有說明，生物同時只能擒抱 1 個生物。

heroes.conditions.overview.rules.en:
Conditions

Some abilities and other effects apply specific negative effects called conditions to a creature. The following conditions show up regularly in the game and can be tracked on your character sheet when they affect your hero.
heroes.conditions.overview.rules.zh:
狀態

有些招式與效果會對生物施加稱為「狀態」的特定負面效果。以下狀態會經常出現在遊戲中。當你的英雄受到這些狀態的影響時，請確實記錄在角色卡上。

heroes.conditions.prone.rules.en:
Prone

While a creature is prone, they are flat on the ground, any strike they make takes a bane, and melee abilities used against them gain an edge. A prone creature must crawl to move along the ground, which costs 1 additional square of movement for every square crawled. A creature can’t climb, jump, swim, or fly while prone. If they are climbing, flying, or jumping when knocked prone, they fall.

Unless the ability or effect that imposed the prone condition says otherwise, a prone creature can stand up using the Stand Up maneuver (see Maneuvers in Chapter 10: Combat). A creature adjacent to a willing prone creature can likewise use the Stand Up maneuver to make that creature stand up.
heroes.conditions.prone.rules.zh:
伏地

若你處於伏地狀態，你的身體會平貼地面。在此狀態下，你發動的任何打擊都會承受 1 個劣勢，而其他生物對你發動的近戰招式則會獲得 1 個優勢。你只能用爬行的方式移動，每移動 1 格都需要額外消耗 1 格移動力。你在伏地時無法進行攀爬、跳躍、游泳或飛行。若你在攀爬、飛行或跳躍時被擊倒伏地，則會立刻墜落。

除非造成伏地狀態的招式或效果另有說明，否則你可以使用起身機動動作（詳見第 10 章〈戰鬥〉的「機動動作」）來解除伏地。此外，若你願意，相鄰的生物也可以對你使用起身機動動作來將你拉起來。

heroes.conditions.restrained.rules.en:
Restrained

A creature who is restrained has speed 0, can’t use the Stand Up maneuver, and can’t be force moved. A restrained creature takes a bane on ability rolls and on Might and Agility tests, and abilities used against them gain an edge.

If a creature teleports while restrained, that condition ends.
heroes.conditions.restrained.rules.zh:
束縛

若你被束縛，你的速度歸 0，無法使用起身機動動作，也無法被強制移動。你在進行招式檢定以及力量與敏捷考驗時會承受 1 個劣勢，而其他生物對你進行的招式檢定則會獲得 1 個優勢。

若你進行傳送，束縛狀態就會立刻解除。

heroes.conditions.slowed.rules.en:
Slowed

A creature who is slowed has speed 2 unless their speed is already lower, and they can’t shift.
heroes.conditions.slowed.rules.zh:
緩速

若你被緩速，你的速度為 2（除非你的速度已經 < 2），而且無法進行遁移。

heroes.conditions.taunted.rules.en:
Taunted

A creature who is taunted has a double bane on ability rolls for any ability that doesn’t target the creature who taunted them, as long as they have line of effect to that creature. If a creature gains the taunted condition from one source while already taunted by a different source, the new condition replaces the old one.
heroes.conditions.taunted.rules.zh:
嘲諷

若你被嘲諷，只要你與嘲諷者之間保持效果線，你對嘲諷者以外的目標進行的任何招式檢定都會承受雙劣勢。若你已經被嘲諷，然後又受到其他來源的嘲諷，則新的嘲諷狀態會取代舊的狀態。

heroes.conditions.weakened.rules.en:
Weakened

A creature who is weakened takes a bane on power rolls.
heroes.conditions.weakened.rules.zh:
虛弱

若你陷入虛弱狀態，你進行的任何檢定都會承受 1 個劣勢。

heroes.kits.arcane-archer.description.en: The Arcane Archer kit allows you to combine magic and ranged weapon strikes. Your lack of armor keeps you mobile, and your magic makes your arrows explode to devastate your foes.
heroes.kits.arcane-archer.description.zh: 魔弓套裝能讓你結合魔法與遠程武器的攻擊。沒有穿戴護甲讓你的行動保持靈活，而你的魔法能讓箭矢爆炸，摧毀敵人。

heroes.kits.arcane-archer.equipment.en: You wear no armor and wield a bow.
heroes.kits.arcane-archer.equipment.zh: 你沒有穿戴護甲，持用 1 把弓箭。

heroes.kits.arcane-archer.signature.expl.en:
Exploding Arrow
Your ammunition explodes with magical energy.
Magic, Ranged, Strike, Weapon • Main action • Ranged 15 • One creature or object
Power Roll + Agility, Reason, Intuition, or Presence:
Tier 1: 5 + A, R, I, or P fire damage
Tier 2: 7 + A, R, I, or P fire damage
Tier 3: 10 + A, R, I, or P fire damage
Effect: One creature or object of your choice within 2 squares of the target takes fire damage equal to the characteristic score used for this ability’s power roll.

fs.en: One creature or object of your choice within 2 squares of the target takes fire damage equal to the characteristic score used for this ability's power roll.
fs.zh: 目標 2 格內的 1 個生物或物體（由你選擇）會受到 X 點火焰傷害，X 等於此招式檢定所使用的屬性值。

heroes.kits.arcane-archer.signature.expl.zh:
爆裂箭矢（Exploding Arrow）
你的彈藥在魔法能量的作用下爆炸。
魔法、遠程、打擊、武器／主要動作／遠程 15／1 個生物或物體
檢定 + 敏捷、理智、直覺或氣場：
① 5 + 敏捷、理智、直覺或氣場火焰傷害
② 7 + 敏捷、理智、直覺或氣場火焰傷害
③ 10 + 敏捷、理智、直覺或氣場火焰傷害
效果：目標 2 格內的 1 個生物或物體（由你選擇）會受到 X 點火焰傷害，X 等於此招式檢定所使用的屬性值。

heroes.kits.battlemind.description.en: Who says lightly armored heroes can’t also be hard to move? You just need to employ some psionics! The Battlemind kit harnesses the power of your mind to make you harder to move—and to make your foes easier to push around.

fs.en: Who says lightly armored heroes can't also be hard to move? You just need to employ some psionics! The Battlemind kit harnesses the power of your mind to make you harder to move—and to make your foes easier to push around.
fs.zh: 誰說輕甲英雄不能難以撼動？只要運用一些靈能就行了！戰念套裝利用你的心靈力量讓你更難被移動，同時讓你的敵人更容易被推開。

heroes.kits.battlemind.description.zh: 誰說輕甲英雄不能難以撼動？只要運用一些靈能就行了！戰念套裝利用你的心靈力量讓你更難被移動，同時讓你的敵人更容易被推開。

heroes.kits.battlemind.equipment.en: You wear light armor and wield a medium weapon.
heroes.kits.battlemind.equipment.zh: 你穿戴輕甲，持用 1 件中型武器。

heroes.kits.battlemind.signature.unmoori.en:
Unmooring
Your weapon unleashes psionic energy that reduces your target’s weight.
Melee, Psionic, Strike, Weapon • Main action • Melee 1 • One creature
Power Roll + Might, Reason, Intuition, or Presence:
Tier 1: 5 + M, R, I, or P damage
Tier 2: 8 + M, R, I, or P damage
Tier 3: 11 + M, R, I, or P damage
Effect: Until the end of the target’s next turn, any forced movement that affects the target has its distance increased by 2.

fs.en: Until the end of the target's next turn, any forced movement that affects the target has its distance increased by 2.
fs.zh: 直到目標下個回合結束之前，所有對目標造成的強制移動距離都會 +2。

heroes.kits.battlemind.signature.unmoori.zh:
脫韁解錨（Unmooring）
你的武器釋放出靈能，減輕目標的重量。
近戰、靈能、打擊、武器／主要動作／近戰 1／1 個生物
檢定 + 力量、理智、直覺或氣場：
① 5 + 力量、理智、直覺或氣場傷害
② 8 + 力量、理智、直覺或氣場傷害
③ 11 + 力量、理智、直覺或氣場傷害
效果：直到目標下個回合結束之前，所有對目標造成的強制移動距離都會 +2。

heroes.kits.cloak-and-dagger.description.en: Providing throwable light weapons and light armor easily concealed by a cloak to confuse your enemies, the Cloak and Dagger kit makes you more mobile while increasing the effectiveness of your short-range strikes.
heroes.kits.cloak-and-dagger.description.zh: 潛襲套裝提供可投擲的輕型武器，以及隱藏在斗篷之下、用以迷惑敵人的輕甲，不僅讓你更機動靈活，還提升了短程攻擊的效率。

heroes.kits.cloak-and-dagger.equipment.en: You wear light armor and wield one or two light weapons.
heroes.kits.cloak-and-dagger.equipment.zh: 你穿戴輕甲，持用 1 件或 2 件輕型武器。

heroes.kits.cloak-and-dagger.signature.f.en:
Fade
A stab, and a few quick, careful steps back.
Melee, Ranged, Strike, Weapon • Main action • Melee 1 or ranged 10 • One creature
Power Roll + Might or Agility:
Tier 1: 3 + M or A damage; you can shift 1 square
Tier 2: 6 + M or A damage; you can shift up to 2 squares
Tier 3: 8 + M or A damage; you can shift up to 3 squares

fs.en: A stab, and a few quick, careful steps back.
fs.zh: 一記精準刺擊，隨後靈巧後退幾步。

heroes.kits.cloak-and-dagger.signature.f.zh:
回身掠影（Fade）
一記精準刺擊，隨後靈巧後退幾步。
近戰、遠程、打擊、武器／主要動作／近戰 1 或遠程 10／1 個生物
檢定 + 力量或敏捷：
① 3 + 力量或敏捷傷害；你可以遁移 1 格
② 6 + 力量或敏捷傷害；你可以遁移最多 2 格
③ 8 + 力量或敏捷傷害；你可以遁移最多 3 格

heroes.kits.dual-wielder.description.en: The Dual Wielder kit is for folks who want to excel at using two weapons at the same time. Your fighting style maximizes the power of each weapon you have in hand, making you a whirling dealer of death.
heroes.kits.dual-wielder.description.zh: 雙持套裝是為了那些想要同時精通兩種武器的人所設計的。你的戰鬥風格能充分發揮兩把武器的威力，讓你成為旋風般的死亡使者。

heroes.kits.dual-wielder.equipment.en: You wear medium armor and wield a light weapon and a medium weapon.
heroes.kits.dual-wielder.equipment.zh: 你穿戴中甲，持用 1 件輕型武器和 1 件中型武器。

heroes.kits.dual-wielder.signature.doubl.en:
Double Strike
Why strike once when you could do it twice?
Melee, Strike, Weapon • Main action • Melee 1 • Two creatures or objects
Power Roll + Might or Agility:
Tier 1: 4 damage
Tier 2: 6 damage
Tier 3: 8 damage
Effect: If you use this ability on your turn, you can use it against one target, then use your maneuver and your move action for that turn before using the ability against a second target. You still use the same power roll for both targets.

fs.en: If you use this ability on your turn, you can use it against one target, then use your maneuver and your move action for that turn before using the ability against a second target. You still use the same power roll for both targets.
fs.zh: 若你在你的回合中發動此招式，你可以先打擊第一個目標，然後使用你該回合的機動動作和移動動作，然後再打擊第二個目標。你仍然只進行 1 次檢定。

heroes.kits.dual-wielder.signature.doubl.zh:
雙重打擊（Double Strike）
既然可以打兩次，為什麼只打一次呢？
近戰、打擊、武器／主要動作／近戰 1／2 個生物或物體
檢定 + 力量或敏捷：
① 4 傷害
② 6 傷害
③ 8 傷害
效果：若你在你的回合中發動此招式，你可以先打擊第一個目標，然後使用你該回合的機動動作和移動動作，然後再打擊第二個目標。你仍然只進行 1 次檢定。

heroes.kits.general.armor-categories.int.en:
Kit Armor Categories
The armor provided by each kit fits into one of five categories, indicating the kind of protection you have while using the kit.
heroes.kits.general.armor-categories.int.zh:
套裝護甲類別
套裝提供的護甲分為以下 5 種類別，分別代表你使用套裝時所受到的防護。

heroes.kits.general.armor.heavy.en:
Heavy Armor
If a kit has heavy armor, then you’re likely wearing metal from head to toe. Chain mail, ring mail, and suits of plate armor protect you better than any other mundane defense.
heroes.kits.general.armor.heavy.zh:
重甲
若套裝提供重甲，那你可能從頭到腳都穿戴著金屬護具。鎖子甲、環甲和全身板甲都能為你提供最頂級的防禦。

heroes.kits.general.armor.light.en:
Light Armor
If a kit features light armor, you might wear padded cloth, leather armor, or a chain shirt.
heroes.kits.general.armor.light.zh:
輕甲
若套裝提供輕甲，你可能會穿戴有襯墊的布甲、皮甲或鎖甲衫。

heroes.kits.general.armor.medium.en:
Medium Armor
If a kit has medium armor, you might wear layers of thick hides, a breastplate, or armor made of metal scales.
heroes.kits.general.armor.medium.zh:
中甲
若套裝提供中甲，你可以穿戴厚實的多層獸皮、胸甲或金屬鱗甲。

heroes.kits.general.armor.none.en:
None
If a kit provides no armor, you can wear whatever clothing you like! Robes, a fashionable tunic and pants—or your character might just loincloth it. It’s totally up to you.
heroes.kits.general.armor.none.zh:
無甲
若套裝沒有提供護甲，你可以穿著任何你喜歡的服裝！無論是長袍、時尚的束腰外衣和長褲，或是只穿著 1 塊遮羞布都可以，完全由你決定。

heroes.kits.general.armor.shield.en:
Shield
If a kit has a shield, then you wield a shield that can be any shape and made of any mundane material you like. The best shields have a sweet insignia on them, so start thinking about yours!
heroes.kits.general.armor.shield.zh:
盾牌
若套裝提供盾牌，你可以使用任何形狀、任何尋常材質製成的盾牌。最好的盾牌都會搭配 1 枚帥氣的徽章，不妨開始構思你的專屬徽章吧！

heroes.kits.general.changing-your-kit.en:
Changing Your Kit
Your choice of kit is always flexible, and your hero is never locked into a specific kit. If you want to change your kit, you can do so as a respite activity (see Respite in Chapter 1: The Basics).
heroes.kits.general.changing-your-kit.zh:
更換套裝
你可以靈活地更換套裝，不會被限制在特定套裝中。你可以使用休整活動來更換套裝（詳見第 1 章〈基礎〉的〈休整〉）。

heroes.kits.general.chapter-intro.en:
Kits
The knight in shining armor. The warrior priest. The sniper. Censors, furies, shadows, tacticians, and troubadours can tap into these and many more archetypal concepts using kits. A kit is a combination of weapons, armor, and fighting techniques that lets you personalize your martial hero for battle.
heroes.kits.general.chapter-intro.zh:
套裝
身披閃亮鎧甲的騎士。武祭。狙擊手。懲戒者、熾怒者、影舞者、戰術家與遊唱家，都能透過套裝展現這些以及更多經典的英雄形象。套裝由武器、護甲與戰鬥技巧組成，讓你能依照自己的喜好，打造英雄在戰鬥中的風格。

heroes.kits.general.customizing-equipmen.en:
Customizing Equipment Appearances
You should absolutely feel free to describe your equipment in a way that makes sense for the story of your game and hero. For instance, if your hero uses a weapon in the whip category as part of their kit, they could use a leather whip, a spiked chain, or a dagger tied to a knotted rope. A hero who wears heavy armor might wear a suit of chain mail, plate armor, or heavy wooden planks tied together. Your choices for equipment aren’t limited just to the examples in this book.
heroes.kits.general.customizing-equipmen.zh:
自訂裝備外觀
你完全可以按照遊戲故事與英雄形象自由描述裝備外觀。例如，若你的英雄使用套裝中的鞭笞武器，可以選擇皮鞭、帶刺鐵鍊，或將匕首綁在打結的繩索上。身穿重甲的英雄也可能穿著鎖子甲、板甲，或把厚重的木板綁在身上當作護甲。你的裝備選擇不受本書範例的限制。

heroes.kits.general.improvised-weapons.d.en:
Improvised Weapons
Improvised weapons include rocks, bottles, plates, furniture, and anything else you pick up that can be bashed, hurled, or stabbed into an enemy. As well, any weapons that aren’t part of your kit count as improvised weapons for you. If you’re not using a kit with unarmed strikes, then your feet and fists are improvised weapons. If you’re not using any kit and pick up a sword to use as part of a melee free strike, the sword counts as an improvised weapon.
heroes.kits.general.improvised-weapons.d.zh:
臨時武器
臨時武器包括石頭、瓶子、盤子、家具，以及其他任何你隨手拿起、可以用來敲擊、投擲或刺向敵人的東西。此外，任何不屬於你套裝的武器，對你而言也都算是臨時武器。若你沒有使用提供徒手攻擊的套裝，你的拳腳也視為臨時武器。如果你沒有使用任何套裝，卻拿起一把劍發動近戰基礎打擊，這把劍也視為臨時武器。

heroes.kits.general.improvised-weapons.u.en: Improvised weapons can be used with weapon abilities you gain from your class. For instance, many melee-focused heroes choose a kit that maximizes their melee capabilities, then make ranged free strikes with improvised weapons. However, you can’t use improvised weapons with weapon abilities gained from your kit, and you add no special bonuses from your kit to a weapon ability used with an improvised weapon.
heroes.kits.general.improvised-weapons.u.zh: 你可以使用臨時武器施展職業賦予的武器招式。例如，許多以近戰為主的英雄會選擇能夠強化近戰能力的套裝，並使用臨時武器發動遠程基礎打擊。不過，臨時武器不能用於套裝賦予的武器招式；而且當你使用臨時武器施展武器招式時，不能將套裝的任何特殊加值加到該招式上。

heroes.kits.general.kit-bonuses-and-trai.en: For example, the Shining Armor kit has a +2/+2/+2 melee damage bonus, increasing the damage of melee weapon abilities across all tier outcomes. The Sniper kit has a +0/+0/+4 ranged damage bonus, having no effect on a tier 1 or tier 2 outcome on an ability roll, but increasing the damage of tier 3 outcomes by +4 for your ranged weapon abilities.
heroes.kits.general.kit-bonuses-and-trai.zh: 例如，鐵騎套裝提供 +2/+2/+2 的近戰傷害加值，讓近戰武器招式在所有階級結果下造成的傷害都增加。狙擊套裝則提供 +0/+0/+4 的遠程傷害加值，對招式檢定的 T1 與 T2 結果沒有影響，但會使遠程武器招式的 T3 結果額外增加 4 點傷害。

heroes.kits.general.kit-bonuses-and-trai.en:
Bonuses Across Tiers
Kit damage bonuses increase based on the tier outcome of the power roll for a weapon ability, and are presented as “+X/+Y/+Z.” The X bonus is added to a tier 1 outcome, the Y bonus is added to a tier 2 outcome, and the Z bonus is added to a tier 3 outcome.
heroes.kits.general.kit-bonuses-and-trai.zh:
各階級的加值
套裝的傷害加值會依照武器招式的檢定階級結果而有所不同，以「+X/+Y/+Z」表示。X 加值適用於 T1 結果，Y 加值適用於 T2 結果，Z 加值適用於 T3 結果。

heroes.kits.general.kit-bonuses-and-trai.en:
Damage Bonuses
Kits can grant you a bonus to damage with both melee and ranged weapon abilities. If a kit has a melee damage bonus, that bonus is added to the rolled damage of any damage-dealing ability with both the Melee and Weapon keywords. A kit’s ranged damage bonus is added to the rolled damage of damage-dealing abilities with both the Ranged and Weapon keywords.
heroes.kits.general.kit-bonuses-and-trai.zh:
傷害加值
套裝可以為近戰與遠程武器招式提供傷害加值。若套裝具有近戰傷害加值，任何同時具有「近戰」與「武器」關鍵詞、而且會造成傷害的招式，其檢定傷害都會加上這項加值。同樣地，遠程傷害加值則適用於同時具有「遠程」與「武器」關鍵詞、而且會造成傷害的招式。

heroes.kits.general.kit-bonuses-and-trai.en:
Disengage Bonus
A kit that has a disengage bonus increases the number of squares you can shift when you take the Disengage move action (see Chapter 10: Combat).
heroes.kits.general.kit-bonuses-and-trai.zh:
撤離加值
若套裝具有撤離加值，你執行「撤離」移動動作時能遁移的格數就會增加（詳見第 10 章〈戰鬥〉）。

heroes.kits.general.kit-bonuses-and-trai.en: A distance bonus doesn’t increase the size of any ability’s area of effect.
heroes.kits.general.kit-bonuses-and-trai.zh: 射程加值不會增加任何招式的效果範圍大小。

heroes.kits.general.kit-bonuses-and-trai.en:
Distance Bonus
A kit’s melee distance bonus increases the distance of abilities with the Melee and Weapon keywords. A kit’s ranged distance bonus increases the distance of abilities with the Ranged and Weapon keywords.
heroes.kits.general.kit-bonuses-and-trai.zh:
射程加值
套裝的近戰射程加值會增加同時具有「近戰」與「武器」關鍵詞之招式的射程。遠程射程加值則會增加同時具有「遠程」與「武器」關鍵詞之招式的射程。

heroes.kits.general.kit-bonuses-and-trai.en:
Kit Bonuses and Traits
A kit can grant a bonus to your Stamina, speed, and stability, as well as the damage and distance of your weapon abilities, including your free strikes. (Abilities in Chapter 5: Classes has information on abilities, ability keywords, and more.)
heroes.kits.general.kit-bonuses-and-trai.zh:
套裝加值與特性
套裝可以為你的體力、速度與穩度，以及武器招式（包含基礎打擊）的傷害與射程提供加值。（招式、招式關鍵詞等相關資訊，詳見第 5 章〈職業〉的〈招式〉。）

heroes.kits.general.kit-bonuses-and-trai.en: For details on the ability format, see Abilities in Chapter 5: Classes.
heroes.kits.general.kit-bonuses-and-trai.zh: 招式格式的詳細資訊，請見第 5 章〈職業〉的〈招式〉。

heroes.kits.general.kit-bonuses-and-trai.en:
Kit Signature Ability
Each kit grants a signature ability, whose distance and damage already includes the kit’s bonuses. For instance, the Guisarmier kit’s Forward Thrust, Backward Smash ability has a distance of melee 2 and deals 4, 7, or 9 damage depending on the tier outcome, with that distance and damage including the bonuses from the kit.
heroes.kits.general.kit-bonuses-and-trai.zh:
套裝招牌招式
每個套裝都會提供 1 個招牌招式，其射程與傷害已經包含套裝提供的加值。例如，長兵套裝的「前刺後劈」招式具有「近戰 2」的射程，並依照階級結果造成 4、7 或 9 點傷害，這些射程與傷害數值都已經包含套裝加值。

heroes.kits.general.kit-bonuses-and-trai.en:
Speed Bonus
Your kit’s speed bonus is added to your speed.
heroes.kits.general.kit-bonuses-and-trai.zh:
速度加值
套裝提供的速度加值會加到你的速度。

heroes.kits.general.kit-bonuses-and-trai.en:
Stability Bonus
Your kit’s stability bonus is added to your stability.
heroes.kits.general.kit-bonuses-and-trai.zh:
穩度加值
套裝提供的穩度加值會加到你的穩度。

heroes.kits.general.kit-bonuses-and-trai.en:
Stamina Bonus
Your kit’s Stamina bonus is added to your Stamina maximum and scales with your echelon.
heroes.kits.general.kit-bonuses-and-trai.zh:
體力加值
套裝提供的體力加值會加到你的體力上限，並隨著境界提高而增加。

heroes.kits.general.kit-equipment.exampl.en: The description of equipment in your kit is limited to broad categories, leaving you free to decide the specifics that best align with your vision of your character. For instance, the Guisarmier kit provides medium armor and a polearm. One player using this kit could wear heavy layers of hide and wield a longspear, while another might wear a shining breastplate and carry a halberd into battle.
heroes.kits.general.kit-equipment.exampl.zh: 套裝中的裝備只是廣泛的參考類別，你能自由決定最符合角色畫風的具體細節。以長兵套裝為例，它提供了中甲和長柄武器。使用此套裝的玩家可以選擇穿戴厚重的獸皮並揮舞長矛，也可能穿戴閃亮的胸甲，手持長戟進入戰場。

heroes.kits.general.kit-equipment.intro.en:
Kit Equipment
Each kit’s equipment entry details the armor and weapons the kit provides. It’s important to know what equipment a kit uses, because that informs your hero’s appearance and story. Equipment is part of what affects the math behind your kit’s benefits, alongside the fighting techniques each kit provides. Equipment also determines the type of magic and psionic treasures your character can wield.
heroes.kits.general.kit-equipment.intro.zh:
套裝裝備
每個套裝的裝備條目都會詳細列出該套裝提供的護甲和武器。了解套裝的裝備很重要，因為這會直接影響你英雄的外觀和故事。裝備和套裝提供的戰鬥技巧，也會影響套裝益處的數值。此外，裝備還決定了你的角色可以使用哪些類型的魔法和靈能寶物。

heroes.kits.general.kit-equipment.nonkit.en: You can wear armor and wield weapons that aren’t part of your kit, but if you do, you don’t get your kit’s bonuses.
heroes.kits.general.kit-equipment.nonkit.zh: 你也可以使用不屬於套裝的護甲和武器，但這樣就無法獲得套裝加值。

heroes.kits.general.kits-a-to-z.intro.en:
Kits A to Z
This section details each kit, whose bonuses and benefits are summarized in the Kits table.
heroes.kits.general.kits-a-to-z.intro.zh:
套裝一覽
本節詳細介紹各種套裝，其加值與益處則彙整於「套裝」總表。

heroes.kits.general.kits-and-treasures.c.en: If you find a piece of equipment you really want to use that isn’t part of your kit, you can always change your kit as a respite activity.
heroes.kits.general.kits-and-treasures.c.zh: 若你找到 1 件你非常想用但不屬於你當前套裝的裝備，你還是可以使用休整活動來變更套裝。

heroes.kits.general.kits-and-treasures.u.en:
Kits and Treasures
When you find a supernatural treasure such as a magic sword, you can use the item as long as it’s in one of your kit’s equipment categories. A Blade of Quintessence is a medium weapon, so you can use it with the Ranger or Shining Armor kits. However, you can’t use it with the Cloak and Dagger or Stick and Robe kits because those kits don’t include medium weapons, meaning you haven’t done the necessary preparations to use the weapon effectively. You can still swing a Blade of Quintessence around as an improvised weapon, but you don’t get any of its bonuses or benefits.
heroes.kits.general.kits-and-treasures.u.zh:
套裝與寶物
當你找到 1 件超常寶物時（例如 1 把魔劍），只要該道具屬於你當前套裝的裝備類別，你就可以使用它。例如，「極粹之刃」屬於中型武器，因此遊俠或鐵騎套裝可以使用這把武器，但潛襲或杖袍套裝無法，因為這些套裝不提供中型武器，代表你還沒有做好有效使用這把武器的必要準備。當然，你仍然可以將「極粹之刃」當作臨時武器揮舞，但你無法獲得寶物提供的任何加值或益處。

heroes.kits.general.losing-equipment.arm.en: If your kit has armor and you aren’t wearing it or wielding it (in the case of a shield), you lose your kit’s Stamina bonus and stability bonus. If you lose your shield but keep the rest of your armor, your Stamina decreases by 3 per echelon. As long as you are carrying your shield, you don’t lose its Stamina bonus, even if you aren’t actively wielding it.
heroes.kits.general.losing-equipment.arm.zh: 若套裝提供護甲，而你沒有穿戴該護甲（盾牌則為沒有持用），你會失去套裝的體力加值與穩度加值。若你失去盾牌，但仍保留其他護甲，你的體力會每境界減少 3 點。只要你仍攜帶盾牌，即使沒有實際持用，也不會失去盾牌提供的體力加值。

heroes.kits.general.losing-equipment.bow.en: If your kit has a bow weapon you aren’t wielding, you lose the kit’s ranged damage bonus and distance bonus.
heroes.kits.general.losing-equipment.bow.zh: 若套裝提供弓箭武器，而你沒有持用該武器，你會失去套裝的遠程傷害加值與遠程射程加值。

heroes.kits.general.losing-equipment.ens.en: If your kit has an ensnaring weapon you aren’t wielding, you lose the kit’s signature ability.
heroes.kits.general.losing-equipment.ens.zh: 若套裝提供捕縛武器，而你沒有持用該武器，你會失去套裝的招牌招式。

heroes.kits.general.losing-equipment.int.en:
Optional Rule: Losing Equipment
The rules of the game expect that heroes always have access to their equipment. That’s because for most of the time in the game, heroes aren’t worried about surviving for days on end in a dungeon and tracking every piece of gear they carry. However, there might be times where your group wants to tell a story of heroes who are captured and stripped of their equipment, or who find themselves at a masquerade where weapons need to be checked at the door. For those kinds of scenarios, you can use the following rules:
heroes.kits.general.losing-equipment.int.zh:
可選規則：失去裝備
遊戲規則假設英雄隨時都能使用自己的裝備。這是因為在大多數情況下，英雄不需要擔心如何在地下城中連續求生數日，也不必逐件清點隨身攜帶的裝備。然而，你們有時可能想要講述英雄遭到俘虜、裝備被奪走的故事，或是英雄參加化裝舞會、必須在門口寄放武器的情境。在這類情況下，你可以使用以下規則：

heroes.kits.general.losing-equipment.lig.en: If your kit has a light weapon you aren’t wielding, you lose the kit’s melee damage bonus, ranged damage bonus, and distance bonus for a weapon you throw. If your kit also has a bow, you don’t lose those benefits for the bow.
heroes.kits.general.losing-equipment.lig.zh: 若套裝提供輕型武器，而你沒有持用該武器，你會失去套裝的近戰傷害加值，以及用於投擲武器的遠程傷害加值與射程加值。若套裝同時提供弓箭武器，你不會失去該弓箭武器的上述益處。

heroes.kits.general.losing-equipment.med.en: If your kit has a medium or heavy weapon you aren’t wielding, you lose the kit’s melee damage bonus.
heroes.kits.general.losing-equipment.med.zh: 若套裝提供中型或重型武器，而你沒有持用該武器，你會失去套裝的近戰傷害加值。

heroes.kits.general.losing-equipment.pol.en: If your kit has a polearm or whip you aren’t wielding, you lose the kit’s melee damage bonus and melee distance bonus.
heroes.kits.general.losing-equipment.pol.zh: 若套裝提供長柄或鞭笞武器，而你沒有持用該武器，你會失去套裝的近戰傷害加值與近戰射程加值。

heroes.kits.general.weapon-categories.in.en:
Kit Weapon Categories
The weapons provided by a kit fall into eight categories that indicate the types of weapons you wield while using the kit.
heroes.kits.general.weapon-categories.in.zh:
套裝武器類別
套裝提供的武器分為以下 8 種類別，表示你使用套裝時所持用的武器類型。

heroes.kits.general.weapon.bow.en:
Bow
Bows cover any weapon used to fire an arrow or bolt projectile, including crossbows, longbows, and shortbows. This weapon group also includes weapons that hurl bullets, stones, darts, or small spears, including slings and atlatls. You don’t need to track mundane ammunition for these weapons unless the Director says otherwise.
heroes.kits.general.weapon.bow.zh:
弓箭
弓箭武器涵蓋任何用於發射箭矢或弩矢的武器，包括弩、長弓和短弓。這類武器也包括投射彈丸、石塊、飛鏢或短矛的武器，例如投石索和投矛器。除非導演另有規定，你不需要追蹤武器的尋常彈藥。

heroes.kits.general.weapon.ensnaring.en:
Ensnaring Weapon
Ensnaring weapons include bolas, nets, and other weapons made to capture an enemy and hold them in place.
heroes.kits.general.weapon.ensnaring.zh:
捕縛武器
捕縛武器包括流星索、網子，以及其他用於捕獲並固定敵人的武器。

heroes.kits.general.weapon.heavy.en:
Heavy Weapon
Heavy weapons are two-handed melee weapons with weighty bladed or bludgeoning heads, made to seriously harm or kill enemies in a single mighty blow. Greatswords, greataxes, mauls, and morningstars are all examples of heavy weapons.
heroes.kits.general.weapon.heavy.zh:
重型武器
重型武器是雙手近戰武器，帶有沉重的刀刃或鎚頭，主要透過強力的攻擊重創或殺死敵人。巨劍、巨斧、巨鎚和釘頭鎚都是重型武器的例子。

heroes.kits.general.weapon.light.en:
Light Weapon
Light weapons are one-handed melee weapons that can be used to make several strikes in rapid succession. Many such weapons can be thrown or used as an off-hand defensive weapon. Daggers, shortswords, rapiers, handaxes, and throwing hammers are typical light weapons.
If your kit uses a light weapon, you can wield two light weapons at a time.
heroes.kits.general.weapon.light.zh:
輕型武器
輕型武器是單手近戰武器，可以快速連續發動多次打擊。這類武器有些可以用來投擲，或作為副手防禦武器使用。匕首、短劍、刺劍、手斧和飛鎚都是典型的輕型武器。如果你的套裝提供輕型武器，你可以雙手各持 1 把輕型武器。

heroes.kits.general.weapon.medium.en:
Medium Weapon
Medium weapons are one-handed melee weapons that can be carried into battle while leaving one hand free, allowing you to use that hand to hold a shield or implement. Battleaxes, clubs, longswords, and warhammers are medium weapons.
heroes.kits.general.weapon.medium.zh:
中型武器
中型武器是單手近戰武器，可以讓你的另 1 隻空手持握盾牌或法器。戰斧、棍棒、長劍和戰鎚都屬於中型武器。

heroes.kits.general.weapon.polearm.en:
Polearm
Polearms are two-handed melee weapons with long hafts that increase the wielder’s reach. They include glaives, halberds, longspears, and quarterstaffs.
heroes.kits.general.weapon.polearm.zh:
長柄武器
長柄武器是帶有長握柄的雙手近戰武器，可以增加使用者的攻擊範圍，包括長柄刀、長戟、長矛和長棍。

heroes.kits.general.weapon.unarmed-strik.en:
Unarmed Strikes
Any kit that uses unarmed strikes allows you to use your body as a weapon. Punches, kicks, eye gouges, and the like are your forte.
heroes.kits.general.weapon.unarmed-strik.zh:
徒手
任何使用徒手攻擊的套裝都允許你將身體當作武器。拳擊、踢擊、挖眼等都是你的專長。

heroes.kits.general.weapon.whip.en:
Whip
Whip weapons include the standard whip, spiked chains, flails, and any similarly long and flexible melee weapon.
heroes.kits.general.weapon.whip.zh:
鞭笞武器
鞭笞武器包括普通的鞭子、帶刺的鐵鍊、連枷，以及任何類似的近戰武器。

heroes.kits.guisarmier.description.en: The Guisarmier kit is for those who want to use a polearm for extended reach while remaining protected by sturdy armor. This is the kit that allows you to become the ultimate halberd, longspear, or glaive fighter.
heroes.kits.guisarmier.description.zh: 長兵套裝適合想要使用長柄武器來延伸攻擊範圍，同時受到堅固護甲保護的戰士。這件套裝能讓你成為無與倫比的長戟、長矛或長柄刀戰士。

heroes.kits.guisarmier.equipment.en: You wear medium armor and wield a polearm.
heroes.kits.guisarmier.equipment.zh: 你穿戴中甲，持用 1 件長柄武器。

heroes.kits.guisarmier.signature.forward.en:
Forward Thrust, Backward Smash
In your hands, the haft is as good as the head.
Melee, Strike, Weapon • Main action • Melee 2 • Two creatures or objects
Power Roll + Might or Agility:
Tier 1: 4 damage
Tier 2: 7 damage
Tier 3: 9 damage

fs.en: In your hands, the haft is as good as the head.
fs.zh: 武器的握柄和頭部在你手中同樣致命。

heroes.kits.guisarmier.signature.forward.zh:
前刺後劈（Forward Thrust, Backward Smash）
武器的握柄和頭部在你手中同樣致命。
近戰、打擊、武器／主要動作／近戰 2／2 個生物或物體
檢定 + 力量或敏捷：
① 4 傷害
② 7 傷害
③ 9 傷害

heroes.kits.martial-artist.description.en: If you want to be fast in a fight, then Martial Artist is the kit for you. Unencumbered by weapons or armor, this fighting style rewards quick, focused unarmed strikes against opponents, and allows you to be the ultimate skirmisher.
heroes.kits.martial-artist.description.zh: 如果你想在戰鬥中保持靈活敏捷，武術套裝就是為你準備的完美選擇。這種戰鬥風格不受武器和護甲的束縛，能讓你對敵人進行快速且精準的徒手打擊，讓你成為無與倫比的游擊戰士。

heroes.kits.martial-artist.equipment.en: You wear no armor and wield only your unarmed strikes.
heroes.kits.martial-artist.equipment.zh: 你不穿戴任何護甲，只依靠徒手打擊。

heroes.kits.martial-artist.signature.bat.en:
Battle Grace
You feint to move your enemies into perfect position.
Melee, Strike, Weapon • Main action • Melee 1 • One creature
Power Roll + Might or Agility:
Tier 1: 5 + M or A damage
Tier 2: 8 + M or A damage; you can swap places with the target
Tier 3: 11 + M or A damage; you can swap places with the target

heroes.kits.mountain.description.en: The Mountain kit does exactly what it says on the tin. You don heavy armor and raise a heavy weapon to stand strong against your foes, quickly demolishing them when it’s your turn to strike.

heroes.kits.panther.description.en: If you want a good balance of protection, speed, and damage, the Panther kit is for you. This kit increases your Stamina not by wearing armor, but through the focused battle preparation of body and mind, letting you be fast and mobile while swinging a heavy weapon at your foes.
heroes.kits.panther.description.zh: 若你想在防護、速度和傷害之間達到最佳平衡，獵豹套裝正適合你。這套裝備不靠穿戴護甲來增加體力，而是透過專注的戰前準備來強化身心，讓你能在揮舞重型武器的同時，仍保持迅速靈活的移動力。

heroes.kits.pugilist.description.en: Meant for brawlers and boxers, the Pugilist kit gives you access to a melee fighting style that grants a boost to Stamina and damage while allowing you to float like a butterfly. If you want to be a tough, strong hero who doles out punishment with your fists, then this kit is for you.

Let’s Dance

heroes.kits.raider.description.en: The Raider kit keeps you protected while granting you full mobility, providing a boost to speed and distance that lets you run around the battlefield like a Viking warrior.

heroes.kits.ranger.description.en: The Ranger kit outfits you with medium armor and weapons for every challenge, letting you easily switch between melee and ranged combat. This kit provides a good balance of bonuses to defense and offense to create a hero who is a jack-of-all-trades.

heroes.kits.shining-armor.description.en: The Shining Armor kit provides the most protection a kit can afford, providing you with the sword, shield, and armor necessary to play the prototypical knight.

heroes.kits.stick-and-robe.description.en: Armed with a simple reach weapon, often a quarterstaff, a character using the Stick and Robe kit is highly mobile thanks to their light armor. This allows your hero to make maximum use of their weapon’s length.

fs.en: Armed with a simple reach weapon, often a quarterstaff, a character using the Stick and Robe kit is highly mobile thanks to their light armor. This allows your hero to make maximum use of their weapon's length.
fs.zh: 使用杖袍套裝的角色持用一把簡單的長兵器（通常是長棍），並因穿戴輕甲而具有高度機動性。這讓你的英雄能夠充分發揮長柄武器的優勢。

heroes.kits.stick-and-robe.description.zh: 使用杖袍套裝的角色持用一把簡單的長兵器（通常是長棍），並因穿戴輕甲而具有高度機動性。這讓你的英雄能夠充分發揮長柄武器的優勢。

heroes.kits.stick-and-robe.equipment.en: You wear light armor and wield a polearm.
heroes.kits.stick-and-robe.equipment.zh: 你穿戴輕甲，持用 1 件長柄武器。

heroes.kits.stick-and-robe.signature.whe.en:
Where I Want You
When your stick speaks, your enemy moves.
Melee, Strike, Weapon • Main action • Melee 2 • One creature
Power Roll + Might or Agility:
Tier 1: 4 + M or A damage
Tier 2: 7 + M or A damage; slide 1
Tier 3: 10 + M or A damage; slide 3

fs.en: When your stick speaks, your enemy moves.
fs.zh: 當你的棍杖發聲，敵人就得移動。

heroes.kits.stick-and-robe.signature.whe.zh:
隨心所置（Where I Want You）
當你的棍杖發聲，敵人就得移動。
近戰、打擊、武器／主要動作／近戰 2／1 個生物

② 7 + 力量或敏捷傷害；滑動 1
③ 10 + 力量或敏捷傷害；滑動 3

heroes.kits.swashbuckler.description.en: If you want to be mobile and deal a lot of damage with melee strikes, then you should reach for the Swashbuckler kit. This is a great kit for heroes who want to be master duelists.
heroes.kits.swashbuckler.description.zh: 若你想靈活移動並在近身戰鬥中造成大量傷害，劍客套裝是你的最佳選擇。這組套裝特別適合渴望成為決鬥大師的英雄。

heroes.kits.swashbuckler.equipment.en: You wear light armor and wield a medium weapon.
heroes.kits.swashbuckler.equipment.zh: 你穿戴輕甲，持用 1 件中型武器。

heroes.kits.swashbuckler.signature.fancy.en:
Fancy Footwork
All combat is a dance—and you’ll be the one leading.
Melee, Strike, Weapon • Main action • Melee 1 • One creature
Power Roll + Might or Agility:
Tier 1: 5 + M or A damage
Tier 2: 7 + M or A damage; push 1
Tier 3: 10 + M or A damage; push 2
Effect: You can shift into any square the target leaves after you push them.

fs.en: You can shift into any square the target leaves after you push them
fs.zh: 在你推動目標後，你可以遁移到目標離開的任何方格。

heroes.kits.swashbuckler.signature.fancy.zh:
華麗步法（Fancy Footwork）
每場戰鬥都是一場舞蹈，而你就是領舞者。
近戰、打擊、武器／主要動作／近戰 1／1 個生物
檢定 + 力量或敏捷：
① 5 + 力量或敏捷傷害
② 7 + 力量或敏捷傷害；推動 1
③ 10 + 力量或敏捷傷害；推動 2
效果：在你推動目標後，你可以遁移到目標離開的任何方格。

heroes.kits.sword-and-board.description.en: The Sword and Board kit doesn’t just give you a shield—it makes the shield part of your offensive arsenal. With a medium weapon in one hand and a block of steel or solid oak in the other, you protect yourself while you control the battlefield.

fs.en: The Sword and Board kit doesn't just give you a shield—it makes the shield part of your offensive arsenal. With a medium weapon in one hand and a block of steel or solid oak in the other, you protect yourself while you control the battlefield.
fs.zh: 劍盾套裝不只提供你一面盾牌，而是讓盾牌成為你重要的進攻手段。一手持中型武器，一手握著鋼鐵或實木盾牌，你既能控制戰場，又能保護自己。

heroes.kits.sword-and-board.description.zh: 劍盾套裝不只提供你一面盾牌，而是讓盾牌成為你重要的進攻手段。一手持中型武器，一手握著鋼鐵或實木盾牌，你既能控制戰場，又能保護自己。

heroes.kits.sword-and-board.equipment.en: You wear medium armor and wield a shield and a medium weapon.
heroes.kits.sword-and-board.equipment.zh: 你穿戴中甲，持用 1 面盾牌和 1 件中型武器。

heroes.kits.sword-and-board.signature.sh.en:
Shield Bash
In your hands, a shield isn’t just for protection.
Melee, Strike, Weapon • Main action • Melee 1 • One creature
Power Roll + Might or Agility:
Tier 1: 4 + M or A damage; push 1
Tier 2: 7 + M or A damage; push 2
Tier 3: 9 + M or A damage; push 3; M < s, prone

fs.en: In your hands, a shield isn't just for protection.
fs.zh: 你手中的盾牌不僅僅是防禦工具。

heroes.kits.sword-and-board.signature.sh.zh:
盾擊（Shield Bash）
你手中的盾牌不僅僅是防禦工具。
近戰、打擊、武器／主要動作／近戰 1／1 個生物
檢定 + 力量或敏捷：
① 4 + 力量或敏捷傷害；推動 1
② 7 + 力量或敏捷傷害；推動 2
③ 9 + 力量或敏捷傷害；推動 3；力量 < 強，伏地

heroes.kits.warrior-priest.description.en: The Warrior Priest kit imbues the power of the gods into your weapon, making it a smiting instrument. You wade into the fray without fear, thanks to the power of the divine … and the heavy armor you wear.
heroes.kits.warrior-priest.description.zh: 武祭套裝將神力注入你的武器，使其成為懲戒之器。多虧了神聖力量以及身穿的重甲，你能夠無懼地投入戰鬥。

heroes.kits.warrior-priest.equipment.en: You wear heavy armor and wield a light weapon.
heroes.kits.warrior-priest.equipment.zh: 你穿戴重甲，持用 1 件輕型武器。

heroes.kits.warrior-priest.signature.wea.en:
Weakening Brand
The impact of your weapon brands your target for destruction.
Magic, Melee, Strike, Weapon • Main action • Melee 1 • One creature or object
Power Roll + Might, Reason, Intuition, or Presence:
Tier 1: 3 + M, R, I, or P holy damage
Tier 2: 5 + M, R, I, or P holy damage
Tier 3: 8 + M, R, I, or P holy damage
Effect: Until the end of the target’s next turn, they have damage weakness equal to the characteristic score used for this ability’s power roll.

fs.en: Until the end of the target's next turn, they have damage weakness equal to the characteristic score used for this ability's power roll.
fs.zh: 在目標下個回合結束之前，他具有 X 點傷害弱點，X 等於此招式檢定所使用的屬性值。

heroes.kits.warrior-priest.signature.wea.zh:
弱化烙印（Weakening Brand）
你的武器擊中目標，在對方身上烙下毀滅的印記。
魔法、近戰、打擊、武器／主要動作／近戰 1／1 個生物或物體
檢定 + 力量、理智、直覺或氣場：
① 3 + 力量、理智、直覺或氣場神聖傷害
② 5 + 力量、理智、直覺或氣場神聖傷害
③ 8 + 力量、理智、直覺或氣場神聖傷害
效果：在目標下個回合結束之前，他具有 X 點傷害弱點，X 等於此招式檢定所使用的屬性值。

heroes.kits.whirlwind.description.en: The Whirlwind kit makes effective use of whips, granting you mobility, damage, and reach. If you want to be a fast-moving warrior who lashes foes with a chain or whip, then this is the kit for you.
heroes.kits.whirlwind.description.zh: 旋風套裝讓你有效地運用鞭笞武器，提供你卓越的機動性、傷害力和攻擊距離。若你希望成為用鐵鍊或鞭子打擊敵人的靈活戰士，這組套裝正是為你準備的。

heroes.kits.whirlwind.equipment.en: You wear no armor and wield a whip.
heroes.kits.whirlwind.equipment.zh: 你沒有穿戴護甲，持用 1 件鞭笞武器。

heroes.kits.whirlwind.signature.extensio.en:
Extension of My Arm
When you draw your whip back after an attack, your enemy is drawn ever closer.
Melee, Strike, Weapon • Main action • Melee 3 • One creature
Power Roll + Might or Agility:
Tier 1: 4 + M or A damage; vertical pull 1
Tier 2: 7 + M or A damage; vertical pull 2
Tier 3: 10 + M or A damage; vertical pull 3

fs.en: When you draw your whip back after an attack, your enemy is drawn ever closer.
fs.zh: 在你攻擊並收回鞭子後，敵人會被拉得更近。

heroes.kits.whirlwind.signature.extensio.zh:
鞭影出臂（Extension of My Arm）
在你攻擊並收回鞭子後，敵人會被拉得更近。
