檢定 + 力量或敏捷：
① 4 + 力量或敏捷傷害；垂直拉動 1
② 7 + 力量或敏捷傷害；垂直拉動 2
③ 10 + 力量或敏捷傷害；垂直拉動 3

heroes.perks.arcane-trick.effect.en:
You have the following ability.
Arcane Trick
You cast an entertaining spell that creates a minor but impressive magical effect.
Magic • Main Action • Self; see below • Self
Effect: Choose one of the following effects:
• You teleport a size 1S or smaller object adjacent to you into an unoccupied space adjacent to you.
• Until the start of your next turn, a part of your body shoots a shower of harmless noisy sparks that light up each square adjacent to you.
• You ignite or snuff out (your choice) every mundane light source of 1L or smaller adjacent to you.
• You transform up to 1 pound of edible food you touch to make it taste delicious or disgusting.
• Until the start of your next turn, you make your body exude a particular odor you’ve smelled before. This smell can be sensed by each creature within 5 squares of you, but can’t impose any condition or other drawback on those creatures.
• You place a small magical inscription on the surface of a mundane object you touch, or you can remove an inscription that was made by you or by another creature using Arcane Trick.
• You touch a size 1T object to cover it with an illusion that makes it look like a different object. Any creature who handles the object becomes aware of the illusion. The illusion ends when you stop touching the object.

fs.en: Choose one of the following effects:
fs.zh: 選擇以下 1 種效果：

heroes.perks.arcane-trick.effect.zh:
你擁有以下招式。

奧術戲法（Arcane Trick）
你施展一個趣味的法術，創造出微小但令人驚豔的魔法效果。
魔法／主要動作／自身；見說明／自身
效果：選擇以下 1 種效果：
• 你將 1 個體型 1S 以下且與你相鄰的物體傳送至 1 個與你相鄰的未占據空間。
• 在你下個回合開始前，你身體的 1 個部位會射出無害的吵雜火花，照亮每個與你相鄰的方格。
• 你點燃或熄滅每個與你相鄰、體型為 1L 以下的尋常光源。
• 你觸碰最多 1 磅的可食用食物，使其味道變得美味或噁心。
• 在你下個回合開始前，你的身體會散發出 1 種你曾經聞過的氣味。在你 5 格內的每個生物都能聞到這個氣味，但不會因此陷入任何狀態或受到不良影響。
• 你觸碰 1 個尋常物體的表面並留下小型魔法銘文，或移除由你或其他生物使用【奧術戲法】留下的任何銘文。
• 你觸碰 1 個體型 1T 的物體，用幻術讓它的外觀變成其他物體。任何與該物體互動的生物都會察覺此幻術。當你不再觸碰該物體時，幻術就會消失。

heroes.perks.area-of-expertise.effect.en: Choose one skill you already have from the crafting skill group. Whenever you obtain a tier 1 outcome on an easy or medium test using this skill, you treat it as a tier 2 outcome instead. Additionally, if you spend 1 minute inspecting an object related to the chosen skill, you can estimate its value and learn of any flaws in its construction.
heroes.perks.area-of-expertise.effect.zh: 從工藝類技能中選擇 1 項你擁有的技能。每當你使用該技能進行簡單或中等難度的考驗時，任何 T1 結果都會視為 T2。此外，若你花費 1 分鐘檢查與該技能有關的物體，你能估算該物體的價值，並發現其結構的缺陷。

heroes.perks.brawny.effect.en: Whenever you fail a Might test, you can lose Stamina equal to 1d6 + your level to improve the outcome of the test by one tier. You can use this perk only once per test.
heroes.perks.brawny.effect.zh: 每當你的力量考驗失敗時，你可以失去 1d6 + 等級的體力，將考驗的結果提升 1 階。此專長每次考驗只能使用 1 次。

heroes.perks.but-i-know-who-does.effect.en: Whenever you fail a test to recall lore using a skill from the lore skill group, you instinctively recall the nearest location where the information you seek might be found. This could be the tower of a local sage, a library in a nearby city, somewhere deep in a dungeon, or any other location of the Director’s determination. The Director can decide that certain lore can’t be revealed this way.
heroes.perks.but-i-know-who-does.effect.zh: 每當你使用學識類技能進行回想知識的考驗失敗時，你能直覺地想起最近的哪個地方可能有你需要的資訊。例如當地的賢者塔樓、附近城市的圖書館、地城深處的某個角落，或任何導演指定的地點。有些知識可能無法透過這種方式取得（由導演判定）。

heroes.perks.camouflage-hunter.effect.en: Whenever you are in wilderness, once you are hidden from a creature, you don’t need cover or concealment to stay hidden from them.
heroes.perks.camouflage-hunter.effect.zh: 當你身處荒野環境時，一旦你對 1 個生物處於隱藏，即使沒有掩護或遮蔽，你也能持續保持隱藏。

heroes.perks.charming-liar.effect.en: If you fail a test using the Lie skill, you don’t suffer any consequences associated with the failure. Additionally, during a negotiation, you can be caught in one lie without negative consequences. When you use either benefit of this perk, you can’t use this perk again until you earn 1 or more Victories.
heroes.perks.charming-liar.effect.zh: 若你使用欺瞞技能但考驗失敗，你不會承受任何失敗的後果。此外，在談判期間，當你首次被發現說謊時，你不會承受負面後果。在你獲得此專長的任何一個好處後，你必須至少獲得 1 點勝利值才能再次使用此專長。

heroes.perks.creature-sense.effect.en: As a maneuver, choose a creature within 10 squares. If that creature is your level or lower, you learn the keywords in their stat block (Demon, Humanoid, Undead, and so forth).

fs.en: Choose a creature within 10 squares. If that creature is your level or lower, you learn the keywords in their stat block (Demon, Humanoid, Undead, and so forth)
fs.zh: 你可以選擇 10 格內的 1 個生物。若該生物的等級 ≦ 你的等級，你會知道他數據表中的關鍵詞（例如惡魔、類人生物、亡靈等）。

heroes.perks.creature-sense.effect.zh: 使用機動動作，你可以選擇 10 格內的 1 個生物。若該生物的等級 ≦ 你的等級，你會知道他數據表中的關鍵詞（例如惡魔、類人生物、亡靈等）。

heroes.perks.criminal-contacts.effect.en: You have access to a network of criminal contacts. As a respite activity while you take a respite in a settlement, you can ask a question of your contacts by making a Presence test. On a tier 2 outcome, you learn one piece of information that would be common among criminals—the secret entrances into a building, the location of a local criminal in hiding, the name of a local thieves’ guild leader, and so forth. On a tier 3 outcome, you can instead gain knowledge that would be uncommon among criminals as long as such information exists—the location of a local treasure cache, the location of a murder weapon used in a noble’s assassination, the name of an NPC secretly bankrolling a local assassin’s guild, and so forth.
heroes.perks.criminal-contacts.effect.zh: 你有一個由犯罪人士組成的人脈網路。在聚落進行休整時，作為休整活動，你可以進行氣場考驗向你的人脈提出 1 個問題。若考驗結果為 T2，你可以獲得 1 則在江湖中廣為人知的情報，例如某棟建築的祕密入口、某個躲起來的罪犯位置，或當地盜賊公會首領的名字等等。若考驗結果為 T3，你可以獲得 1 則在江湖中鮮為人知的情報（前提是真的有這樣的情報），例如當地某個寶藏的藏匿地點、某件用來刺殺貴族的兇器下落，或是某個暗中資助當地刺客公會的 NPC 名字等等。

heroes.perks.danger-sense.effect.en: Whenever you are in a natural environment (but not in a settlement in that environment), you gain an edge on tests made using the Alertness skill, and you can’t be surprised. Additionally, you have a connection to nature that warns you if any natural disaster is imminent within the next 72 hours, though you don’t know exactly what it will entail (an earthquake, a wildfire, and so forth).
heroes.perks.danger-sense.effect.zh: 當你身處自然環境時（但不是在聚落內），你使用警覺技能進行考驗會獲得 1 個優勢，而且你不會措手不及。此外，你與大自然有一種奇妙的連結，你會知道未來 72 小時內是否有任何自然災害即將發生，但你無法確切知道會發生什麼事（例如地震或野火等）。

heroes.perks.dazzler.effect.en: Whenever a creature watches you sing, dance, or perform a role (as an actor, not just in disguise) for 1 uninterrupted minute or more, you gain an edge on any test made to influence that creature for 1 hour after the performance ends.
heroes.perks.dazzler.effect.zh: 若有生物不間斷地觀賞你唱歌、跳舞或演戲（以演員身分演出，而不只是易容）至少 1 分鐘，在表演結束後的 1 小時內，你試圖影響該生物的所有考驗都會獲得 1 個優勢。

heroes.perks.eidetic-memory.effect.en: Your mind is an encyclopedia, though not always an easy one to organize. When you finish a respite, choose one skill from the lore skill group that you don’t have. You have that skill until you finish your next respite. Additionally, if you spend 1 uninterrupted minute or more reading any page of text, you can memorize its contents, allowing you to memorize entire books with sufficient time.
heroes.perks.eidetic-memory.effect.zh: 不管凌亂還是整齊，你的心智都如同一部百科全書。當你完成休整時，你可以從學識類技能中選擇 1 項你沒有的技能。你可以獲得該技能，直到下次休整結束。此外，若你花費至少 1 分鐘不間斷地閱讀任何一頁文字，你可以記住全部的內容，讓你在有充足時間的情況下記住整本書。

heroes.perks.engrossing-monologue.effect.en: Whenever you are not in combat, you can shout to get the attention of hearing creatures within 10 squares of you. Each such creature who is not hostile toward you listens to what you have to say for 1 uninterrupted minute or more, or until they sense danger or any form of imminent harm. While creatures are listening to you, each of your allies gains an edge on tests made to avoid being noticed by those creatures.
heroes.perks.engrossing-monologue.effect.zh: 若你不處於戰鬥，你可以大聲呼喊，讓 10 格內所有能聽見你的生物將注意力放在你身上。每個對你不懷敵意的生物都會不間斷地專心聽你說的話，至少 1 分鐘，除非他們感知到任何危險或即將來襲的傷害。當生物正在聽你說話時，你的每個盟友在進行避免被該生物發現的考驗時都會獲得 1 個優勢。

heroes.perks.expert-artisan.effect.en: Whenever you make a test as part of a crafting or research project that uses a skill you already have from the crafting skill group, you can make the power roll twice and use either roll.
heroes.perks.expert-artisan.effect.zh: 每當你進行工藝類或研究類專案的考驗時，若你使用你擁有的工藝類技能，你可以擲骰 2 次，並選用其中 1 個結果。

heroes.perks.expert-sage.effect.en: Whenever you make a test as part of a crafting or research project using a skill from the lore skill group, you can make the power roll twice and use either roll.
heroes.perks.expert-sage.effect.zh: 每當你進行工藝類或研究類專案的考驗時，若你使用學識類技能，你可以擲骰 2 次，並選用其中 1 個結果。

heroes.perks.familiar.effect.en:
Familiar
A supernatural spirit who has taken the form of a specific small animal or animated object has chosen to be your familiar—or to adopt you as their familiar.
The spirit uses the familiar stat block.

The familiar can hold small objects in their mouth or claws, but can’t perform activities that would typically require hands (opening a door, unrolling a scroll, and so forth). They can’t harm other creatures or objects. They can flank in combat, but only with you.
If your familiar is destroyed, you can restore them as a respite activity, or by spending a Recovery as a main action to bring them back into existence in an unoccupied space adjacent to you.

Familliar [stat block heading as printed in Heroes 1.01b]
Size: 1T | Speed: 5 | Stamina: 2 × your level | Stability: 0 | Free Strike: 0
Immunity: — | Weakness: — | Movement: —
Might: -3 | Agility: +2 | Reason: 0 | Intuition: 0 | Presence: +1
Telepathic
The While you and your familiar are within 10 squares of each other, you can communicate telepathically and share each other’s senses. While sharing senses, each of you also benefits from your own senses at the same time.

fs.en: A supernatural spirit who has taken the form of a specific small animal or animated object has chosen to be your familiar—or to adopt you as their familiar.
fs.zh: 1 個超自然的精魂化身為特定的小動物或活化物體，成為你的魔寵。或者，將你當成牠的魔寵。

heroes.perks.familiar.effect.zh:
1 個超自然的精魂化身為特定的小動物或活化物體，成為你的魔寵。或者，將你當成牠的魔寵。魔寵的數據表請見下文。

魔寵可以用嘴巴或爪子握住小型物體，但無法進行需要使用手的行為（例如開門或打開卷軸）。牠不能傷害其他生物或物體。在戰鬥中，牠只能與你一起進行夾擊。

若你的魔寵被消滅，你可以透過休整活動來復活牠，或使用主要動作並花費 1 點復元力，讓牠在 1 個與你相鄰的未占據空間中重新出現。

魔寵（Familiar）
體型：1T｜速度：5｜體力：2 × 你的等級｜穩度：0｜基礎打擊：0
免疫：—｜弱點：—｜移動：—
力量：−3｜敏捷：+2｜理智：0｜直覺：0｜氣場：+1

心靈感應（Telepathic）
若你和你的魔寵相距 10 格內，你們可以進行心靈溝通並共享彼此的感官。在共享感官的同時，你們仍然會保有自己原本的感官能力。

heroes.perks.forgettable-face.effect.en: If you spend 10 minutes or less interacting with a creature who hasn’t met you before, you can cause them to forget your face when you part. If asked to describe you, the creature gives only a vague, blank, and unhelpful description. Additionally, if you spend 1 hour or more assembling a disguise, you automatically obtain a tier 2 outcome on any test that could make use of the Disguise skill. If you have the Disguise skill, you automatically obtain a tier 3 outcome on the test.
heroes.perks.forgettable-face.effect.zh: 若你與初次見面的生物互動不超過 10 分鐘，你可以讓對方在離開後忘記你的長相。若他人問起你的外表，該生物只能提供模糊、空泛且毫無參考價值的描述。此外，若你投入 1 小時以上的時間進行偽裝，在任何可以使用易容技能的考驗中，你都會自動獲得 T2 結果。如果你已經擁有易容技能，則自動獲得 T3 結果。

heroes.perks.friend-catapult.effect.en: As a maneuver, you grab a willing adjacent ally or object of your size or smaller, then vertical push that target up to a number of squares equal to twice your Might score. If a creature you push falls as a result of this movement, the effective distance of the fall is reduced by a number of squares equal to twice your Might score. When you use this perk, you can’t use it again until you earn 1 or more Victories.

fs.en: You grab a willing adjacent ally or object of your size or smaller, then vertical push that target up to a number of squares equal to twice your Might score. If a creature you push falls as a result of this movement, the effective distance of the fall is reduced by a number of squares equal to twice your Might score. When you use this perk, you can’t use it again until you earn 1 or more Victories.
fs.zh: 你抓住 1 個相鄰的自願盟友或物體（兩者的體型都必須 ≦ 你），然後將目標垂直推動最多等於你力量 ×2 的格數。如果你推動的生物因此墜落，墜落的有效距離會減少等於你力量 ×2 的格數。使用此專長後，你必須至少獲得 1 點勝利值才能再次使用。

heroes.perks.friend-catapult.effect.zh: 使用機動動作，你抓住 1 個相鄰的自願盟友或物體（兩者的體型都必須 ≦ 你），然後將目標垂直推動最多等於你力量 ×2 的格數。如果你推動的生物因此墜落，墜落的有效距離會減少等於你力量 ×2 的格數。使用此專長後，你必須至少獲得 1 點勝利值才能再次使用。

heroes.perks.gum-up-the-works.effect.en: Whenever a mundane trap activates within 3 squares, you can use a triggered action to move up to 3 squares toward it. If this movement brings you adjacent to any of the trap’s mechanisms, you can jam the trap, preventing it from activating. As long as you stay adjacent to the mechanism, the trap can’t go off unless an attempt to disarm it fails.

fs.en: You can move up to 3 squares toward the trap. If this movement brings you adjacent to any of the trap’s mechanisms, you can jam the trap, preventing it from activating. As long as you stay adjacent to the mechanism, the trap can’t go off unless an attempt to disarm it fails.
fs.zh: 向陷阱移動最多 3 格。若這次移動能讓你與陷阱的任何機關相鄰，你可以卡住陷阱，阻止它啟動。只要你保持與機關相鄰，除非有人嘗試解除陷阱卻失敗，否則陷阱不會觸發。

heroes.perks.gum-up-the-works.effect.zh: 每當 3 格內的 1 個尋常陷阱啟動時，你可以使用反應動作向陷阱移動最多 3 格。若這次移動能讓你與陷阱的任何機關相鄰，你可以卡住陷阱，阻止它啟動。只要你保持與機關相鄰，除非有人嘗試解除陷阱卻失敗，否則陷阱不會觸發。

heroes.perks.handy.effect.en: Whenever you make a test to craft something and don’t have a skill that applies to the test, you gain a +1 bonus to the power roll.
heroes.perks.handy.effect.zh: 每當你進行考驗來製造物品時，若你沒有任何適用的技能，你的檢定會獲得 +1 加值。

heroes.perks.harmonizer.effect.en: You can make a Presence test using the Music skill to influence creatures who don’t have emotions or can’t understand you. Additionally, once during a negotiation when an ally makes an argument, you can play music to give that ally an edge on their test.
heroes.perks.harmonizer.effect.zh: 你可以使用音樂技能進行氣場考驗來影響那些沒有情感或無法理解你的生物。此外，每次談判 1 次，當 1 個盟友提出論據時，你可以演奏音樂讓該次考驗獲得 1 個優勢。

heroes.perks.improvisation-creation.effe.en: Without needing to make a test—and even without tools—you can quickly jury-rig or repair a mundane item or piece of equipment related to a skill you have from the crafting skill group. That item lasts for 1 hour or works for one use or activation (whichever comes first, as the Director determines), then breaks beyond repair. For example, if you have the Carpentry skill, you could repair a rickety wooden bridge long enough for a group of creatures to cross it, or build a simple shovel made of wood that can be used for 1 hour.
heroes.perks.improvisation-creation.effe.zh:
你不需要進行考驗，甚至不需要工具，就可以迅速組裝或修復 1 個尋常道具或裝備（前提是該物體必須與你擁有的 1 個工藝類技能有關）。該道具可以持續 1 小時或使用或啟動 1 次（以先發生者為準，由導演判定），然後就會損壞，無法再修復。

例如，若你擁有木工技能，你可以修復一座搖搖欲墜的木橋來讓一群生物通過，或製作一把能使用 1 小時的簡易木鏟。

heroes.perks.inspired-artisan.effect.en: When you make a project roll using a skill from the crafting skill group, you can spend a hero token to make another project roll for the same project as part of the same respite activity. You can’t use this perk more than once per respite.
heroes.perks.inspired-artisan.effect.zh: 當你使用工藝類技能進行專案檢定時，作為同一次休整活動的一部分，你可以花費 1 枚英雄幣，為同一個專案額外進行 1 次專案檢定。此專長每次休整只能使用 1 次。

heroes.perks.invisible-force.effect.en:
You have the ability Invisible Force.
Invisible Force
You manipulate a tiny object with your mind.
Psionic, Ranged • Maneuver • Ranged 10 • One size 1T object
Effect: You can grab or manipulate the target object with your mind, moving the object up to a number of squares equal to your Reason, Intuition, or Presence score (your choice). You can use this ability to turn doorknobs, pull levers, and so forth. You can manipulate any small movable piece of a larger object as long as the piece is unattended and size 1T. You can’t use this ability to break a smaller piece off a larger object.

fs.en: You can grab or manipulate the target object with your mind, moving the object up to a number of squares equal to your Reason, Intuition, or Presence score (your choice). You can use this ability to turn doorknobs, pull levers, and so forth. You can manipulate any small movable piece of a larger object as long as the piece is unattended and size 1T. You can’t use this ability to break a smaller piece off a larger object.
fs.zh: 你可以透過意念抓取或操控目標物體，將它移動最多等於你理智、直覺或氣場（由你選擇）的格數。你可以使用此招式來轉動門把、拉動操縱桿等物體。你也可以操控較大物體中的較小且可移動的部件（前提是該部件無人持有或操控，且體型為 1T），但你無法使用此招式將這些較小的部件從較大的物體上折斷。

heroes.perks.invisible-force.effect.zh:
你擁有以下招式。

無形念力（Invisible Force）
你可以透過意念操控微小的物體。
靈能、遠程／機動動作／遠程 10／1 個體型 1T 的物體
效果：你可以透過意念抓取或操控目標物體，將它移動最多等於你理智、直覺或氣場（由你選擇）的格數。你可以使用此招式來轉動門把、拉動操縱桿等物體。你也可以操控較大物體中的較小且可移動的部件（前提是該部件無人持有或操控，且體型為 1T），但你無法使用此招式將這些較小的部件從較大的物體上折斷。

heroes.perks.ive-got-you.effect.en: Whenever a willing ally falls and would land on you or adjacent to you, you can safely catch them as a free triggered action. Neither of you takes damage from the ally’s fall.

fs.en: You catch your ally. Neither of you takes damage from the fall.
fs.zh: 你可以安全地接住他。你和盟友都不會受到墜落造成的傷害。

heroes.perks.ive-got-you.effect.zh: 當 1 個自願的盟友即將墜落在你身上或與你相鄰的位置時，你可以使用免費反應動作安全地接住他。你和盟友都不會受到墜落造成的傷害。

heroes.perks.ive-read-about-this-place.e.en:
Each time you enter a settlement you’ve never been to before, you can ask the Director one of the following questions:
• Who is the most influential public figure in this settlement?
• Who in this settlement would be the friendliest to us right now?
• What does this settlement need most from outsiders?
If the Director doesn’t have an answer to the question you ask, or doesn’t want to answer, you can instead ask a different question.
heroes.perks.ive-read-about-this-place.e.zh:
每當你首次進入未曾造訪的聚落時，你可以向導演提出以下 1 個問題：
• 誰是這聚落中最有影響力的公眾人物？
• 這聚落中誰目前對我們最友善？
• 這聚落最需要外來者提供什麼？
若導演對你提出的問題沒有答案或不願回答，你可以改提其他問題。

heroes.perks.lie-detector.effect.en: In response to another creature communicating information to you, you can spend a hero token to determine whether that information contained any knowing lies. If so, you know what the lies are, but not what the truth is.
heroes.perks.lie-detector.effect.zh: 當其他生物向你傳達資訊時，你可以花費 1 枚英雄幣來判斷該資訊是否包含任何故意的謊言。若有，你會知道哪些部分是謊言，但不會知道背後的真相。

heroes.perks.linguist.effect.en: You automatically learn two new languages, as long as you have regularly heard those languages spoken or seen them written before. Additionally, if you spend 7 days or more in a place where you regularly hear or read a language you don’t know, you can pick up enough of that language to hold a conversation or understand basic written information. Having picked up a language this way, you can subsequently learn it using the Learn New Language research project at half the usual project goal cost (see Chapter 12: Downtime Projects).

fs.en: You have an ear for languages. You automatically learn two new languages, as long as you have regularly heard those languages spoken or seen them written before.
fs.zh: 你自動學會 2 種新語言，前提是你曾經有機會經常聽到或讀到這些語言。

heroes.perks.linguist.effect.zh: 你自動學會 2 種新語言，前提是你曾經有機會經常聽到或讀到這些語言。此外，若你在某個地方停留至少 7 天，並有機會經常聽到或讀到 1 種你不懂的語言，你就可以掌握足夠的語言能力來進行對話或理解基礎書面資訊。以這種方式掌握語言後，你可以使用「學習新語言」研究類專案來進一步學習，且專案目標費用只需要原本的一半（詳見第 12 章〈休整專案〉）。

heroes.perks.lucky-dog.effect.en: Whenever you fail a test using any skill from the intrigue skill group, you can lose Stamina equal to 1d6 + your level to improve the outcome of the test by one tier. You can use this perk only once per test.
heroes.perks.lucky-dog.effect.zh: 每當你使用任一項諜報類技能進行考驗而失敗時，你可以失去 1d6 + 等級的體力，將考驗結果提升 1 階。此專長每次考驗只能使用 1 次。

heroes.perks.master-of-disguise.effect.en: You can don or remove a disguise as part of any test you make using the Hide skill, or while using the Hide maneuver.
heroes.perks.master-of-disguise.effect.zh: 當你進行任何躲藏考驗或使用躲藏機動動作時，你可以同時換上或卸下偽裝。

heroes.perks.monster-whisperer.effect.en: You can use the Handle Animals skill to interact with nonsapient creatures who are not animals.
heroes.perks.monster-whisperer.effect.zh: 你可以使用馴獸技能與不是動物的非智慧生物進行互動。

heroes.perks.open-book.effect.en: Whenever you speak one-on-one with a creature, you can ask them one question about themself that might typically offend them or raise suspicion. If they choose not to answer honestly, they simply deflect or redirect the question, with no further complications. If they choose to answer honestly, the creature can immediately ask you a question about yourself in turn, which you must answer honestly.
heroes.perks.open-book.effect.zh: 當你與某個生物一對一交談時，你可以向他提出 1 個關於他自己的問題，即使這個問題通常會冒犯他或引起懷疑。若他不想誠實回答，他只會簡單地迴避或轉移話題，不會有其他後果。若他誠實回答，該生物可以立刻反過來向你提出 1 個關於你自己的問題，而你必須誠實回答。

heroes.perks.pardon-my-friend.effect.en: When an ally within 5 squares fails a Presence test, you can step in and make a Presence test that takes a bane, with your roll replacing the ally’s roll. This perk can be used only once per test, even if more than one character has it.
heroes.perks.pardon-my-friend.effect.zh: 當 5 格內的 1 個盟友進行氣場考驗而失敗時，你可以介入進行帶有 1 個劣勢的氣場考驗，並以你的擲骰結果取代盟友的結果。即使有多名角色擁有此專長，每次考驗也只能使用 1 次。

heroes.perks.polymath.effect.en: Whenever you make a test to recall lore and don’t have a skill that applies to the test, you gain a +1 bonus to the power roll.
heroes.perks.polymath.effect.zh: 每當你進行考驗來回想知識時，若你沒有任何適用的技能，你的檢定會獲得 +1 加值。

heroes.perks.power-player.effect.en: Whenever you make a test that uses the Brag, Flirt, or Intimidate skills, you can use Might instead of any other characteristic the test calls for.
heroes.perks.power-player.effect.zh: 每當你使用誇耀、魅惑或威嚇技能進行考驗時，你可以使用力量取代原本要求的屬性。

heroes.perks.psychic-whisper.effect.en:
You have the following ability.
Psychic Whisper
You send a one-way telepathic message to a friend.
Psionic, Ranged • Maneuver • Ranged 10 • One ally
Effect: As long as the target understands one or more languages, you send a telepathic message to them that takes 10 seconds or less to speak. The target knows who the message is from and can decide to ignore it and subsequent messages.

fs.en: You send a telepathic message to them that takes 10 seconds or less to speak. The target knows who the message is from and can decide to ignore it and subsequent messages.
fs.zh: 你可以向目標傳送 1 則 10 秒之內能說完的心靈訊息。目標會知道訊息來自何人，而且可以決定是否忽略此訊息及後續訊息。

heroes.perks.psychic-whisper.effect.zh:
你擁有以下招式。

心靈低語（Psychic Whisper）
你向朋友發送單向的心靈訊息。
靈能、遠程／機動動作／遠程 10／1 個盟友
效果：只要目標理解至少 1 種語言，你可以向目標傳送 1 則 10 秒之內能說完的心靈訊息。目標會知道訊息來自何人，而且可以決定是否忽略此訊息及後續訊息。

heroes.perks.put-your-back-into-it.effec.en: During montage tests, whenever you make a test to assist a test and obtain a tier 1 outcome, the assisted test doesn’t take a bane. Additionally, once per montage test, you can turn an ally’s tier 1 test outcome into a tier 2 outcome.
heroes.perks.put-your-back-into-it.effec.zh: 在蒙太奇考驗中，每當你進行協助考驗並獲得 T1 結果時，被協助的考驗不會承受 1 個劣勢。此外，每場蒙太奇考驗 1 次，你可以將 1 個盟友的 T1 考驗結果提升為 T2。

heroes.perks.ritualist.effect.en: You can spend 1 uninterrupted minute to perform a magic ritual of blessing, targeting yourself or one willing creature you touch. The target has a double edge on the next test they make within the next minute. A target can’t use this benefit on an activity that takes longer than 1 minute.
heroes.perks.ritualist.effect.zh: 你可以花費 1 分鐘不間斷地進行祝福魔法儀式，指定自身或觸碰 1 個自願生物為目標。目標在接下來 1 分鐘內進行的下次考驗會獲得雙優勢。此效果不能用於耗時超過 1 分鐘的活動。

heroes.perks.slipped-lead.effect.en: You gain an edge on tests made to escape bonds. Given 1 uninterrupted minute, you can escape any mundane bonds without making a test. Additionally, it’s not immediately obvious when you’ve escaped bonds until you do something that makes it clear you have done so (cast them off, use an ability that harms one or more creatures, and so forth).
heroes.perks.slipped-lead.effect.zh: 當你進行掙脫束縛的考驗時，你獲得 1 個優勢。若你擁有 1 分鐘不間斷的時間，你不需要進行考驗即可掙脫任何尋常束縛。此外，在你做出明顯表明你已掙脫的行為前（例如丟開束縛物、發動能傷害生物的招式等），其他人不會一眼看出你已經掙脫。

heroes.perks.so-tell-me.effect.en: Whenever you succeed on a Presence test to influence one or more creatures, you can ask one creature you influenced a follow-up question after the test resolves, which they must answer honestly. At the Director’s discretion, the creature doesn’t have to answer the question completely—or at all—if the response would put them or a loved one in danger.
heroes.perks.so-tell-me.effect.zh: 每當你進行氣場考驗並成功影響 1 個以上的生物時，你可以在考驗結算後向其中 1 個被影響的生物提出 1 個後續問題，該生物必須誠實回答。在導演的判定下，若回答問題會讓該生物或他所愛的人陷入危險，他可以選擇只回答一部分，或完全不回答。

heroes.perks.specialist.effect.en: You are a leading expert on a particular subject. Choose one skill you have from the lore skill group. You always have a double edge on tests made to recall lore using this skill. Additionally, your specialist knowledge grants you notoriety in fields related to the chosen skill. You treat your Renown as 1 higher when negotiating with an NPC who knows your reputation, or 2 higher if they have the same skill you chose for this perk.
heroes.perks.specialist.effect.zh: 你是特定領域的頂尖專家。從學識類技能中選擇 1 項你擁有的技能。每當你使用該技能進行回想知識的考驗時，你總是獲得雙優勢。此外，你的專業知識讓你在相關領域贏得了一定的名聲。在與了解你名聲的 NPC 進行談判時，你的聲望會視為增加 1 點；若該 NPC 也擁有你為此專長選擇的技能，則視為增加 2 點。

heroes.perks.spot-the-tell.effect.en: Whenever you make a test to read a person and obtain a tier 3 outcome, you notice several tells that give away their true feelings. Any test you make to read that person in the future gains an edge.
heroes.perks.spot-the-tell.effect.zh: 每當你進行觀色考驗並獲得 T3 結果時，你會發現對方幾個顯露真實感受的破綻。你之後對他進行的任何觀色考驗都會獲得 1 個優勢。

heroes.perks.team-leader.effect.en: At the start of a group test or montage test, you can spend a hero token. If you do, all participants make tests as if they also had any skill you have from the exploration group.
heroes.perks.team-leader.effect.zh: 在團隊考驗或蒙太奇考驗開始時，你可以花費 1 枚英雄幣。若你這麼做，所有參與者在進行考驗時，都會視為擁有你具備的任何探索類技能。

heroes.perks.teamwork.effect.en: When you take your first turn during any montage test, you can both make a test and assist another hero’s test.

fs.en: When you take your first turn during a montage test, you can both make a test and assist another hero’s test.
fs.zh: 在蒙太奇考驗中，當你進行你的第 1 個回合時，你可以同時進行自己的考驗並協助另 1 個英雄的考驗。

heroes.perks.teamwork.effect.zh: 在任何蒙太奇考驗中，當你進行你的第 1 個回合時，你可以同時進行自己的考驗並協助另 1 個英雄的考驗。

heroes.perks.thingspeaker.effect.en:
When you hold an object in your hand for 1 uninterrupted minute, you can sense whether it bears emotional resonance. Objects with emotional resonance could include treasured gifts, murder weapons, or personal keepsakes. If the Director determines that the object bears emotional resonance, you learn the most dominant emotion associated with the object, then receive a vision that answers one of the following questions:
• What was the name of the person whose emotion is imprinted on this object?
• Why does this emotion linger on the object?
• How long has it been since the object was held by the person whose emotion lingers on it?
After asking one question, you can choose to delve deeper by asking one additional question from the list, but you are then overcome with emotions that do not belong to you. You take a bane on Intuition and Presence tests until you finish a respite, and you can’t use this perk again while you suffer this bane.
heroes.perks.thingspeaker.effect.zh:
若你不間斷地持握 1 個物體達 1 分鐘，你可以感應它是否帶有情感共鳴。具有情感共鳴的物體可能包括珍貴的禮物、凶器或個人紀念物。若導演判定該物體確實帶有情感共鳴，你會感應到與之相關的最強烈情感，然後獲得 1 個可以回答以下其中 1 個問題的異象：
① 情感烙印在這個物體上的人，叫什麼名字？
② 為什麼這種情感會殘留在物體上？
③ 留下這份情感的人，上次持握這個物體距今已過了多久？
詢問 1 個問題後，你可以深入探索，再從列表中額外提出 1 個問題，但你隨後會被不屬於自己的情感所淹沒。在完成休整之前，你的直覺和氣場考驗會承受 1 個劣勢，而且在承受此劣勢期間，你無法再次使用此專長。

heroes.perks.traveling-artisan.effect.en: On any day when you don’t take a respite, you can spend 1 uninterrupted hour working on a crafting project using a skill you have from the crafting skill group. If you do so, you gain 1d10 project points toward that project.
heroes.perks.traveling-artisan.effect.zh: 在任何你沒有進行休整的日子裡，你可以花費 1 小時不間斷地使用你擁有的工藝類技能進行工藝類專案。若你這麼做，該專案會獲得 1d10 點專案點數。

heroes.perks.traveling-sage.effect.en: On any day when you don’t take a respite, you can spend 1 uninterrupted hour working on a research project using a skill you have from the lore skill group. If you do so, you gain 1d10 project points toward that project.
heroes.perks.traveling-sage.effect.zh: 在任何你沒有進行休整的日子裡，你可以花費 1 小時不間斷地使用你擁有的學識類技能進行研究類專案。若你這麼做，該專案會獲得 1d10 點專案點數。

heroes.perks.wood-wise.effect.en: When you make a test using a skill from the exploration skill group and at least one of the d10s rolled is a 1, you can reroll one d10. You can use this perk only once per test.
heroes.perks.wood-wise.effect.zh: 當你使用探索類技能進行考驗時，若至少有 1 顆 d10 擲出 1，你可以重擲 1 顆 d10。此專長每次考驗只能使用 1 次。

heroes.skills.applying.rules.en:
Applying Skills

If you have a skill that applies to a test you make, you gain a +2 bonus to the test. For instance, if your hero has the Hide skill, you have a +2 bonus to any test you make that involves hiding yourself. This might include an Agility test to hide behind a barrel, or a Presence test to disappear into a crowd.

The +2 bonus gained for a skill isn’t an edge. A player can make a test that has both the +2 bonus for a skill and the +2 bonus for an edge.

You can’t apply more than one skill to a test.
heroes.skills.applying.rules.zh:
運用技能

若你擁有適用於當前考驗的技能，該考驗會獲得 +2 加值。例如，若你的英雄擁有躲藏技能，你在所有涉及隱藏自己的考驗都會獲得 +2 加值，包括躲在桶子後方的敏捷考驗，或是混進人群的氣場考驗。

技能提供的 +2 加值與優勢不同，所以每次考驗可以同時獲得技能的 +2 加值，以及優勢提供的 +2 加值。

每次考驗最多只能套用 1 項技能。

heroes.skills.characteristics.rules.en:
Mixing Characteristics and Skills

Although certain skills are often paired with one characteristic more than others, a skill can apply to a test made using any characteristic that makes sense. The Director has the final say on which characteristic is used to complete a task, and can call for a different characteristic based on the circumstances.

For example, intimidating someone with a purely verbal threat is a Presence test. But if a player describes their character tearing a log in half with their bare hands to intimidate a foe, the Director is likely to call for a Might test instead. The Intimidate skill can apply to both tests. In the same way, scaling the side of a building is covered by a Might test, but if a hero does a series of leaps from one balcony to another to reach a roof, the Director could call for an Agility test instead. The Climb skill applies to both of these tests.
heroes.skills.characteristics.rules.zh:
混用屬性和技能

雖然某些技能經常與特定的屬性搭配使用，但只要合理，任何技能都可以套用於任何屬性的考驗。進行考驗需要用到什麼屬性，導演有最終裁定權，並可以根據實際情況要求你使用不同的屬性。

例如，若單純使用言語威脅他人，需要進行氣場考驗；但如果玩家描述英雄徒手將木頭撕成兩半來威嚇敵人，導演可能會改為要求進行力量考驗，而威嚇技能在這兩種考驗中都適用。同理，攀爬建築物通常需要進行力量考驗，但若英雄想在陽台間連續跳躍到達屋頂，導演可以改為要求進行敏捷考驗，而攀爬技能同樣適用於這兩種考驗。

heroes.skills.crafting.rules.en:
Crafting Skills

Skills from the crafting skill group are used in the creation and appraisal of goods and for jury-rigging contraptions. They are especially useful during rests and downtime.

Rewards for tests made with crafting skills typically include having leftover rare material used in the creation process, knowing a buyer willing to pay extra for goods or items you’re appraising, or making a jury-rigged device so amazing that it lasts for more uses than it should.

Consequences for tests made with crafting skills typically include wasting rare materials used in the creation process, greatly overestimating or underestimating an item’s value, and poorly jury-rigging a contraption so that it harms people (or at least the wrong people).

Skill | Use
Alchemy | Make bombs and potions
Architecture | Create buildings and vehicles
Blacksmithing | Forge metal armor and weapons
Carpentry | Create items out of wood
Cooking | Create delicious dishes
Fletching | Make ranged weapons and ammunition
Forgery | Create false badges, documents, and other items
Jewelry | Create bracelets, crowns, rings, and other jewelry
Mechanics | Build machines and clockwork items
Tailoring | Craft clothing of cloth or leather
heroes.skills.crafting.rules.zh:
工藝類技能

工藝類技能主要用於製作和鑑定物品，以及組裝臨時裝置，在休整時特別實用。

使用工藝類技能進行考驗而獲得有獎勵的成功時，你可能會保留製作過程中的稀有材料、認識願意支付高價的買家，或是製作出超級耐用的臨時裝置。

若考驗失敗且遭遇波折，你可能會浪費稀有材料、對物品價值的判斷出現重大誤差，或是組裝出有缺陷的裝置而傷及他人。

技能｜用途
鍊金（Alchemy）｜製作炸彈與藥水
建築（Architecture）｜打造建築物與載具
鍛造（Blacksmithing）｜打造金屬護甲與武器
木工（Carpentry）｜打造木製物品
烹飪（Cooking）｜烹調美味料理
製箭（Fletching）｜製作遠程武器與彈藥
偽造（Forgery）｜製作偽造徽章、文件與其他物品
珠寶（Jewelry）｜製作手環、頭冠、戒指與其他珠寶
機關（Mechanics）｜打造機器與發條裝置
裁縫（Tailoring）｜製作布料或皮革服飾

heroes.skills.director-custom.rules.en:
For the Director: Make Your Own Skills

Directors should feel free to make their own skills that they feel are relevant and useful to their campaigns and adventures. For instance, the game doesn’t have a Brewing skill for brewing ale or a Painting skill for making art because those aren’t tasks that typically come up in a game about fighting monsters and saving the world. However, a Director could decide that their campaign involves poisoned barrels of ale and large amounts of counterfeit art, and that adding these two new skills to the game would make it more fun for the players. The Director simply needs to pick a group for these new skills—in this case, crafting makes sense. They then let the players know that they can swap out any crafting skill they have for these new skills.
heroes.skills.director-custom.rules.zh:
給導演：自訂技能

導演可以自由建立自己認為與戰役和冒險相關且實用的技能。例如，遊戲沒有用來釀造麥酒的釀造技能，也沒有用來創作藝術作品的繪畫技能，因為這些通常不是一款以對抗怪物、拯救世界為主題的遊戲會碰到的挑戰。不過，若導演覺得自己的戰役會涉及被下毒的麥酒桶、大量偽造藝術品，而且加入這些新技能會讓玩家玩得更開心，那就可以這麼做。

導演只需要替這些新技能選擇 1 個技能類別。在上述例子中，歸入工藝類技能很合理。接著告訴玩家，他們可以將自己擁有的任意 1 項工藝類技能換成其中 1 項新技能。

heroes.skills.edge-specific.rules.en:
Edges on Tests With Specific Skills

Certain features and abilities grant a creature an edge on tests made with a specific skill. A creature making a test where the specific skill would apply gains an edge on the test even if they don’t have the skill. For example, the conduit’s Blessing of Fortunate Weather can create foggy weather that grants creatures who make tests using the Hide skill an edge on those tests. Any creature who attempts to hide in the fog gains an edge on the test as long as the Hide skill would apply to that test, regardless of whether they have that skill or not.
heroes.skills.edge-specific.rules.zh:
使用特定技能進行考驗的優勢

某些特性與招式會讓生物在使用特定技能的考驗中獲得優勢。即使生物本身沒有該技能，只要該技能適用於這次考驗，該考驗仍會獲得優勢。例如，神導士的【Blessing of Fortunate Weather】可以創造濃霧天氣，讓使用躲藏技能進行考驗的生物獲得優勢。所以，任何生物只要試圖躲藏在濃霧中，而且躲藏技能適用於該考驗，就能獲得優勢，無論該生物是否實際擁有該項技能。

heroes.skills.equal.rules.en:
Are All Skills Equal?

When choosing skills for your character, deciding which skills will be most useful depends a lot on the campaign. For instance, the Swim skill might be used constantly during a campaign that takes place on the ocean and has heroes exploring underwater ruins, but it won’t come up as much in a campaign that takes place entirely in a vast desert. The Psionics skill might come up a lot in a campaign where voiceless talkers are the main foes, and Magic might be more useful in a game where the heroes take on a circle of evil wizards. If you’re worried about whether a skill you’d like to take will be useful, discuss your skill list with the Director after you create a hero. And if a skill doesn’t work out, you can always trade it for another skill as you wish (see Changing Character Options in Chapter 2: Making a Hero).
heroes.skills.equal.rules.zh:
所有技能都同樣實用嗎？

替角色選擇技能時，技能的實用度很大程度取決於戰役內容。例如，在英雄經常探索水下遺跡的戰役中，游泳技能可能會不斷派上用場，但如果整場戰役都發生在廣闊沙漠裡，游泳就不會那麼常出現。若某場戰役的主要敵人是心語者，靈能技能可能會經常派上用場；若英雄要對抗一群邪惡巫師，魔法技能可能更實用。若你擔心自己想選的技能派不上用場，你可以在創角後與導演討論你的技能清單。若某項技能實際玩起來不合適，你也可以按照自己的意願換成其他技能（詳見第 2 章〈創造英雄〉的「Changing Character Options」）。

heroes.skills.exploration.rules.en:
Exploration Skills

Skills from the exploration skill group are used to physically explore the environment around the characters, and to overcome physical obstacles.

Rewards for tests made with exploration skills typically include helping another creature engaging in the same task succeed without needing to also make a test, automatically succeeding on a follow-up test while engaged in the same task, reaching a destination faster than anticipated, and learning about or avoiding an upcoming hazard.

Consequences for tests made with exploration skills include harming yourself, your gear, or your allies; becoming lost; or stumbling headlong into a hazard or a place you were trying to avoid.

Skill | Use
Climb | Move up vertical surfaces
Drive | Control vehicles
Endurance | Remain engaged in strenuous activity over a long period of time
Gymnastics | Move across unsteady or narrow surfaces; tumble
Heal | Use mundane first aid
Jump | Leap vertical and horizontal distances
Lift | Pick up, carry, and throw heavy objects
Navigate | Read a map and travel without becoming lost
Ride | Ride and control a nonsapient mount, such as a horse
Swim | Move through deep liquid
heroes.skills.exploration.rules.zh:
探索類技能

探索類技能主要用於幫助英雄探索周遭環境並克服各種實體障礙。

若考驗成功且獲得獎勵，你可能會協助其他生物在進行相同挑戰時自動成功；讓自己後續的相關考驗自動成功；比預期更快抵達目的地；或是得知並避開即將到來的危險。

若考驗失敗且遭遇波折，你可能會傷害自己、裝備或盟友；迷失方向；或是不慎闖入危險區域或原本想避開的地方。

技能｜用途
攀爬（Climb）｜在垂直表面上移動
駕駛（Drive）｜控制載具
耐力（Endurance）｜長時間進行高強度活動
體操（Gymnastics）｜在不穩定或狹窄表面上移動；翻滾
醫療（Heal）｜進行基本急救
跳躍（Jump）｜進行垂直與水平跳躍
舉重（Lift）｜舉起、搬運與投擲重物
導航（Navigate）｜讀懂地圖；在旅行中避免迷路
騎術（Ride）｜騎乘及控制非智慧坐騎，例如馬匹
游泳（Swim）｜在深水等液體中移動

heroes.skills.groups.rules.en:
Skill Groups

Skills are broken down into five skill groups: crafting, exploration, interpersonal, intrigue, and lore.
heroes.skills.groups.rules.zh:
技能類別

技能分為五個類別：工藝類、探索類、交涉類、諜報類、學識類。

heroes.skills.interpersonal.rules.en:
Interpersonal Skills

Skills from the interpersonal skill group are used to socially interact with other creatures, and are particularly useful during negotiations (see Chapter 11: Negotiation). Aside from the Handle Animals skill, you can generally only use interpersonal skills when you attempt to influence creatures who have emotions and who can understand you.

Rewards for tests made with interpersonal skills typically include gaining an extra favor, item, or piece of information from the people or creatures you interact with.

Consequences for tests made with interpersonal skills include making the creature you’re interacting with angry, sad, embarrassed, offended, or otherwise upset or uncomfortable. This might cause them to ignore you, storm off, spread rumors about you, attack you, betray you, blackmail you, or otherwise attempt to harm you.

Skill | Use
Brag | Impress others with stories of your deeds
Empathize | Relate to someone on a personal level
Flirt | Attract romantic attention from someone
Gamble | Make bets with others
Handle Animals | Interact with nonsapient animal wildlife
Interrogate | Obtain information from a creature withholding it
Intimidate | Awe or scare a creature
Lead | Inspire people to action
Lie | Convince someone that a falsehood is true
Music | Perform music vocally or with an instrument
Perform | Engage in dance, oratory, acting, or some other physical performance
Persuade | Convince someone to agree with you through use of your charms and grace
Read Person | Read the emotions and body language of other creatures
heroes.skills.interpersonal.rules.zh:
交涉類技能

交涉類技能主要用於對其他生物進行社交互動，在談判場合中特別有用（詳見第 11 章〈談判〉）。除了馴獸技能外，你通常只能對具有情緒且能理解你的生物使用交涉類技能。

若考驗成功且獲得獎勵，你可能會從互動對象那裡獲得人情、物品或情報。

若考驗失敗且遭遇波折，你可能會讓互動對象感到憤怒、悲傷、尷尬、被冒犯，或產生其他負面情緒。這些後果可能會導致對方忽視你、憤然離去、散播謠言、攻擊你、背叛你、勒索你，或是試圖以其他方式傷害你。

技能｜用途
誇耀（Brag）｜運用你的豐功偉業來打動他人
共感（Empathize）｜與他人在個人層面產生共感
魅惑（Flirt）｜吸引他人對你產生浪漫興趣
賭博（Gamble）｜與他人下注
馴獸（Handle Animals）｜與非智慧野生動物互動
審訊（Interrogate）｜從隱瞞情報的生物獲取資訊
威嚇（Intimidate）｜讓生物產生畏懼或敬畏
領導（Lead）｜鼓舞他人採取行動
欺瞞（Lie）｜讓他人相信虛假的事情
音樂（Music）｜使用歌聲或樂器進行演出
表演（Perform）｜展現舞蹈、演說、戲劇等表演藝術
遊說（Persuade）｜運用魅力與風度說服他人同意你的觀點
觀色（Read Person）｜理解其他生物的情緒與身體語言

heroes.skills.intrigue.rules.en:
Intrigue Skills

Skills from the intrigue skill group are used in tasks centered around investigation, thievery, and spycraft.

Rewards for tests made with skills from this group typically include helping another creature engaging in the same task succeed without needing to also make a test, automatically succeeding on a follow-up test while engaged in the same task, discovering helpful information in addition to what you set out to learn, and performing an extra bit of clandestine activity in addition to what you set out to do.

Consequences for tests made with intrigue skills include getting caught in the act or failing to notice a detail that places you in danger, such as triggering a trap or walking into an ambush.

Skill | Use
Alertness | Intuitively sense the details of your surroundings
Conceal Object | Hide an object on your person or in your environment
Disguise | Change your appearance to look like a different person
Eavesdrop | Actively listen to something that is hard to hear, such as a whispered conversation through a door
Escape Artist | Escape from bonds such as rope or manacles
Hide | Conceal yourself from others’ observation
Pick Lock | Open a lock without using the key
Pick Pocket | Steal an item that another person wears or carries without them noticing
Sabotage | Disable a mechanical device such as a trap
Search | Actively search an environment for important details and items
Sneak | Move silently
Track | Follow a trail that another creature has left behind
heroes.skills.intrigue.rules.zh:
諜報類技能

諜報類技能主要用於調查、竊盜與間諜活動。

若考驗成功且獲得獎勵，你可能會協助其他生物在進行相同挑戰時自動成功；讓自己後續的相關考驗自動成功；得知額外的有用資訊；或是在完成原定計畫時順便執行其他行動。

若考驗失敗且遭遇波折，你可能會當場被人抓個正著，或是忽略危險的細節而觸發陷阱或誤入埋伏。

技能｜用途
警覺（Alertness）｜本能地察覺周遭環境的細節
藏物（Conceal Object）｜將物品藏在身上或環境之中
易容（Disguise）｜改變外表來假扮他人
竊聽（Eavesdrop）｜仔細聆聽難以聽清的聲音，例如隔著門的低聲交談
脫逃（Escape Artist）｜掙脫繩索或手銬等束縛物
躲藏（Hide）｜讓自己不被他人察覺
開鎖（Pick Lock）｜不使用鑰匙來解開鎖具
扒竊（Pick Pocket）｜不引人注意地偷取他人的隨身物品
拆除（Sabotage）｜讓機械裝置無法運作，例如解除陷阱
搜索（Search）｜主動搜索環境中的重要細節與物品
潛行（Sneak）｜無聲地移動
追蹤（Track）｜跟隨其他生物留下的蹤跡

heroes.skills.justify.rules.en:
Justify the Skill

It’s not the Director’s job to know every task potentially covered by the skills in the game, or to know the specific skills your hero has. Instead, the Director asks you to make a test using a characteristic and you tell the Director if you think you have a skill that applies. If it’s not obvious why the skill applies, tell the Director how your hero is approaching the task and justify why that approach uses the skill. The Director then decides if you get the +2 bonus the skill represents. If the Director disagrees with you, that’s the final word.

Approaching problems creatively while remaining reasonable can help you get the most out of your skills. For example, if you’re making a Presence test to impress a noble at a party, using the Brag skill is an obvious choice. But what if you don’t have that skill? Maybe you could instead try to impress the noble with a brief but exciting lecture about the nature of the elements, making a Presence test using the Magic skill that you do have!

Sometimes you won’t have a skill that applies to a test. That’s okay! If your characteristic score is decent, you likely have a good chance of success without a skill.
heroes.skills.justify.rules.zh:
解釋技能

導演不需要記住所有技能可以用在哪些情況，也不必知道英雄擁有什麼技能。當導演要求你進行考驗時，你需要主動告知你的英雄是否有適用的技能。若技能的適用性不夠明顯，你需要向導演說明英雄會如何應對挑戰，並解釋為何這種方法會用到該技能。導演會根據你的說法來決定是否給予技能提供的 +2 加值。若導演不同意，則以導演的判定為準。

在合理範圍內發揮創意處理問題，可以讓你充分運用自己的技能。例如，若你想要在宴會上進行氣場考驗來打動貴族，使用誇耀技能是最明顯的選擇，但如果你沒有這項技能呢？你也可以改用簡短而精彩的元素本質演講來打動貴族，藉此運用你的魔法技能來進行氣場考驗！

有時候，你就是沒有技能可以用於某次考驗。沒關係！只要你的屬性值夠高，即使沒有相關技能，你仍然有不錯的成功率。

heroes.skills.lore.rules.en:
Lore Skills

Skills from the lore skill group are used to research and recall specific information. They are especially useful during rests and downtime.

Rewards for tests made with lore skills typically include learning an extra piece of useful information.

Consequences for tests made with lore skills typically include learning an incorrect piece of information that seems useful, but which actually works against your interests or wastes time. (It’s fun to roleplay these kinds of moments, so lean in!) Alternatively, the Director can make medium and hard tests with lore group skills for each hero in secret, then let the players know the narrative outcome without revealing the outcome of the power roll (see the Optional Rule: Secret Reactive Tests sidebar earlier in this chapter).

Skill | Use
Criminal Underworld | Knowing about criminal organizations, their crimes, their relationships, and their leaders
Culture | Knowing about a culture’s customs, folktales, and taboos
History | Knowing about significant past events
Magic | Knowing about magical places, spells, rituals, items, and phenomena
Monsters | Knowing monster ecology, strengths, and weaknesses
Nature | Knowing about natural flora, fauna, and weather
Psionics | Knowing about psionic places, spells, rituals, items, and phenomena
Religion | Knowing about religious mythology, practices, and rituals
Rumors | Knowing gossip, legends, and uncertain truths
Society | Knowing noble etiquette and the leadership and power dynamics of noble families
Strategy | Knowing about battle tactics and logistics
Timescape | Knowing about the many worlds of the timescape
heroes.skills.lore.rules.zh:
學識類技能

學識類技能主要用於研究和回想特定資訊，在休整時特別實用。

若考驗成功且獲得獎勵，你可能會得知額外的有用資訊。

若考驗失敗且遭遇波折，你可能會得知看似有用，但實際上反而危害你或浪費時間的錯誤資訊。（這類情境很適合角色扮演，所以盡量投入吧！）或者，導演也可以暗中為每個英雄進行中等或困難的學識類技能考驗，然後告知玩家敘事結果，但不透露檢定結果（詳見本章前文的選用規則「Secret Reactive Tests」側欄）。

技能｜用途
江湖（Criminal Underworld）｜了解犯罪組織的活動、結構、人際網路與首領
文化（Culture）｜了解一個文化的風俗民情、民間故事與禁忌
歷史（History）｜了解重大歷史事件
魔法（Magic）｜了解魔法地點、法術、儀式、道具與現象
怪物（Monsters）｜了解怪物的生態、強項與弱點
自然（Nature）｜了解自然界的動植物與氣候變化
靈能（Psionics）｜了解靈能地點、法術、儀式、道具與現象
宗教（Religion）｜了解宗教的神話、習俗與儀式
傳聞（Rumors）｜了解各種八卦、傳說與未經證實的傳言
社會（Society）｜了解貴族禮儀與其家族之間的權力結構
戰略（Strategy）｜了解戰術運用及後勤管理
時界（Timescape）｜了解時界中的眾多世界

heroes.skills.overview.rules.en:
Skills

Skills represent the different specializations a hero has outside of attacking, defending, and using their ancestry features, class features, and equipment. Whenever you make a test, having a particular skill associated with the test increases your chance of success.
heroes.skills.overview.rules.zh:
技能

技能是英雄除了攻擊、防禦、族裔特性、職業特性和裝備以外的各種專門技藝。每當你進行考驗時，若你擁有某項與該考驗相關的技能，就能提高考驗的成功機率。

heroes.skills.specific.rules.en:
Many Specific Skills

Draw Steel includes a big list of skills, and each is fairly specific. For example, instead of one Athletics skill that covers climbing, jumping, swimming, and lifting heavy objects, your character might use separate Climb, Jump, Lift, and Swim skills. Instead of a Thievery skill that covers picking locks, picking pockets, and disabling traps, the game has three skills: Pick Lock, Pick Pocket, and Sabotage.

Having a wide range of specific skills means you’ll frequently make tests that don’t use one of your character’s skills, simply applying a characteristic. By not having a few broader skills, it means that having a character who covers the spread of every skill is actually impossible. Luckily, the math of the game doesn’t require you to have a skill to have a decent chance of success on a test. That means heroes can attempt tasks without the help of a skill just because someone needs to do it, and that’s pretty darn heroic!

Since you don’t need to worry about your character covering a wide spread of skills, you’re free to choose the skills you think fit your hero best and are the most fun to work with. Maybe you’re thinking about an elementalist who has a gymnastic background in jumping and tumbling, and who also studied religion and blacksmithing. Having that kind of specific backstory is a big part of cinematic storytelling.

The rules for skills allow for them to be flexibly applied to any test that is appropriate for the skill. This encourages clever thinking. A player can ask the Director, “I want to impress the duke with a story about how I ascended the sheer Cliffs of Azgahnan. Can I use my Climb skill for a +2 bonus to my Presence test?” Getting creative like that is a lot of fun. It paints a visual picture, and it’s good tactical thinking! However, if the skills in a game are too broad in the kinds of activities they represent, players inevitably end up applying the same skill over and over again to as many tests as possible. This isn’t fun for anyone, and doesn’t make a very compelling story.
heroes.skills.specific.rules.zh:
大量專門技能

本遊戲包含大量的專門技能，每種技能都有特定的用途。例如，遊戲不會使用單個運動技能來涵蓋所有體能活動，而是將攀爬、跳躍、游泳和舉重設計成獨立技能。同理，遊戲也不採用統一的巧手技能，而是將開鎖、扒竊和拆除分成 3 個不同技能。

因為技能劃分得很細，你會經常單純使用屬性來進行考驗，而不一定會用到技能。由於遊戲採用細分的技能系統，而非少數的通用技能，這代表沒有角色可以掌握所有技能。但別擔心！遊戲的數值機制讓你即使沒有特定技能，也會有不錯的成功率。這代表英雄可以在必要時挺身而出，勇敢嘗試沒有相關技能的挑戰，這才是英雄該有的精神！

由於不必擔心讓英雄掌握所有技能，你可以自由選擇最適合且最有趣的技能來發展你的英雄。也許你想創造擁有體操背景、精通跳躍和翻滾的元素師，而這位角色還研究過宗教和鍛造技藝。這種獨特的背景設定，正是打造電影般精彩故事的關鍵要素。

技能規則允許你將技能靈活運用於任何適合的考驗，藉此鼓勵你發揮創意。玩家可以主動詢問導演：「我想講述自己攀上險峻的【Cliffs of Azgahnan】的故事來讓公爵留下深刻印象。我可以使用攀爬技能來讓氣場考驗獲得 +2 加值嗎？」這種富有創意的思考方式不僅有趣，還能描繪生動的畫面，同時展現精妙的戰術思維！然而，如果技能的涵蓋範圍過於廣泛，玩家就會傾向反覆將同個技能套用在各種考驗上，這不但讓遊戲失去樂趣，也無法創造出引人入勝的故事。
